bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Meropenem injection is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, including infections of the lungs, abdomen, urinary tract, skin and other body areas. It is used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It kills bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall, helping to stop the infection from spreading.

How to take/use it
Meropenem is given into a vein by a doctor or nurse, usually in a hospital or clinical setting. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function and other medical factors. Complete the prescribed course unless the doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, headache, rash, and pain or inflammation at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to meropenem, penicillins, cephalosporins or other antibiotics. Inform the doctor about kidney disease, seizures or brain-related conditions, and if taking sodium valproate or valproic acid. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, seizures, or severe or persistent diarrhoea.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to provide vitamins and minerals and help prevent or correct dietary deficiencies. It is not a substitute for a balanced diet.

How does it work?
The vitamins and minerals support normal body functions, including energy metabolism, immunity and maintenance of bones, blood and tissues. The Pinus roxburghii extract provides an additional plant-based ingredient, but its specific benefit depends on the formulation.

How to take/use it
Take the tablet with water and follow the dose stated on the product label or recommended by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
May cause nausea, stomach upset, constipation or diarrhoea. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of an allergic reaction occur.

Precautions
Avoid taking it with other multivitamin or mineral supplements unless advised by a healthcare professional. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is a medical condition or regular medicine use. Keep out of reach of children.

title: NBET Injection 1ml (40x50x1ml) Betamethasone 4 mg Inj by Abbott

searchText: NBET Injection 1ml (40x50x1ml) Betamethasone 4 mg Inj by Abbott Abbott 2040000904
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Betamethasone injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce severe inflammation and overactive immune reactions in conditions such as severe allergies, inflammatory disorders and some autoimmune conditions. Its exact use depends on the medical condition and the doctor's assessment.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and suppresses excessive immune activity.

How to take/use it
This injection must be given by a doctor or nurse. The route, dose and duration depend on the condition being treated and should be decided by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Injection-site pain or redness, indigestion, increased appetite, sleep problems, mood changes, and temporary increases in blood sugar or blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental health conditions, liver or kidney problems, or any current or recent infection. Corticosteroids can reduce the body's ability to fight infections and may mask infection symptoms. Do not stop repeated or prolonged treatment suddenly unless advised. Seek medical help for signs of infection, severe mood changes, breathing difficulty, or a serious allergic reaction.

What is it used for?
Fluconazole is an antifungal medicine used to treat fungal infections, including vaginal yeast infections, oral thrush and other susceptible fungal infections.

How does it work?
It blocks the production of an essential part of the fungal cell membrane, helping stop the fungus from growing.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth and swallow with water, with or without food, exactly as prescribed. Do not take extra doses or stop treatment early without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea and indigestion.

searchText: Pantagon 40MG 10TABS (120x20x10s) Pantoprazole 40 mg Gastro-Resistant Tab by Abbott Abbott 2040014637
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat acidity, heartburn and acid reflux, especially when these symptoms are associated with indigestion or slow movement of food through the stomach.

How does it work?
Pantoprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Levosulpiride helps improve movement of the upper digestive tract and supports stomach emptying.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed. Swallow the capsule whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Follow the prescribed timing in relation to meals, and do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, stomach discomfort, dizziness or drowsiness. Levosulpiride may also cause restlessness or changes related to the hormone prolactin, such as breast tenderness or menstrual changes.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, a history of seizures, gastrointestinal bleeding or blockage, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or any prolactin-related condition. Seek medical help for involuntary movements, severe or persistent diarrhoea, vomiting blood, black stools, or severe abdominal pain. Avoid driving if dizzy or drowsy.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pantoprazole 40 mg injection is used to reduce excess stomach acid in conditions such as acidity, heartburn, acid reflux and ulcers. It is usually given when treatment by mouth is not suitable, under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It blocks the stomach's acid-producing proton pumps, thereby reducing the amount of acid released into the stomach.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given as an injection into a vein by a doctor or nurse. It should not be self-administered. The dose and duration depend on the condition being treated and the medical advice provided.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, constipation, dizziness or pain at the injection site.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to pantoprazole or similar medicines, liver problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, rash, swelling of the face or difficulty breathing. Long-term treatment should be used only under medical supervision.

What is it used for?
Used to prevent and treat dehydration caused by diarrhoea, vomiting or excessive fluid loss. It replaces lost water and essential salts.

How does it work?
It contains water, salts and glucose, which help the body absorb fluids and restore the body's fluid and electrolyte balance.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Sip slowly and frequently, especially after loose motions or vomiting. Do not dilute unless instructed. Do not use if the solution appears spoiled or the pack is damaged.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach bloating or discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Seek medical help for severe dehydration, persistent vomiting or diarrhoea, blood in the stools, confusion, extreme weakness, or inability to drink. Use medical advice if there is kidney disease, heart failure or another condition requiring fluid or salt restriction. This solution does not treat the underlying cause of diarrhoea.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pantoprazole injection reduces excess stomach acid. It is used for acid-related conditions such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and peptic ulcers, especially when oral treatment is not suitable.

How does it work?
It blocks the stomach's acid-producing proton pumps, thereby reducing acid production and helping relieve acid-related symptoms and support healing.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given slowly into a vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and duration depend on the condition being treated and should be decided by a healthcare professional. It is generally used when pantoprazole cannot be taken by mouth.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, gas, and pain or irritation at the injection site.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about allergies to pantoprazole or other acid-reducing medicines, liver disease, and all other medicines being taken. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, rash or swelling, breathing difficulty, or signs of a serious allergic reaction. Prolonged treatment may require medical monitoring for low magnesium or vitamin B12 deficiency.

What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of cough, blocked nose, runny nose and sneezing associated with common cold or similar upper-respiratory symptoms.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan helps reduce the urge to cough. Phenylephrine reduces nasal swelling and congestion, while chlorpheniramine helps relieve runny nose and sneezing.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the package or by a doctor. Shake the bottle well and measure the syrup with the supplied measuring device. Do not take it with other cough, cold or allergy medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, headache, nervousness or trouble sleeping. Phenylephrine may cause a fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Avoid driving or operating machinery if drowsy or dizzy, and avoid alcohol and other medicines that cause sleepiness. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, difficulty passing urine or prostate problems. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines or within 14 days of stopping them. Ask a doctor before giving it to children, during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, severe palpitations, or a cough that persists or worsens.

Cefoperazone with sulbactam is an injectable antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, such as infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, skin and soft tissues, bones and joints, or blood. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Cefoperazone kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall. Sulbactam helps cefoperazone work against bacteria that can otherwise resist certain antibiotics.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or nurse. The dose and duration depend on the type and severity of infection and should be decided by the prescriber. Complete the prescribed course unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, skin rash, and pain or redness at the injection site may occur. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, breathing difficulty, facial swelling, or a widespread rash.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to penicillins, cephalosporins, or other antibiotics. Inform the doctor if there is liver disease, kidney disease, a bleeding or clotting problem, or a history of severe antibiotic-related diarrhoea. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for a period advised by the doctor after the last dose. Use only under medical supervision.

title: Sodium Chloride I.V. (100x100ml) Sodium Chloride 0.900 g Inj by Abbott
name: Sodium Chloride I.V. (100x100ml) Sodium Chloride 0.900 g Inj by Abbott
searchText: Sodium Chloride I.V. (100x100ml) Sodium Chloride 0.900 g Inj by Abbott Abbott 2040003754
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sodium chloride 0.9% injection is a sterile salt-water solution used in hospitals to replace lost fluids and sodium and chloride, such as during dehydration or low blood volume. It may also be used by healthcare professionals as a diluent or to flush intravenous lines, depending on the product and clinical need.

How does it work?
It adds water and sodium chloride to the bloodstream, helping restore fluid and electrolyte balance.

How to take/use it
This injection is given into a vein or used for other medical purposes only by a healthcare professional. The amount and rate depend on the patient’s condition and must be decided by the treating clinician.

Common side effects
Fluid retention, swelling, increased blood sodium or chloride levels, and irritation or pain at the injection site may occur. Excessive amounts can cause fluid overload.

Precautions
Use carefully in people with heart failure, kidney problems, high blood pressure, swelling, or conditions causing high sodium levels. Medical monitoring may be needed during treatment. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, severe swelling, confusion, or worsening symptoms.

title: Superquin 500mg Tab (50x20x5's) Levofloxacin 500 mg Tab by Abbott
name: Superquin 500mg Tab (50x20x5's) Levofloxacin 500 mg Tab by Abbott
searchText: Superquin 500mg Tab (50x20x5's) Levofloxacin 500 mg Tab by Abbott Abbott 2040006341
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levocloperastine is a cough suppressant used to relieve dry, irritating cough.

How does it work?
It reduces the activity of the cough reflex, helping to decrease the urge to cough.

How to take/use it
Take the suspension exactly as directed on the label or by a doctor. Shake the bottle well before use and measure each dose with the supplied measuring device. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea or stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
It may cause drowsiness; avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery. Seek medical advice for a cough with heavy phlegm, breathing difficulty, chest pain, blood, or fever, or if the cough persists. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in children.

title: Superquin I.V (100x100ml) Levofloxacin 500 mg, Dextrose Anhydrous 5.0% w/v IV Infusion by Abbott
name: Superquin I.V (100x100ml) Levofloxacin 500 mg, Dextrose Anhydrous 5.0% w/v IV Infusion by Abbott
searchText: Superquin I.V (100x100ml) Levofloxacin 500 mg, Dextrose Anhydrous 5.0% w/v IV Infusion by Abbott Abbott 2040006340
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levofloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some infections of the lungs, urinary tract, sinuses and skin. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking enzymes they need to copy and repair their DNA.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water, with or without food. Keep antacids and supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc at least 2 hours before or after this medicine, unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and difficulty sleeping.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, tendon problems, nerve problems, heart rhythm problems, myasthenia gravis, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and any allergy to quinolone antibiotics. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, severe mood or nerve symptoms, a serious allergic reaction, or fast or irregular heartbeat. Avoid unnecessary sun exposure and driving if dizzy or less alert.

title: Supractiv Capsules 15's New (24x10x15's) Omega-3 Fatty Acids, Multivitamins, Multiminerals, Amino Acids Cap by Abbott
name: Supractiv Capsules 15's New (24x10x15's) Omega-3 Fatty Acids, Multivitamins, Multiminerals, Amino Acids Cap by Abbott
searchText: Supractiv Capsules 15's New (24x10x15's) Omega-3 Fatty Acids, Multivitamins, Multiminerals, Amino Acids Cap by Abbott Abbott 2040000421
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections that may cause diarrhoea, loose motions or dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin stops the growth of susceptible bacteria. Metronidazole acts against certain anaerobic bacteria and parasites by damaging their genetic material.

How to take/use it
Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with the supplied measuring device. Take it only in the dose and for the duration prescribed by the doctor, and complete the course unless advised otherwise. Do not self-medicate for diarrhoea.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, metallic taste and temporary changes in bowel movements may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 3 days after the last dose. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver disease, a history of seizures or nerve problems, tendon problems, or allergy to quinolone antibiotics or metronidazole. Seek medical help for severe rash, breathing difficulty, numbness or tingling, tendon pain or swelling, palpitations, or worsening or bloody diarrhoea.

title: Vicogra Force (48x20x1x4) Sildenafil 50 mg, Dapoxetine 30 mg by Abbott
name: Vicogra Force (48x20x1x4) Sildenafil 50 mg, Dapoxetine 30 mg by Abbott
searchText: Vicogra Force (48x20x1x4) Sildenafil 50 mg, Dapoxetine 30 mg by Abbott Abbott 2040013037
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used in adult men to treat erectile dysfunction, which is difficulty getting or keeping an erection, and premature ejaculation. It helps improve erection and may delay ejaculation.

How does it work?
Sildenafil increases blood flow to the penis during sexual stimulation, helping achieve an erection. Dapoxetine affects serotonin activity in the nervous system and helps delay ejaculation.

How to take/use it
Take this medicine by mouth exactly as prescribed. Do not take more than directed or combine it with other medicines for erectile dysfunction. Sexual stimulation is needed for sildenafil to work. Avoid drinking large amounts of alcohol while using it.

Common side effects
Headache, dizziness, flushing, indigestion, nausea, diarrhoea, blocked nose and visual changes may occur.

Precautions
Do not use with nitrate medicines for chest pain or riociguat, as this can cause a dangerous fall in blood pressure. Tell the doctor about heart disease, low blood pressure, fainting, liver or kidney problems, or use of antidepressants, tramadol, certain migraine medicines or medicines for high blood pressure. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, fainting, a sudden change or loss of vision or hearing, an erection lasting more than 4 hours, or severe agitation, fever or muscle stiffness.

title: VitaFriend D3 Tablets (4 Tabs) Cholecalciferol 60,000 IU Tab by Abbott
name: VitaFriend D3 Tablets (4 Tabs) Cholecalciferol 60,000 IU Tab by Abbott
searchText: VitaFriend D3 Tablets (4 Tabs) Cholecalciferol 60,000 IU Tab by Abbott Abbott 2040011478
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent and treat vitamin D deficiency. It helps the body absorb calcium and supports healthy bones and muscles.

How does it work?
Cholecalciferol is vitamin D3. It is converted into an active form in the body, which improves calcium and phosphate absorption and helps maintain bone strength.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist, as 60,000 IU is a high-strength dose. Swallow the tablet with water; taking it with a meal may help absorption. Do not take extra vitamin D or calcium supplements unless advised.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated when used as directed. Excessive intake may cause nausea, vomiting, constipation, stomach pain, weakness, increased thirst or frequent urination.

Precautions
Inform the doctor if there is kidney disease, kidney stones, high calcium levels, or a condition such as sarcoidosis. Avoid prolonged or repeated high-dose use without medical advice. Seek medical help if severe nausea, vomiting, confusion, unusual weakness, or excessive thirst or urination occurs.

name: Zimnic 200 Tablets (56x12x10's) Cefixime 200 mg Tab by Abbott
searchText: Zimnic 200 Tablets (56x12x10's) Cefixime 200 mg Tab by Abbott Abbott 2040001037
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cefixime is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the throat, ears, lungs, urinary tract and other areas when prescribed by a doctor. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by stopping them from forming their protective cell wall, which helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take this medicine exactly as prescribed. It may be taken with or without food. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve, unless a doctor tells otherwise. Do not share antibiotics with others or use leftover medicine.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, indigestion and headache may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to cefixime, cephalosporins or penicillin-type antibiotics, or if there is kidney disease. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, or severe or persistent diarrhoea, especially with blood or mucus. Use only when prescribed for a bacterial infection.

title: Zithrolect100- Suspension (200x15ml) Azithromycin 100 mg Susp by Abbott
name: Zithrolect100- Suspension (200x15ml) Azithromycin 100 mg Susp by Abbott
searchText: Zithrolect100- Suspension (200x15ml) Azithromycin 100 mg Susp by Abbott Abbott 2040005715
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Azithromycin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the throat, ears, chest, skin and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which prevents them from growing and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Shake the suspension well before each dose and measure it with a proper measuring device. Follow the prescribed schedule and complete the course unless advised otherwise. Do not use leftover antibiotics or share them with others.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain and headache may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to azithromycin or other macrolide antibiotics, liver problems, or a history of abnormal heart rhythm or QT prolongation. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, yellowing of the skin or eyes, a fast or irregular heartbeat, or signs of a serious allergic reaction such as swelling or breathing difficulty.

searchText: Zithrolect 250 Tablets 6s (50x20x6s) Azithromycin 250 mg Tab by Abbott Abbott 2040005717
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Azithromycin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some infections of the throat, ears, chest, skin and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as common colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, with or without food, and complete the prescribed course even if symptoms improve. Do not share leftover antibiotics or use them without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain, vomiting and headache.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to azithromycin or other macrolide antibiotics. Tell the doctor about liver disease, heart rhythm problems, or medicines that may affect heart rhythm. Seek urgent medical help for severe allergic symptoms, fainting, fast or irregular heartbeat, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or severe or persistent diarrhoea.

Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain, vomiting and headache.

title: Ab Mal Injection 150 Mg/2Ml (2Ml) Alpha-Beta Arteether 150 Mg By Alkem
name: Ab Mal Injection 150 Mg/2Ml (2Ml) Alpha-Beta Arteether 150 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Ab Mal Injection 150 Mg/2Ml (2Ml) Alpha-Beta Arteether 150 Mg By Alkem Alkem AICE01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Alpha-Beta Arteether is an injectable antimalarial used to treat malaria, especially severe or complicated malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum. Severe malaria requires urgent hospital treatment.

How does it work?
It is an artemisinin-based medicine that damages the malaria parasite and helps clear it from the blood.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given as an injection by a doctor or trained healthcare professional, usually in a hospital or clinic. The dose and treatment schedule depend on the severity of malaria and must be decided by the doctor. Do not self-inject.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, weakness, fever, and pain or reactions at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to artemisinin medicines, liver or kidney disease, heart rhythm problems, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Seek urgent medical care for fainting, severe weakness, breathing difficulty, worsening fever, or yellowing of the skin or eyes. Complete the treatment and attend follow-up as advised.

title: Aceday-Sp Tablets (10'S) (10'S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg + Serratiopeptidase 10 Mg By Alkem
name: Aceday-Sp Tablets (10'S) (10'S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg + Serratiopeptidase 10 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Aceday-Sp Tablets (10'S) (10'S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg + Serratiopeptidase 10 Mg By Alkem Alkem ATMK11
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of pain, swelling and inflammation affecting the muscles and joints, including painful joint conditions.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps relieve pain, while serratiopeptidase may help reduce swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by a doctor. Take it with or after food and swallow it with water. Do not take more than the prescribed amount, use it for longer than advised, or combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol or NSAIDs unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness, headache and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or a bleeding disorder. Avoid alcohol and use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, only on medical advice. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin reactions, breathing difficulty or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Alcoxib 120 (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 120 Mg By Alkem
name: Alcoxib 120 (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 120 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alcoxib 120 (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 120 Mg By Alkem Alkem ATQC11
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Etoricoxib is used to reduce pain, swelling and inflammation in conditions such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis and acute gout. The specific condition and treatment duration should be decided by a doctor.

How does it work?
It selectively blocks COX-2 enzymes involved in producing prostaglandins, substances that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably at the same time each day. It may be taken with or without food. Do not take more than prescribed or combine it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen, diclofenac or naproxen unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, headache, dizziness, swelling of the feet or legs and increased blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor before use if there is a history of heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney disease, liver disease or allergy to painkillers. It may increase the risk of heart attack, stroke, fluid retention and stomach bleeding, especially with long-term or high-dose use. Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically prescribed. Seek medical help for chest pain, breathing difficulty, black stools, severe skin reactions or swelling of the face or throat.

title: Alcoxib 90 (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 90 Mg By Alkem
name: Alcoxib 90 (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 90 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alcoxib 90 (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 90 Mg By Alkem Alkem ATQC01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Etoricoxib is used to relieve pain and swelling caused by osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It may also be prescribed for acute gout or short-term dental pain.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and inflammation. It belongs to a group of medicines called selective COX-2 anti-inflammatory medicines.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth with water, exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet whole and do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. It may be taken with or without food.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, headache, dizziness, swelling of the feet or legs and increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about high blood pressure, heart disease, previous heart attack or stroke, stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, or an allergy to aspirin or other anti-inflammatory medicines. Avoid taking it with other anti-inflammatory painkillers unless advised. It may increase the risk of heart problems, especially with higher doses or long-term use. Seek medical help for chest pain, breathing difficulty, black stools, severe skin reactions or swelling of the face or throat. It should generally be avoided during pregnancy, especially after 20 weeks, unless specifically prescribed.

title: Alcoxib-Mr (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 60 Mg + Thiocolchicoside 4 Mg By Alkem
name: Alcoxib-Mr (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 60 Mg + Thiocolchicoside 4 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alcoxib-Mr (10'S) (10'S) Etoricoxib 60 Mg + Thiocolchicoside 4 Mg By Alkem Alkem ATQC21
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve painful muscle spasms and the associated pain in musculoskeletal conditions, such as painful back or neck problems. It is generally used for short-term treatment when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Etoricoxib reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Thiocolchicoside helps relax tight or spasming muscles.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the doctor. Do not take more often or for longer than advised. It may cause dizziness or sleepiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery if affected. Do not take it with other painkillers or anti-inflammatory medicines unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and sleepiness may occur. Seek medical help for severe stomach pain, black stools, swelling, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about a history of stomach ulcers or bleeding, heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure, kidney or liver problems, asthma triggered by painkillers, or seizures. Avoid use during pregnancy, especially late pregnancy, and while breastfeeding unless specifically advised. Women who could become pregnant should follow the prescriber’s advice about effective contraception. Avoid alcohol and seek advice before using this medicine with other medicines.

title: Alcoxib P Tablets (10'S) (10S) Etoricoxib 60 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg By Alkem

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve pain and inflammation, especially in joint and muscle conditions such as arthritis. It may also be prescribed for other short-term painful conditions when considered suitable by a doctor.

How does it work?
Etoricoxib reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, with or without food. Do not take more than the prescribed amount, and avoid other medicines containing paracetamol unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach discomfort, nausea, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, swelling of the feet or legs, and increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney disease, liver disease, or allergy to painkillers or NSAIDs. Avoid taking it with other etoricoxib-containing medicines or NSAIDs unless prescribed. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially later pregnancy. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe skin reactions, or black stools.

title: Aldigesic 100 Tab (10S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg By Alkem

searchText: Aldigesic 100 Tab (10S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg By Alkem Alkem DT00000002
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Aceclofenac 100 mg is used to relieve pain, swelling and stiffness caused by joint and muscle conditions such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis.

How does it work?
It is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine (NSAID). It reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with or after food, and swallow it with water. Do not take more than recommended or combine it with other NSAID painkillers unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness, headache and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid or use only under medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to NSAIDs. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty or facial swelling. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially blood thinners, steroids and other painkillers. It should generally be avoided during the last 3 months of pregnancy and used in pregnancy only on medical advice.

title: Aldigesic P (Box Packing) Tablets (15'S) (15'S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg By Alkem

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Aceclofenac 100 mg + Paracetamol 325 mg is used to relieve pain, swelling and inflammation, especially in muscle, joint and arthritis-related conditions. It may also help reduce fever.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps relieve pain and reduce fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed, preferably with or after food and with water. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or additional painkillers such as ibuprofen or diclofenac unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness and headache.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, severe liver or kidney disease, or allergy to painkillers, unless specifically advised by a doctor. Tell the doctor about heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma or regular alcohol use. Avoid alcohol and do not exceed the prescribed dose. It should generally be avoided during pregnancy, especially in the last three months, unless prescribed. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin reactions, breathing difficulty or yellowing of the eyes or skin.

title: Aldigesic Tc Tablets (10'S) (10'S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg + Trypsin Chymotrypsin 50000 Au By Alkem

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of pain, swelling and inflammation, especially in muscle, joint, bone and soft-tissue conditions.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac and paracetamol help reduce pain and inflammation through different actions. Trypsin and chymotrypsin are enzymes used to help reduce inflammatory swelling.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. It is generally taken with or after food to reduce stomach irritation. Do not take more than the recommended dose, and do not combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol or painkillers such as ibuprofen unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness and skin rash may occur. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for signs of stomach bleeding, severe allergy or breathing difficulty.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, bleeding disorders, or allergies to painkillers. Use caution with blood thinners and avoid excessive alcohol. It should generally be avoided during the last three months of pregnancy unless specifically prescribed. Do not use it with other paracetamol-containing medicines without medical advice.

title: Aldigesic Th Plus Tablets (10'S) (10'S) Aceclofenac 100 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg + Thiocolchicoside 4 Mg By Alkem

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of painful muscle spasms and other painful musculoskeletal conditions, such as back, neck, joint or soft-tissue pain, when inflammation and muscle tightness are present.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac reduces pain and inflammation, while paracetamol provides additional pain relief. Thiocolchicoside helps relax tightened muscles and reduce muscle spasm.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor, preferably with or after food. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not take additional paracetamol-containing medicines or other painkillers such as ibuprofen or diclofenac unless advised by a doctor. Use for the shortest duration prescribed.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, dizziness, drowsiness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if allergic to any ingredient or if it has previously caused asthma, wheezing or an allergic reaction. Tell the doctor about stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma, or a history of seizures. Thiocolchicoside should not be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless specifically advised; effective contraception may be required during treatment. Avoid alcohol and driving if dizzy or drowsy. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin rash, breathing difficulty or facial swelling.

title: Alkasulf Sprinkling Powder (10Gm) (10Gm) Neomycin + Bacitracin + Sulphacetamide By Alkem
name: Alkasulf Sprinkling Powder (10Gm) (10Gm) Neomycin + Bacitracin + Sulphacetamide By Alkem
searchText: Alkasulf Sprinkling Powder (10Gm) (10Gm) Neomycin + Bacitracin + Sulphacetamide By Alkem Alkem AHPH01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This is a topical antibacterial combination generally used to treat bacterial infections of the eye, when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Neomycin, bacitracin and sulphacetamide act against susceptible bacteria, helping stop their growth or kill them.

How to take/use it
Use only in the form and amount directed by the doctor or product label. Wash hands before and after use. If it is an eye preparation, do not touch the dropper or tube tip to the eye or other surfaces. Complete the prescribed course unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, irritation, redness or itching at the application site. Allergic reactions such as swelling or rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any of its ingredients or if a previous antibiotic caused a serious reaction. Use only for the prescribed infection; it does not treat viral or fungal infections. Seek medical advice for worsening symptoms, eye pain, vision changes, marked swelling or lack of improvement. Avoid wearing contact lenses during an eye infection unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Alkemcefu 250 Tablets (10S) Cefuroxime 250 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemcefu 250 Tablets (10S) Cefuroxime 250 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemcefu 250 Tablets (10S) Cefuroxime 250 Mg By Alkem Alkem DT00000354
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cefuroxime is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the throat, ears, sinuses, lungs, urinary tract and skin. It does not work for viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from forming the protective cell wall they need to survive.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. Do not skip doses or use leftover antibiotics. Swallow with water and follow the instructions on the prescription or product label.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and headache. Mild skin rash may also occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to cefuroxime, cephalosporin antibiotics or certain penicillin-type antibiotics. Tell the prescriber about kidney problems or previous antibiotic-related diarrhoea. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Alkemcefu 500 Tablets (10S) Cefuroxime 500 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemcefu 500 Tablets (10S) Cefuroxime 500 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemcefu 500 Tablets (10S) Cefuroxime 500 Mg By Alkem Alkem DT00000355
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cefuroxime is an antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections, including certain infections of the throat, ears, sinuses, chest, urinary tract and skin. It does not treat viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from forming their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Follow the prescribed dose and treatment duration, and complete the course even if symptoms improve. Do not share leftover antibiotics or use them for colds and flu.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort and headache. Mild skin rash may also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to cefuroxime, penicillin or other cephalosporin antibiotics. Inform the doctor if there is kidney disease or a previous severe reaction to antibiotics. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, a severe rash, or severe or persistent diarrhoea. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Alkemcefu-Cv 500 Tab 10S (10S) Cefuroxime 500 Mg + Clavulanic Acid 125 Mg By Alkem

searchText: Alkemcefu-Cv 500 Tab 10S (10S) Cefuroxime 500 Mg + Clavulanic Acid 125 Mg By Alkem Alkem DT00000508
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This is a prescription antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections. It does not work for viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Cefuroxime stops bacteria from building their protective cell wall. Clavulanic acid helps protect cefuroxime from enzymes made by some resistant bacteria, allowing it to work more effectively.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not share it with others or use leftover medicine. If a dose is missed, follow the instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to cefuroxime, other cephalosporin antibiotics, penicillins, or related antibiotics. Seek medical advice for swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty, or a severe rash. Contact a doctor if severe or persistent diarrhoea develops, as this can occur during or after antibiotic treatment. Tell the doctor about kidney problems, previous antibiotic-related diarrhoea, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or other medicines being taken.

Precautions

title: Alkem Cold Active Tab (10S) Paracetamol 500 Mg + Phenylephrine Hydrochloride 5 Mg + Diphenhydramine Hydrochloride 25 Mg + Caffeine 30 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkem Cold Active Tab (10S) Paracetamol 500 Mg + Phenylephrine Hydrochloride 5 Mg + Diphenhydramine Hydrochloride 25 Mg + Caffeine 30 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkem Cold Active Tab (10S) Paracetamol 500 Mg + Phenylephrine Hydrochloride 5 Mg + Diphenhydramine Hydrochloride 25 Mg + Caffeine 30 Mg By Alkem Alkem DT00000503
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold and flu symptoms such as fever, headache, body aches, blocked or stuffy nose, runny nose and sneezing.

How does it work?
Paracetamol reduces fever and pain. Phenylephrine helps reduce nasal congestion, while diphenhydramine reduces runny nose and sneezing; caffeine may support pain relief and reduce tiredness.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than recommended or use it with other medicines containing paracetamol, diphenhydramine or a decongestant.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, nervousness, difficulty sleeping, palpitations or increased blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving, operating machinery and alcohol. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, overactive thyroid, difficulty urinating or regular heavy alcohol use. Check with a doctor or pharmacist during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or before use in children. Avoid use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines unless advised by a doctor.

title: Alkem Cold Ds Drops (15Ml) (15 Ml) Phenylephrine Hydrochloride 5 Mg + Chlorpheniramine Maleate 2 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkem Cold Ds Drops (15Ml) (15 Ml) Phenylephrine Hydrochloride 5 Mg + Chlorpheniramine Maleate 2 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkem Cold Ds Drops (15Ml) (15 Ml) Phenylephrine Hydrochloride 5 Mg + Chlorpheniramine Maleate 2 Mg By Alkem Alkem AOGG02
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold or allergy-related symptoms such as blocked or stuffy nose, runny nose and sneezing.

How does it work?
Phenylephrine reduces swelling in the nasal passages, helping relieve congestion. Chlorpheniramine blocks histamine, which helps reduce sneezing and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid combining it with other cold or allergy medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and headache may occur. Phenylephrine may sometimes cause a fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
This medicine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, diabetes, difficulty urinating or prostate problems. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) medicines, or within 14 days of stopping them, unless advised by a doctor. Consult a doctor before giving it to children, during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

title: Alkemcort (1Ml) Vial (1Ml Amp) Triamcinolone Acetonide 40 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemcort (1Ml) Vial (1Ml Amp) Triamcinolone Acetonide 40 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemcort (1Ml) Vial (1Ml Amp) Triamcinolone Acetonide 40 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIPE01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Triamcinolone acetonide is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and allergic reactions in conditions prescribed by a doctor. The exact use depends on the formulation and the condition being treated.

How does it work?
It reduces the activity of substances in the body that cause inflammation, swelling, redness and allergic symptoms.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed. The dose, treatment duration and route depend on the condition and formulation. Products containing 40 mg are often given as an injection by a healthcare professional and should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Pain or discomfort at the injection site, facial flushing, increased blood sugar, indigestion, mood or sleep changes, and fluid retention may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, glaucoma, liver or kidney problems, or any infection. Corticosteroids can weaken immunity and may mask signs of infection. Do not receive live vaccines or stop repeated treatment suddenly without medical advice. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only when specifically advised.

title: Alkemcort-H (7.5Ml) (7.5 Ml Vial) Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate 100 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemcort-H (7.5Ml) (7.5 Ml Vial) Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate 100 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemcort-H (7.5Ml) (7.5 Ml Vial) Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate 100 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIPE11
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Hydrocortisone sodium succinate injection is used under medical supervision to quickly reduce severe inflammation or allergic reactions. It may also be used to replace cortisol in people whose adrenal glands do not produce enough of this hormone. It is commonly given in hospital or emergency settings.

How does it work?
It is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation and overactivity of the immune system. It also provides a form of cortisol needed for important body functions.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a doctor or nurse as an injection into a vein or muscle. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the medical condition and response to treatment.

Common side effects
Increased blood sugar or blood pressure, fluid retention, stomach upset, headache, dizziness, mood changes and difficulty sleeping may occur. Pain or irritation at the injection site is also possible.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental health conditions, liver or kidney problems, or any infection. Corticosteroids can reduce the body's ability to fight infections and may hide infection symptoms. Do not stop prolonged treatment suddenly unless advised by a doctor. Medical advice is needed before receiving live vaccines while using this medicine.

title: Alkem Dexa (20Ml) (20 Ml Vial) Dexamethasone 4 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkem Dexa (20Ml) (20 Ml Vial) Dexamethasone 4 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkem Dexa (20Ml) (20 Ml Vial) Dexamethasone 4 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIPL02
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and overactivity of the immune system. Doctors may prescribe it for severe allergies, inflammatory or autoimmune conditions, swelling, and certain other medical conditions.

How does it work?
It acts like natural steroid hormones made by the body. It reduces inflammation and suppresses excessive immune reactions.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with food if it causes stomach upset. Do not change the dose or stop it suddenly, especially if it has been used for several days or longer, unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, increased appetite, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, fluid retention, increased blood sugar, and increased risk of infections may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, glaucoma, mental health problems, or any infection. Avoid close contact with people who have infections and check before receiving vaccines. Long-term treatment requires medical monitoring. Seek medical advice for signs of infection, severe mood changes, vision problems, or severe stomach pain.

title: Alkem Dexa Injection (2Ml) Vial (2Ml Vial) Dexamethasone 4 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkem Dexa Injection (2Ml) Vial (2Ml Vial) Dexamethasone 4 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkem Dexa Injection (2Ml) Vial (2Ml Vial) Dexamethasone 4 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIPL04
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and suppress an overactive immune response. It may be prescribed for certain allergic, inflammatory, autoimmune and other serious medical conditions, only under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and limits excessive immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not change the dose or stop treatment suddenly, especially after prolonged use. If it is taken by mouth, taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset.

Common side effects
Indigestion, increased appetite, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, increased blood sugar, fluid retention and weight gain. Longer use may cause skin thinning and increased risk of infections.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision. Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental health problems, glaucoma or any current infection. Dexamethasone can mask signs of infection and may worsen some infections. Avoid live vaccines unless approved by the doctor. Seek medical advice before stopping it after regular or prolonged use.

title: Alkemfero Er 300 Tablet (6'S) Faropenem 300 Mg Extended Release By Alkem
name: Alkemfero Er 300 Tablet (6'S) Faropenem 300 Mg Extended Release By Alkem
searchText: Alkemfero Er 300 Tablet (6'S) Faropenem 300 Mg Extended Release By Alkem Alkem DT00000701
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Faropenem is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some infections of the respiratory tract, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow the extended-release tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not share leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it without medical advice if there has been an allergy to faropenem, penicillins, cephalosporins or other beta-lactam antibiotics. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash or severe/persistent diarrhoea. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being taken.

title: Alkemflam Tablets (20'S) (20S) Ibuprofen 400 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemflam Tablets (20'S) (20S) Ibuprofen 400 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemflam Tablets (20'S) (20S) Ibuprofen 400 Mg + Paracetamol 325 Mg By Alkem Alkem ATRV01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for the short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and fever, including body aches, headache, toothache, muscle pain and period pain.

How does it work?
Ibuprofen reduces pain, inflammation and fever. Paracetamol reduces pain and fever through a different mechanism, providing combined relief.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow with water; taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol, ibuprofen or other NSAIDs.

Common side effects
Indigestion, nausea, stomach pain, vomiting, dizziness and headache may occur.

Precautions
Avoid use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, severe kidney or liver disease, or an allergy to ibuprofen, paracetamol, aspirin or other NSAIDs. Seek medical advice before use with blood thinners or other regular medicines, or if there is asthma, heart disease or high blood pressure. Avoid excessive alcohol. Do not use ibuprofen during the last 3 months of pregnancy unless specifically advised by a doctor. Stop and seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin reactions or breathing difficulty.

title: Alkem Genta (20Ml) (20 Ml Vial) Gentamicin 40 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkem Genta (20Ml) (20 Ml Vial) Gentamicin 40 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkem Genta (20Ml) (20 Ml Vial) Gentamicin 40 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIPM02
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Gentamicin is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, especially infections caused by certain gram-negative bacteria. It is generally used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which prevents them from growing and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed. The dose, frequency, duration and route depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function, and the product formulation. If supplied as an injection, it is usually administered by a healthcare professional. Complete the prescribed course unless the doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, pain or irritation at the injection site, and skin rash may occur. More serious effects can include reduced urine output, hearing changes, ringing in the ears, dizziness or balance problems.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, pregnancy, or neuromuscular disorders. Kidney function and, when needed, blood levels, hearing and balance may require monitoring. Use caution with other medicines that can affect the kidneys, hearing or nervous system. Seek medical advice promptly for reduced urination, swelling, unusual weakness, ringing in the ears, hearing loss or severe dizziness.

title: Alkem Metro Iv Infusion (100Ml) (100Ml) Metronidazole 100 Mg + Sodium Chloride 900 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkem Metro Iv Infusion (100Ml) (100Ml) Metronidazole 100 Mg + Sodium Chloride 900 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkem Metro Iv Infusion (100Ml) (100Ml) Metronidazole 100 Mg + Sodium Chloride 900 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIQT01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Metronidazole infusion is used to treat serious infections caused by anaerobic bacteria and certain protozoa. It may be used when treatment through a vein is needed, as decided by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Metronidazole enters susceptible bacteria and protozoa and damages their genetic material, stopping them from surviving and multiplying.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given slowly into a vein by a healthcare professional. The dose, infusion rate and treatment duration depend on the infection and clinical condition. It must not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, metallic taste and irritation at the infusion site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to metronidazole or similar medicines, liver disease, or a history of nerve problems or seizures. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Tell the doctor about all medicines being used, especially warfarin. Report numbness, tingling, severe rash, confusion or seizures promptly.

title: Alkemnim Tablets (15'S) (15S) Nimesulide 100 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemnim Tablets (15'S) (15S) Nimesulide 100 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemnim Tablets (15'S) (15S) Nimesulide 100 Mg By Alkem Alkem ATRN01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Nimesulide is used for short-term relief of pain, swelling and inflammation, such as muscle or joint pain, toothache, period pain and other acute painful conditions. It may also help reduce fever when prescribed.

How does it work?
It is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine (NSAID). It reduces the production of substances in the body that cause pain, swelling and fever.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed, preferably with or after food. Use the lowest effective amount for the shortest period advised. Do not take more than recommended or combine it with other painkillers without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain or indigestion, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it without medical advice if there is liver disease, a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, severe kidney or heart problems, or an allergy to NSAIDs. Avoid alcohol and other medicines that may affect the liver. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding; it should not be used in the last three months of pregnancy. Stop it and seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe abdominal pain, unusual bleeding, breathing difficulty or a serious skin reaction.

title: Alkem'S Cod Liver Oil Soft Gel Caps (100 N) Cod Liver Oil Soft Gel Caps By Alkem
name: Alkem'S Cod Liver Oil Soft Gel Caps (100 N) Cod Liver Oil Soft Gel Caps By Alkem
searchText: Alkem'S Cod Liver Oil Soft Gel Caps (100 N) Cod Liver Oil Soft Gel Caps By Alkem Alkem DC00000130
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cod liver oil is used as a dietary supplement to provide omega-3 fatty acids and vitamins A and D. It may help meet nutritional requirements when dietary intake is insufficient.

How does it work?
It supplies omega-3 fatty acids and fat-soluble vitamins that the body needs for normal health and body functions.

How to take/use it
Take the softgel capsules exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow with water, preferably with food. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Fishy aftertaste or burping, nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort, or heartburn may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to fish or seafood. Avoid taking more than the recommended amount, as excess vitamins A and D can be harmful. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, if taking blood-thinning medicines, or if there is a bleeding disorder or liver disease. Tell a healthcare professional about other vitamin A or D supplements being taken.

title: Alkemsert Cream (10G) (10Gm) Sertaconazole Nitrate 2% W/W By Alkem
name: Alkemsert Cream (10G) (10Gm) Sertaconazole Nitrate 2% W/W By Alkem
searchText: Alkemsert Cream (10G) (10Gm) Sertaconazole Nitrate 2% W/W By Alkem Alkem ASRL01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sertaconazole 2% is a topical antifungal used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, jock itch, and other superficial fungal infections of the skin.

How does it work?
It damages the fungal cell membrane by interfering with the production of ergosterol, a substance fungi need to survive. This stops fungal growth and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Use it for the prescribed duration and avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, and other mucous membranes.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, dryness, or irritation at the application site may occur.

Precautions
For external use only. Do not apply to the eyes, mouth, or severely broken skin. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash, or signs of an allergic reaction occur. Consult a doctor if the infection does not improve or worsens.

title: Alkem'S Ors Novo Apple Flavour (200 Ml) (200 Ml) Ors Liquid By Alkem
name: Alkem'S Ors Novo Apple Flavour (200 Ml) (200 Ml) Ors Liquid By Alkem
searchText: Alkem'S Ors Novo Apple Flavour (200 Ml) (200 Ml) Ors Liquid By Alkem Alkem DL00000004
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
ORS Liquid helps prevent and treat dehydration caused by diarrhoea, vomiting, or other fluid loss by replacing water and essential salts.

How does it work?
It contains water, salts and glucose, which help the intestines absorb fluids and restore the body's fluid and electrolyte balance.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth in small, frequent sips. Use it as supplied and follow the product label for storage and the time limit after opening. Do not add extra water or other ingredients unless instructed. If vomiting occurs, wait briefly and restart with small sips.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort or bloating may occur, especially if taken too quickly.

Precautions
Seek medical help for severe dehydration, persistent vomiting or diarrhoea, blood in the stool, very little or no urine, unusual drowsiness, or inability to drink. Use with medical advice in severe kidney disease or when fluid or salt intake is restricted. Keep infants and children under close observation during diarrhoea.

title: Alkem'S Ors Novo Lemon Flavour (200 Ml) (200 Ml) Ors Liquid By Alkem
name: Alkem'S Ors Novo Lemon Flavour (200 Ml) (200 Ml) Ors Liquid By Alkem

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
ORS Liquid is used to prevent or treat dehydration caused by diarrhoea, vomiting, or loss of fluids. It replaces water and essential salts lost from the body.

How does it work?
It contains a balanced combination of water, salts, and glucose. These help the intestine absorb fluids and restore the body's fluid and electrolyte balance.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Take small, frequent sips, especially if there is vomiting. Do not dilute or add ingredients unless instructed on the label. Use only within the recommended period after opening.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, or bloating may occur in some people.

Precautions
Seek medical care for severe dehydration, persistent vomiting, blood in the stool, high fever, confusion, very little urine, or worsening diarrhoea. Infants, older adults, and people with kidney disease, heart failure, or conditions requiring salt or fluid restriction should use it only with medical advice. ORS does not replace medical treatment when diarrhoea is severe or prolonged.

title: Alkem'S Ors Novo Orange Flavour (200 Ml) (200 Ml) Ors Liquid By Alkem

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
ORS liquid is used to prevent and treat dehydration caused by diarrhoea, vomiting, or loss of fluids and salts. It replaces the water and electrolytes the body loses.

How does it work?
It contains a balanced combination of water, salts and glucose. These help the intestine absorb fluids and electrolytes more effectively.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth as supplied, in small, frequent sips. Do not dilute or mix it with other drinks unless the product label directs. Follow the storage and use instructions on the pack, and do not use it if it is past its expiry date.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, bloating or stomach discomfort may occur, especially if taken too quickly.

Precautions
Seek medical advice if there is severe dehydration, persistent vomiting, blood in the stool, confusion, very little urine, or inability to drink. People with kidney disease, heart failure, or other conditions requiring fluid or salt restriction should use it only on medical advice. Infants, young children and older adults may need prompt medical assessment if dehydration is suspected.

title: Alkemvan-1000 Injection (Vial) (Vial) Vancomycin Hydrochloride 1000 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemvan-1000 Injection (Vial) (Vial) Vancomycin Hydrochloride 1000 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemvan-1000 Injection (Vial) (Vial) Vancomycin Hydrochloride 1000 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIRB11
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Vancomycin is a prescription antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by certain Gram-positive bacteria, including some infections caused by MRSA. When taken by mouth, it is used for certain infections of the intestine, such as Clostridioides difficile infection.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from building their protective cell wall, which kills the bacteria or prevents them from growing.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed. The route depends on the formulation and infection: injectable vancomycin is usually given into a vein by a healthcare professional, while oral vancomycin is used for specific intestinal infections. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, pain or inflammation at the injection site, and infusion-related flushing or itching. Kidney problems and hearing changes can occur, especially with injectable treatment, and require medical attention.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing problems, or previous allergy to vancomycin. Kidney function and, when needed, blood levels may be monitored during injectable treatment. Injectable vancomycin must be given at the recommended rate because rapid infusion can cause flushing, itching, low blood pressure, or breathing difficulty. Seek urgent medical help for severe rash, breathing difficulty, reduced urination, or severe or persistent diarrhoea.

title: Alkemvan-500 Injection (Vial) (Vial) Vancomycin Hydrochloride 500 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemvan-500 Injection (Vial) (Vial) Vancomycin Hydrochloride 500 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemvan-500 Injection (Vial) (Vial) Vancomycin Hydrochloride 500 Mg By Alkem Alkem AIRB01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Vancomycin is an antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by certain bacteria, including some resistant Gram-positive infections such as MRSA. Depending on the formulation, oral vancomycin may be used for certain intestinal infections, including Clostridioides difficile infection.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from forming their protective cell wall, causing the bacteria to die.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed. The route depends on the formulation: injectable vancomycin is usually given into a vein by a healthcare professional, while oral vancomycin is taken by mouth. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Pain or irritation at the injection site, nausea, rash, itching, flushing, and headache may occur. Diarrhoea can occur with antibiotics.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing problems, previous allergy to vancomycin, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Kidney function and sometimes blood levels may need monitoring, especially with injectable treatment. Rapid infusion can cause flushing, itching, low blood pressure, or breathing difficulty; seek urgent medical help if these occur. Use only for the infection prescribed, as it does not treat viral infections.

title: Alkemvit-12 Inj (Vial) Vitamin C 150 Mg + Vitamin B12 2500 Mcg + Folic Acid 0.7 Mg + Nicotinamide 12 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkemvit-12 Inj (Vial) Vitamin C 150 Mg + Vitamin B12 2500 Mcg + Folic Acid 0.7 Mg + Nicotinamide 12 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkemvit-12 Inj (Vial) Vitamin C 150 Mg + Vitamin B12 2500 Mcg + Folic Acid 0.7 Mg + Nicotinamide 12 Mg By Alkem Alkem DI00000173
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This vitamin combination is used to help prevent or correct deficiencies of vitamin C, vitamin B12, folic acid and nicotinamide when dietary intake is inadequate or the body needs extra supplementation. These vitamins support normal blood cell formation, nerve function and general body processes.

How does it work?
It supplies essential vitamins needed for normal red blood cell production, nerve function, tissue maintenance and energy-related processes.

How to take/use it
Take or use it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount or take multiple vitamin products containing the same ingredients unless advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort or diarrhoea may occur. Unusual reactions are possible.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional about any kidney disease or history of kidney stones, iron-overload disorders, vitamin deficiencies or regular medicines. Folic acid may mask some signs of vitamin B12 deficiency, so unexplained anaemia or nerve symptoms should be medically assessed. Stop use and seek help if signs of an allergic reaction occur.

title: Alkemvit Cee Tablet (15'S) Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Sodium Ascorbate & Zinc Chewable Tablet By Alkem
name: Alkemvit Cee Tablet (15'S) Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Sodium Ascorbate & Zinc Chewable Tablet By Alkem
searchText: Alkemvit Cee Tablet (15'S) Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Sodium Ascorbate & Zinc Chewable Tablet By Alkem Alkem DT00000838
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement is used to provide vitamin C and zinc, help prevent or correct dietary deficiencies, and support normal immune function, collagen formation and wound healing.

How does it work?
Vitamin C acts as an antioxidant and helps the body make collagen, which is important for skin and tissues. Zinc supports normal immune function and many enzyme processes in the body.

How to take/use it
Chew the tablet thoroughly and take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Taking it with food may reduce stomach upset.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, heartburn, diarrhoea, or a metallic taste may occur, especially with excessive intake.

Precautions
Avoid excessive or prolonged use. Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, iron-storage disease, or an allergy to any ingredient. Long-term high-dose zinc may cause copper deficiency. Ask a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if taking other medicines; zinc may interfere with the absorption of some antibiotics and thyroid medicines.

title: Alkemvit Q10 Capsule (10S) Alkemvit Q10 Capsule By Alkem
name: Alkemvit Q10 Capsule (10S) Alkemvit Q10 Capsule By Alkem
searchText: Alkemvit Q10 Capsule (10S) Alkemvit Q10 Capsule By Alkem Alkem DC00000121
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Alkemvit Q10 Capsule is a Coenzyme Q10 supplement used to support normal energy production in cells and provide antioxidant support.

How does it work?
Coenzyme Q10 helps cells produce energy, particularly in tissues that need high energy. It also has antioxidant activity that helps protect cells from oxidative damage.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Swallow the capsule with water, preferably with food if advised. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, nausea, diarrhoea, loss of appetite, headache or difficulty sleeping may occur.

Precautions
Check with a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical advice if taking warfarin, medicines for diabetes or blood pressure, or if there is an ongoing medical condition. Stop use and seek advice if an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Alkof Drops 15Ml (15 Ml) Ambroxol 7.5 Mg + Terbutaline 0.25 Mg + Guaiphenesin 12.5 Mg By Alkem
name: Alkof Drops 15Ml (15 Ml) Ambroxol 7.5 Mg + Terbutaline 0.25 Mg + Guaiphenesin 12.5 Mg By Alkem
searchText: Alkof Drops 15Ml (15 Ml) Ambroxol 7.5 Mg + Terbutaline 0.25 Mg + Guaiphenesin 12.5 Mg By Alkem Alkem AOJY01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used for cough with phlegm, especially when mucus is thick or there is wheezing or narrowing of the airways. It helps loosen and clear mucus and makes breathing easier.

How does it work?
Ambroxol and guaiphenesin help thin and loosen mucus so it can be coughed out more easily. Terbutaline relaxes the airway muscles and helps open the airways.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as prescribed by the doctor or as directed on the product label. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. If it is a liquid, measure each dose with the supplied measuring device.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach upset, headache, dizziness, tremor, nervousness, muscle cramps or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use only with medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, low potassium or a history of seizures. Tell the doctor about pregnancy or breastfeeding before use. Seek medical attention for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, a very fast or irregular heartbeat, or a skin rash or swelling. Do not combine with other cough medicines unless advised by a doctor.

title: Almox-C Plus Capsules (10'S) (10S) Amoxicllin 250Mg & Cloxacillin 250Mg By Alkem
name: Almox-C Plus Capsules (10'S) (10S) Amoxicllin 250Mg & Cloxacillin 250Mg By Alkem
searchText: Almox-C Plus Capsules (10'S) (10S) Amoxicllin 250Mg & Cloxacillin 250Mg By Alkem Alkem DC00000159
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxicillin and cloxacillin are antibiotics used to treat bacterial infections caused by susceptible bacteria. They do not treat viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Both medicines stop susceptible bacteria from making their protective cell wall, which kills the bacteria and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Follow the prescribed timing and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. Do not share this medicine or use leftover antibiotics. Do not take a dose more often or for longer than prescribed.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin or related antibiotics. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash or severe or persistent diarrhoea. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems and any previous antibiotic-related allergic reaction. Use only when prescribed, as unnecessary antibiotic use can cause resistance.

title: Alpiptakem-T Injection (Vial) (Vial) Piperacillin 4 G + Tazobactam 0.5 G By Alkem
name: Alpiptakem-T Injection (Vial) (Vial) Piperacillin 4 G + Tazobactam 0.5 G By Alkem
searchText: Alpiptakem-T Injection (Vial) (Vial) Piperacillin 4 G + Tazobactam 0.5 G By Alkem Alkem AIRJ01
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Piperacillin + tazobactam is a prescription antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, including infections of the lungs, abdomen, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, and other hospital-acquired infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Piperacillin kills bacteria by stopping them from building their protective cell wall. Tazobactam helps protect piperacillin from enzymes made by some bacteria, allowing it to work against a wider range of infections.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection or intravenous infusion by a doctor or nurse, usually in a hospital or clinical setting. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection and kidney function. Use it only as prescribed and complete the prescribed course unless the treating doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, rash, headache, and pain or irritation at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it without medical advice if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin, other beta-lactam antibiotics, or cephalosporins. Tell the doctor about kidney disease, bleeding problems, seizures, or previous antibiotic-related severe diarrhoea. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, a severe rash, or persistent or bloody diarrhoea. The doctor may monitor kidney function and blood tests during prolonged treatment.
