bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cilnidipine 20 mg is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). It helps lower blood pressure and reduces the risk of complications related to uncontrolled hypertension.

How does it work?
It relaxes and widens the blood vessels, allowing blood to flow more easily and reducing the pressure inside the blood vessels.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor, preferably at the same time each day. Swallow the tablet with water and do not stop taking it suddenly without medical advice. Do not change the dose or treatment duration on your own.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, flushing, palpitations, and swelling of the ankles or feet may occur.

Precautions
Use with caution if there is low blood pressure, liver disease, or heart-related illness. Rise slowly if dizziness occurs. Avoid driving or operating machinery if feeling dizzy. Inform the doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding, and tell them about all other medicines being taken.

title: Clearvas F-10 Tab (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Clearvas F-10 Tab (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Clearvas F-10 Tab (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000204
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used with diet and exercise to manage high cholesterol and high triglyceride levels, especially mixed dyslipidaemia. It may be prescribed when both LDL cholesterol and triglycerides need to be reduced.

How does it work?
Rosuvastatin reduces the liver’s production of cholesterol and lowers LDL (bad) cholesterol. Fenofibrate helps reduce triglycerides and may increase HDL (good) cholesterol.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Regular cholesterol, liver and kidney tests may be recommended.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, indigestion or stomach pain, diarrhoea, and muscle aches may occur. Mild increases in liver enzymes can also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver or kidney disease, gallbladder problems, thyroid problems, heavy alcohol use, or any history of muscle problems with cholesterol medicines. The combination can rarely cause serious muscle damage; seek medical help for severe or unexplained muscle pain, weakness, fever, or dark urine. Seek medical advice for yellowing of the skin or eyes or severe stomach pain. It is generally avoided during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Tell the doctor about all other medicines, especially blood thinners or other cholesterol-lowering medicines.

title: Cpero D Eye/Ear Drop (10ml) Ciprofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Dexamethasone 0.1% w/v, Benzalkonium Solution 0.02% w/v Eye/Ear Drops by Aristo
name: Cpero D Eye/Ear Drop (10ml) Ciprofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Dexamethasone 0.1% w/v, Benzalkonium Solution 0.02% w/v Eye/Ear Drops by Aristo
searchText: Cpero D Eye/Ear Drop (10ml) Ciprofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Dexamethasone 0.1% w/v, Benzalkonium Solution 0.02% w/v Eye/Ear Drops by Aristo Aristo 48000294
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for bacterial eye infections accompanied by inflammation, such as bacterial conjunctivitis, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ciprofloxacin kills susceptible bacteria causing the infection. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces redness, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Use in the affected eye(s) exactly as prescribed. Wash hands before use and avoid touching the dropper tip to the eye or other surfaces. Do not wear contact lenses during treatment unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, irritation, blurred vision or discomfort after application. These effects are usually short-lived.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice, as steroid-containing eye medicines may worsen some viral or fungal infections and may increase eye pressure or delay healing if used for too long. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, vision changes, severe pain or swelling develops, or there is no improvement. Do not use if the solution is contaminated or the seal is damaged.

title: Cpero Eye Drop (15ml) Ciprofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Benzalkonium 0.02% w/v Eye Drops by Aristo
name: Cpero Eye Drop (15ml) Ciprofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Benzalkonium 0.02% w/v Eye Drops by Aristo
searchText: Cpero Eye Drop (15ml) Ciprofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Benzalkonium 0.02% w/v Eye Drops by Aristo Aristo 48000270
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat bacterial infections of the eye, such as bacterial conjunctivitis, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ciprofloxacin is an antibiotic that stops the growth of bacteria causing the infection. Benzalkonium helps preserve the solution.

How to take/use it
Use in the eye only if the product is labelled for ophthalmic use, and follow the dose and duration prescribed. Wash hands before use, do not touch the dropper tip, and do not share the bottle. Remove contact lenses before use and ask a doctor when they can be worn again.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, burning, irritation, redness, itching or blurred vision may occur after application.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ciprofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics. Stop use and seek medical help for swelling, rash, breathing difficulty, severe eye pain or worsening vision. Consult a doctor if symptoms do not improve or worsen. Benzalkonium may irritate the eyes and may affect soft contact lenses.

title: Cpero IV (100Ml) Ciprofloxacin Infusion by Aristo
name: Cpero IV (100Ml) Ciprofloxacin Infusion by Aristo
searchText: Cpero IV (100Ml) Ciprofloxacin Infusion by Aristo Aristo 48000272
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ciprofloxacin infusion is an antibiotic used in hospitals to treat serious bacterial infections when treatment through a vein is needed. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking enzymes they need to copy and repair their DNA.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given slowly into a vein by a healthcare professional. The dose and treatment length depend on the type and severity of infection and kidney function. Complete the prescribed course unless the doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, rash, and pain or irritation at the infusion site.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies to ciprofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics, kidney problems, heart rhythm problems, tendon disorders, seizures, nerve problems, or myasthenia gravis. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe mood or nerve changes, palpitations, or a serious allergic reaction. Use in children, pregnancy, or breastfeeding only when specifically prescribed. It should be administered under medical supervision.

title: DandroCheck Soap (75gm) Ketoconazole 2% w/w Soap by Aristo
name: DandroCheck Soap (75gm) Ketoconazole 2% w/w Soap by Aristo
searchText: DandroCheck Soap (75gm) Ketoconazole 2% w/w Soap by Aristo Aristo 48000228
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% is an antifungal medicine used on the skin or scalp to treat fungal infections, including dandruff and seborrhoeic dermatitis when prescribed or labelled for these conditions.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making ergosterol, an essential part of their cell membrane. This prevents the fungi from growing and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Use only on the affected skin or scalp and follow the product label or prescriber's instructions. Clean and dry the area before application if advised. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Wash hands after use unless the hands are being treated.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site.

Precautions
For external use unless specifically directed otherwise. Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient. Avoid contact with the eyes and rinse well with water if this occurs. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty develops, or if the condition worsens or does not improve as expected.

title: Dapasto 10 Tab (10x3x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Dapasto 10 Tab (10x3x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Dapasto 10 Tab (10x3x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000330
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dapagliflozin is mainly used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes. It is also prescribed for some adults with heart failure or chronic kidney disease to reduce the risk of worsening disease and hospitalisation.

How does it work?
It helps the kidneys remove excess glucose and some sodium from the body through urine. This lowers blood sugar and may also reduce the workload on the heart and kidneys.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow it with water. It may usually be taken with or without food. Drink enough fluids unless a doctor has advised fluid restriction. Do not stop it without medical advice.

Common side effects
Increased urination, thirst, dehydration, dizziness, urinary tract infection, and genital fungal infection. Low blood sugar may occur, especially when used with insulin or certain other diabetes medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney problems, low blood pressure, dehydration, or frequent urinary or genital infections. Seek urgent medical help for nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual tiredness, breathing difficulty, or confusion, as these may indicate diabetic ketoacidosis even if blood sugar is not very high. It may need to be temporarily stopped during severe illness, prolonged fasting, or before surgery, only on medical advice. Discuss its use during pregnancy or breastfeeding with a doctor.

title: Dapasto M Tab (10x1x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 500 mg ER Tab by Aristo
name: Dapasto M Tab (10x1x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 500 mg ER Tab by Aristo
searchText: Dapasto M Tab (10x1x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 500 mg ER Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000302
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes. It is not used to treat type 1 diabetes.

How does it work?
Metformin reduces glucose production by the liver and helps the body use insulin better. Dapagliflozin helps the kidneys remove excess glucose from the body through urine.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with food. Swallow the extended-release tablet whole; do not crush, chew or split it. Drink enough fluids unless a doctor has advised fluid restriction.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, increased urination, urinary tract infection, and genital fungal infection. Low blood sugar is more likely when used with insulin or certain other diabetes medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, heavy alcohol use, or planned surgery or prolonged fasting. Seek urgent medical help for severe nausea or vomiting, stomach pain, unusual tiredness, difficulty breathing, confusion, or signs of severe dehydration. Report burning urination, fever, or genital itching or swelling. This medicine may need to be stopped temporarily during serious illness or some medical procedures, only as advised by a doctor.

title: Dapasto Trio 500 Tab (10x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 500 mg, Sitagliptin 100 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Dapasto Trio 500 Tab (10x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 500 mg, Sitagliptin 100 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Dapasto Trio 500 Tab (10x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 500 mg, Sitagliptin 100 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000317
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used along with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes when treatment with other diabetes medicines is not enough. It is not used to treat type 1 diabetes.

How does it work?
Dapagliflozin helps the kidneys remove excess glucose through urine. Metformin reduces glucose production by the liver, while sitagliptin helps the body release insulin and reduce glucose production after meals.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, preferably with food if advised, and at the same time each day. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Drink adequate fluids unless fluid restriction has been advised.

Common side effects
Increased urination, urinary or genital infections, nausea, diarrhoea, stomach upset, headache and dizziness. Low blood sugar is more likely when used with insulin or sulfonylurea medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, recurrent urinary or genital infections, heart problems, or heavy alcohol use. Seek urgent medical help for severe nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual tiredness or difficulty breathing, as these may indicate ketoacidosis or lactic acidosis. Kidney function should be checked regularly. Inform the doctor before surgery, prolonged fasting, or receiving contrast dye, and before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Dapasto Trio Forte Tab (10x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 1000 mg, Sitagliptin 100 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Dapasto Trio Forte Tab (10x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 1000 mg, Sitagliptin 100 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Dapasto Trio Forte Tab (10x10) Dapagliflozin 10 mg, Metformin 1000 mg, Sitagliptin 100 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000318
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes when one or more diabetes medicines are not enough. It is not used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis.

How does it work?
Dapagliflozin helps the kidneys remove excess sugar through urine. Metformin reduces sugar production by the liver and improves the body's response to insulin, while sitagliptin helps the body release insulin and reduce sugar production after meals.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with food, and swallow it as directed. Do not crush or split the tablet unless advised. Maintain adequate fluid intake and continue the recommended diet and exercise plan. Do not stop it without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, increased urination, urinary tract infection and genital fungal infection. Low blood sugar may occur, especially when used with insulin or sulfonylureas.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, recurrent urinary or genital infections, pancreatitis, heart failure, or heavy alcohol use. Seek urgent medical help for severe vomiting, stomach pain, unusual tiredness, breathing difficulty, confusion, or symptoms of severe dehydration. Discuss its use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Kidney function and blood sugar should be monitored as advised. Temporarily stopping it may be necessary during serious illness, prolonged fasting, or before some procedures—follow medical advice.

title: Doxisto LB Cap (10x1x10) Doxycycline 100 mg, Lactobacillus 5 billion spores Cap by Aristo
name: Doxisto LB Cap (10x1x10) Doxycycline 100 mg, Lactobacillus 5 billion spores Cap by Aristo
searchText: Doxisto LB Cap (10x1x10) Doxycycline 100 mg, Lactobacillus 5 billion spores Cap by Aristo Aristo 48000088
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat various bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as common cold or flu. Lactobacillus is included as a probiotic to help support the normal balance of bacteria in the gut.

How does it work?
Doxycycline stops susceptible bacteria from making proteins they need to grow and multiply. Lactobacillus is a beneficial bacterium that helps support normal intestinal flora.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Swallow the capsule with a full glass of water while sitting or standing, and do not lie down immediately afterwards. Avoid taking it close to milk or dairy products, antacids, iron, calcium or magnesium supplements unless advised otherwise. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, diarrhoea, abdominal discomfort and increased sensitivity to sunlight may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to doxycycline or other tetracycline antibiotics. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice. It is generally avoided in children under 8 years unless specifically prescribed. Use sun protection and limit prolonged exposure to sunlight. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, difficulty swallowing, severe headache or vision changes.

title: Dydrowish Tab (10x1x10) Dydrogesterone 10 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Dydrowish Tab (10x1x10) Dydrogesterone 10 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Dydrowish Tab (10x1x10) Dydrogesterone 10 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000226
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dydrogesterone is a progesterone-like medicine used to treat conditions caused by low progesterone, such as irregular or painful periods, endometriosis, and some menstrual or reproductive problems. It may also be prescribed during pregnancy or fertility treatment when progesterone support is needed.

How does it work?
It acts like the natural hormone progesterone. It helps support the lining of the uterus and regulate the menstrual cycle.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the doctor. The dose and treatment duration depend on the condition being treated. Swallow the tablet with water, preferably at the same time each day. Do not stop it without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache or migraine, nausea, abdominal discomfort, breast tenderness, spotting or changes in menstrual bleeding, and mood changes.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about unexplained vaginal bleeding, liver disease, a history of depression, migraine, or hormone-sensitive conditions. Seek medical advice for heavy or persistent bleeding, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or severe headache. Tell the doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding. This medicine is not a contraceptive.

title: Footsoul Cream (25gm) Herbal Cream For Crack Heals by Aristo
name: Footsoul Cream (25gm) Herbal Cream For Crack Heals by Aristo
searchText: Footsoul Cream (25gm) Herbal Cream For Crack Heals by Aristo Aristo 48000106
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to moisturise and soften dry, rough, cracked skin on the heels and help improve heel cracks.

How does it work?
It generally helps by moisturising the skin and improving its softness, which may support healing of dryness-related cracks. The exact action depends on the herbal ingredients.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry heels as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or an allergic reaction may occur in sensitive people.

Precautions
Stop use if significant irritation or an allergic reaction develops. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Seek medical advice if the cracks are deep, painful, bleeding, infected, or do not improve. People with diabetes or poor circulation should seek medical advice for persistent or severe heel cracks.

title: Itrafix 100 Cap (10x1x10) Itraconazole 100 mg Cap by Aristo
name: Itrafix 100 Cap (10x1x10) Itraconazole 100 mg Cap by Aristo
searchText: Itrafix 100 Cap (10x1x10) Itraconazole 100 mg Cap by Aristo Aristo 48000311
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Itraconazole is an antifungal medicine used to treat fungal infections, including infections of the skin, nails, mouth, vagina and, in some cases, internal organs. The exact use depends on the type and severity of the infection.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making ergosterol, a substance needed to maintain their cell membranes. This prevents the fungi from growing and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the recommended course. If this is an itraconazole capsule, take it immediately after a full meal and swallow it whole. Do not change the dose or stop treatment early without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, headache, dizziness, rash and changes in liver function tests.

Precautions
Itraconazole has many important medicine interactions, so inform the doctor about all prescription medicines, over-the-counter medicines and supplements being taken. Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, heart failure or a history of heart problems. Seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe rash, breathing difficulty or swelling of the legs. Use during pregnancy only when specifically prescribed. Antacids and medicines that reduce stomach acid may affect absorption; ask a doctor or pharmacist how to take them with itraconazole.

title: Itrafix 200 Cap (10x1x10) Itraconazole 200 mg Cap by Aristo
name: Itrafix 200 Cap (10x1x10) Itraconazole 200 mg Cap by Aristo
searchText: Itrafix 200 Cap (10x1x10) Itraconazole 200 mg Cap by Aristo Aristo 48000312
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Itraconazole is an antifungal medicine used to treat fungal infections of the skin, nails, mouth, vagina and other parts of the body. The exact use depends on the infection and the doctor's prescription.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making ergosterol, a substance they need to build and maintain their cell membranes. This prevents the fungi from growing and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take or use it exactly as prescribed. Do not change the dose or stop treatment early. Instructions may differ depending on the formulation, so follow the product label and medical advice. Tell the doctor about all other medicines being taken because itraconazole has important drug interactions.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, heart failure, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or an allergy to antifungal medicines. Itraconazole can interact with many medicines. Seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe tiredness, breathing difficulty, swelling of the legs, or a severe skin reaction.

title: Linzalife 600 Tab (10x10) Linezolid 600 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Linzalife 600 Tab (10x10) Linezolid 600 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Linzalife 600 Tab (10x10) Linezolid 600 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000256
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Linezolid is an antibiotic used to treat certain serious bacterial infections, including some types of pneumonia, skin and soft-tissue infections, and infections caused by resistant bacteria. It does not work for viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and survive.

How to take/use it
Take the tablet exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. It may be taken with or without food. Do not share it with others or use leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, and changes in taste may occur. Longer treatment can affect blood counts.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about antidepressants or other medicines that affect serotonin, as serious interactions may occur. Inform the doctor about high blood pressure, blood disorders, or liver problems. During prolonged treatment, blood tests may be needed. Seek medical advice for unusual bruising, persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, vision changes, or severe headache. Avoid self-medication and use only under medical supervision.

title: Lostin 50mg Tab (10x2x15) Losartan 50 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Lostin 50mg Tab (10x2x15) Losartan 50 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Lostin 50mg Tab (10x2x15) Losartan 50 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000276
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Losartan 50 mg is mainly used to treat high blood pressure. It may also be prescribed to help protect the kidneys in some people with diabetes and to reduce the risk of stroke in certain people with high blood pressure.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of a hormone that causes blood vessels to narrow. This helps the blood vessels relax, lowering blood pressure and reducing strain on the heart.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day, with or without food. Continue it regularly even if feeling well, and do not stop it without medical advice. If a dose is missed, follow the instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, tiredness, low blood pressure, and stomach upset may occur. Blood potassium levels or kidney function may change.

Precautions
Do not use during pregnancy, especially after the first three months; inform the doctor immediately if pregnancy occurs. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, or use of potassium supplements, potassium-containing salt substitutes, or medicines that can affect the kidneys. Seek urgent medical help for swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, or difficulty breathing.

title: Lostin H Tab (10x2x15) Losartan 50 mg, Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Lostin H Tab (10x2x15) Losartan 50 mg, Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Lostin H Tab (10x2x15) Losartan 50 mg, Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000286
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Losartan 50 mg with hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). Controlling blood pressure helps reduce the risk of complications such as stroke and heart disease.

How does it work?
Losartan relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of a hormone that raises blood pressure. Hydrochlorothiazide is a diuretic (‘water tablet’) that helps the kidneys remove extra salt and water from the body.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually at the same time each day. It may be taken with or without food and should be swallowed with water. Do not stop or change the medicine without medical advice. Regular blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte checks may be recommended.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, tiredness, increased urination and a drop in blood pressure may occur. Changes in potassium or sodium levels can also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, dehydration, gout, diabetes, or electrolyte problems. Do not use during pregnancy; seek medical advice promptly if pregnancy occurs. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised. Some medicines, including painkillers such as ibuprofen, lithium and other blood-pressure medicines, may interact with it. Rise slowly if dizzy and seek medical help for fainting, severe weakness, swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

title: Megachymo Forte Tab (10x20) Trypsin-Chymotrypsin 100,000 Armour Units Tab by Aristo
name: Megachymo Forte Tab (10x20) Trypsin-Chymotrypsin 100,000 Armour Units Tab by Aristo
searchText: Megachymo Forte Tab (10x20) Trypsin-Chymotrypsin 100,000 Armour Units Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000233
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Trypsin-chymotrypsin is used to help reduce swelling, inflammation and discomfort after injuries, surgery or other soft-tissue inflammation. It may also be prescribed for some muscle and joint conditions.

How does it work?
These enzymes help break down proteins involved in inflammation and swelling, which may support the body's recovery from tissue injury.

How to take/use it
Take only in the dose and for the duration prescribed by the doctor. If supplied as a tablet, swallow it whole with water; do not chew or crush it unless advised. Do not self-medicate.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, nausea, diarrhoea, skin rash or other allergic reactions may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about bleeding disorders, liver or kidney problems, allergies, or use of blood-thinning medicines. Use only under medical advice before surgery, during pregnancy or while breastfeeding. Stop the medicine and seek urgent help for signs of a serious allergic reaction or unusual bleeding.

title: Megaphylline 100mg Cap (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg Cap by Aristo
name: Megaphylline 100mg Cap (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg Cap by Aristo
searchText: Megaphylline 100mg Cap (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg Cap by Aristo Aristo 48000326
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Acebrophylline 100 mg is used to help manage breathing problems such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It helps reduce airway narrowing and loosen thick mucus, making breathing easier. It is not usually used for the immediate relief of a sudden asthma attack.

How does it work?
It relaxes the muscles around the airways and helps reduce the thickness of mucus. This allows air to move more easily through the lungs.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Continue to keep any prescribed rescue inhaler available for sudden breathing difficulty.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, palpitations and difficulty sleeping may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is heart disease, an irregular heartbeat, high blood pressure, liver or kidney problems, or a history of stomach ulcers. Seek medical help for severe palpitations, chest pain or worsening breathing difficulty. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding and all other medicines being taken. Do not take it if allergic to acebrophylline or similar medicines.

title: Megaphylline 200SR Tab (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 200 mg SR Tab by Aristo
name: Megaphylline 200SR Tab (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 200 mg SR Tab by Aristo
searchText: Megaphylline 200SR Tab (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 200 mg SR Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000327
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Acebrophylline 200 mg Sustained Release is used to help relieve breathing difficulty, wheezing and cough caused by asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It helps open the airways and loosen thick mucus.

How does it work?
It relaxes the muscles around the airways, helping them widen, and helps reduce the thickness of mucus so it can be cleared more easily.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed. Swallow the sustained-release tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. It is not meant for immediate relief during a sudden breathing attack—use the prescribed rescue inhaler if one has been provided.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, restlessness, difficulty sleeping, tremor or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart disease, high blood pressure, irregular heartbeat, seizures, thyroid problems, or liver or kidney disease. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially other theophylline-containing medicines. Avoid taking more than prescribed and limit excessive caffeine, as this may increase side effects. Seek medical help for severe palpitations, persistent vomiting, seizures or worsening breathing difficulty. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Megaphylline-N Tab (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg, Acetylcysteine 600 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Megaphylline-N Tab (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg, Acetylcysteine 600 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Megaphylline-N Tab (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg, Acetylcysteine 600 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000329
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as prescribed to help manage asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) with breathing difficulty, wheezing and thick mucus. It helps loosen phlegm and clear mucus from the airways. It is not a rescue medicine for a sudden breathing attack.

How does it work?
Acebrophylline helps relax and widen the airways, while acetylcysteine thins thick mucus so it can be coughed out more easily.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Use the appropriate rescue inhaler or seek urgent medical care for sudden or severe breathing difficulty.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, tremor or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart disease, high blood pressure, seizures, stomach ulcers, or liver or kidney problems before use. Seek medical advice if palpitations, severe vomiting, rash or worsening breathing occurs. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice. Keep this medicine away from children.

title: Minovant-5 Solution (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Topical Solution by Aristo
name: Minovant-5 Solution (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Topical Solution by Aristo
searchText: Minovant-5 Solution (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Topical Solution by Aristo Aristo 48000252
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Minoxidil Topical Solution 5% is used to help treat pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia) by promoting hair growth on the scalp.

How does it work?
It helps increase blood flow around hair follicles and may prolong the active hair-growth phase, supporting the growth of thicker hair.

How to take/use it
Apply only to the dry scalp and use exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands after application and avoid contact with the eyes, face and other areas of the body. Do not apply to broken, irritated or sunburned skin.

Common side effects
Scalp itching, dryness, redness or irritation; temporary increased hair shedding; unwanted facial or body hair. Headache or dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Do not use for sudden, patchy or unexplained hair loss without medical advice. Stop using it and seek medical advice if chest pain, rapid or irregular heartbeat, fainting, severe dizziness or swelling occurs. Consult a healthcare professional during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Keep away from children and open flames, as the solution may be flammable.

title: Minovant-F Solution (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% Solution by Aristo
name: Minovant-F Solution (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% Solution by Aristo
searchText: Minovant-F Solution (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% Solution by Aristo Aristo 48000369
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help treat androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss), helping reduce hair loss and support hair regrowth on the scalp.

How does it work?
Minoxidil helps stimulate hair follicles and support the hair-growth phase. Finasteride lowers dihydrotestosterone (DHT), a hormone involved in pattern hair loss.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by the prescriber. If supplied for scalp application, apply to the clean, dry scalp as directed and wash hands after use. Do not use more than recommended or apply to irritated or broken skin.

Common side effects
Scalp irritation, itching, dryness, redness or flaking, and temporary increased hair shedding may occur. Finasteride may rarely cause decreased sexual desire, erection problems or reduced semen volume.

Precautions
For external use only unless otherwise directed. Avoid contact with the eyes and wash thoroughly if contact occurs. Stop use and seek medical advice for severe scalp irritation, dizziness, fainting, chest pain, rapid heartbeat or swelling. Finasteride can harm a developing male baby; women who are pregnant or may become pregnant should not use this product or handle leaking product. Discuss use with a doctor if there is heart disease, low blood pressure or unexplained hair loss.

title: Moflux Eye Drop (10ml) Moxifloxacin 0.5% w/v, Benzalkonium 0.02% w/v Eye Drops by Aristo

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat bacterial infections of the eye, such as bacterial conjunctivitis. It does not treat viral or fungal eye infections.

How does it work?
Moxifloxacin is an antibiotic that stops susceptible bacteria from growing and multiplying. Benzalkonium solution acts as a preservative.

How to take/use it
Use in the eye only and follow the dose and duration prescribed by the doctor. Wash hands before use, do not touch the dropper tip to the eye or other surfaces, and close the container after use. Remove contact lenses before application and ask a doctor when they can be worn again.

Common side effects
Temporary burning or stinging, eye irritation, redness, itching, dryness, blurred vision, or a change in taste may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to moxifloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics. Stop using it and seek medical help if there is swelling, rash, severe itching, breathing difficulty, severe eye pain, or worsening vision. Seek medical advice if symptoms do not improve or become worse.

title: Naproxet D 250 Tab (10x15) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 250 mg Tab by Aristo

searchText: Naproxet D 250 Tab (10x15) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 250 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000262
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve migraine headaches and help control associated nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Naproxen reduces pain and inflammation involved in migraine. Domperidone helps reduce nausea and vomiting and supports movement of the stomach.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow it with water and do not take more than recommended. Taking it with or after food may help reduce stomach irritation from naproxen.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, nausea, dry mouth, dizziness or drowsiness may occur.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is an allergy to naproxen, other painkillers or domperidone. Tell the doctor about stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney, liver or heart problems, or asthma triggered by painkillers. Domperidone may affect heart rhythm, so inform the doctor about heart disease or medicines that affect heart rhythm. Avoid combining it with other NSAID painkillers unless advised. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, chest palpitations or fainting. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, or while breastfeeding.

title: Naproxet D 500 Tab (10x15) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 200 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Naproxet D 500 Tab (10x15) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 200 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Naproxet D 500 Tab (10x15) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 200 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000263
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is usually used to relieve migraine headache and associated nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Naproxen reduces pain and inflammation by blocking substances involved in pain. Domperidone helps control nausea and vomiting and may improve stomach movement.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed or directed on the label. Swallow with water; taking it with or after food may help reduce stomach irritation. Do not take more than recommended or combine it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen or diclofenac unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, indigestion, heartburn, stomach pain, nausea, dry mouth, dizziness or headache.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if allergic to naproxen, aspirin or other NSAIDs, or if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding. Tell the doctor about kidney, liver or heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or heart rhythm problems. Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically advised. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, chest palpitations or fainting. Check with a doctor or pharmacist before use with blood thinners, steroids, other NSAIDs or medicines that can affect heart rhythm.

title: Nimodol Plus Tab (Amber Pvc) (10x2x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Tab by Aristo

searchText: Nimodol Plus Tab (Amber Pvc) (10x2x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000095
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and fever, such as body aches, muscle or joint pain, and other painful conditions. Use only when recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Nimesulide reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed, preferably after food, with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Avoid taking other medicines containing paracetamol, nimesulide or other painkillers unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash. Stop use and seek medical help if yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe rash or unusual bleeding occurs.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is liver disease, severe kidney disease, stomach ulcer or bleeding, or an allergy to its ingredients, unless specifically advised by a doctor. Avoid alcohol because of the risk of liver damage. Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, or other medicines being used. Do not combine with other paracetamol-containing products or painkillers without medical advice.

Nimesulide reduces substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever.

Take only in the dose and for the duration prescribed. Taking it after food may help reduce stomach upset. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or nimesulide unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is liver disease, severe kidney disease, stomach ulcer or bleeding, or an allergy to painkillers unless specifically advised by a doctor. Avoid alcohol. Do not exceed the prescribed dose because paracetamol and nimesulide can cause serious liver damage in excess. Consult a doctor during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, or while breastfeeding. Stop use and seek medical help if yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe stomach pain, unusual bleeding or an allergic reaction occurs.

Use only under medical advice. Avoid it if there is liver disease, a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, or severe kidney disease unless specifically approved by a doctor. Avoid alcohol. searchText: Norethinol Tab (20x10) Norethisterone 5 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000316
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Norethisterone is a progesterone-like medicine used to treat heavy, painful or irregular menstrual bleeding. It may also be prescribed for endometriosis or to delay a period, depending on medical advice.

How does it work?
It acts like the natural hormone progesterone and helps control the lining of the womb, reducing or regulating bleeding.

How to take/use it
Take this tablet by mouth with water, exactly as prescribed. The dose and treatment duration depend on the reason for use. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Norethisterone is not a contraceptive.

Common side effects
Nausea, headache, bloating, breast tenderness, mood changes, and spotting or changes in menstrual bleeding may occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if pregnant unless specifically advised by a doctor. Tell the doctor about a history of blood clots, liver disease, unexplained vaginal bleeding, hormone-sensitive cancer, migraine, or depression. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, sudden breathlessness, coughing blood, one-sided leg swelling, severe headache, vision changes, or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Nozeesyn-Oxy Nasal Spray (10Ml) Oxymetazoline 0.05% w/v Nasal Spray by Aristo
name: Nozeesyn-Oxy Nasal Spray (10Ml) Oxymetazoline 0.05% w/v Nasal Spray by Aristo
searchText: Nozeesyn-Oxy Nasal Spray (10Ml) Oxymetazoline 0.05% w/v Nasal Spray by Aristo Aristo 48000236
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Oxymetazoline nasal medicine provides short-term relief from a blocked or stuffy nose caused by colds, allergies or sinus congestion.

How does it work?
It narrows swollen blood vessels in the lining of the nose, helping reduce swelling and improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Use in the nose exactly as directed on the package or by a healthcare professional. Do not use it for longer than 3 days unless advised, as prolonged use can cause worsening or rebound nasal congestion.

Common side effects
Temporary nasal burning, stinging, dryness, sneezing or irritation may occur. Overuse may cause rebound congestion.

Precautions
Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, glaucoma or an enlarged prostate, or if monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines are being taken. Avoid sharing the product and keep it away from children. Seek medical advice if congestion persists or worsens.

title: Nozeesyn-P Xylo Nasal Spray (100ml) Xylometazoline 0.05% Nasal Spray by Aristo
name: Nozeesyn-P Xylo Nasal Spray (100ml) Xylometazoline 0.05% Nasal Spray by Aristo
searchText: Nozeesyn-P Xylo Nasal Spray (100ml) Xylometazoline 0.05% Nasal Spray by Aristo Aristo 48000328
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Xylometazoline 0.05% nasal spray provides short-term relief from a blocked or stuffy nose caused by common colds, sinus congestion or nasal allergies.

How does it work?
It narrows swollen blood vessels in the lining of the nose, helping reduce swelling and improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Use in the nose only, following the product label or a doctor's instructions. Clear the nose gently before use, and do not share the spray with others. Do not use it more often or for longer than recommended, as this can cause worsening congestion.

Common side effects
Nasal dryness, irritation, burning, sneezing or headache. Temporary worsening of congestion may occur after prolonged use.

Precautions
This pediatric strength should be used only for the age group stated on the label or advised by a doctor. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use in children with high blood pressure, heart disease, overactive thyroid, glaucoma or other significant medical conditions. Seek medical advice if congestion persists or worsens. Avoid prolonged or excessive use.

title: Nozeesyn-S Nasal Spray (20ml) Sodium Chloride 0.65% Nasal Spray by Aristo

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sodium chloride 0.65% is a mild saline solution commonly used as nasal drops or a spray to moisturise dry nasal passages, loosen mucus and help relieve a blocked or irritated nose.

How does it work?
It adds moisture to the nasal passages and helps wash away mucus, dust and other irritants.

How to take/use it
Use in the nose only if the product is labelled for nasal use. Follow the instructions on the product label. Wash hands before use, and do not share the container or touch its tip to the nose or other surfaces.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, irritation, sneezing or a feeling of dryness may occur.

Precautions
For nasal use only when labelled for that purpose. Do not use the product if it appears contaminated or the container is damaged. Stop use and seek medical advice if irritation is severe, symptoms worsen or nasal blockage persists.

title: Nozeesyn Vapo Inhalant Capsules (10x2x10) Camphor 25 mg, Chlorothymol 5 mg, Eucalyptol 125 mg, Menthol 55 mg, Terpineol 120 mg Cap by Aristo

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of a blocked nose and nasal discomfort associated with the common cold.

How does it work?
Its volatile aromatic ingredients release vapours that provide a cooling sensation and may temporarily make nasal breathing feel easier.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a pharmacist. Do not swallow or use by mouth unless the product instructions specifically say to do so. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Nasal, skin or eye irritation; coughing or breathing irritation; allergic reactions may occur.

Precautions
Keep away from children. Do not swallow, as camphor and concentrated aromatic ingredients can be harmful if ingested. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction occurs. Seek medical advice if nasal symptoms persist or worsen.

title: Nozeesyn-Xylo Nasal Spray (10Ml) Xylometazoline 0.1% w/v Nasal Spray by Aristo

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Xylometazoline nasal drops or spray provide short-term relief from a blocked or stuffy nose due to colds, sinus congestion or allergic rhinitis.

How does it work?
It narrows swollen blood vessels inside the nose, reducing swelling and helping air pass more easily.

How to take/use it
Use only in the nose and follow the product label or prescriber’s instructions. Do not swallow it, share it with others, or use it for longer than recommended, as prolonged use can worsen nasal blockage.

Common side effects
Nasal dryness, irritation, burning or discomfort, sneezing, headache, or a temporary increase in congestion after the effect wears off.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, overactive thyroid, diabetes, glaucoma, or use of certain antidepressants such as MAO inhibitors. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Stop and seek advice if symptoms persist or worsen.

title: Ofler Eye Drop (10ml) Ofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Benzalkonium 0.02% w/v Eye Drops by Aristo

searchText: Ofler Eye Drop (10ml) Ofloxacin 0.3% w/v, Benzalkonium 0.02% w/v Eye Drops by Aristo Aristo 48000271
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This antibacterial solution is used to treat bacterial infections of the eye. It should be used for ear infections only if specifically prescribed for that purpose.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin stops the growth of susceptible bacteria by interfering with enzymes needed for bacterial DNA. Benzalkonium helps preserve the solution.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. If used in the eye, wash hands before use, avoid touching the dropper tip to any surface, and complete the prescribed course. Do not wear contact lenses during treatment unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging or burning, eye irritation, redness, watery eyes, or blurred vision may occur briefly after use.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, vision changes persist, severe pain or swelling develops, or signs of a serious allergic reaction occur. This medicine treats bacterial infections and does not work against viral or fungal infections.

title: Ofloxacin IV (100Ml) Ofloxacin Infusion by Aristo
name: Ofloxacin IV (100Ml) Ofloxacin Infusion by Aristo
searchText: Ofloxacin IV (100Ml) Ofloxacin Infusion by Aristo Aristo 48000313
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ofloxacin Infusion is an antibiotic used in hospitals to treat serious bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills bacteria by blocking enzymes needed for bacterial DNA replication, stopping the infection from spreading.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given slowly into a vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function and medical advice. Do not stop treatment early unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and pain or irritation at the infusion site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies to ofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics, kidney disease, heart rhythm problems, seizures, diabetes, nerve disorders or a history of tendon problems. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe mood or nerve-related symptoms, rash, breathing difficulty or fainting. Use during pregnancy, breastfeeding and in children only when specifically prescribed. Avoid driving if dizzy or affected by vision or nervous-system symptoms.

title: Olsmile 40 Tab (10x15) Olmesartan 40 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Olsmile 40 Tab (10x15) Olmesartan 40 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Olsmile 40 Tab (10x15) Olmesartan 40 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000112
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Olmesartan is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). Controlling blood pressure helps reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke and kidney problems.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of a hormone that narrows blood vessels. This helps the blood vessels relax, allowing blood to flow more easily and lowering blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day, with or without food. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not stop treatment or change the dose without medical advice. If a dose is missed, follow the instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, diarrhoea, nausea and tiredness may occur. Contact a doctor if side effects are severe or persistent.

Precautions
Do not use during pregnancy, especially after the first trimester, unless specifically advised by a doctor. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, or if taking medicines or supplements that may increase potassium. Blood pressure, kidney function and potassium levels may need monitoring. Seek urgent medical help for swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat or difficulty breathing.

What is it used for?
Used for the local care and relief of mouth ulcers and the discomfort associated with them.

How does it work?
The exact action depends on the Ayurvedic ingredients. As a mouth ulcer gel, it is applied directly to the affected area for local action.

How to take/use it
Apply to the mouth ulcer only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands before and after use. Do not use more often or for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
The specific side effects cannot be confirmed without the ingredient list. Stop using it if it causes worsening irritation or an allergic reaction.

Precautions
For oral use only. Avoid use if allergic to any ingredient. Seek medical advice if ulcers are severe, keep recurring, last longer than 2 weeks, or make eating and drinking difficult.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement is used to help prevent or correct deficiencies of certain B vitamins, including riboflavin, folic acid and niacinamide. The lactic acid bacillus may help support the balance of beneficial bacteria in the digestive system.

How does it work?
The B vitamins support energy production, healthy skin and nerves, and normal blood-cell formation. Lactic acid bacillus is a probiotic that helps support healthy gut bacteria.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Mild nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or gas may occur. Seek medical advice if side effects are severe or persistent.

Precautions
Tell a doctor about any allergy to the ingredients. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or if there is a known vitamin B12 deficiency or other medical condition. Do not use it as a substitute for a balanced diet or prescribed treatment.

Its action depends on the exact formulation and ingredients, which are not provided.

Use only according to the instructions on the product label or as advised by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not guess the dose or duration of use.

Product-specific side effects cannot be reliably listed without the complete formulation. Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction or other concerning symptom occurs.

Check the ingredients and intended use before taking it. Ask a doctor or pharmacist for advice during pregnancy, breastfeeding, in children, or if there is a known allergy to papaya or other ingredients.

title: Platigud Tab (10x1x15) Carica Papaya Leaf Extract 1100 mg Tab by Aristo

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Carica papaya leaf extract is a herbal supplement commonly used to support platelet counts during dengue fever. Evidence of benefit is limited, and it must not replace medical evaluation or prescribed dengue treatment.

How does it work?
Its exact mechanism is not fully established. It may influence platelet production, but this effect is not reliably proven.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. During dengue, seek medical care and follow advice about monitoring platelet counts and warning signs.

Common side effects
May cause nausea, stomach discomfort, vomiting or allergic reactions such as rash or itching.

Precautions
Do not use it as a substitute for dengue treatment or urgent medical care. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or if there is liver or kidney disease. Stop use and seek medical help if an allergic reaction occurs. Tell the doctor about its use, especially before surgery or when taking medicines that affect bleeding.

title: Progestify 200 SR Tab (10x10) Progesterone 200 mg SR Tab by Aristo
name: Progestify 200 SR Tab (10x10) Progesterone 200 mg SR Tab by Aristo
searchText: Progestify 200 SR Tab (10x10) Progesterone 200 mg SR Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000297
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Progesterone 200 mg tablets are used to supplement the female hormone progesterone. Depending on the doctor's advice, they may be prescribed for irregular or absent periods, hormone replacement therapy during menopause, or support during fertility treatment and early pregnancy.

How does it work?
It replaces or supplements progesterone, a hormone that helps regulate the menstrual cycle and prepares the lining of the uterus.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet with water and do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. It may cause drowsiness or dizziness, so use caution when driving or operating machinery.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, headache, nausea, abdominal bloating, breast tenderness, and changes in menstrual bleeding.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about unexplained vaginal bleeding, liver disease, a history of blood clots, stroke, or hormone-sensitive cancer before use. Seek medical advice for severe headache, chest pain, breathing difficulty, leg swelling, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or unusual bleeding. Use during pregnancy only when prescribed.

title: Protone Z Syrup (100ml) Multivitamin & Mineral With Zinc Syr by Aristo
name: Protone Z Syrup (100ml) Multivitamin & Mineral With Zinc Syr by Aristo
searchText: Protone Z Syrup (100ml) Multivitamin & Mineral With Zinc Syr by Aristo Aristo 48000337
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement the diet and help prevent or correct vitamin and mineral deficiencies, including zinc deficiency, when dietary intake may be inadequate.

How does it work?
It provides a combination of vitamins and minerals needed for normal body functions such as energy metabolism, immunity, and maintenance of tissues.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, constipation or diarrhoea, and a metallic taste may occur.

Precautions
Check the ingredients if there is an allergy or sensitivity to any vitamin, mineral, or other component. Avoid taking multiple vitamin or mineral supplements together unless advised by a healthcare professional. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in case of kidney or liver disease. Some minerals may interact with medicines such as certain antibiotics or thyroid medicines; seek advice about suitable spacing between doses.

title: Protone Z Syrup (200ml) Multivitamin & Mineral With Zinc Syr by Aristo
name: Protone Z Syrup (200ml) Multivitamin & Mineral With Zinc Syr by Aristo
searchText: Protone Z Syrup (200ml) Multivitamin & Mineral With Zinc Syr by Aristo Aristo 48000304
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement the diet with essential vitamins and minerals, including zinc, and to help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies when dietary intake is inadequate.

How does it work?
It provides vitamins and minerals needed for normal body functions. Zinc supports normal immune function, wound healing and other essential processes.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount or use it together with other multivitamin or mineral supplements unless advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, constipation or diarrhoea, and an unpleasant or metallic taste may occur.

Precautions
Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or if there is a medical condition. Tell the healthcare professional about all medicines being taken, as minerals may affect the absorption of some medicines. Keep out of reach of children; excessive intake can be harmful.

title: Qure IV (100Ml) Levofloxacin Infusion by Aristo
name: Qure IV (100Ml) Levofloxacin Infusion by Aristo
searchText: Qure IV (100Ml) Levofloxacin Infusion by Aristo Aristo 48000295
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levofloxacin infusion is an antibiotic used to treat certain serious bacterial infections, including some infections of the lungs and urinary system. It does not treat viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops bacteria from making the enzymes needed for their growth and multiplication, helping to clear the infection.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given slowly into a vein by a doctor or nurse, usually in a hospital or clinic. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type of infection and kidney function. Do not self-administer or stop treatment early unless advised by the doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, difficulty sleeping, and pain or irritation at the infusion site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, heart rhythm problems, tendon disorders, seizures, diabetes, or myasthenia gravis, and about all medicines being used. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe mood or nerve-related symptoms, palpitations, fainting, or signs of a serious allergic reaction. Avoid strenuous exercise if tendon pain develops.

title: Rabitop DSR Cap (Strip) (20x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR Cap by Aristo
name: Rabitop DSR Cap (Strip) (20x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR Cap by Aristo
searchText: Rabitop DSR Cap (Strip) (20x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR Cap by Aristo Aristo 48000148
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux symptoms. The domperidone component may also help with nausea, bloating and slow stomach emptying associated with these symptoms.

How does it work?
Rabeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Domperidone helps food move through the stomach and may reduce nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed. It is generally taken before food. Swallow the sustained-release capsule or tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not take more or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, constipation, stomach pain, nausea, dry mouth and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver or kidney problems, heart disease, an irregular heartbeat, or a history of low potassium or magnesium. Domperidone can rarely affect heart rhythm, so inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially medicines that affect heart rhythm or certain antibiotics and antifungals. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice. Seek urgent medical help for fainting, fast or irregular heartbeat, vomiting blood or black stools.

title: Rabitop Raft Suspension (Glass Bottle) (200 ml) Sodium Alginate 250 mg, Sodium Bicarbonate 133.5 mg, Calcium Carbonate 80 mg by Aristo
name: Rabitop Raft Suspension (Glass Bottle) (200 ml) Sodium Alginate 250 mg, Sodium Bicarbonate 133.5 mg, Calcium Carbonate 80 mg by Aristo
searchText: Rabitop Raft Suspension (Glass Bottle) (200 ml) Sodium Alginate 250 mg, Sodium Bicarbonate 133.5 mg, Calcium Carbonate 80 mg by Aristo Aristo 48000382
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to relieve symptoms of acid reflux, including heartburn and acid regurgitation.

How does it work?
Sodium alginate forms a protective barrier that helps prevent stomach contents from flowing back into the food pipe. Sodium bicarbonate and calcium carbonate help neutralise stomach acid.

How to take/use it
Use as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. The exact dose and frequency depend on the formulation. Do not exceed the recommended dose.

Common side effects
Possible side effects include nausea, constipation, diarrhoea or stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Consult a doctor before use if you have kidney disease, are on a sodium-restricted diet or have persistent symptoms. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen or do not improve.

title: Ramlo AT Tab (10x2x15) Amlodipine 5 mg, Atenolol 50 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Ramlo AT Tab (10x2x15) Amlodipine 5 mg, Atenolol 50 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Ramlo AT Tab (10x2x15) Amlodipine 5 mg, Atenolol 50 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000225
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amlodipine 5 mg + atenolol 50 mg is mainly used to treat high blood pressure. It may also be prescribed to help prevent chest pain due to angina.

How does it work?
Amlodipine relaxes and widens blood vessels, while atenolol slows the heart rate and reduces the heart’s workload. Together, they help lower blood pressure and reduce strain on the heart.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably at the same time each day. It may be taken with or without food. Do not stop it suddenly without medical advice, especially if it is being used for heart-related problems.

Common side effects
Dizziness, tiredness, headache, flushing, ankle swelling, nausea, low blood pressure, or a slow heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about asthma or other breathing problems, a slow heartbeat, heart block, heart failure, diabetes, kidney disease, liver disease, or pregnancy. Atenolol may hide some warning signs of low blood sugar. Avoid driving if dizzy, and seek medical help for fainting, severe breathing difficulty, or an unusually slow heartbeat.

title: Ramlo Tab (10x30) Amlodipine 5 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Ramlo Tab (10x30) Amlodipine 5 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Ramlo Tab (10x30) Amlodipine 5 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000331
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amlodipine is used to treat high blood pressure. It is also used to help prevent chest pain caused by angina.

How does it work?
It relaxes and widens blood vessels, helping blood flow more easily. This lowers blood pressure and reduces the workload on the heart.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Ankle or foot swelling, headache, dizziness, flushing, tiredness, palpitations, nausea and stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice if there is very low blood pressure, liver disease or heart problems. Rise slowly if dizziness occurs. Seek urgent medical help for severe dizziness, fainting, worsening chest pain or signs of an allergic reaction. Discuss use during pregnancy or breastfeeding with a doctor.

title: Rifaristo 200 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 200 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Rifaristo 200 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 200 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Rifaristo 200 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 200 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000191
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rifaximin 200 mg is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections of the intestine, especially some cases of travellers’ diarrhoea caused by non-invasive bacteria. It should be used only when prescribed, as it is not suitable for every type of diarrhoea.

How does it work?
It acts mainly inside the intestine by stopping susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins needed for their growth.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow the tablet with water. It may be taken with or without food. Complete the prescribed course unless a healthcare professional advises otherwise. Do not self-medicate for diarrhoea.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain or discomfort, bloating, gas, headache and dizziness.

Precautions
Do not use it if there is an allergy to rifaximin or other rifamycin antibiotics. Seek medical advice if diarrhoea is accompanied by fever or blood, becomes severe, or does not improve. Tell the doctor about liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and about all other medicines being taken. Stop the medicine and seek urgent help for signs of a serious allergic reaction or severe, persistent diarrhoea.

title: Rifaristo 400 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 400 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Rifaristo 400 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 400 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Rifaristo 400 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 400 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000192
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rifaximin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections in the intestine, including some cases of infectious or traveller’s diarrhoea. It may also be prescribed for other conditions, such as reducing episodes of hepatic encephalopathy, depending on the doctor’s assessment.

How does it work?
It acts mainly inside the intestine and stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which prevents them from growing. Very little of the medicine is absorbed into the bloodstream.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not use it for diarrhoea unless a healthcare professional has advised it.

Common side effects
Nausea, abdominal pain or discomfort, bloating, constipation, headache and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it if allergic to rifaximin or other rifamycin antibiotics. Seek medical advice for diarrhoea with blood, high fever, severe abdominal pain, dehydration or symptoms that do not improve. Tell the doctor about liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Stop treatment and seek urgent help if severe rash, swelling or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Rifaristo 550 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 550 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Rifaristo 550 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 550 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Rifaristo 550 Tab (10x1x10) Rifaximin 550 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000193
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rifaximin 550 mg is used to reduce the risk of repeated episodes of hepatic encephalopathy in adults with liver disease. It may also be prescribed for irritable bowel syndrome with diarrhoea (IBS-D), under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It is a gut-acting antibiotic that reduces the growth of certain bacteria in the intestines. This can help reduce the production of substances linked with hepatic encephalopathy and improve diarrhoea-related symptoms in some patients.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water; it may generally be taken with or without food. Do not self-treat diarrhoea with this medicine or change the prescribed treatment duration.

Common side effects
Nausea, abdominal pain or bloating, headache, dizziness, constipation, and tiredness may occur. Seek medical advice if side effects are severe or persistent.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergy to rifaximin or other rifamycin antibiotics, liver disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Contact a doctor promptly for severe or persistent diarrhoea, fever, blood or mucus in the stool, or worsening symptoms, as antibiotic-associated diarrhoea can occur. Use only under medical supervision, especially in severe liver impairment.

title: Rozysto 10 Tab (10x2x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg Tab by Aristo
name: Rozysto 10 Tab (10x2x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg Tab by Aristo
searchText: Rozysto 10 Tab (10x2x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg Tab by Aristo Aristo 48000374
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rosuvastatin is used to lower high cholesterol, particularly LDL (bad) cholesterol, and to reduce cardiovascular risk in eligible patients.

How does it work?
It reduces cholesterol production in the liver, which lowers LDL cholesterol in the blood.

How to take/use it
Take as prescribed by a doctor, with or without food. Do not stop taking it without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, constipation and muscle pain may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about liver or kidney problems, thyroid disorders and other medicines. Seek medical advice promptly for unexplained muscle pain or weakness. Rosuvastatin should generally be avoided during pregnancy.

title: Rozysto-F10 Tab (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg by Aristo
name: Rozysto-F10 Tab (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg by Aristo
searchText: Rozysto-F10 Tab (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg by Aristo Aristo 48000376
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to manage abnormal blood cholesterol and triglyceride levels when a doctor considers both medicines necessary.

How does it work?
Rosuvastatin reduces cholesterol production in the liver. Fenofibrate helps lower triglycerides and can increase HDL (good) cholesterol.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed by a doctor. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Possible side effects include muscle pain, headache, nausea and stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems and all other medicines being taken. Seek medical help promptly for unexplained muscle pain, tenderness or weakness, especially with fever or dark urine.

title: Rozysto Gold 10 Cap (10x10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Clopidogrel 75 mg, Aspirin 75 mg Cap by Aristo
name: Rozysto Gold 10 Cap (10x10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Clopidogrel 75 mg, Aspirin 75 mg Cap by Aristo
searchText: Rozysto Gold 10 Cap (10x10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Clopidogrel 75 mg, Aspirin 75 mg Cap by Aristo Aristo 48000377
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is prescribed for selected patients to lower cholesterol and help prevent blood clots that can cause heart attack or stroke.

How does it work?
Rosuvastatin lowers LDL cholesterol. Clopidogrel and aspirin reduce platelet clumping, helping prevent blood clots.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Do not stop clopidogrel or aspirin without medical advice.

Common side effects
Stomach discomfort, nausea, easy bruising and bleeding may occur. Muscle pain may also occur.

Precautions
This medicine increases bleeding risk. Inform the doctor about ulcers, bleeding disorders and other medicines, especially blood thinners and painkillers. Seek urgent medical help for severe bleeding, black stools or vomiting blood.
