What is it used for?
Piperacillin and tazobactam is an antibiotic injection used to treat serious bacterial infections, such as certain infections of the lungs, abdomen, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, and bloodstream. It is usually used in hospitals or under close medical supervision.

How does it work?
Piperacillin kills bacteria by stopping them from building their protective cell wall. Tazobactam helps protect piperacillin from enzymes made by some bacteria, allowing it to work against a wider range of infections.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given into a vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection and kidney function. Do not self-administer it, and complete the prescribed course unless the doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, headache, skin rash, and pain or irritation at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to penicillin, cephalosporin or other antibiotics, kidney problems, or previous antibiotic-related diarrhoea. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Telmisartan is used to treat high blood pressure. Controlling blood pressure helps reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke and other blood vessel problems.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of angiotensin II, a substance that narrows blood vessels. This helps the blood vessels relax and lowers blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor, with or without food. Take it regularly and do not stop it without medical advice. If a dose is missed, follow the instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, diarrhoea, back pain and low blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney or liver disease, dehydration, or high potassium levels. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised by a doctor. Telmisartan 40 mg is mainly used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). It may also be prescribed to help reduce the risk of certain cardiovascular problems in some adults.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of angiotensin II, a substance that narrows blood vessels and raises blood pressure. This helps relax the blood vessels and lower blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed, preferably at the same time each day. It may be taken with or without food. Do not stop taking it without medical advice.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, diarrhoea, back pain and tiredness may occur. Dizziness may be more likely when starting treatment or when standing up suddenly.

Precautions
Do not use during pregnancy; tell the doctor immediately if pregnancy occurs. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve painful menstrual cramps and the associated lower abdominal pain or spasms.

How does it work?
Dicyclomine relaxes the muscles of the abdomen and uterus to reduce spasms. Mefenamic acid reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor, preferably with or after food and with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen or aspirin unless advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or constipation, dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness and blurred vision.

Precautions
Avoid use or seek medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or bowel obstruction. Do not use during pregnancy, especially after 20 weeks, unless prescribed. Avoid alcohol and driving if dizzy, drowsy or experiencing blurred vision. Seek urgent help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash.

What is it used for?
Permethrin Lotion 5% is used to treat scabies, a skin infestation caused by tiny mites. It kills the mites and helps stop the infestation from spreading.

How does it work?
It acts on the nervous system of scabies mites, causing them to die. It also helps kill mite eggs.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to the skin exactly as directed by the doctor or product instructions. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and wash hands after applying. Do not apply more often or use for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Temporary itching, redness, burning, stinging, tingling or a mild rash may occur after application.

Precautions
Do not swallow or use near the eyes or inside the mouth. Avoid applying to severely irritated or broken skin unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical advice if symptoms do not improve, become worse, or if severe skin irritation occurs. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in young children.

What is it used for?
Cefpodoxime is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the ears, throat, sinuses, chest, urinary tract and skin. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from forming their protective cell wall, which stops the infection from growing.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Prepare the suspension with water exactly as directed on the label or by the pharmacist. Shake well before each use and measure with an oral syringe or measuring spoon. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not use leftover antibiotics or share this medicine.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and headache. Skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any previous allergy to cefpodoxime, cephalosporins, penicillins or other antibiotics. Dose adjustment may be needed in kidney disease. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, blood or mucus in stools, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash. Use only for a confirmed or strongly suspected bacterial infection.

What is it used for?
Pregabalin is used to treat nerve pain, such as pain caused by diabetes, shingles or injury. It may also be used with other medicines to help control certain types of seizures. In some cases, it is prescribed for generalised anxiety disorder.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of certain chemicals involved in pain signals and excessive nerve activity in the brain.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow the capsule whole with water, with or without food. Do not stop taking it suddenly; the dose usually needs to be reduced gradually under medical supervision. The dose may need adjustment in kidney problems.

Common side effects
Dizziness, sleepiness, blurred vision, headache, dry mouth, tiredness, swelling of the hands or feet, increased appetite and weight gain.

Precautions
It may cause dizziness or drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol and tell the doctor about opioid or other sedative use, as breathing problems may occur. Seek urgent help for swelling of the face, lips or tongue, breathing difficulty, or severe rash. Tell the doctor about kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or any history of dependence on medicines. Report new or worsening depression or thoughts of self-harm.

How does it work?
Pregabalin reduces abnormal pain signals from damaged or overactive nerves. Methylcobalamin is a form of vitamin B12 that supports normal nerve health.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food, and swallow the capsule whole with water. Do not stop it suddenly without medical advice. Avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known.

Common side effects
Dizziness, sleepiness, blurred or double vision, tiredness, dry mouth, constipation, swelling of the hands or feet, and weight gain.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol because it can increase sleepiness and dizziness. Use only under medical advice if there is kidney disease, breathing difficulty, or a history of drug dependence. Seek urgent medical help for facial or throat swelling, severe breathing difficulty, or a serious skin rash. Report unusual mood changes or thoughts of self-harm promptly. Do not stop treatment suddenly without medical advice.

What is it used for?
Sitagliptin is used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes. It may be used alone or with other diabetes medicines. It is not used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis.

How does it work?
It blocks an enzyme called DPP-4, helping the body release more insulin after meals and reduce excess glucose production by the liver. This helps lower blood sugar levels.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Take it regularly and do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. A dose adjustment may be needed in kidney disease. If taken with insulin or certain other diabetes medicines, follow medical advice about the risk of low blood sugar.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach discomfort, and cold-like symptoms such as a stuffy or runny nose or sore throat. Low blood sugar may occur, especially when used with insulin or sulfonylureas.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about kidney disease, previous pancreatitis, or allergies to this medicine. Seek urgent medical help for severe or persistent stomach pain, swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty, severe skin reactions, or severe joint pain. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

It is an antiplatelet medicine that stops blood cells called platelets from sticking together and forming harmful clots.

Take it exactly as prescribed and at the same times each day. Swallow the tablet with water; it may usually be taken with or without food. Precautions

Tell the doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines, especially anticoagulants, other antiplatelet medicines, NSAID painkillers and medicines that affect ticagrelor levels. title: Acnecidol 0.1% Foaming Facewash New (100ml) Acnebuster +Salicylic Acid+Glycolic Acid by Csc
name: Acnecidol 0.1% Foaming Facewash New (100ml) Acnebuster +Salicylic Acid+Glycolic Acid by Csc
searchText: Acnecidol 0.1% Foaming Facewash New (100ml) Acnebuster +Salicylic Acid+Glycolic Acid by Csc CSC I0647
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Acnebuster containing salicylic acid and glycolic acid is used for acne-prone skin. It may help unclog pores, reduce blackheads and whiteheads, and improve rough or uneven skin texture.

How does it work?
Salicylic acid helps remove excess oil and dead skin from inside pores. Glycolic acid exfoliates the skin surface, helping prevent pore blockage and improve skin texture.

How to take/use it
Use on clean, dry skin exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, lips and other sensitive areas. Wash hands after use unless the hands are being treated.

Common side effects
Dryness, peeling, redness, stinging, burning or skin irritation may occur, especially when starting treatment.

Precautions
For external use only. Do not apply to broken, sunburned or irritated skin. Avoid using it with other strong exfoliants or irritating acne products unless advised by a healthcare professional. Glycolic acid can increase sensitivity to sunlight; use sun protection and limit sun exposure. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Acnecidol 0.1% Foaming Facewash New (110ml) Salicylic Acid, Glycolic Acid 0.1% Foaming Facewash by Csc
name: Acnecidol 0.1% Foaming Facewash New (110ml) Salicylic Acid, Glycolic Acid 0.1% Foaming Facewash by Csc
searchText: Acnecidol 0.1% Foaming Facewash New (110ml) Salicylic Acid, Glycolic Acid 0.1% Foaming Facewash by Csc CSC I0311
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Acnebuster containing salicylic acid and glycolic acid is a topical product used to help manage acne, pimples, clogged pores and excess dead skin on the face or other affected areas.

How does it work?
Salicylic acid helps unclog pores and remove excess oil and dead skin. Glycolic acid exfoliates the skin surface, helping improve blocked pores and uneven skin texture.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry, affected skin as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, lips and other sensitive areas. Wash hands after use.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, dryness, redness, irritation, peeling or burning may occur, especially when starting treatment.

Precautions
Avoid using on broken, sunburned or irritated skin. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs. Use sun protection, as these ingredients may increase sensitivity to sunlight. Avoid combining with other harsh exfoliating or irritating skin products unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Acnecidol 3% Acne Vanish Gel (10 gm ) Tretinoin 0.5%, Niacinamide 5%, Glycolic Acid 3% Gel by Csc
name: Acnecidol 3% Acne Vanish Gel (10 gm ) Tretinoin 0.5%, Niacinamide 5%, Glycolic Acid 3% Gel by Csc
searchText: Acnecidol 3% Acne Vanish Gel (10 gm ) Tretinoin 0.5%, Niacinamide 5%, Glycolic Acid 3% Gel by Csc CSC I0046
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical medicine is primarily used to help manage acne, unclog pores and improve uneven skin texture. It may also help reduce the appearance of mild dark spots and uneven pigmentation.

How does it work?
ATRA (tretinoin) increases skin cell turnover and helps prevent blocked pores. Glycolic acid exfoliates the skin, while niacinamide helps support the skin barrier and reduce irritation.

How to take/use it
For skin use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, completely dry skin exactly as directed by the doctor or product instructions. Avoid the eyes, lips, nostrils and broken or irritated skin. Use sunscreen during the day.

Common side effects
Dryness, redness, peeling, burning, stinging, itching and increased sensitivity to sunlight may occur, especially during the first few weeks.

Precautions
Avoid excessive sun exposure and use sunscreen regularly. Do not use on sunburned, broken or severely irritated skin. Avoid combining it with other irritating exfoliants or acne treatments unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or blistering occurs. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Age- Less Face Serum (30 ml ) Peptide Complex 5.5%, Lactobionic Acid, Polydeoxyribonucleotide 500 ppm Serum by Csc
name: Age- Less Face Serum (30 ml ) Peptide Complex 5.5%, Lactobionic Acid, Polydeoxyribonucleotide 500 ppm Serum by Csc
searchText: Age- Less Face Serum (30 ml ) Peptide Complex 5.5%, Lactobionic Acid, Polydeoxyribonucleotide 500 ppm Serum by Csc CSC I0945
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This is a topical skincare product intended to support skin hydration, smoothness and overall appearance. It is not enough information to confirm treatment of a specific skin disease or medical condition.

How does it work?
It contains peptides, lactobionic acid and PDRN. These ingredients are used in skincare formulations to help improve the appearance and feel of the skin, while lactobionic acid provides gentle exfoliating action.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes and broken or irritated skin. Patch-test before wider use and use sun protection during the day.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, dryness or irritation may occur, particularly in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Stop use if significant irritation, swelling or rash develops. Avoid using on damaged skin. Use cautiously with other exfoliating or irritating skincare products. Seek medical advice for persistent or severe skin reactions.

title: AHA BHA Acne Facewash (100g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Charcoal Beads Facewash by Csc
name: AHA BHA Acne Facewash (100g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Charcoal Beads Facewash by Csc
searchText: AHA BHA Acne Facewash (100g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Charcoal Beads Facewash by Csc CSC I0906
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a topical skincare product to exfoliate the skin, remove dead skin cells and help unclog pores. It may be useful for oily or blemish-prone skin.

How does it work?
Glycolic acid loosens dead skin cells on the surface, while salicylic acid helps clear oil and debris from pores. Charcoal beads provide a physical cleansing and exfoliating action.

How to take/use it
Use only on the skin and follow the product label instructions. Avoid contact with the eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Do not use more often than directed.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, dryness, redness, irritation or peeling may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before wider use. Stop use if severe irritation develops. Use sun protection, as glycolic acid can increase sensitivity to sunlight. Avoid combining with other strong exfoliants or irritating skincare products unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: AHA BHA Acne Facewash (60g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Vitamin E Facewash by Csc
name: AHA BHA Acne Facewash (60g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Vitamin E Facewash by Csc
searchText: AHA BHA Acne Facewash (60g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Vitamin E Facewash by Csc CSC I0061
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for cleansing and gentle exfoliation of oily or acne-prone skin. It may help remove dead skin cells, unclog pores and reduce acne-related breakouts.

How does it work?
Glycolic acid exfoliates the skin surface, while salicylic acid helps loosen dead skin and oil from clogged pores. Vitamin E helps provide antioxidant support.

How to take/use it
Use externally as directed on the product label. Apply to wet skin, gently massage and rinse thoroughly. Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes.

Common side effects
Dryness, stinging, redness, irritation or peeling may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before regular use. Avoid applying to broken, irritated or sunburned skin. Stop use if severe irritation develops. These acids can increase sun sensitivity; use suitable sun protection and limit excessive sun exposure.

title: AHA BHA Acne Facewash Sachet (10g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Charcoal Beads Face Wash by Csc
name: AHA BHA Acne Facewash Sachet (10g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Charcoal Beads Face Wash by Csc
searchText: AHA BHA Acne Facewash Sachet (10g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Charcoal Beads Face Wash by Csc CSC I0443
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used topically to exfoliate the skin, remove excess oil and unclog pores. It may help improve acne-prone skin, blackheads and rough or uneven skin texture.

How does it work?
Salicylic acid helps loosen dead skin and clear blocked pores, while glycolic acid exfoliates the skin surface. Charcoal beads help cleanse and remove surface impurities.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Apply gently to the affected skin and avoid the eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Rinse thoroughly if it is a rinse-off product.

Common side effects
Dryness, stinging, redness, burning, peeling or skin irritation may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before use. Avoid using on broken, sunburned or irritated skin. Do not combine with other strong exfoliants or acne treatments unless advised by a healthcare professional. Use sunscreen, as these acids can increase sensitivity to sunlight. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Alkatech (100ml) Disodium Hydrogen Citrate 1.53 g by Csc
name: Alkatech (100ml) Disodium Hydrogen Citrate 1.53 g by Csc
searchText: Alkatech (100ml) Disodium Hydrogen Citrate 1.53 g by Csc CSC I0332
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Disodium hydrogen citrate is used to make urine less acidic. It may help relieve burning or discomfort during urination and may be used as part of treatment for uric acid kidney stones or gout, as advised by a doctor.

How does it work?
It is converted into alkaline substances in the body, which increase the pH of urine and reduce its acidity.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor or pharmacist. If supplied as a liquid, measure the dose carefully and dilute it only as directed. Do not change the dose or treatment duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, or a bloated feeling may occur.

Precautions
Use only with medical advice if there is kidney disease, heart failure, high blood pressure, or a need to restrict sodium. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, or other medicines being taken. Seek medical care for fever, severe back or side pain, blood in the urine, or symptoms that do not improve.

title: Amotus DX (100 ml ) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg by Csc
name: Amotus DX (100 ml ) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg by Csc
searchText: Amotus DX (100 ml ) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg by Csc CSC I0813
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve dry cough associated with cold or allergy symptoms. It may also help reduce sneezing, runny nose and watery eyes.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the cough reflex. Chlorpheniramine is an antihistamine that reduces allergy-related symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the label or by a doctor. Use the measuring device supplied if it is a liquid, and do not take more than the recommended amount. Do not combine with other cough, cold or antihistamine medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and constipation may occur.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) medicines, and check with a doctor before use with antidepressants or other medicines that cause drowsiness. Seek medical advice for breathing difficulty, a persistent cough, or a cough with large amounts of phlegm. Use medical advice in children, older adults, glaucoma, prostate or urinary problems, and during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Argilift (6.5gm ) L-Arginine 3 g, Proanthocyanidin 75 mg by Csc
name: Argilift (6.5gm ) L-Arginine 3 g, Proanthocyanidin 75 mg by Csc
searchText: Argilift (6.5gm ) L-Arginine 3 g, Proanthocyanidin 75 mg by Csc CSC I0327
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This product is used as a nutritional supplement providing L-arginine and proanthocyanidins. It may support nitric oxide production, blood-vessel function and antioxidant protection. The exact medical use should be confirmed with a doctor or pharmacist.

How does it work?
L-arginine is used by the body to produce nitric oxide, which helps blood vessels relax. Proanthocyanidins are antioxidant plant compounds that help protect cells from oxidative damage.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not exceed the recommended amount, as the correct dose and duration depend on the intended use.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness or a drop in blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is low blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, or a history of herpes infections. Consult a doctor before using with blood-pressure medicines, nitrates or erectile-dysfunction medicines, as blood pressure may fall further. Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should use it only on medical advice.

title: Asthazin AG (100ml) Levosalbutamol, Ambroxol, Guaiphenesin Syr by Csc
name: Asthazin AG (100ml) Levosalbutamol, Ambroxol, Guaiphenesin Syr by Csc
searchText: Asthazin AG (100ml) Levosalbutamol, Ambroxol, Guaiphenesin Syr by Csc CSC I0002
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This syrup is used to relieve cough with phlegm and may help ease wheezing or chest tightness in certain respiratory conditions.

How does it work?
Levosalbutamol relaxes the muscles of the airways to improve breathing. Ambroxol thins and loosens mucus, while guaiphenesin helps clear phlegm from the airways.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed or as directed on the label. Shake the bottle well before use and measure each dose with the provided measuring cup or spoon. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, trembling or nervousness, and a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use cautiously and seek medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, or a history of seizures. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical attention for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, a very fast or irregular heartbeat, or a cough that persists or worsens.

title: Atordil 10 (20x10) Atorvastatin 10 mg by Csc
name: Atordil 10 (20x10) Atorvastatin 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Atordil 10 (20x10) Atorvastatin 10 mg by Csc CSC I0003
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Atorvastatin is used to lower high cholesterol, especially “bad” LDL cholesterol and triglycerides. It also helps reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke in people at increased cardiovascular risk.

How does it work?
It reduces the liver’s production of cholesterol by blocking an enzyme involved in cholesterol formation. This helps lower cholesterol levels in the blood.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Take it regularly and do not stop treatment without medical advice. Continue recommended diet, exercise and follow-up blood tests.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, diarrhoea, indigestion and muscle aches or pain may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, heavy alcohol use, thyroid problems or a history of muscle problems. Seek medical advice promptly for unexplained or severe muscle pain, weakness, fever or dark urine. It is not usually used during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Tell the doctor about all other medicines, including certain antibiotics, antifungals and cholesterol medicines, because interactions can increase side effects.

title: Atordil 20 (20x10) Atorvastatin 20 mg by Csc
name: Atordil 20 (20x10) Atorvastatin 20 mg by Csc
searchText: Atordil 20 (20x10) Atorvastatin 20 mg by Csc CSC I0004
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Atorvastatin is used to lower high cholesterol, especially LDL (bad) cholesterol, and to help reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke in people at increased cardiovascular risk.

How does it work?
It blocks an enzyme involved in making cholesterol in the liver. This lowers LDL cholesterol and helps reduce the build-up of fatty deposits in blood vessels.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed, with or without food, preferably at the same time each day. Continue dietary and lifestyle advice given by the doctor. Do not stop it without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, indigestion, diarrhoea, and muscle aches or pain may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, heavy alcohol use, or any unexplained muscle pain or weakness. Seek medical advice promptly for severe muscle pain, weakness, or dark urine. It is generally avoided during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines, as some can interact with atorvastatin.

title: Axicold P Drops (15ml) Phenylephrine, Chlorpheniramine, Paracetamol Drops by Csc
name: Axicold P Drops (15ml) Phenylephrine, Chlorpheniramine, Paracetamol Drops by Csc
searchText: Axicold P Drops (15ml) Phenylephrine, Chlorpheniramine, Paracetamol Drops by Csc CSC I0005
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold symptoms such as blocked or runny nose, sneezing, fever, headache and body aches.

How does it work?
Phenylephrine helps reduce nasal congestion, while chlorpheniramine (CPM) helps relieve sneezing and a runny nose. Paracetamol helps reduce fever and relieve pain.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the label or by a doctor. Measure the drops carefully using the supplied dropper. Do not use with other paracetamol-containing or cold medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dry mouth, dizziness, nausea, stomach discomfort, headache, or palpitations may occur.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol if affected. Seek medical advice before use in high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, overactive thyroid, difficulty passing urine, liver disease, or when taking sedatives. Do not exceed the recommended amount, as too much paracetamol can seriously damage the liver.

title: Axipar SP (10x1x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Serratiopeptidase 15 mg by Csc
name: Axipar SP (10x1x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Serratiopeptidase 15 mg by Csc
searchText: Axipar SP (10x1x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Serratiopeptidase 15 mg by Csc CSC I0006
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and swelling, especially in muscle, joint and other musculoskeletal conditions.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac reduces substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps relieve pain, while serratiopeptidase may help reduce swelling.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by a doctor. It is usually taken after food to reduce stomach irritation. Do not take more than the prescribed amount, and do not combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol or anti-inflammatory painkillers unless advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, liver or kidney disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, bleeding problems, or allergy to anti-inflammatory medicines or paracetamol. Avoid excessive alcohol. Use during pregnancy, especially the last three months, only on medical advice. Seek urgent help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin rash, facial swelling or breathing difficulty.

title: Bakuchiol (Pure)1% Age-Renew Cream (25 gm ) Bakuchiol 1%, Copper Tripeptide-1 2000 ppm, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 2% Cream by Csc
name: Bakuchiol (Pure)1% Age-Renew Cream (25 gm ) Bakuchiol 1%, Copper Tripeptide-1 2000 ppm, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 2% Cream by Csc
searchText: Bakuchiol (Pure)1% Age-Renew Cream (25 gm ) Bakuchiol 1%, Copper Tripeptide-1 2000 ppm, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 2% Cream by Csc CSC .
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Intended to help improve the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and uneven skin texture.

How does it work?
Bakuchiol is used in skincare for retinol-like cosmetic effects. Peptides are skin-conditioning ingredients.

How to take/use it
Apply to clean skin according to the product label. Patch-test before regular use and avoid the eyes.

Common side effects
Redness, itching, irritation or sensitivity may occur.

Precautions
Stop use if irritation develops. Seek professional advice if pregnant or breastfeeding.

title: Beclogen CG (10g) Beclomethasone 0.25%, Clotrimazole 1%, Neomycin 0.5% by Csc
name: Beclogen CG (10g) Beclomethasone 0.25%, Clotrimazole 1%, Neomycin 0.5% by Csc
searchText: Beclogen CG (10g) Beclomethasone 0.25%, Clotrimazole 1%, Neomycin 0.5% by Csc CSC I0007
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used on the skin to treat fungal skin infections, especially when there is inflammation and a possible secondary bacterial infection. Use it only for the condition diagnosed or advised by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Clotrimazole kills or stops the growth of fungi. Beclomethasone reduces redness, swelling and itching, while neomycin helps control susceptible bacterial infections.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean and dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer as directed by a healthcare professional. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Do not cover the area with a tight or airtight dressing unless advised.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, irritation, itching, dryness or redness may occur at the application site. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the nose. Do not use on large areas, broken skin or for prolonged periods unless prescribed. Stop using it and seek medical advice if the infection worsens, the skin becomes severely irritated, or there is no improvement. Avoid use if allergic to any of its ingredients, including neomycin. Do not use for untreated viral skin infections or ordinary acne unless specifically advised.

title: Bella Aloe Vera Gel (50ml) Aloe Vera Gel 90%, Neem Gel by Csc
name: Bella Aloe Vera Gel (50ml) Aloe Vera Gel 90%, Neem Gel by Csc
searchText: Bella Aloe Vera Gel (50ml) Aloe Vera Gel 90%, Neem Gel by Csc CSC I0008
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Aloe vera gel with neem is used topically to moisturise and soothe dry or mildly irritated skin. It may also provide a cooling sensation after minor skin discomfort.

How does it work?
Aloe vera helps hydrate and soothe the skin. The gel forms a light layer over the skin, helping reduce dryness and discomfort.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes and wash hands after use.

Common side effects
Mild burning, redness, itching or skin irritation may occur, especially in people with sensitive skin.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to aloe vera, neem or any ingredient. Test on a small area first and stop use if irritation or an allergic reaction develops. Do not apply to deep wounds, serious burns or infected skin without medical advice. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Bella Neem Facewash (60g) Neem, Aloe Vera, Papaya Extract, Cucumber Extract Facewash by Csc
name: Bella Neem Facewash (60g) Neem, Aloe Vera, Papaya Extract, Cucumber Extract Facewash by Csc
searchText: Bella Neem Facewash (60g) Neem, Aloe Vera, Papaya Extract, Cucumber Extract Facewash by Csc CSC I0009
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for gently cleansing the face and removing dirt, oil and impurities. It is a cosmetic facewash and is not a treatment for acne or other skin diseases.

How does it work?
The cleanser helps remove dirt and excess oil from the skin surface. The plant extracts may provide a refreshing and soothing feel, but their specific effects depend on the formulation.

How to take/use it
Wet the face, apply a small amount, gently massage, and rinse thoroughly with water. Use only as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Some people may experience skin dryness, redness, itching or irritation.

Precautions
For external use only. Perform a patch test before regular use, especially if the skin is sensitive. Avoid contact with the eyes and broken or irritated skin. Stop use if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Neem With Aloe Vera Soap is used for cleansing the skin and removing dirt, oil and sweat during bathing. It is a personal-care soap and is not a treatment for a specific skin infection or disease.

How does it work?
Soap cleans the skin by loosening dirt, oil and other impurities so they can be rinsed away with water.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Wet the skin, apply the soap to form a lather, rinse thoroughly and avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
May cause skin dryness, irritation, redness or itching in some people.

Precautions
Avoid use on the eyes, inside the mouth or on broken skin. Stop using it if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Seek medical advice if a skin problem persists or worsens.

title: Betacos 16 (20x10) Betahistine 16 mg by Csc
name: Betacos 16 (20x10) Betahistine 16 mg by Csc
searchText: Betacos 16 (20x10) Betahistine 16 mg by Csc CSC I0436
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Betahistine is used to relieve vertigo (a spinning or dizzy sensation), especially vertigo associated with Ménière’s disease. It may also help reduce related symptoms such as ringing in the ears, hearing difficulty and nausea.

How does it work?
It acts on histamine receptors and may improve blood flow and pressure balance in the inner ear, helping reduce vertigo and related symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, preferably with or after food if it causes stomach upset. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort or bloating.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is asthma, a history of stomach ulcers, or an allergy to betahistine. It should not be used in people with pheochromocytoma unless specifically advised by a doctor. Seek urgent medical help for swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty or a severe skin reaction.

title: Betacos 8 (20x10) Betahistine 8 mg by Csc
name: Betacos 8 (20x10) Betahistine 8 mg by Csc
searchText: Betacos 8 (20x10) Betahistine 8 mg by Csc CSC I0422
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Betahistine is used to reduce vertigo (a spinning or dizzy sensation) associated with Ménière’s disease. It may also help relieve related symptoms such as ringing in the ears and hearing difficulty.

How does it work?
It acts on histamine receptors and helps improve blood flow and pressure regulation in the inner ear, which can reduce dizziness and other Ménière’s disease symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. It is usually taken by mouth, preferably with or after food to reduce stomach upset. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort, bloating, headache, or mild stomach pain.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer, asthma, or allergy to betahistine. It should not be used in people with pheochromocytoma unless specifically advised by a specialist. Seek medical help for swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty, or a severe skin rash. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Betatech C (30 gm ) Betamethasone 0.10%, Clioquinol 3.00% by Csc
name: Betatech C (30 gm ) Betamethasone 0.10%, Clioquinol 3.00% by Csc
searchText: Betatech C (30 gm ) Betamethasone 0.10%, Clioquinol 3.00% by Csc CSC I0935
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for inflamed skin conditions, such as eczema or dermatitis, when there may also be a bacterial or fungal skin infection. It helps reduce redness, swelling and itching while controlling certain germs on the skin.

How does it work?
Betamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces skin inflammation and itching. Clioquinol helps control certain bacteria and fungi that can cause or worsen skin infections.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after applying, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid covering the area with bandages or tight dressings unless specifically advised.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, irritation, dryness or itching may occur. Prolonged or repeated use can cause skin thinning or other skin changes.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the nose. Do not use on the face, broken skin, large areas or under occlusive dressings unless advised by a healthcare professional. Avoid prolonged use, especially in children. Seek medical advice if the skin condition worsens, spreads or does not improve, or if a severe rash or allergic reaction develops.

title: Betatech N (25 gm ) Betamethasone 0.10%, Neomycin Sulphate 0.50% by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for inflamed skin conditions such as eczema or dermatitis when there is also a bacterial skin infection. It helps reduce redness, swelling, itching and bacterial infection.

How does it work?
Betamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces skin inflammation and itching. Neomycin is an antibiotic that helps control susceptible bacteria on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid covering the area with a tight dressing unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Mild burning, irritation, itching or redness may occur. Prolonged or repeated use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or changes in skin colour. Neomycin may cause an allergic skin reaction.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not use on fungal or viral skin infections, acne, or untreated skin infections unless specifically advised. Avoid prolonged use, large areas, broken skin, the face, groin and skin folds unless prescribed. Stop using it and seek medical advice if the rash worsens or a severe irritation or allergic reaction develops. Use in children only under medical advice.

title: Betogen (20 gm ) Betamethasone Dipropionate, Gentamicin Cream by Csc
name: Betogen (20 gm ) Betamethasone Dipropionate, Gentamicin Cream by Csc
searchText: Betogen (20 gm ) Betamethasone Dipropionate, Gentamicin Cream by Csc CSC I0934
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on inflamed skin conditions where a bacterial infection is present or suspected, such as infected dermatitis or eczema. It helps reduce redness, swelling, itching and bacterial infection.

How does it work?
Betamethasone reduces skin inflammation and itching. Gentamicin is an antibiotic that acts against susceptible bacteria on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin exactly as directed by the doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Do not cover the area with a bandage or dressing unless advised.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, irritation, dryness or redness at the application site. Prolonged or repeated use may cause skin thinning or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Do not use on untreated fungal or viral skin infections unless specifically advised. Avoid prolonged use, large amounts or use on large areas without medical advice. Do not use on the face, groin or skin folds unless prescribed. Stop using it and seek medical advice if the skin condition worsens, shows an allergic reaction or does not improve as expected.

title: Bilatech- M (10x1x10) Bilastine 20 mg, Montelukast 10 mg Tab by Csc
name: Bilatech- M (10x1x10) Bilastine 20 mg, Montelukast 10 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Bilatech- M (10x1x10) Bilastine 20 mg, Montelukast 10 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0762
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis (hay fever), such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose, and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Bilastine is an antihistamine that reduces the effects of histamine, a chemical involved in allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, substances that contribute to inflammation and congestion in the airways and nose.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Bilastine is generally taken on an empty stomach; follow the product label or prescriber’s instructions, especially regarding food and fruit juice. Do not take more or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, sleepiness or tiredness, dizziness, stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Montelukast can rarely cause mood or behaviour changes, nightmares, sleep problems, depression, or suicidal thoughts. Stop the medicine and seek medical advice promptly if these occur. Tell the prescriber about liver or kidney problems, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or any previous reaction to these medicines. This medicine is not a rescue treatment for a sudden asthma or breathing attack. Avoid driving or operating machinery if it causes sleepiness or dizziness.

title: Breezon SPF 30+ (50g) Octyl Methoxycinnamate, Benzophenone-3, Avobenzone, Titanium Dioxide, Vitamin E by Csc
name: Breezon SPF 30+ (50g) Octyl Methoxycinnamate, Benzophenone-3, Avobenzone, Titanium Dioxide, Vitamin E by Csc
searchText: Breezon SPF 30+ (50g) Octyl Methoxycinnamate, Benzophenone-3, Avobenzone, Titanium Dioxide, Vitamin E by Csc CSC I0011
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to protect the skin from harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays, helping prevent sunburn and reduce sun-related skin damage.

How does it work?
Its sunscreen ingredients absorb, scatter or reflect UVA and UVB rays before they reach the skin. Vitamin E provides antioxidant support against oxidative damage.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply evenly to exposed skin before sun exposure and use again as directed on the product label, especially after swimming, sweating or wiping the skin. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or rash may occur. Eye irritation can occur if the product gets into the eyes.

Precautions
Do not use on broken or irritated skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop use if a rash or irritation develops. Avoid prolonged direct sun exposure even when using sunscreen, and use protective clothing and shade. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Breezon SPF 50+ (50g) Octyl Methoxycinnamate, Benzophenone-3, Avobenzone, Titanium Dioxide, Vitamin E by Csc
name: Breezon SPF 50+ (50g) Octyl Methoxycinnamate, Benzophenone-3, Avobenzone, Titanium Dioxide, Vitamin E by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a sunscreen to help protect exposed skin from UVA and UVB rays, sunburn and sun-related skin damage.

How does it work?
The ingredients form a protective barrier and absorb, reflect or scatter ultraviolet (UV) radiation before it reaches the skin. Vitamin E provides antioxidant support.

How to take/use it
Apply evenly and generously to all exposed skin before sun exposure. Reapply regularly, especially after swimming, sweating or towel drying. Follow the product label for specific directions.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or dryness may occur. Eye irritation can occur if the product gets into the eyes.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not apply to broken or irritated skin. Stop use if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Sunscreen does not completely prevent sun damage; avoid prolonged sun exposure and use protective clothing and shade.

title: Bubble Bash Hydrating Body Wash (200 ml ) Multi Ceramide, Shea Butter, Licorice Root Extract Body Wash by Csc

searchText: Bubble Bash Hydrating Body Wash (200 ml ) Multi Ceramide, Shea Butter, Licorice Root Extract Body Wash by Csc CSC I0723
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to moisturise dry or rough skin and help support the skin’s natural protective barrier.

How does it work?
Ceramides help replenish skin barrier lipids, while shea butter helps soften and moisturise the skin. Licorice root extract may help soothe irritated-looking skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Mild irritation, redness, stinging or itching may occur, especially in sensitive skin. Allergic reactions are possible.

Precautions
Patch-test on a small area before wider use. Stop using it if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Avoid applying to broken or infected skin unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Burn O Relief (20g) Silver Nitrate, Chlorhexidine Gluconate Cream by Csc
name: Burn O Relief (20g) Silver Nitrate, Chlorhexidine Gluconate Cream by Csc
searchText: Burn O Relief (20g) Silver Nitrate, Chlorhexidine Gluconate Cream by Csc CSC I0012
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a topical antiseptic to help prevent or treat bacterial infection in minor skin wounds, cuts and burns. Larger, deep or seriously infected wounds require medical attention.

How does it work?
Silver nitrate and chlorhexidine help kill or inhibit bacteria on the skin, reducing the risk of infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean and gently dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after use. Do not apply to the eyes, mouth or other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, redness, irritation or skin staining may occur. Stop using it and seek medical help if a severe rash, swelling or breathing difficulty develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to silver nitrate, chlorhexidine or similar antiseptics. Avoid applying to large areas, deep wounds or extensive burns unless advised by a healthcare professional. Keep away from the eyes and mucous membranes. Seek medical care if the wound is deep, worsening, severely painful or not healing.

title: Calciness (10x2x15) Calcium Carbonate 500 mg, Calcitriol 0.25 mcg, Zinc 7.5 mg by Csc
name: Calciness (10x2x15) Calcium Carbonate 500 mg, Calcitriol 0.25 mcg, Zinc 7.5 mg by Csc
searchText: Calciness (10x2x15) Calcium Carbonate 500 mg, Calcitriol 0.25 mcg, Zinc 7.5 mg by Csc CSC I0013
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to provide calcium, active vitamin D and zinc. It helps prevent or treat calcium and vitamin D deficiency and supports bone health, including in people at risk of weak or brittle bones.

How does it work?
Calcium helps build and maintain strong bones and teeth. Calcitriol, the active form of vitamin D, helps the body absorb calcium, while zinc supports normal body functions and tissue health.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed or directed on the label. Calcium carbonate is generally best taken with food. Do not take more than the recommended amount, and do not use other calcium or vitamin D supplements at the same time unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or gas may occur. Excess calcium may cause increased thirst, frequent urination, weakness or confusion and requires medical attention.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, or high calcium or vitamin D levels. Regular monitoring may be needed during prolonged use. Check with a healthcare professional before combining it with other calcium or vitamin D products, or medicines such as digoxin, thiazide diuretics, thyroid medicines or certain antibiotics, as dose spacing or monitoring may be required.

name: Calciness (200 ml) Calcium Susp by Csc
searchText: Calciness (200 ml) Calcium Susp by Csc CSC I0014
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a calcium supplement to prevent or treat low calcium levels and support normal bone and teeth health.

How does it work?
It provides calcium needed for healthy bones and teeth, as well as normal muscle, nerve and heart function.

How to take/use it
Shake the suspension well before use. Measure it with the supplied measuring device and follow the product label or the doctor's instructions. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Constipation, stomach discomfort, bloating, nausea or vomiting.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones or high calcium levels. Calcium can interfere with the absorption of some medicines, including iron supplements, thyroid medicines and certain antibiotics; ask a doctor or pharmacist about suitable spacing. Seek medical advice if severe constipation, persistent vomiting or unusual thirst develops.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement calcium and vitamin D, helping maintain healthy bones and teeth and prevent or correct low calcium or vitamin D levels when recommended.

How does it work?
Calcium provides a mineral needed for bones, teeth, muscles and nerves. Vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium from the intestine.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Calcium carbonate is generally best taken with food and swallowed with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other calcium or vitamin D products without medical advice.

Common side effects
Constipation, gas, bloating, nausea or stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Tell a doctor if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones or high calcium levels. Calcium can reduce the absorption of some medicines, including iron, thyroid medicines and certain antibiotics; these may need to be taken at a separate time as advised by a doctor or pharmacist. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used as prescribed to provide calcium and active vitamin D (calcitriol) for calcium or vitamin D deficiency and to support bone health. It also provides omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin B12, folic acid and boron as nutritional support.

How does it work?
Calcium provides the mineral needed for strong bones, while calcitriol helps the body absorb and use calcium. The other ingredients provide their respective nutritional roles in the body.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow the softgel whole with water, preferably with food unless advised otherwise. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or fishy aftertaste may occur. Excess calcium or calcitriol can cause increased thirst, frequent urination, vomiting, weakness or confusion.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, high calcium levels or vitamin D excess. Seek medical advice if symptoms of high calcium occur. Calcium can interfere with the absorption of some medicines, including thyroid medicines, iron and certain antibiotics; inform the doctor or pharmacist about all medicines being taken. Consult a healthcare professional before use with blood-thinning medicines.

name: Calciness Fem (10x1x10) Calcitriol 0.25 mcg, Calcium Carbonate 500 mg, Soya Isoflavones 50 mg, Menaquinone-7 45 mcg, Magnesium 50 mg by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to provide calcium and active vitamin D support for maintaining bone strength and helping manage or prevent low bone density, including osteoporosis, when prescribed. It may be particularly useful when dietary calcium or vitamin D intake is inadequate.

How does it work?
Calcium provides the mineral needed for strong bones, while calcitriol, an active form of vitamin D, helps the body absorb calcium. Magnesium, vitamin K2 and soya isoflavones also support normal bone metabolism.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed or directed on the product label. Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other calcium or vitamin D supplements unless advised by a doctor. Calcium carbonate is generally better absorbed with food. Separate it from medicines such as thyroid tablets, certain antibiotics and iron supplements as advised by a pharmacist or doctor.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or diarrhoea may occur. Excess calcium may cause increased thirst, frequent urination, weakness or confusion and requires medical attention.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, high blood calcium or vitamin D levels, or disorders causing increased calcium levels. Avoid unnecessary calcium or vitamin D supplements. Vitamin K2 may interfere with warfarin and other vitamin K-sensitive blood thinners. Avoid use if allergic to any ingredient, including soya, and seek medical advice during pregnancy, breastfeeding or when taking long-term medicines.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used as a calcium and active vitamin D supplement to support bone strength and help prevent or manage calcium and vitamin D deficiency. It may be used as part of bone-health care when recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Calcium provides the mineral needed for strong bones. Calcitriol helps the body absorb calcium, while zinc and vitamin K support normal bone health.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow with water; calcium carbonate is generally better absorbed with food. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or gas. Excess calcium may cause increased thirst or frequent urination.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, kidney stones, high calcium levels, or disorders affecting vitamin D metabolism. Calcium can reduce the absorption of some medicines, including thyroid medicines, iron and certain antibiotics, so separate doses as advised. Vitamin K may affect the action of warfarin and similar blood thinners. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if taking other calcium or vitamin D products.

title: Calciness Nano Shots (5 ml) Cholecalciferol 60,000 IU by Csc
name: Calciness Nano Shots (5 ml) Cholecalciferol 60,000 IU by Csc
searchText: Calciness Nano Shots (5 ml) Cholecalciferol 60,000 IU by Csc CSC I0319
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cholecalciferol is a form of vitamin D used to prevent or treat vitamin D deficiency. It supports calcium absorption and helps maintain strong bones and muscles.

How does it work?
It increases the body’s vitamin D levels, helping the intestines absorb calcium and phosphate needed for healthy bones and muscles.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or as stated on the product label. Do not take extra doses or use it for longer than recommended. Avoid taking other vitamin D or calcium supplements unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated when used as directed. Excessive vitamin D intake may cause nausea, vomiting, constipation, stomach discomfort, unusual thirst, frequent urination or weakness.

Precautions
Tell a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, kidney stones, high calcium levels, or a condition that increases calcium levels. Seek medical advice if symptoms of excessive calcium occur. Keep out of reach of children.

name: Calciness XT (10x1x15) Elemental Calcium 500 mg, Cholecalciferol 2000 IU, Mecobalamin 1500 mcg, L-Methylfolate Calcium 1 mg, Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate 20 mg by Csc
searchText: Calciness XT (10x1x15) Elemental Calcium 500 mg, Cholecalciferol 2000 IU, Mecobalamin 1500 mcg, L-Methylfolate Calcium 1 mg, Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate 20 mg by Csc CSC I0989
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement provides calcium and vitamin D to help maintain strong bones and teeth and to prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies. It also supplies vitamin B12, folate and vitamin B6, which support normal nerve function and red blood cell production.

How does it work?
Calcium provides the mineral needed for bones, teeth, muscles and nerves, while vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium. Vitamin B12, folate and vitamin B6 support nerve health and the formation of healthy blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Calcium carbonate is generally better absorbed when taken with food. Swallow with water and do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Constipation, gas, bloating, nausea or stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, or high calcium or vitamin D levels. Avoid taking additional calcium or vitamin D supplements unless advised. Calcium can reduce the absorption of some medicines, including thyroid medicines, iron supplements and certain antibiotics; separate doses as advised by a doctor or pharmacist.

name: Calirex CV Lotion (70 ml ) Calamine, Vitamin E, Aloe Vera, Olive Oil Lotion by Csc
searchText: Calirex CV Lotion (70 ml ) Calamine, Vitamin E, Aloe Vera, Olive Oil Lotion by Csc CSC I0017
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to soothe minor skin irritation and itching, including discomfort from insect bites, mild rashes and sunburn.

How does it work?
Calamine forms a soothing protective layer on the skin and helps reduce irritation and itching. Aloe vera, vitamin E and olive oil may help moisturise and comfort dry or irritated skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes.

Common side effects
Mild dryness, irritation or redness may occur. Rarely, an allergic skin reaction may develop.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Stop use if irritation or a rash worsens. Avoid applying to large areas, deep wounds or infected skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice if symptoms are severe, persistent or spreading.

title: Carifull Syrup (200 ml ) Supports Platelet Count by Csc
name: Carifull Syrup (200 ml ) Supports Platelet Count by Csc
searchText: Carifull Syrup (200 ml ) Supports Platelet Count by Csc CSC I0765
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
It is intended to support platelet count. The exact use and benefits depend on its ingredients and should be confirmed from the product label or a healthcare professional. It should not replace medical evaluation for a low platelet count.

How does it work?
The exact mechanism cannot be determined from the supplied information because the ingredients are not provided.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
The possible side effects cannot be determined without knowing the ingredients. Check the product label for ingredient-specific warnings.

Precautions
A low platelet count can have several causes and may require medical testing and treatment. Seek medical advice promptly for unusual bleeding, easy bruising, blood in the urine or stools, or pinpoint red spots on the skin. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or alongside other medicines.

title: Carifull Tab (1X15) Carica Papaya Leaf Extract Tab by Csc
name: Carifull Tab (1X15) Carica Papaya Leaf Extract Tab by Csc
searchText: Carifull Tab (1X15) Carica Papaya Leaf Extract Tab by Csc CSC I0646
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Papaya leaf extract is a herbal supplement commonly used to support platelet counts during dengue fever. Evidence of benefit is limited, and it should not replace medical evaluation, monitoring or prescribed dengue treatment.

How does it work?
Its exact mechanism is not established. Some studies suggest papaya leaf compounds may influence platelet production, but this benefit has not been conclusively proven.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not self-treat suspected dengue fever; seek medical care for testing and platelet monitoring.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset and loose stools may occur. Allergic reactions are possible.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to papaya or papaya products. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or if taking other medicines. Stop use and seek urgent care for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, unusual bleeding or worsening dengue symptoms.

title: Cefinex 200 DT (10x1x10) Cefixime 200 mg DT Tab by Csc
name: Cefinex 200 DT (10x1x10) Cefixime 200 mg DT Tab by Csc
searchText: Cefinex 200 DT (10x1x10) Cefixime 200 mg DT Tab by Csc CSC I0023
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cefixime is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the throat, ears, chest, urinary tract and other areas. It does not work against viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from making their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. The tablet may be taken with or without food, and should be dispersed in water if required for the DT formulation. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not share leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, indigestion and vomiting. Skin rash may also occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to cefixime, other cephalosporins or certain penicillin-type antibiotics. Tell the doctor about kidney problems, previous antibiotic-related diarrhoea or allergies. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty or a severe skin rash.

What is it used for?

How does it work?
Cefixime is an antibiotic that stops susceptible bacteria from forming their protective cell wall, helping to kill the bacteria. Lactic acid bacillus is a probiotic included to help support the normal balance of gut bacteria.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor and complete the recommended course, even if symptoms improve. Take with water and do not share leftover antibiotics. Do not use it without medical advice for a suspected viral infection.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cefixime + Ofloxacin is a prescription antibiotic combination used to treat certain bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Cefixime damages the bacterial cell wall. Ofloxacin blocks enzymes that bacteria need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Take it only in the dose and for the duration prescribed by the doctor. Follow the prescription carefully and complete the course, even if symptoms improve. Do not share this medicine or use leftover antibiotics. Keep doses of antacids, iron, calcium or zinc supplements separate as advised by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and indigestion may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to cefixime, other cephalosporin antibiotics, ofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics. Inform the doctor about kidney disease, seizures, heart-rhythm problems, tendon disorders, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Stop taking it and seek medical advice for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe rash, breathing difficulty, or unusual heartbeat. Avoid driving if it causes dizziness.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cefixime + ofloxacin is a prescription antibiotic combination used to treat certain bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

How does it work?
Cefixime damages the bacterial cell wall, while ofloxacin stops bacteria from multiplying by interfering with their DNA. Together, they help eliminate susceptible bacteria.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by a doctor. Follow the prescribed dose and duration, swallow with water, and complete the course even if symptoms improve. Do not self-medicate or share this medicine.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain, indigestion, headache, dizziness, or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to cephalosporins, penicillins, or quinolone antibiotics. Use with caution if there is a history of tendon problems, seizures, nerve problems, heart rhythm problems, kidney disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, swelling or breathing difficulty, unusual tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, or severe dizziness. Avoid driving if dizzy.

What is it used for?

searchText: Cenitra OC (15gm) Itraconazole 1.00% w/w, Ofloxacin 0.75% w/w, Ornidazole 2.00% w/w, Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w by Csc CSC I0039
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is generally prescribed for certain mixed skin infections involving fungal and bacterial germs, especially when redness, itching and inflammation are present. Use it only when recommended by a doctor, as the steroid component may worsen some infections if used incorrectly.

How does it work?
Itraconazole fights fungi, while ofloxacin and ornidazole act against susceptible bacteria and other germs. Clobetasol reduces skin inflammation, redness and itching.

How to take/use it
Use only by the route and for the duration stated on the label or prescribed by the doctor. If it is a skin preparation, apply only to the affected area as directed, wash hands before and after use, and avoid contact with the eyes and mouth. Do not cover the area tightly unless advised.

Common side effects
Burning, stinging, irritation, dryness or itching at the application site may occur. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
For external use only if stated on the product label. Do not use on the face, skin folds, broken skin or near the eyes unless specifically prescribed. Do not use for longer than advised, and do not self-treat an undiagnosed rash. Stop using it and seek medical advice if the infection worsens, irritation is severe, or there is no improvement.

searchText: Cenitra SB 130 (10x1x10) Itraconazole 130 mg by Csc CSC I0727
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Itraconazole is an antifungal medicine used to treat certain fungal infections of the skin, nails, mouth, lungs or other parts of the body. The exact infection and treatment duration depend on the doctor's diagnosis.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making ergosterol, a substance needed to build and maintain their cell membranes. This prevents the fungi from growing and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed and complete the recommended course. Follow the product label regarding food and swallowing instructions, as these can vary between itraconazole formulations. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, headache, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about liver disease, heart failure or any history of heart problems. Itraconazole can interact with many medicines, so provide a complete list of prescription medicines, over-the-counter products and supplements. Seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe tiredness, breathing difficulty, swelling of the legs or a severe skin reaction. Inform the doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.

What is it used for?
Itraconazole is an antifungal medicine used to treat various fungal infections, including infections affecting the skin, nails, mouth, genitals or internal organs, as prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It blocks the production of ergosterol, a substance fungi need to build and maintain their cell walls. This stops fungal growth and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and follow the product-specific instructions about food. Do not change the dose, stop treatment early or substitute it with another itraconazole formulation without medical advice. Tell the doctor about all medicines and supplements being taken.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about liver disease, heart failure, pregnancy or plans to become pregnant. Itraconazole can cause serious medicine interactions and, rarely, liver or heart problems. Seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe tiredness, shortness of breath, swelling of the legs or a severe skin reaction. Avoid taking it if allergic to itraconazole or similar antifungal medicines.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination may be prescribed to support memory, thinking and other cognitive problems associated with stroke or certain neurological conditions. It should be used only on medical advice and is not a general memory booster.

How does it work?
Citicoline supports the production of substances needed for nerve-cell membranes and brain signalling. Piracetam may help support neuronal membrane function and communication between nerve cells; its exact mechanism is not fully understood.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor and swallow it with water. Do not change the dose, stop treatment suddenly or take an extra dose without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, dizziness, nervousness, restlessness, difficulty sleeping, nausea, stomach discomfort or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, a history of bleeding or brain haemorrhage, seizure disorders, or use of blood thinners such as warfarin or aspirin. Dose adjustment may be needed in kidney problems. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical advice if unusual bleeding, severe agitation or worsening neurological symptoms occur.

What is it used for?
Trypsin and chymotrypsin are used as supportive treatment to help reduce swelling and inflammation after injuries, surgery, or other soft-tissue damage. Use should be based on medical advice.

How does it work?
These proteolytic enzymes break down proteins involved in inflammation and tissue swelling, which may help support recovery.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Do not change the dose or treatment duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, or indigestion may occur. Allergic reactions are uncommon but possible.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about any bleeding or clotting disorder, planned surgery, or use of blood-thinning medicines. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of an allergic reaction occur. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to treat superficial fungal infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, jock itch and other fungal skin infections. Some ciclopirox preparations may also be prescribed for seborrhoeic dermatitis, depending on the product.

How does it work?
Ciclopirox is an antifungal medicine that damages essential processes in fungal cells, helping stop their growth. Benzyl alcohol mainly helps protect and preserve the formulation.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry affected skin exactly as directed on the product label or by the doctor. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and wash hands after application unless the hands are being treated.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, dryness or irritation at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ciclopirox or any ingredient. Avoid applying to the eyes or swallowing it. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops, or if the infection does not improve as expected.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain outer-ear infections (otitis externa) caused by bacteria and fungi, especially when the ear is inflamed, itchy or painful. It should be used only when prescribed, as the cause of an ear infection needs to be confirmed.

How does it work?
Gentamicin kills bacteria and clotrimazole treats fungal infection. Beclomethasone reduces swelling and inflammation, while lignocaine helps relieve ear pain and discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only in the affected ear and exactly as directed by the doctor or on the product label. Do not insert the dropper tip into the ear. Keep the ear dry during treatment, and do not use it in the eyes or swallow it. Do not use leftover drops for a new ear problem.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, itching or irritation in the ear. Allergic rash or worsening discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if there is a known allergy to any ingredient. Do not use if the eardrum is perforated or a tube is present unless specifically advised by a doctor, as gentamicin may damage hearing. Avoid prolonged or repeated use because the steroid can worsen or mask infection. Stop and seek medical advice if pain, discharge, hearing changes, dizziness or irritation worsens, or if there is no improvement.

What is it used for?
This supplement provides lysine and several B vitamins. It is used to help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies, especially when dietary intake is inadequate or during periods of increased nutritional need.

Lysine is an essential amino acid, while the B vitamins support energy metabolism and normal functioning of the nerves, skin and blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach discomfort.

Nausea, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or headache may occur. Stop use and seek medical advice if unusual or severe symptoms develop.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or if there is kidney disease or another medical condition. Avoid taking it together with other vitamin supplements unless advised, as this may lead to excessive intake.
