Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, headache and dizziness. Skin rash may also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, heart failure, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and any allergy to antifungal medicines. Itraconazole can interact with many medicines, so provide a complete list of all medicines and supplements being used. Seek medical advice for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe tiredness, breathing difficulty or swelling of the legs.

title: Consent 100 (30x1x4) Sildenafil 100 mg by Csc
name: Consent 100 (30x1x4) Sildenafil 100 mg by Csc
searchText: Consent 100 (30x1x4) Sildenafil 100 mg by Csc CSC I0479
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sildenafil 100 mg is used mainly to treat erectile dysfunction (difficulty getting or keeping an erection firm enough for sexual activity). It works only when there is sexual stimulation.

How does it work?
It increases blood flow to the penis during sexual stimulation, helping an erection develop and last.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. For erectile dysfunction, it is usually taken before sexual activity; follow the timing and instructions on the prescription or pack. Do not take more than prescribed.

Common side effects
Headache, facial flushing, indigestion, blocked or runny nose, dizziness, and temporary visual changes.

Precautions
Do not use with nitrate medicines for chest pain or with riociguat, as this can cause a dangerous fall in blood pressure. Tell the doctor about heart or blood-pressure problems, previous stroke or heart attack, eye or vision problems, or if taking alpha-blockers or other medicines for erectile dysfunction. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, sudden loss of vision or hearing, or an erection lasting more than 4 hours. Avoid excessive alcohol, which may reduce the ability to get an erection and increase dizziness.

title: Consent Condoms 3's Pack (48x3's) Strawberry and Chocolate Flavoured Condoms by Csc
name: Consent Condoms 3's Pack (48x3's) Strawberry and Chocolate Flavoured Condoms by Csc
searchText: Consent Condoms 3's Pack (48x3's) Strawberry and Chocolate Flavoured Condoms by Csc CSC I0373
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Flavoured condoms are used during sexual activity to help prevent pregnancy and reduce the risk of sexually transmitted infections (STIs), including HIV. They do not provide complete protection.

How does it work?
The condom forms a physical barrier that helps prevent semen from entering the vagina and reduces contact with infected body fluids and genital areas.

How to take/use it
Use a new condom before any sexual contact. Check that the packet is sealed and within its expiry date. Carefully open it, place it on the erect penis with the rolled rim outside, pinch the tip to remove air, and unroll it fully. After ejaculation, hold the base while withdrawing, remove carefully, tie or wrap it, and throw it in a bin. Use only once and follow the pack instructions.

Common side effects
Some people may experience skin irritation, itching or discomfort. Allergic reactions, including to latex or flavouring ingredients, can occur.

Precautions
Do not use if the packet is damaged or the condom is torn, dry or expired. Do not use oil-based lubricants with latex condoms; use a water- or silicone-based lubricant instead. Stop using it if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Condoms can break or slip and do not completely prevent pregnancy or STIs. Do not use two condoms together or reuse a condom.

title: Consent Gold (20x1x4) Dapoxetine 30 mg, Sildenafil 50 mg Tab by Csc
name: Consent Gold (20x1x4) Dapoxetine 30 mg, Sildenafil 50 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Consent Gold (20x1x4) Dapoxetine 30 mg, Sildenafil 50 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0758
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used in adult men to treat erectile dysfunction (difficulty getting or keeping an erection) along with premature ejaculation, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Sildenafil increases blood flow to the penis during sexual stimulation, helping achieve and maintain an erection. Dapoxetine increases serotonin activity, which can help delay ejaculation.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. Swallow the tablet whole with water. Do not take more than prescribed, and do not use it with other medicines for erectile dysfunction unless directed by a doctor.

Common side effects
Headache, dizziness, flushing, indigestion, nausea, diarrhoea, blocked nose and visual changes may occur.

Precautions
Do not use with nitrate medicines for chest pain, ‘poppers’ or riociguat, as this can cause a dangerous fall in blood pressure. Avoid alcohol because it may increase dizziness or fainting. Tell the doctor about heart problems, low blood pressure, liver or kidney disease, or use of antidepressants, tramadol, MAO inhibitors or other medicines affecting serotonin. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, fainting, a sudden change in vision or hearing, or an erection lasting more than 4 hours.

title: Consent Muesli Gold (10x1x10) Safed Musli 85 mg, Kaunch 80 mg, Ashwagandha 75 mg, Shilajit 60 mg, Gokhru 60 mg, Talmakhana 50 mg, Jaiphal 40 mg, Akarkara 20 mg, Vidarikand 15 mg, Laung 10 mg, Pipali 5 mg, Kesar 5 mg, Swarna Bhasma 100 mcg by Csc
name: Consent Muesli Gold (10x1x10) Safed Musli 85 mg, Kaunch 80 mg, Ashwagandha 75 mg, Shilajit 60 mg, Gokhru 60 mg, Talmakhana 50 mg, Jaiphal 40 mg, Akarkara 20 mg, Vidarikand 15 mg, Laung 10 mg, Pipali 5 mg, Kesar 5 mg, Swarna Bhasma 100 mcg by Csc
searchText: Consent Muesli Gold (10x1x10) Safed Musli 85 mg, Kaunch 80 mg, Ashwagandha 75 mg, Shilajit 60 mg, Gokhru 60 mg, Talmakhana 50 mg, Jaiphal 40 mg, Akarkara 20 mg, Vidarikand 15 mg, Laung 10 mg, Pipali 5 mg, Kesar 5 mg, Swarna Bhasma 100 mcg by Csc CSC I0254
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This Ayurvedic herbal combination is traditionally used to support sexual vitality, libido and general energy in men. It should not be considered a proven treatment for erectile dysfunction, infertility or other medical conditions.

How does it work?
Its ingredients are traditionally believed to support energy and sexual wellness. The exact effects and mechanism of this combination are not well established scientifically.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by an Ayurvedic doctor or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount, and do not use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Possible side effects may include stomach upset, nausea, loose motions, dizziness or drowsiness. Stop use and seek medical advice if unusual symptoms occur.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use if there is diabetes, high or low blood pressure, thyroid disease, liver or kidney disease, or if medicines are being taken for these conditions. Seek advice before combining it with sedatives, blood thinners or other sexual-health supplements. Avoid use during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless specifically advised. Products containing bhasma should be obtained from a reliable source and used only as directed.

title: CSC Advance Whey 2LB (0.907gm) Protein Powder by Csc
name: CSC Advance Whey 2LB (0.907gm) Protein Powder by Csc
searchText: CSC Advance Whey 2LB (0.907gm) Protein Powder by Csc CSC I0914
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Protein Powder is a dietary supplement used to help increase daily protein intake. It may support muscle maintenance and recovery when combined with a balanced diet and suitable physical activity.

How does it work?
It provides protein and amino acids that the body uses to maintain and repair muscles and other tissues.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Mix the recommended amount with water, milk or another suitable drink, as stated on the pack. Do not use it as a replacement for a varied, balanced diet unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Some people may experience bloating, gas, stomach discomfort, nausea or diarrhoea. These effects may depend on the protein source or added ingredients.

Precautions
Check the ingredient list for allergens such as milk, soy or other ingredients before use. Seek medical advice before using protein supplements if there is kidney disease, liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding or a medically restricted diet. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of an allergic reaction occur.

title: CSC COD Liver Oil (100) Cod Liver Oil 300 mg by Csc
name: CSC COD Liver Oil (100) Cod Liver Oil 300 mg by Csc
searchText: CSC COD Liver Oil (100) Cod Liver Oil 300 mg by Csc CSC I0491
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cod liver oil is a nutritional supplement that provides omega-3 fatty acids and may provide vitamins A and D. It is used to support general nutrition and normal eye, bone and immune function; it is not a substitute for treatment of a diagnosed condition.

How does it work?
The omega-3 fatty acids support normal cell and body functions. Vitamins A and D, when present, help support normal vision, bones and immune function.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount, especially if using other supplements containing vitamins A or D.

Common side effects
Fishy taste or burps, nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort or loose stools may occur.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to fish or any ingredient. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy, particularly because excess vitamin A may be harmful. Consult a healthcare professional if taking blood-thinning medicines, if there is a bleeding disorder, or if using other vitamin A or D supplements.

title: CSC Fish Oil 1000 mg (1x60) Fish Oil 1000 mg by Csc
name: CSC Fish Oil 1000 mg (1x60) Fish Oil 1000 mg by Csc
searchText: CSC Fish Oil 1000 mg (1x60) Fish Oil 1000 mg by Csc CSC I0964
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Fish Oil 1000 mg is a dietary supplement that provides omega-3 fatty acids. It is used to supplement the diet when fish or omega-3 intake is low. It should not be used to treat high triglycerides unless advised by a doctor.

How does it work?
It supplies omega-3 fatty acids, including EPA and DHA, which are involved in normal body and lipid functions.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label. Taking it with food may help reduce fishy aftertaste and stomach discomfort. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Fishy aftertaste or burping, nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort, and loose stools or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Avoid it if allergic to fish or seafood. Consult a doctor before use if taking blood thinners, having a bleeding disorder, or before surgery. Seek medical advice during pregnancy or breastfeeding. The amount of EPA and DHA can vary between products; follow the label instructions.

title: CSC Protein Powder (200 gm ) Protein Powder by Csc
name: CSC Protein Powder (200 gm ) Protein Powder by Csc
searchText: CSC Protein Powder (200 gm ) Protein Powder by Csc CSC I0093
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Protein powder is used to supplement dietary protein when food intake is insufficient. It may support muscle maintenance and recovery, especially alongside regular exercise, but it is not a substitute for a balanced diet.

How does it work?
It provides protein, which is broken down into amino acids used by the body to maintain and repair muscles and other tissues.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Mix the recommended amount with water, milk or another suitable drink. Do not exceed the stated serving unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Some people may experience bloating, gas, nausea, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or constipation.

Precautions
Check the ingredient and allergen label before use. Seek medical advice before using regularly if there is kidney or liver disease, or if protein intake has been medically restricted. Stop use and seek help if signs of an allergic reaction occur. Keep out of reach of children unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: CSC WHEY Protein 4LB (1.81Kg) Concentrated Whey Protein Powder by Csc
name: CSC WHEY Protein 4LB (1.81Kg) Concentrated Whey Protein Powder by Csc
searchText: CSC WHEY Protein 4LB (1.81Kg) Concentrated Whey Protein Powder by Csc CSC I0616
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement dietary protein, helping support muscle maintenance and recovery when combined with a balanced diet and physical activity. It is a nutritional supplement, not a treatment for a specific disease.

How does it work?
Whey protein provides amino acids, which the body uses to build and repair muscles and other tissues.

How to take/use it
Mix with water, milk or another suitable drink as directed on the product label. Do not use it as the sole source of nutrition.

Common side effects
Bloating, gas, stomach discomfort, nausea or loose stools may occur, especially in people sensitive to milk or lactose.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to milk proteins. People with lactose intolerance may need to choose a lactose-free option. Those with kidney disease or who have been advised to restrict protein should seek medical advice before use. Check the label for sugar and other ingredients if managing diabetes or food allergies.

title: Culite (15g) Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone Cream by Csc
name: Culite (15g) Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone Cream by Csc
searchText: Culite (15g) Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone Cream by Csc CSC I0044
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This cream is commonly prescribed for melasma and other areas of darkened skin or hyperpigmentation, especially on the face. It should be used only under medical supervision.

How does it work?
Hydroquinone reduces the production of skin pigment, while tretinoin helps increase skin cell turnover. Mometasone reduces inflammation and irritation.

How to take/use it
Apply only to the affected skin as directed by the doctor. Use on clean, dry skin and avoid the eyes, lips, inside of the nose, and broken or irritated skin. Wash hands after applying. Do not use it for longer than prescribed.

Common side effects
Redness, burning, stinging, itching, dryness, peeling, irritation, or increased sensitivity to sunlight. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, acne-like eruptions, or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Use sunscreen and limit sun exposure, as sunlight can worsen pigmentation and irritation. Avoid using other irritating skin products unless advised by a doctor. Do not use on large areas or for prolonged periods without medical advice. Tell the doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy, breastfeeding, or if severe irritation or unusual darkening develops.

title: Curadol 500 (20x15) Paracetamol 500 mg by Csc
name: Curadol 500 (20x15) Paracetamol 500 mg by Csc
searchText: Curadol 500 (20x15) Paracetamol 500 mg by Csc CSC I0306
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Paracetamol is used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain, such as headache, body pain, toothache and muscle aches.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances in the body that cause pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth with water, with or without food. Follow the dose and timing stated on the pack or prescribed by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than recommended or use it with other medicines containing paracetamol.

Common side effects
Most people have no side effects. Nausea, stomach discomfort or skin rash may occasionally occur. Serious liver damage can occur with an overdose.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to paracetamol. Seek medical advice before use if there is liver disease, regular heavy alcohol use, or use of other paracetamol-containing medicines. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Seek urgent medical help after taking too much, even if feeling well.

title: Curadol 650 (20x15) Paracetamol 650 mg by Csc
name: Curadol 650 (20x15) Paracetamol 650 mg by Csc
searchText: Curadol 650 (20x15) Paracetamol 650 mg by Csc CSC I0476
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Paracetamol 650 mg is used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain, such as headache, body pain, toothache and muscle aches.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of certain chemicals in the brain that cause pain and raise body temperature.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth with water, exactly as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol.

Common side effects
Paracetamol is usually well tolerated. Nausea or a skin rash may occur. Serious liver damage can occur with an overdose.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to paracetamol. Ask a healthcare professional before use if there is liver disease, regular alcohol use, or use of other medicines. Avoid taking multiple paracetamol-containing products together. Seek urgent medical help after taking more than the recommended amount, even if feeling well.

title: Curebenate GM Lotion (25ml) Clobetasol, Miconazole, Gentamicin, Zinc Oxide Lotion by Csc
name: Curebenate GM Lotion (25ml) Clobetasol, Miconazole, Gentamicin, Zinc Oxide Lotion by Csc
searchText: Curebenate GM Lotion (25ml) Clobetasol, Miconazole, Gentamicin, Zinc Oxide Lotion by Csc CSC I0047
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This lotion is used on the skin for certain inflamed fungal skin infections where a bacterial infection may also be present. It should be used only when recommended by a doctor, as the steroid component can worsen some untreated skin infections.

How does it work?
Miconazole helps stop fungal growth, while gentamicin acts against certain bacteria. Clobetasol reduces redness, swelling and itching, and zinc oxide helps protect the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin exactly as directed by the doctor. Avoid the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and do not cover the area with a tight bandage unless advised.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, irritation or dryness may occur. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Do not use on the face, groin, skin folds, wounds or large areas unless specifically prescribed. Avoid prolonged use, especially in children. Do not use for acne or undiagnosed rashes. Stop and seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads or does not improve. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Curebenate Gm Plus Cream (20g) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Miconazole Nitrate 2.0% w/w, Neomycin Sulphate 0.1 w/w Cream by Csc
name: Curebenate Gm Plus Cream (20g) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Miconazole Nitrate 2.0% w/w, Neomycin Sulphate 0.1 w/w Cream by Csc
searchText: Curebenate Gm Plus Cream (20g) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Miconazole Nitrate 2.0% w/w, Neomycin Sulphate 0.1 w/w Cream by Csc CSC I0048
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This cream is used on the skin for certain inflamed fungal infections, especially when a bacterial infection is also present or suspected. It should be used only when prescribed, as the strong steroid component can mask or worsen some skin infections.

How does it work?
Miconazole fights fungal growth, while neomycin helps control susceptible bacterial infections. Clobetasol is a strong steroid that reduces redness, swelling and itching.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as directed by a doctor. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and do not cover the area tightly unless advised. Do not use for longer or on larger areas than prescribed.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, irritation, dryness or redness may occur. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks, changes in skin colour or increased sensitivity. Neomycin may cause an allergic skin rash in some people.

Precautions
Do not use on untreated viral infections, acne or open wounds unless specifically advised. Avoid use on the face, groin, skin folds or large areas unless prescribed. Stop using it and seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads, or causes severe irritation or swelling. Keep away from the eyes. Children and pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should use it only on medical advice.

title: Curedid-B (15 g) Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025%, Clotrimazole 1% by Csc
name: Curedid-B (15 g) Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025%, Clotrimazole 1% by Csc
searchText: Curedid-B (15 g) Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025%, Clotrimazole 1% by Csc CSC I0049
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat fungal skin infections that are accompanied by redness, itching or inflammation, such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and jock itch. The antifungal treats the infection, while the steroid helps reduce inflammation.

How does it work?
Clotrimazole stops the growth of fungi on the skin. Beclomethasone reduces inflammation, redness and itching.

How to take/use it
Use only on the skin and apply a thin layer to the affected area as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Clean and dry the area first, wash hands before and after use, and avoid covering the area tightly unless advised. Do not use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, dryness, redness or irritation at the application site. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or acne-like changes.

Precautions
For external use only; do not swallow or apply to the eyes, mouth or open wounds. Avoid prolonged use, large areas of skin, tight coverings and use on the face, groin or skin folds unless specifically advised. Steroids can mask or worsen fungal infections if used incorrectly. Stop use and seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads or causes severe irritation.

title: Curedid-B Lotion (25ml) Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025%, Clotrimazole 1% Lotion by Csc
name: Curedid-B Lotion (25ml) Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025%, Clotrimazole 1% Lotion by Csc
searchText: Curedid-B Lotion (25ml) Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025%, Clotrimazole 1% Lotion by Csc CSC I0050
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to treat fungal infections that are associated with redness, itching or inflammation. Use only as advised by a doctor, as the steroid component can mask or worsen some fungal infections if used incorrectly.

How does it work?
Clotrimazole stops the growth of fungi. Beclomethasone reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by skin inflammation.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin as directed by the doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, irritation, dryness or redness at the application site. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Do not use on the face, groin, skin folds, broken skin or large areas unless specifically advised. Avoid covering the area tightly unless directed. Do not use for longer than recommended. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads or does not improve. Consult a doctor before use in children, during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

title: Curedid-Mouth Paint (15ml) Clotrimazole 1% w/v Mouth Paint by Csc
name: Curedid-Mouth Paint (15ml) Clotrimazole 1% w/v Mouth Paint by Csc
searchText: Curedid-Mouth Paint (15ml) Clotrimazole 1% w/v Mouth Paint by Csc CSC I0449
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat fungal infections of the skin, such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, jock itch and some yeast-related skin infections.

How does it work?
Clotrimazole is an antifungal medicine that damages the protective outer layer of fungal cells, stopping their growth.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes and mouth.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use in the eyes or swallow. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens or does not improve with proper use. Keep out of reach of children.

title: CureFlora 10b (10x1x10) Pre-Probiotic 10 Billion CFU Cap by Csc
name: CureFlora 10b (10x1x10) Pre-Probiotic 10 Billion CFU Cap by Csc
searchText: CureFlora 10b (10x1x10) Pre-Probiotic 10 Billion CFU Cap by Csc CSC I0990
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pre-probiotic capsules contain beneficial microorganisms and prebiotic ingredients that help support a healthy balance of gut bacteria and overall digestive health.

How does it work?
The probiotics add beneficial live microorganisms to the gut, while prebiotics help support the growth of beneficial bacteria.

How to take/use it
Take as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Follow any storage instructions on the pack.

Common side effects
Gas, bloating, abdominal discomfort or changes in bowel movements may occur, especially when starting use.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use if immunocompromised, seriously ill, pregnant or breastfeeding, or if there is a significant underlying medical condition. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe or persistent symptoms occur. Check the label for ingredients that may cause an allergy or intolerance.

title: Curenice Gel (30 gm ) Nimesulide 10 mg, Methyl Salicylate 100 mg, Menthol 50 mg, Capsaicin 0.25 mg Gel by Csc
name: Curenice Gel (30 gm ) Nimesulide 10 mg, Methyl Salicylate 100 mg, Menthol 50 mg, Capsaicin 0.25 mg Gel by Csc
searchText: Curenice Gel (30 gm ) Nimesulide 10 mg, Methyl Salicylate 100 mg, Menthol 50 mg, Capsaicin 0.25 mg Gel by Csc CSC I0832
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical combination is used for temporary relief of muscle and joint pain, including pain associated with sprains, strains and arthritis.

How does it work?
Nimesulide helps reduce pain and inflammation. Methyl salicylate, menthol and capsaicin act on skin nerve endings to produce cooling, warming or counter-irritant effects that help reduce the feeling of pain.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a small amount to the painful area and use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not apply more often or in larger amounts than recommended. Wash hands after use.

Common side effects
Burning, stinging, warmth, cooling sensation, redness, itching or skin irritation at the application site.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, mucous membranes, broken or irritated skin. Do not cover tightly or use with a heating pad unless advised. Do not use if allergic to aspirin, other NSAID painkillers or any ingredient in the product. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, blistering or breathing difficulty occurs. Ask a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or in children.

title: Cypogro Plus (200ml) Cyproheptadine, Tricholine Citrate Syr by Csc
name: Cypogro Plus (200ml) Cyproheptadine, Tricholine Citrate Syr by Csc
searchText: Cypogro Plus (200ml) Cyproheptadine, Tricholine Citrate Syr by Csc CSC I0051
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cyproheptadine HCl + Tricholine Citrate syrup is used to improve poor appetite and support weight gain when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Cyproheptadine can increase appetite by blocking certain histamine and serotonin effects. Tricholine citrate provides choline, and together the ingredients may help improve appetite.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the healthcare professional. Measure the syrup with the provided measuring device and do not take more than the recommended amount. Do not stop or continue treatment for longer than advised without medical guidance.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, increased appetite, weight gain, nausea or stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
This medicine may cause sleepiness; avoid driving, operating machinery and alcohol until its effects are known. Tell the healthcare professional if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, asthma, liver or kidney disease. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Daibimet Ayur Capsules (1x30) Supports Healthy Glucose Metabolism by Csc
name: Daibimet Ayur Capsules (1x30) Supports Healthy Glucose Metabolism by Csc
searchText: Daibimet Ayur Capsules (1x30) Supports Healthy Glucose Metabolism by Csc CSC I0763
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
It is used to support healthy glucose metabolism. It is not a replacement for prescribed diabetes treatment or a balanced diet and regular physical activity.

How does it work?
The specific mechanism cannot be determined without knowing the product's ingredients.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
No specific side effects can be stated without the ingredient list. Check the product packaging for ingredient-specific information.

Precautions
People with diabetes or those taking medicines that affect blood sugar should seek medical advice before use, as glucose levels may need monitoring. Do not use as a substitute for prescribed treatment. Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Daibimet GP1 (10x10) Metformin 500 mg, Glimepiride 1 mg by Csc
name: Daibimet GP1 (10x10) Metformin 500 mg, Glimepiride 1 mg by Csc
searchText: Daibimet GP1 (10x10) Metformin 500 mg, Glimepiride 1 mg by Csc CSC I0055
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes when one medicine alone is not sufficient.

How does it work?
Metformin reduces glucose production by the liver and helps the body use insulin better. Glimepiride helps the pancreas release more insulin, lowering blood sugar.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually with or just after food to reduce stomach upset. Take it at the same time each day and do not skip meals. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach upset, abdominal discomfort, and loss of appetite may occur. Low blood sugar can cause sweating, shaking, dizziness, hunger, or weakness. Weight gain may also occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision if there are kidney or liver problems, heart failure, severe infection, or heavy alcohol use. Tell the doctor before surgery or an X-ray scan using an iodine contrast dye. Monitor blood sugar regularly and carry a source of fast-acting sugar for symptoms of low blood sugar. Seek urgent medical help for severe weakness, breathing difficulty, persistent vomiting, or unusual sleepiness. Take extra care in older adults and do not drive if blood sugar is low.

title: Daibimet GP2 (10x10) Metformin 500 mg, Glimepiride 2 mg by Csc
