searchText: Dexophan BL (100ml) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Bilastine 3.3 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg Syr by Csc CSC I1035
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of dry cough, blocked nose, sneezing and runny nose associated with colds or allergies.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan suppresses the cough reflex. Bilastine reduces allergy symptoms, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Measure the syrup with a proper measuring device. Do not take more than recommended or combine it with other cough, cold or allergy medicines without checking with a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, restlessness or trouble sleeping, and fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and driving if drowsiness or dizziness occurs. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, difficulty passing urine, or liver or kidney problems. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines, and check with a doctor before combining with antidepressants or other medicines that cause drowsiness. Consult a doctor during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Dexophan DX (100ml) Dextromethorphan, Chlorpheniramine Syr by Csc
name: Dexophan DX (100ml) Dextromethorphan, Chlorpheniramine Syr by Csc
searchText: Dexophan DX (100ml) Dextromethorphan, Chlorpheniramine Syr by Csc CSC I0407
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of dry cough along with cold- or allergy-related symptoms such as a runny nose and sneezing.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the cough reflex. Chlorpheniramine is an antihistamine that helps relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Shake the bottle well and measure the syrup with the provided measuring device. Do not take more than recommended or use it with other medicines containing dextromethorphan or chlorpheniramine.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and stomach upset.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Ask a doctor before use in children, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or with glaucoma, breathing problems, difficulty passing urine, or liver disease. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines or within 14 days of stopping them. Seek medical advice if the cough lasts several days, worsens, or is accompanied by breathing difficulty or high fever.

title: Dexophan Junior (60ml) Dextromethorphan, Chlorpheniramine, Phenylephrine Syr by Csc
name: Dexophan Junior (60ml) Dextromethorphan, Chlorpheniramine, Phenylephrine Syr by Csc
searchText: Dexophan Junior (60ml) Dextromethorphan, Chlorpheniramine, Phenylephrine Syr by Csc CSC I0065
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination syrup is used for temporary relief of cough, blocked or runny nose, sneezing and related symptoms of the common cold.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan helps reduce the urge to cough. Chlorpheniramine reduces allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Use the measuring cup or device provided, and do not take more than recommended. Avoid taking it with other cough, cold or allergy medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and stomach upset may occur. Phenylephrine may cause restlessness, palpitations or a rise in blood pressure.

Precautions
It may cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or prostate problems. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitors, and check with a healthcare professional before use with antidepressants or other medicines that cause drowsiness. Children, pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should use it only on medical advice. Seek medical advice for a persistent, worsening or breathing-related cough.

title: Dexophen SG (10x1x10) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg by Csc
name: Dexophen SG (10x1x10) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Dexophen SG (10x1x10) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg by Csc CSC I0297
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of dry cough, blocked nose, runny nose and sneezing associated with the common cold or allergies.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan suppresses the cough reflex. Chlorpheniramine reduces allergy symptoms, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the package or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other cough, cold or allergy medicines containing similar ingredients.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and nervousness may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and activities requiring alertness if drowsiness or dizziness occurs. Consult a doctor before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, prostate or urinary problems. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitors, and seek medical advice before combining with antidepressants or other medicines. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in children. Seek medical advice if the cough lasts, worsens or is accompanied by breathing difficulty or high fever.

title: Diclotech (20x10) Diclofenac Potassium 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg by Csc
name: Diclotech (20x10) Diclofenac Potassium 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg by Csc
searchText: Diclotech (20x10) Diclofenac Potassium 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg by Csc CSC I0566
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve short-term pain and reduce inflammation, such as body or musculoskeletal pain. It may also help reduce fever when prescribed for this purpose.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow with water, preferably with or after food, to reduce stomach irritation. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or diclofenac unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe allergic reactions or severe skin rash.

Precautions
Avoid use or seek medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, or asthma triggered by painkillers. Avoid excessive alcohol. Tell the doctor if taking blood thinners or other painkillers. It should generally be avoided during the last three months of pregnancy and used during pregnancy only on medical advice.

title: Diclotech Aero Spray (55ml) Diclofenac Sodium 1.0%, Linseed Oil 3.0%, Methyl Salicylate 10%, Menthol 5.0% Spray by Csc
name: Diclotech Aero Spray (55ml) Diclofenac Sodium 1.0%, Linseed Oil 3.0%, Methyl Salicylate 10%, Menthol 5.0% Spray by Csc
searchText: Diclotech Aero Spray (55ml) Diclofenac Sodium 1.0%, Linseed Oil 3.0%, Methyl Salicylate 10%, Menthol 5.0% Spray by Csc CSC I0957
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical gel is used to relieve pain and inflammation in muscles and joints, including pain from sprains, strains and arthritis.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Menthol and methyl salicylate provide a cooling and warming sensation that may help soothe the painful area.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the painful area and gently rub in, following the product label or the healthcare professional’s instructions. Wash hands after use. Do not apply to broken, infected or irritated skin, or cover tightly with a bandage or heat pad.

Common side effects
Redness, itching, burning, dryness or skin irritation at the application site. Stop use if a severe rash or other allergic reaction occurs.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Do not use if allergic to diclofenac, aspirin, other painkillers, salicylates or any ingredient in the product. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is a history of asthma or allergy triggered by painkillers. Keep away from children and do not apply over large areas or for prolonged use without medical advice.

title: Diclotech MR (30x10) Diclofenac 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Chlorzoxazone 250 mg by Csc
name: Diclotech MR (30x10) Diclofenac 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Chlorzoxazone 250 mg by Csc
searchText: Diclotech MR (30x10) Diclofenac 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Chlorzoxazone 250 mg by Csc CSC I0066
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of painful muscle and joint conditions associated with muscle stiffness or spasm, such as back pain, sprains and strains. It helps reduce pain, inflammation and muscle spasm.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol provides additional pain relief, while chlorzoxazone acts on the central nervous system to help relax painful muscle spasms.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, preferably with or after food, and do not exceed the recommended dose. Do not take it together with other medicines containing diclofenac, paracetamol or similar painkillers unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness, drowsiness and headache may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and driving or operating machinery if dizziness or drowsiness occurs. Tell the doctor before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, liver or kidney disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to painkillers. Avoid use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, unless specifically prescribed. Seek medical help for severe stomach pain, black stools, vomiting blood, yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, facial swelling or breathing difficulty.

title: Diclotech SP (10x10) Diclofenac 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Serratiopeptidase 15 mg Tab by Csc
name: Diclotech SP (10x10) Diclofenac 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Serratiopeptidase 15 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Diclotech SP (10x10) Diclofenac 50 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Serratiopeptidase 15 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0067
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and swelling, such as in muscle, joint, dental or other painful inflammatory conditions, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Diclofenac and paracetamol help reduce pain, while diclofenac also reduces inflammation. Serratiopeptidase may help reduce swelling associated with inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Taking it with or after food may help reduce stomach irritation. Do not take more than the prescribed dose or combine it with other medicines containing diclofenac, paracetamol or similar painkillers unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache may occur. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for signs of stomach bleeding, severe allergy or breathing difficulty.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, liver or kidney disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, bleeding problems or allergy to painkillers. Use caution with blood thinners and before surgery. Avoid excessive alcohol. This medicine may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially in the last three months, unless specifically prescribed.

title: Dicure 1ML (Amp.) Diclofenac Sodium 75 mg/ml Inj by Csc
name: Dicure 1ML (Amp.) Diclofenac Sodium 75 mg/ml Inj by Csc
searchText: Dicure 1ML (Amp.) Diclofenac Sodium 75 mg/ml Inj by Csc CSC I0296
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Diclofenac injection is used for short-term relief of moderate to severe pain and inflammation, such as pain affecting the muscles, joints or bones, and other acute painful conditions when an injection is needed.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection, usually by a doctor or nurse. It should not be self-injected. The dose and duration depend on the condition and must be decided by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Injection-site pain or irritation, nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, asthma or allergy after painkillers, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, or blood-clotting problems. Avoid using it with other NSAID painkillers unless advised. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe allergic symptoms, chest pain or breathing difficulty. It is generally avoided during the last three months of pregnancy and should only be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding on medical advice.

title: Dicure Forte Gel (30g) Diclofenac Sodium 2% w/w, Methyl Salicylate 10% w/w, Menthol 5% w/w Gel by Csc
name: Dicure Forte Gel (30g) Diclofenac Sodium 2% w/w, Methyl Salicylate 10% w/w, Menthol 5% w/w Gel by Csc
searchText: Dicure Forte Gel (30g) Diclofenac Sodium 2% w/w, Methyl Salicylate 10% w/w, Menthol 5% w/w Gel by Csc CSC I0068
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of local muscle and joint pain, including pain from sprains, strains and arthritis.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Methyl salicylate and menthol provide a cooling or warming sensation that may help relieve discomfort.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the painful area and gently rub in, following the product label or a healthcare professional’s instructions. Wash hands after use, unless the hands are being treated. Do not apply to broken or infected skin, or cover tightly with a bandage.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, redness, itching, rash, burning or stinging at the application site. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe skin reactions or breathing difficulty occur.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not use if allergic to diclofenac, aspirin, other NSAIDs or any ingredient in the product. Avoid using with other diclofenac or NSAID products unless advised by a healthcare professional. Avoid excessive sunlight and external heat on the treated area. Ask a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy, especially during the last 3 months, or while breastfeeding.

title: Dicure Hot Gel (30g) Diclofenac Sodium 1% w/w, Virgin Linseed Oil 3% w/w, Capsaicin 0.025% w/w, Methyl Salicylate 10% w/w, Menthol 5% w/w Gel by Csc
name: Dicure Hot Gel (30g) Diclofenac Sodium 1% w/w, Virgin Linseed Oil 3% w/w, Capsaicin 0.025% w/w, Methyl Salicylate 10% w/w, Menthol 5% w/w Gel by Csc
searchText: Dicure Hot Gel (30g) Diclofenac Sodium 1% w/w, Virgin Linseed Oil 3% w/w, Capsaicin 0.025% w/w, Methyl Salicylate 10% w/w, Menthol 5% w/w Gel by Csc CSC I0069
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of localized muscle and joint pain, including pain associated with sprains, strains and arthritis.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Menthol, methyl salicylate and capsaicin provide a cooling, warming or counter-irritant effect that can help reduce the feeling of pain.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the painful area and gently rub in, following the instructions on the product label or advice of a healthcare professional. Wash hands after use, unless the hands are being treated. Do not use more than recommended.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching, burning, stinging or rash at the application site. Stop use if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

Precautions
Do not apply to broken, infected or irritated skin, or near the eyes, mouth or other sensitive areas. Avoid tight bandages, heating pads and other sources of heat over the treated area. Do not use if allergic to diclofenac, aspirin, other NSAIDs or any ingredient in the product. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy, especially in the last three months, or if using it on large areas or for a prolonged period.

title: Dikart (15 gm ) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Neomycin Sulphate 0.50% w/w, Miconazole Nitrate 2.0% w/w, Chlorhexidine Gluconate 0.20% w/w, Chlorocresol 0.10% w/w Cream by Csc
name: Dikart (15 gm ) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Neomycin Sulphate 0.50% w/w, Miconazole Nitrate 2.0% w/w, Chlorhexidine Gluconate 0.20% w/w, Chlorocresol 0.10% w/w Cream by Csc
searchText: Dikart (15 gm ) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Neomycin Sulphate 0.50% w/w, Miconazole Nitrate 2.0% w/w, Chlorhexidine Gluconate 0.20% w/w, Chlorocresol 0.10% w/w Cream by Csc CSC I0481
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This cream is used on the skin for certain inflamed skin conditions complicated by bacterial or fungal infection. It should be used only when prescribed, as the steroid component is very potent.

How does it work?
Clobetasol reduces skin inflammation, redness and itching. Neomycin and chlorhexidine act against bacteria, while miconazole acts against fungi.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as directed by the doctor. Wash hands before and after use, unless treating the hands. Do not cover the area with a bandage or dressing unless advised.

Common side effects
Burning, stinging, irritation, redness, itching or allergic rash. Prolonged or repeated use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Avoid the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not use on the face, groin, underarms, broken skin or large areas unless specifically advised. Do not use for longer than prescribed, and do not self-treat with it because the steroid may worsen or mask an infection. Avoid use if allergic to clobetasol, neomycin, miconazole, chlorhexidine or similar ingredients. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens or a severe rash, swelling or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Dikart 5 Lotion (35ml) Ketoconazole, Iodochlorhydroxyquin, Neomycin, Tolnaftate, Clobetasol Lotion by Csc
name: Dikart 5 Lotion (35ml) Ketoconazole, Iodochlorhydroxyquin, Neomycin, Tolnaftate, Clobetasol Lotion by Csc
searchText: Dikart 5 Lotion (35ml) Ketoconazole, Iodochlorhydroxyquin, Neomycin, Tolnaftate, Clobetasol Lotion by Csc CSC I1052
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This lotion is used for certain fungal skin infections, especially when there is associated bacterial infection and significant redness, itching or inflammation. It should be used only when prescribed, as it contains a strong corticosteroid.

How does it work?
Ketoconazole and tolnaftate act against fungi, while neomycin acts against certain bacteria. Clobetasol reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by inflammation.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as prescribed. Clean and dry the area first, and wash hands before and after application unless the hands are being treated. Do not use it more often or for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, irritation, dryness or redness may occur. Prolonged or improper use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks, colour changes or worsening of the infection. Neomycin may cause an allergic skin reaction.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not apply to the face, groin, skin folds, broken skin or large areas unless specifically advised by a doctor. Avoid covering the treated area with tight or airtight dressings unless instructed. Do not use for an undiagnosed rash or suspected viral skin infection, and seek medical advice if the condition worsens or does not improve.

title: Dikart-K5 (15g) Ketoconazole 2.0% w/w, Iodochlorhydroxyquinoline 1.0% w/w, Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Gentamicin 0.10% w/w, Chlorocresol 0.10% w/w by Csc
name: Dikart-K5 (15g) Ketoconazole 2.0% w/w, Iodochlorhydroxyquinoline 1.0% w/w, Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Gentamicin 0.10% w/w, Chlorocresol 0.10% w/w by Csc
searchText: Dikart-K5 (15g) Ketoconazole 2.0% w/w, Iodochlorhydroxyquinoline 1.0% w/w, Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% w/w, Gentamicin 0.10% w/w, Chlorocresol 0.10% w/w by Csc CSC I1051
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for certain inflamed fungal skin infections, especially when there may also be a bacterial infection. It should be used only when prescribed, as the steroid component can worsen or mask some skin infections.

How does it work?
Ketoconazole and iodochlorhydroxyquinoline act against fungi, while gentamicin acts against certain bacteria. Clobetasol reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by inflammation.

How to take/use it
For use on the skin only. Apply a thin layer to the affected area exactly as directed by the doctor. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and do not cover the area with a bandage unless advised.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness or irritation at the application site. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks, or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice and only for the prescribed condition. Avoid prolonged use and use on the face, groin, skin folds, broken skin or in children unless specifically advised. Stop and seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads, or causes severe irritation. Avoid the eyes and seek medical advice if accidental contact occurs.

title: Dipflox 200 (20x10) Ofloxacin 200 mg by Csc
name: Dipflox 200 (20x10) Ofloxacin 200 mg by Csc
searchText: Dipflox 200 (20x10) Ofloxacin 200 mg by Csc CSC I0852
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ofloxacin 200 mg is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the urinary tract, respiratory tract, skin and other tissues, when prescribed by a doctor. It does not work for viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops bacteria from multiplying by blocking enzymes needed for bacterial DNA replication.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water and do not take it at the same time as antacids or mineral supplements containing aluminium, magnesium, iron or zinc; follow the prescribed spacing instructions. Do not share leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and sleep disturbances.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice. Stop taking it and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe mood or nerve-related symptoms, a severe rash, breathing difficulty or persistent watery or bloody diarrhoea. Tell the doctor about kidney problems, seizures, heart rhythm problems, tendon disorders, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being taken. Avoid driving if dizziness or other nervous-system effects occur.

title: Dipflox OZ (20x10) Ofloxacin 200 mg, Ornidazole 500 mg by Csc
name: Dipflox OZ (20x10) Ofloxacin 200 mg, Ornidazole 500 mg by Csc
searchText: Dipflox OZ (20x10) Ofloxacin 200 mg, Ornidazole 500 mg by Csc CSC I0075
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections, especially infectious diarrhoea and dysentery, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin kills susceptible bacteria. Ornidazole acts against certain parasites and bacteria that can cause intestinal infections.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and complete the recommended course. Swallow with water, with or without food. Do not take it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc; keep a suitable time gap as advised by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not self-medicate for diarrhoea.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic or bitter taste may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and ask a doctor when it is safe to drink after the last dose. Seek medical advice if severe or persistent diarrhoea, tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, seizures, severe dizziness, or an irregular heartbeat occurs. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney or liver problems, seizures, heart-rhythm problems, tendon disorders, or medicines being taken. Avoid driving if dizzy or drowsy.

title: Dipsid (10g) Fusidic Acid Cream by Csc
name: Dipsid (10g) Fusidic Acid Cream by Csc
searchText: Dipsid (10g) Fusidic Acid Cream by Csc CSC I0076
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Fusidic acid cream is used to treat bacterial skin infections, including infected cuts, wounds and conditions such as impetigo, when caused by bacteria sensitive to fusidic acid.

How does it work?
It is a topical antibiotic that stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the nose.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, burning, stinging, itching, redness or rash at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use for fungal or viral infections unless advised by a healthcare professional. Avoid prolonged or repeated use, as this may encourage antibiotic resistance. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, breathing difficulty or worsening infection occurs.

title: Dipsid-B (10g) Fusidic Acid, Beclomethasone Dipropionate Cream by Csc
name: Dipsid-B (10g) Fusidic Acid, Beclomethasone Dipropionate Cream by Csc
searchText: Dipsid-B (10g) Fusidic Acid, Beclomethasone Dipropionate Cream by Csc CSC I0078
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for bacterial skin infections accompanied by inflammation, redness, itching or swelling, such as infected eczema or dermatitis, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Fusidic acid stops the growth of certain bacteria on the skin. Beclomethasone dipropionate is a corticosteroid that reduces skin inflammation, redness and itching.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as directed by the doctor. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the nose.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, irritation, redness or dryness at the application site. Prolonged or repeated use may cause skin thinning or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Use only on the condition for which it was prescribed. Do not use on untreated fungal or viral skin infections, acne, or large areas of skin unless advised by a doctor. Avoid prolonged use, covering the area tightly, or applying it to the face, skin folds or broken skin unless specifically directed. Stop and seek medical advice if the infection worsens, the skin becomes severely irritated, or there is no improvement.

title: Domynap (10x1x10) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 250 mg by Csc
name: Domynap (10x1x10) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 250 mg by Csc
searchText: Domynap (10x1x10) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 250 mg by Csc CSC I0483
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of migraine headaches, especially when the migraine is accompanied by nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Naproxen reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Domperidone helps control nausea and vomiting and supports movement of the stomach.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by a doctor. Swallow with water, preferably with or after food to reduce stomach irritation. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Avoid taking other naproxen or NSAID painkillers unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness, headache, dry mouth or stomach cramps may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an irregular heartbeat. Domperidone may affect heart rhythm and may interact with some medicines. Naproxen can increase the risk of stomach bleeding, kidney problems and cardiovascular events, particularly with prolonged use. Avoid during pregnancy unless specifically prescribed, especially in the later months. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, chest pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or fainting.

title: Domynap 500 (10x1x10) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 500 mg by Csc
name: Domynap 500 (10x1x10) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 500 mg by Csc
searchText: Domynap 500 (10x1x10) Domperidone 10 mg, Naproxen 500 mg by Csc CSC I0843
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to relieve migraine headache and associated nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Naproxen reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Domperidone helps control nausea and vomiting and may improve the absorption of naproxen.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Swallow with water, preferably with or after food, to reduce stomach irritation. Do not take it with other naproxen, ibuprofen, diclofenac or similar painkillers unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, heartburn, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, dry mouth, dizziness or headache. Naproxen may rarely cause stomach ulcers or bleeding.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, uncontrolled high blood pressure, or allergy to aspirin or other NSAID painkillers. Domperidone may affect heart rhythm; inform the doctor about heart problems or medicines that affect heart rhythm. Avoid during pregnancy, particularly after 20 weeks and in the last trimester, unless specifically prescribed. Seek urgent help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, chest discomfort, fainting or an allergic reaction.

title: DoriFloz DS (60ml) Lactic Acid Bacillus With Vitamins by Csc
name: DoriFloz DS (60ml) Lactic Acid Bacillus With Vitamins by Csc
searchText: DoriFloz DS (60ml) Lactic Acid Bacillus With Vitamins by Csc CSC I0980
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Lactic acid bacillus helps restore the balance of healthy bacteria in the intestines. It may be used to support digestive health, including during or after diarrhoea or antibiotic treatment. The added vitamins provide nutritional supplementation.

How does it work?
It supplies beneficial bacteria that help support the normal balance of microorganisms in the gut. The vitamins support normal body functions, depending on the specific vitamins present.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Follow any storage instructions on the pack.

Common side effects
Gas, bloating or mild abdominal discomfort may occur. Seek medical advice if symptoms are severe or persistent.

Precautions
Consult a doctor before use if there is a weakened immune system, serious illness or a central venous catheter. Seek medical advice for diarrhoea with fever, blood in the stool, signs of dehydration or symptoms that do not improve. Check with a healthcare professional if taking antibiotics or other medicines.

title: Doxiness (Vial) Doxycycline 100 mg by Csc
name: Doxiness (Vial) Doxycycline 100 mg by Csc
searchText: Doxiness (Vial) Doxycycline 100 mg by Csc CSC I0776
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Doxycycline is an antibiotic used to treat a range of bacterial infections. It may also be prescribed for certain skin conditions, such as acne, when considered appropriate by a doctor. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making proteins needed for their growth and survival, helping control the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the recommended course. Swallow with a full glass of water while sitting or standing, and do not lie down immediately afterwards. Keep it separate from antacids and supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc as advised by a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the product label or prescription for the exact dose and timing.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach upset, heartburn or irritation of the food pipe, headache, and increased sensitivity to sunlight.

Precautions
Avoid excessive sunlight and use protective clothing and sunscreen. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, plans for pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver problems, or an allergy to tetracycline antibiotics. Use in young children only when specifically prescribed. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, difficulty swallowing, severe skin reactions, or signs of an allergic reaction. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about all medicines and supplements being used.

title: Doxytech LB (10x15) Doxycycline 100 mg, Lactic Acid Bacillus 5 Million by Csc
name: Doxytech LB (10x15) Doxycycline 100 mg, Lactic Acid Bacillus 5 Million by Csc
searchText: Doxytech LB (10x15) Doxycycline 100 mg, Lactic Acid Bacillus 5 Million by Csc CSC I0918
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is an antibiotic used to treat infections caused by susceptible bacteria. The lactic acid bacillus is included to help support healthy intestinal bacteria during antibiotic treatment.

How does it work?
Doxycycline stops susceptible bacteria from making proteins needed for their growth. Lactic acid bacillus is a beneficial bacterium that may help maintain the normal balance of gut bacteria.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with a full glass of water. Do not lie down immediately after taking it. Avoid taking it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium or magnesium; follow a healthcare professional’s advice about spacing them. Complete the prescribed course unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, diarrhoea and increased sensitivity to sunlight may occur.

Precautions
Avoid unnecessary sunlight and use sun protection. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, difficulty swallowing, severe headache or vision changes. Tell the healthcare professional about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver problems, swallowing or food-pipe problems, or allergy to tetracycline antibiotics. Doxycycline is generally avoided in pregnancy and in children under 8 years unless specifically prescribed. Take medical advice about other medicines and supplements.

title: Dydrotech -10 (10x1x10) Dydrogesterone 10 mg by Csc
name: Dydrotech -10 (10x1x10) Dydrogesterone 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Dydrotech -10 (10x1x10) Dydrogesterone 10 mg by Csc CSC I0452
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dydrogesterone is used to treat conditions caused by low or ineffective progesterone, such as irregular or painful periods, endometriosis, and some fertility or pregnancy-related problems. It may also be prescribed with oestrogen during hormone replacement therapy to protect the lining of the womb.

How does it work?
It is a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It helps regulate the womb lining and supports a normal menstrual cycle.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, as the dose and treatment schedule vary depending on the condition. Swallow the tablet with water and try to take it at the same time each day. Do not stop treatment or take a double dose after a missed dose without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache or migraine, nausea, abdominal discomfort, breast tenderness, changes in menstrual bleeding, or spotting may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about unexplained vaginal bleeding, liver problems, a history of hormone-sensitive cancer, migraine, or depression. Seek medical advice if jaundice, severe abdominal pain, or unusual bleeding occurs. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only when prescribed. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines being taken, as some medicines may reduce its effect.

title: Ebercon (15g) Eberconazole 1% w/w Cream by Csc
name: Ebercon (15g) Eberconazole 1% w/w Cream by Csc
searchText: Ebercon (15g) Eberconazole 1% w/w Cream by Csc CSC I0079
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Eberconazole cream is used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and jock itch. It may also be used for other fungal infections of the skin as prescribed.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, which prevents their growth and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to eberconazole or any ingredient in the cream. Avoid applying to the eyes, inside the mouth, or severely broken skin. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens or does not improve as expected.

title: Emizip (30ml) Ondansetron Oral Solution by Csc
name: Emizip (30ml) Ondansetron Oral Solution by Csc
searchText: Emizip (30ml) Ondansetron Oral Solution by Csc CSC I0400
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ondansetron oral solution is used to prevent and treat nausea and vomiting, including those related to cancer treatment, surgery, or other medical conditions.

How does it work?
It blocks serotonin signals that can trigger nausea and vomiting in the brain and digestive system.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Measure the oral solution with the provided measuring device, not a household spoon. Do not take more or use it for longer than directed.

Common side effects
Headache, constipation, diarrhoea, tiredness, dizziness, and flushing may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to ondansetron or similar medicines, liver disease, heart rhythm problems, or low potassium or magnesium levels. It may affect heart rhythm, especially with certain medicines or in people with heart conditions. Seek medical help for fainting, a fast or irregular heartbeat, severe allergic symptoms, or symptoms such as agitation, sweating, fever, muscle stiffness, or diarrhoea while taking medicines that affect serotonin.

title: Emizip-4 MD (20x10) Ondansetron 4 mg MD Tab by Csc
name: Emizip-4 MD (20x10) Ondansetron 4 mg MD Tab by Csc
searchText: Emizip-4 MD (20x10) Ondansetron 4 mg MD Tab by Csc CSC I0404
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ondansetron 4 mg tablets are used to prevent and treat nausea and vomiting, including nausea and vomiting related to chemotherapy, radiotherapy or surgery. Use it only as directed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ondansetron blocks serotonin signals that can trigger nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed. Follow the timing instructions given by the doctor, especially if it is being used around chemotherapy, radiotherapy or surgery. Do not take more or for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, constipation, diarrhoea, tiredness and dizziness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of abnormal heart rhythm, long QT syndrome, low potassium or magnesium levels, liver disease, or an allergy to ondansetron. It may affect heart rhythm and can interact with some medicines, including apomorphine and certain medicines that affect heart rhythm or serotonin levels. Seek medical help for fainting, a fast or irregular heartbeat, severe allergic symptoms or severe agitation with sweating, fever and muscle stiffness.

title: Enterofill ( 5 ml) Bacillus Clausii Spores Susp by Csc
name: Enterofill ( 5 ml) Bacillus Clausii Spores Susp by Csc
searchText: Enterofill ( 5 ml) Bacillus Clausii Spores Susp by Csc CSC I0302
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Bacillus clausii spores suspension is a probiotic used to help restore the balance of healthy bacteria in the intestine, especially during or after diarrhoea or antibiotic treatment.

How does it work?
It contains spores of Bacillus clausii, which can survive in the intestine and help support the normal balance of intestinal microorganisms.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not inject it. Shake the suspension if instructed on the label, and use it only within the recommended storage and expiry period.

Common side effects
It is generally well tolerated. Mild gas, bloating or stomach discomfort may occasionally occur. Allergic reactions are rare.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to Bacillus clausii or any ingredient in the product. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, blood in the stool, fever or signs of dehydration. People with severely weakened immunity or serious illness should use it only on medical advice.

title: Esorom DSR (10x1x10) Esomeprazole 40 mg Enteric-Coated, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
name: Esorom DSR (10x1x10) Esomeprazole 40 mg Enteric-Coated, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Esorom DSR (10x1x10) Esomeprazole 40 mg Enteric-Coated, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc CSC I0080
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat acidity, heartburn and acid reflux (GERD). It may also be prescribed when reflux is accompanied by nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Esomeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Domperidone helps improve movement of the upper digestive tract and helps control nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed. Swallow the enteric-coated/sustained-release medicine whole with water; do not crush, chew or break it. It is generally taken before food, but follow the product label or prescriber’s instructions.

Common side effects
Headache, abdominal discomfort or pain, diarrhoea, constipation, nausea, dry mouth and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Domperidone can rarely affect heart rhythm. Tell the prescriber about heart disease, an irregular heartbeat, liver disease, electrolyte problems, or any medicines being taken, especially medicines that affect heart rhythm or certain antibiotics/antifungals. Do not use without medical advice if there is gastrointestinal bleeding, blockage or perforation, or a prolactin-related tumour. Seek urgent medical help for fainting, severe dizziness or a fast or irregular heartbeat. Consult a doctor during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Esorom L (10x1x10) Esomeprazole 40 mg Enteric Coated, Levosulpride 75 mg SR by Csc
name: Esorom L (10x1x10) Esomeprazole 40 mg Enteric Coated, Levosulpride 75 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Esorom L (10x1x10) Esomeprazole 40 mg Enteric Coated, Levosulpride 75 mg SR by Csc CSC I0310
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat acid reflux (GERD), heartburn and indigestion, especially when symptoms are associated with delayed stomach emptying, bloating or nausea.

How does it work?
Esomeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Levosulpride helps improve stomach movement and the passage of food, which may reduce reflux and digestive discomfort.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed. Swallow the enteric-coated sustained-release medicine whole with water; do not crush, chew or break it. Follow the prescribed timing in relation to meals and do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, abdominal pain, bloating, diarrhoea or constipation, dizziness, drowsiness and restlessness. Increased breast fullness or milk production may occur due to levosulpride.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver or kidney problems, a history of seizures, intestinal obstruction or bleeding, or hormone-related conditions. Levosulpride may cause drowsiness or dizziness; avoid driving if affected. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially sedatives, antipsychotics and medicines that affect heart rhythm. Seek medical advice for black stools, vomiting blood, severe abdominal pain or persistent symptoms.

title: Etorgap 120 (10x1x10) Etoricoxib 120 mg by Csc
name: Etorgap 120 (10x1x10) Etoricoxib 120 mg by Csc
searchText: Etorgap 120 (10x1x10) Etoricoxib 120 mg by Csc CSC I0546
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Etoricoxib is used to relieve pain, swelling and stiffness caused by arthritis, including osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It may also be prescribed for short-term treatment of acute gout and other painful conditions.

How does it work?
It selectively blocks COX-2 enzymes that produce chemicals responsible for pain and inflammation. This helps reduce pain, swelling and stiffness.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water; it may be taken with or without food. Do not take more than the prescribed amount or combine it with other anti-inflammatory painkillers unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, swelling of the feet or legs, and increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney disease, liver disease, or allergy to aspirin or other anti-inflammatory medicines. It may increase the risk of heart attack or stroke, especially with long-term use or in people with cardiovascular risk factors. Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically advised. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, breathing difficulty, black stools, severe allergic reactions or unusual swelling.

title: Etorgap 90 (10x1x10) Etoricoxib 90 mg by Csc
name: Etorgap 90 (10x1x10) Etoricoxib 90 mg by Csc
searchText: Etorgap 90 (10x1x10) Etoricoxib 90 mg by Csc CSC I0547
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Etoricoxib is used to relieve pain, swelling and stiffness caused by osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and other joint conditions. It may also be prescribed for short-term treatment of acute gout or other severe pain, as directed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It selectively blocks COX-2 enzymes that produce substances responsible for pain and inflammation. This helps reduce pain, swelling and stiffness.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, with or without food. Do not take more than prescribed or use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, headache, dizziness, swelling of the feet or legs and increased blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney disease, liver disease or allergy to painkillers. Avoid taking it with other anti-inflammatory painkillers unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for chest pain, breathing difficulty, black stools, severe stomach pain, facial swelling or a serious skin rash. It is generally avoided during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless specifically prescribed.

title: ExaCalm Itch Relief Gel (50 gm ) Skin Calming Gel by Csc
name: ExaCalm Itch Relief Gel (50 gm ) Skin Calming Gel by Csc
searchText: ExaCalm Itch Relief Gel (50 gm ) Skin Calming Gel by Csc CSC I0273
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
The supplied information only identifies this product as a skin calming gel. Its specific use or the skin conditions it treats cannot be confirmed without the ingredient list or product label.

How does it work?
The way it works cannot be reliably determined from the supplied information.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not use it until its ingredients and intended use have been confirmed.

Common side effects
Cannot be reliably determined from the supplied information.

Precautions
Check the ingredients and instructions before use. Stop using it and seek medical advice if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Fabutech 40 (10x1x10) Febuxostat 40 mg by Csc
name: Fabutech 40 (10x1x10) Febuxostat 40 mg by Csc
searchText: Fabutech 40 (10x1x10) Febuxostat 40 mg by Csc CSC I0784
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Febuxostat is used for the long-term treatment of gout and high uric acid levels. It helps prevent uric acid crystal build-up and future gout attacks. It is not a painkiller and does not provide immediate relief during an acute gout attack.

How does it work?
It blocks an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which reduces the body's production of uric acid.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and continue it regularly, even if symptoms improve. It may be taken with or without food. Do not stop or change the dose without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, joint pain, skin rash, and changes in liver function tests. Gout attacks may temporarily become more frequent when treatment is started.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, heart disease, or a previous heart attack or stroke. Seek medical help for chest pain, breathing difficulty, severe rash, facial swelling, or yellowing of the skin or eyes. Do not use with azathioprine or mercaptopurine unless specifically directed by a doctor. Take it during an acute gout attack only as advised by the doctor.

title: Fesifol 123 (10x1x15) Docosahexaenoic Acid 40% 200 mg, Vitamin B12 1 mcg, Folic Acid 5 mg by Csc
name: Fesifol 123 (10x1x15) Docosahexaenoic Acid 40% 200 mg, Vitamin B12 1 mcg, Folic Acid 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Fesifol 123 (10x1x15) Docosahexaenoic Acid 40% 200 mg, Vitamin B12 1 mcg, Folic Acid 5 mg by Csc CSC I0885
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Provides DHA, vitamin B12 and folic acid. These nutrients support normal nerve function and red blood cell formation. DHA and folate are also important during pregnancy.

How does it work?
DHA is an omega-3 fatty acid found in brain and retinal structures. Vitamin B12 and folic acid support cell division and red blood cell production.

How to take/use it
Use according to prescribed directions. Do not determine dose from the ingredient list alone.

Common side effects
Digestive discomfort or nausea may occur.

Precautions
The listed folic acid strength is 5 mg. Use under medical guidance, particularly during pregnancy or when taking other vitamin supplements.

title: Fesifol Red (300ml) Elemental Iron 32.8 mg + Folic Acid 0.5 mg + Vitamin B 7.5 mcg by Csc
name: Fesifol Red (300ml) Elemental Iron 32.8 mg + Folic Acid 0.5 mg + Vitamin B 7.5 mcg by Csc
searchText: Fesifol Red (300ml) Elemental Iron 32.8 mg + Folic Acid 0.5 mg + Vitamin B 7.5 mcg by Csc CSC I0081
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat iron and folic acid deficiency, which can lead to nutritional anaemia and tiredness. It supports the formation of healthy red blood cells and may be prescribed when increased nutritional needs occur, such as during pregnancy.

How does it work?
Iron helps make haemoglobin, the substance that carries oxygen in the blood. Folic acid and vitamin B12 support the formation and normal development of red blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. It is usually better absorbed on an empty stomach, but it may be taken with food if it causes stomach upset. Avoid taking it at the same time as antacids, calcium supplements, tea or coffee; ask a pharmacist about the appropriate interval. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation, diarrhoea and dark-coloured stools. Mild stomach upset may improve when taken with food.

Precautions
Keep out of reach of children, as an iron overdose can be dangerous. Tell the doctor if there is iron overload, a blood disorder, or a history of stomach or intestinal problems. Folic acid may mask some signs of vitamin B12 deficiency, so medical advice is important when anaemia has not been properly diagnosed. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about other medicines and supplements being taken.

title: Fesifol XT (10x1x10) Ferrous Ascorbate 100 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Elemental Zinc 22.50 by Csc
name: Fesifol XT (10x1x10) Ferrous Ascorbate 100 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Elemental Zinc 22.50 by Csc
searchText: Fesifol XT (10x1x10) Ferrous Ascorbate 100 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Elemental Zinc 22.50 by Csc CSC I0082
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat iron and folic acid deficiency, including nutritional anaemia caused by low levels of these nutrients. It may also be prescribed when the body's need for iron and folate is increased.

How does it work?
Iron helps the body make haemoglobin, which carries oxygen in the blood. Folic acid supports the formation of healthy red blood cells, while vitamin C helps improve iron absorption.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as directed by the doctor or as stated on the product label. Swallow with water and do not exceed the recommended amount. If stomach upset occurs, taking it with food may help. Keep a gap from antacids, calcium supplements and certain other medicines as advised by a doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea, and dark-coloured stools. Dark stools are common with iron supplements.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is iron overload, a blood disorder, or anaemia not caused by iron deficiency. Inform the doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines, especially thyroid medicines, antacids, calcium supplements and some antibiotics. Keep out of reach of children, as an iron overdose can be dangerous.

title: Fexotech 120 (10x1x10) Fexofenadine 120 mg Tab by Csc
name: Fexotech 120 (10x1x10) Fexofenadine 120 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Fexotech 120 (10x1x10) Fexofenadine 120 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0084
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Fexofenadine 120 mg tablets are used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching. Fexofenadine may also be used to relieve itching and hives (urticaria).

How does it work?
It is an antihistamine that blocks the action of histamine, a substance responsible for many allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take the tablet exactly as directed by a doctor or according to the package instructions. Swallow it with water. Avoid taking it with fruit juice, as this may reduce its effect. If using antacids containing aluminium or magnesium, ask a pharmacist about separating their use from fexofenadine.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, dizziness, and mild drowsiness may occur.

Precautions
Tell a doctor or pharmacist if there is kidney disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizziness or drowsiness occurs. Seek medical advice if symptoms are severe, persistent, or worsening.

title: Fight & Fade Acne Facewash (100 g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Rosa Canina Fruit Extract, Vitamin E, Niacinamide Face Wash by Csc
name: Fight & Fade Acne Facewash (100 g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Rosa Canina Fruit Extract, Vitamin E, Niacinamide Face Wash by Csc
searchText: Fight & Fade Acne Facewash (100 g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Rosa Canina Fruit Extract, Vitamin E, Niacinamide Face Wash by Csc CSC I0699
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a topical skincare product to exfoliate dead skin cells, help unclog pores, and improve the appearance of uneven skin texture and tone. It may be useful for oily or acne-prone skin.

How does it work?
Glycolic acid and salicylic acid exfoliate the skin and help clear excess oil and blocked pores. Niacinamide, vitamin E and Rosa canina fruit extract help support the skin’s appearance and condition.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Do not use more often than recommended.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, dryness, irritation, peeling or increased skin sensitivity may occur.

Precautions
Patch test before wider use. Use sunscreen during the day, as exfoliating acids can increase sensitivity to sunlight. Avoid combining with other strong exfoliating or irritating products unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop use if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Fight & Fade Acne Facewash (60g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Rosa Canina Fruit Extract, Vitamin E, Niacinamide Face Wash by Csc
name: Fight & Fade Acne Facewash (60g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Rosa Canina Fruit Extract, Vitamin E, Niacinamide Face Wash by Csc
searchText: Fight & Fade Acne Facewash (60g) Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Rosa Canina Fruit Extract, Vitamin E, Niacinamide Face Wash by Csc CSC I0742
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used in skincare to exfoliate dead skin cells, help unclog pores and improve uneven skin texture. It may also help reduce excess oil and the appearance of blemishes.

How does it work?
Glycolic acid and salicylic acid exfoliate the skin, helping remove surface dead cells and clear blocked pores. Niacinamide, vitamin E and Rosa canina fruit extract help support and condition the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin exactly as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Use sunscreen during the day.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, dryness, peeling or irritation may occur, especially when starting use.

Precautions
Patch-test before regular use. Stop using if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops. Avoid using on sunburned or damaged skin and avoid combining with other strong exfoliants or irritating skincare products unless advised by a healthcare professional. Glycolic and salicylic acids can increase sensitivity to sunlight, so use sun protection.

title: Fineraft Suspension (170 ml ) Sodium Alginate, Sodium Bicarbonate, Calcium Carbonate Susp by Csc
name: Fineraft Suspension (170 ml ) Sodium Alginate, Sodium Bicarbonate, Calcium Carbonate Susp by Csc
searchText: Fineraft Suspension (170 ml ) Sodium Alginate, Sodium Bicarbonate, Calcium Carbonate Susp by Csc CSC I0991
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve heartburn, acid indigestion and symptoms of acid reflux, such as a burning feeling in the chest or an unpleasant taste caused by stomach acid.

How does it work?
Sodium alginate forms a protective layer that helps prevent stomach contents from flowing back into the food pipe. Sodium bicarbonate and calcium carbonate help neutralise excess stomach acid.

How to take/use it
Shake the suspension well before use. Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If symptoms continue or keep returning, seek medical advice.

Common side effects
Bloating, nausea, constipation or diarrhoea may occur. Stop use and seek medical advice if troublesome or unusual symptoms develop.

Precautions
Tell a doctor or pharmacist before use if there is kidney disease, heart failure, or a need to follow a low-sodium or low-calcium diet. Antacids can affect the absorption of some medicines, so check with a pharmacist about separating this product from other medicines. Seek medical advice for severe, persistent or unexplained symptoms, difficulty swallowing, vomiting, weight loss or chest pain.

title: Finokep 1mg (10x30) Finasteride 1 mg by Csc
name: Finokep 1mg (10x30) Finasteride 1 mg by Csc
searchText: Finokep 1mg (10x30) Finasteride 1 mg by Csc CSC I0946
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Finasteride 1 mg is used in adult men to treat male pattern hair loss. It may help slow hair loss and support hair regrowth with regular use as prescribed.

How does it work?
It reduces the formation of dihydrotestosterone (DHT), a hormone that can shrink hair follicles and contribute to male pattern hair loss.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Swallow the tablet whole and take it regularly. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Reduced sexual desire, difficulty getting or keeping an erection, and changes in ejaculation may occur. Mood changes, including low mood or depression, can also occur.

Precautions
For adult men only unless specifically prescribed otherwise. Women who are pregnant or may become pregnant should not handle crushed or broken tablets, as finasteride may harm a developing male baby. Tell the doctor about any history of depression or sexual problems. Finasteride can lower PSA blood-test results, so inform the doctor before prostate-related testing. Seek medical advice if breast lumps, pain, or nipple discharge occur.

title: Firstest Prega (60x1) Pregnancy Diagnostic Kit by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
A pregnancy diagnostic kit is used to check for pregnancy by detecting human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine.

How does it work?
The test detects hCG, a hormone produced during pregnancy. A positive result usually indicates pregnancy.

How to take/use it
Use the urine sample and follow the instructions provided with the kit. Check the result only within the time stated in the instructions. If the result is negative but pregnancy is still suspected, repeat the test later or seek medical advice.

Common side effects
No side effects are expected from using the test kit.

Precautions
Do not use an expired or damaged kit. A test taken very early may show a false-negative result. A positive result should be confirmed with a healthcare professional, especially if there is pain or bleeding.

title: Fizz-Off Gas (25x2) Papain, Fungal Diastase, Simethicone Effervescent Tab by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of indigestion, bloating and gas, especially when related to meals.

How does it work?
Papain and fungal diastase are digestive enzymes that help break down proteins and carbohydrates. Simethicone helps combine gas bubbles, making trapped gas easier to pass.

How to take/use it
Dissolve the effervescent tablet in a glass of water and take it exactly as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Do not swallow it dry, and do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Some people may experience nausea, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or constipation. Allergic reactions are uncommon but possible.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to papain, fungal diastase, simethicone or any other ingredient. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, blood in the stool or ongoing digestive symptoms. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

Its ingredients are intended to reduce excess stomach acid and/or help relieve trapped gas. The exact action depends on the ingredients in the product.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as directed on the product label. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If symptoms keep returning or do not improve, seek medical advice.

Common side effects
Depending on the ingredients, mild constipation, diarrhoea, nausea or changes in bowel habits may occur.

Precautions
Check the label carefully if taking other medicines, as some acidity medicines can affect their absorption. Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used in the nose to relieve blocked or congested nose and symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, runny nose and nasal irritation.

How does it work?
Fluticasone furoate reduces inflammation caused by allergies inside the nose. Oxymetazoline narrows swollen nasal blood vessels to provide short-term relief from nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
For nasal use only. Use exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not swallow or spray into the eyes. Clean the nozzle after use and do not share the spray. Do not use continuously for longer than recommended, as congestion may worsen after prolonged use.

Common side effects
Nasal dryness or irritation, sneezing, headache, sore throat and nosebleeds. Prolonged or excessive use may cause rebound nasal congestion.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, overactive thyroid, diabetes, prostate enlargement, recent nasal surgery or nasal injury. Seek advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if taking other decongestants or medicines for depression. Stop and seek medical advice for frequent or heavy nosebleeds, vision changes, severe irritation or symptoms that do not improve.

Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness or skin irritation may occur, especially on sensitive or cracked skin.

Ambroxol and guaifenesin help thin and loosen mucus so it can be coughed out more easily. Terbutaline relaxes the airway muscles and helps improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed by a doctor or as stated on the label. Measure the syrup with the supplied measuring device and do not exceed the recommended amount. Shake the bottle well before use.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, tremor, nervousness, palpitations or a fast heartbeat.

Precautions
Use only with medical advice in people with heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, overactive thyroid or a history of seizures. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Glutathione and vitamin C act as antioxidants, helping protect cells from oxidative damage. Vitamin C also supports collagen formation and normal immune function.

How to take/use it
This is an injectable medicine and should be given only by a trained healthcare professional. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the medical condition and must be decided by the prescriber. Do not self-inject.

Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site, nausea, stomach discomfort, flushing or headache may occur. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash or fainting.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about allergies to glutathione, vitamin C or injectable medicines; kidney disease or a history of kidney stones; and glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use only under medical supervision, especially if other medicines or supplements are being taken.

This combination is used as a nutritional supplement to support joint health, cartilage and connective tissue. It may be used as supportive care for joint discomfort or stiffness, but it is not a substitute for medical treatment of arthritis or other joint conditions.

Chondroitin, collagen peptides and hyaluronate provide components associated with cartilage and connective tissue. Vitamin C helps the body make collagen, while L-arginine is an amino acid involved in normal tissue functions.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Swallow with water; the product may be taken with food if it causes stomach discomfort.

Possible side effects include nausea, stomach upset, bloating, diarrhoea or headache. Stop use and seek medical help for signs of an allergic reaction.

Precautions
Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is kidney disease, low blood pressure, asthma or a history of recurrent herpes infection. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes, along with a suitable diet and exercise. It is prescribed when one medicine alone is not enough to control blood glucose.

How does it work?
Metformin reduces glucose production by the liver and helps the body use insulin better. Gliclazide helps the pancreas release more insulin, which lowers blood sugar.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed, usually with or just after food to reduce stomach upset. Take it at the same time each day and do not change the dose or stop it without medical advice. Do not take an extra dose if one is missed; follow the advice provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain, indigestion, reduced appetite and a metallic taste may occur. Low blood sugar can cause sweating, shakiness, dizziness, hunger, weakness or confusion, especially if meals are missed.

Precautions
Monitor blood sugar regularly. Do not skip meals or drink excessive alcohol, as this may increase the risk of low blood sugar. Inform the doctor about kidney or liver disease, heavy alcohol use, severe infection, dehydration, planned surgery or an X-ray scan using contrast dye. Seek urgent medical help for severe weakness, breathing difficulty, persistent vomiting, unusual sleepiness or confusion. This medicine is generally not used for type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis unless specifically directed by a specialist.

Precautions
For external use only; avoid contact with the eyes and mouth. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes. It is not used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis.

How does it work?
Dapagliflozin helps the kidneys remove excess glucose through urine. Sitagliptin increases the body's natural insulin response after meals and reduces the release of glucose from the liver.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed by the doctor, with or without food. Do not stop or change the medicine without medical advice. Maintain adequate fluid intake unless fluid restriction has been advised.

Common side effects
Increased urination, genital fungal infections, urinary tract infections, thirst, dehydration, headache, nausea and stomach discomfort. Low blood sugar is more likely when used with insulin or sulfonylureas.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, dehydration, recurrent urinary or genital infections, pancreatitis, or planned surgery. Seek urgent medical help for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, difficulty breathing, unusual weakness, or signs of severe dehydration. Stop and seek medical advice if symptoms of diabetic ketoacidosis occur, even if blood sugar is not very high. Discuss use during pregnancy or breastfeeding with a doctor.

Sitagliptin helps the body release more insulin after meals and reduces the amount of sugar made by the liver. Metformin also lowers sugar production by the liver and helps the body use insulin better.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with food, to reduce stomach upset. Swallow the tablet as directed and do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. If a dose is missed, follow the instructions on the prescription and do not take a double dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, indigestion, headache and cold-like symptoms may occur. Low blood sugar is more likely when used with insulin or certain other diabetes medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, heavy alcohol use, pancreatitis, or vitamin B12 deficiency. Kidney function may need monitoring. Seek urgent medical help for severe or persistent abdominal pain, unusual weakness, breathing difficulty or severe vomiting. Tell the doctor before surgery or an X-ray scan using an iodinated contrast dye. Discuss use during pregnancy or breastfeeding with a doctor.

title: Istafall-M 50/500 (10X2X15) Sitagliptin 50 mg, Metformin 500 mg by Csc

searchText: Istafall-M 50/500 (10X2X15) Sitagliptin 50 mg, Metformin 500 mg by Csc CSC I0619
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes. It may be prescribed when metformin alone does not control blood sugar adequately, or when both medicines are needed together.

How does it work?
Sitagliptin helps the body release more insulin and reduce glucagon when blood sugar is high. Metformin reduces glucose production by the liver and helps the body use insulin more effectively.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually with meals to reduce stomach upset. Swallow the tablet as directed and do not stop treatment without medical advice. The dose may need adjustment based on kidney function and other medicines.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, indigestion, headache and cold-like symptoms may occur. Low blood sugar is more likely when used with insulin or sulfonylurea medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, severe infection, heavy alcohol use, or planned surgery or contrast-dye scans. Seek medical help for severe or persistent abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, breathing difficulty, unusual weakness, or signs of an allergic reaction. Kidney function may need checking, and long-term metformin use can reduce vitamin B12 levels.

title: Ivertech A (30X1X1) Albendazole 400 mg, Ivermectin 12 mg by Csc
name: Ivertech A (30X1X1) Albendazole 400 mg, Ivermectin 12 mg by Csc
searchText: Ivertech A (30X1X1) Albendazole 400 mg, Ivermectin 12 mg by Csc CSC I0464
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain parasitic worm infections, including intestinal worm infections. It should be used only when recommended by a doctor or pharmacist.

How does it work?
Albendazole damages the parasite's ability to absorb nutrients, while ivermectin affects the parasite's nerve and muscle activity. Together, they help kill or remove susceptible parasites.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed. Do not change the dose, repeat treatment or share this medicine without medical advice. Follow the prescribed instructions regarding food and treatment duration.

Common side effects
Stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver disease or a history of allergy to either medicine. Use in children or people with other medical conditions should be guided by a healthcare professional. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizziness occurs. Seek medical help for severe rash, breathing difficulty or unusual weakness.

title: Jigerzym Syrup (200ml) Ayurvedic Liver Enztme Syrup by Csc
name: Jigerzym Syrup (200ml) Ayurvedic Liver Enztme Syrup by Csc
searchText: Jigerzym Syrup (200ml) Ayurvedic Liver Enztme Syrup by Csc CSC I0526
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This Ayurvedic syrup is intended for general liver support. Its exact uses depend on the ingredients and product formulation; check the label for specific indications.

How does it work?
The mechanism depends on the Ayurvedic ingredients in the syrup. It is generally formulated to support normal liver function, but the ingredients were not provided.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a qualified healthcare professional. Do not use a dose or treatment duration unless stated on the label.

Common side effects
Specific side effects cannot be reliably listed without the ingredient details. Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction or other concerning symptoms occur.

Precautions
Check the ingredients before use, especially if there is an allergy, liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or use of other medicines. Seek medical advice for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe abdominal pain, or persistent vomiting. Do not use it as a substitute for medical treatment of diagnosed liver disease.

title: Kabz Off Granuels (120g) Natural Laxative granules for Constipation and improves Digestive system by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve constipation and help make bowel movements easier.

How does it work?
It helps promote bowel movement. The exact action depends on the natural laxative ingredients in the granules.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a pharmacist. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Drink adequate fluids unless a doctor has advised fluid restriction.

Common side effects
Bloating, gas, abdominal cramps, nausea or loose stools may occur.

Precautions
Do not use for persistent constipation without medical advice. Seek medical help for severe or unexplained abdominal pain, vomiting, marked abdominal swelling, blood in the stool or inability to pass stool or gas. Avoid prolonged or excessive use unless advised by a healthcare professional. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in children.

title: Kabz Off Tablet (10x10) Laxative Tablets Relieves Gas & Constipation by Csc
name: Kabz Off Tablet (10x10) Laxative Tablets Relieves Gas & Constipation by Csc
