bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of constipation and discomfort caused by trapped gas or bloating.

How does it work?
The laxative component helps stool move through the bowel or makes it easier to pass. The gas-relief component helps reduce discomfort from trapped gas.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a pharmacist. Do not exceed the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Drink adequate fluids unless a healthcare professional has advised fluid restriction.

Common side effects
Abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, loose stools or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if there is severe or persistent abdominal pain, vomiting, marked abdominal swelling, or inability to pass stools or gas. Avoid prolonged or frequent laxative use unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice if constipation does not improve or keeps returning. Consult a healthcare professional before use in children, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or with other medical conditions.

title: Keteen (30g) Ketoconazole 2% w/w Cream by Csc
name: Keteen (30g) Ketoconazole 2% w/w Cream by Csc
searchText: Keteen (30g) Ketoconazole 2% w/w Cream by Csc CSC I0096
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% cream is used to treat fungal infections of the skin, such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, jock itch, pityriasis versicolor and some yeast-related skin infections. It may also be used for seborrhoeic dermatitis when prescribed.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, helping to kill the fungus and clear the infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the clean, dry affected area exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after applying it, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, dryness or irritation at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient in the cream. Avoid contact with the eyes and rinse with clean water if accidental contact occurs. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs. Consult a doctor if the infection worsens or does not improve as expected.

title: Keteen Lotion (50ml) Ketoconazole 2% Lotion by Csc
name: Keteen Lotion (50ml) Ketoconazole 2% Lotion by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% lotion is used to treat fungal infections of the skin, including ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal groin infections and pityriasis versicolor. It may also be used for some other fungal skin conditions as prescribed.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, helping to control and clear the infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry, affected skin as directed by a doctor or the product label. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient in the lotion. Avoid applying to the eyes or severely broken skin. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs. Seek medical advice if the infection does not improve or gets worse.

title: Keteen Plus Soap (75g) Ketoconazole, Glycerin, Olive Oil Soap by Csc
name: Keteen Plus Soap (75g) Ketoconazole, Glycerin, Olive Oil Soap by Csc
searchText: Keteen Plus Soap (75g) Ketoconazole, Glycerin, Olive Oil Soap by Csc CSC I0441
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole soap is used on the skin to help treat fungal skin infections, such as ringworm and other superficial fungal infections. It may also help relieve related itching and scaling.

How does it work?
Ketoconazole is an antifungal medicine that stops the growth of fungi by affecting their cell membranes. Glycerin and olive oil help cleanse and may reduce skin dryness.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Wet the affected skin, apply the soap to form a lather, rinse well and dry gently. Use it exactly as directed by a doctor or as stated on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, burning, itching, redness or dryness may occur at the application site. Stop use and seek medical advice if a severe rash or allergic reaction develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient. Avoid using on broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a doctor. Do not swallow. Keep away from the eyes; rinse with plenty of water if contact occurs. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens or does not improve with use.

title: Keteen Shampoo (100 ml ) Ketoconazole 2% Shampoo by Csc
name: Keteen Shampoo (100 ml ) Ketoconazole 2% Shampoo by Csc
searchText: Keteen Shampoo (100 ml ) Ketoconazole 2% Shampoo by Csc CSC I0444
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% shampoo is used to treat dandruff and seborrhoeic dermatitis, which can cause flaky, itchy or scaly skin on the scalp. It may also be used for certain fungal skin infections, such as pityriasis versicolor, when recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It is an antifungal medicine that stops the growth of fungi by interfering with the formation of their cell membranes. This helps reduce fungal overgrowth, flaking and irritation.

How to take/use it
Use only on the skin and scalp. Wet the affected area, apply the shampoo, gently work it into a lather and rinse thoroughly. Follow the product label or healthcare professional’s instructions for how often to use it and how long to continue treatment. Avoid contact with the eyes; rinse well with water if this happens.

Common side effects
Mild burning, itching, irritation, dryness or redness of the scalp or skin. Changes in hair texture may occur.

Precautions
For external use only; do not swallow. Avoid use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient. Do not apply to broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs. Keep away from the eyes and rinse immediately with water if contact occurs.

title: Keteen Shampoo (75ml) Ketoconazole 2% Shampoo by Csc
name: Keteen Shampoo (75ml) Ketoconazole 2% Shampoo by Csc
searchText: Keteen Shampoo (75ml) Ketoconazole 2% Shampoo by Csc CSC I0098
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% shampoo is used to treat fungal conditions affecting the scalp or skin, including dandruff (seborrhoeic dermatitis) and pityriasis versicolor.

How does it work?
It is an antifungal medicine that stops the growth of fungi causing these conditions.

How to take/use it
Use on the affected scalp or skin exactly as directed by a doctor or the product label. Apply to wet hair or affected skin, gently lather, and rinse thoroughly. Avoid contact with the eyes; rinse well with clean water if contact occurs.

Common side effects
Mild burning, itching, irritation, dryness, or changes in hair texture may occur at the application site.

Precautions
For external use only. Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient. Avoid applying to broken or severely irritated skin and avoid contact with the eyes. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash, or breathing difficulty occurs.

How does it work?
It is an antifungal medicine that reduces the growth of fungi on the scalp or skin, helping relieve flaking, itching and irritation.

How to take/use it
Use externally only. Apply to wet hair and scalp or the affected skin, gently massage to form a lather, leave briefly as directed on the label or by the prescriber, and rinse well. Common side effects
Mild burning, itching, irritation, dryness or oiliness of the scalp or skin. Changes in hair texture may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient. Avoid contact with the eyes and broken skin. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs. Seek medical advice if symptoms do not improve or worsen.

How does it work?
Ketoconazole is an antifungal medicine that stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, helping to control the infection.

What is it used for?
Used mainly to treat dandruff and seborrhoeic dermatitis, a condition causing flaky, itchy or irritated skin of the scalp. It may also be used for certain fungal skin infections when prescribed or recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Ketoconazole is an antifungal medicine that reduces the growth of fungi on the skin. Zinc pyrithione also helps control fungal growth and reduce flaking.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply or use on the affected area exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Wash hands after use.

Common side effects

Precautions

name: Ketorotech DT (10x1x15) Ketorolac Tromethamine 10 mg DT Tab by Csc
searchText: Ketorotech DT (10x1x15) Ketorolac Tromethamine 10 mg DT Tab by Csc CSC I0624
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketorolac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine used for the short-term relief of moderate to severe acute pain, such as pain after surgery or injury. It is not generally intended for long-term or minor pain.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not take more often or for longer than directed. Take with food or milk if it causes stomach upset. Do not take it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen, diclofenac, naproxen or aspirin unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, indigestion, nausea, stomach pain, headache, dizziness and drowsiness.

Precautions
It can cause stomach ulcers or bleeding and may affect kidney function. Avoid it or seek medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney disease, severe dehydration, heart disease, uncontrolled high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or use of blood thinners. Avoid during pregnancy unless specifically prescribed, especially after 20 weeks of pregnancy. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, chest pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a serious skin rash.

What is it used for?
This syrup is used for temporary relief of dry cough, blocked or stuffy nose, and allergy or cold-related symptoms.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan suppresses the cough reflex. Chlorpheniramine reduces allergy symptoms, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Measure the syrup with a proper measuring device and do not exceed the recommended amount. Avoid taking it with other cough, cold or decongestant medicines unless advised.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, headache, and nervousness may occur. Phenylephrine may cause a fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and driving or operating machinery if drowsy or dizzy. Consult a doctor before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, prostate or urinary problems, or liver disease. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitors and check with a doctor before combining with antidepressants or other medicines that cause drowsiness. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in young children.

title: Koffskip DX (30x10) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg by Csc
name: Koffskip DX (30x10) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg by Csc

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the cough reflex. Chlorpheniramine helps relieve allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose, while phenylephrine reduces nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Use the measuring device provided and do not take more than recommended. Avoid combining it with other cough, cold or allergy medicines unless advised by a doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, headache and restlessness may occur. Some people may experience a fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and driving or operating machinery if drowsy or dizzy. Ask a doctor before use in children, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, prostate or urinary problems. title: Koffskip Total (100 ml ) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Ambroxol 15 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Menthol 1.5 mg by Csc
name: Koffskip Total (100 ml ) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Ambroxol 15 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Menthol 1.5 mg by Csc
searchText: Koffskip Total (100 ml ) Dextromethorphan 10 mg, Ambroxol 15 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Menthol 1.5 mg by Csc CSC I0070
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for the temporary relief of cough associated with cold or allergy symptoms, including a blocked or runny nose, sneezing and throat irritation. It also helps loosen mucus, making it easier to clear.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan helps reduce the cough reflex, while ambroxol loosens mucus. Chlorpheniramine reduces allergy symptoms, phenylephrine relieves nasal congestion, and menthol provides a soothing sensation.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Measure liquid doses with the supplied measuring device, if applicable, and do not take more than recommended. Avoid taking it with other cough, cold or allergy medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, stomach upset, headache, nervousness or difficulty sleeping. Palpitations or increased blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and driving or operating machinery if drowsy or dizzy. Consult a doctor before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, prostate or urinary problems, or breathing problems. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitors, and check with a doctor before use with antidepressants or other medicines affecting serotonin. Consult a doctor during pregnancy or breastfeeding, and before giving to children. Seek medical advice for a persistent, worsening or bloody cough, breathing difficulty, or fever.

title: Kojicraft Plus Cream (15 gm ) Kojic Acid Dipalmitate, Pine Bark Extract, Arbutin, Allantoin, Vitamin E Acetate, Nicotinamide, Octinoxate Gel by Csc
name: Kojicraft Plus Cream (15 gm ) Kojic Acid Dipalmitate, Pine Bark Extract, Arbutin, Allantoin, Vitamin E Acetate, Nicotinamide, Octinoxate Gel by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used topically to help reduce the appearance of dark spots, hyperpigmentation and uneven skin tone.

How does it work?
Kojic acid dipalmitate, arbutin and niacinamide help reduce excess melanin formation, which may gradually lighten dark areas. Allantoin, vitamin E and pine bark extract help soothe and protect the skin, while octinoxate provides some UVB protection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Use sun protection during the day, as sunlight can worsen pigmentation.

Common side effects
Mild redness, burning, itching, dryness or skin irritation may occur, especially in sensitive skin. Stop use if severe irritation or an allergic reaction develops.

Precautions
Patch-test before regular use. Avoid applying to broken or inflamed skin and keep away from the eyes. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Seek medical advice if irritation persists or if the pigmentation changes rapidly or has an uncertain cause.

title: Kojicraft Plus Soap (75g) Glutathione, Ascorbic Acid, Kojic Acid Soap by Csc

How does it work?
Ketoconazole stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, which helps control the fungal infection. Glycerine and olive oil help cleanse and moisturise the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Wet the affected skin, apply the soap as directed on the label or by a doctor, and rinse thoroughly. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Wash hands after use unless the hands are being treated.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, burning, itching, dryness or redness may occur where it is applied.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient. Avoid applying to the eyes, inside the mouth or on severely broken skin. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops, or if the infection does not improve. Do not share personal towels or clothing during a fungal infection.

title: Korean Glutathione D-Tan Soap (70 gm ) Glutathione, Kojic Acid, Honey Soap by Csc
name: Korean Glutathione D-Tan Soap (70 gm ) Glutathione, Kojic Acid, Honey Soap by Csc
searchText: Korean Glutathione D-Tan Soap (70 gm ) Glutathione, Kojic Acid, Honey Soap by Csc CSC I0882
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used in topical skincare products to help reduce the appearance of dark spots, pigmentation and uneven skin tone. Honey may help moisturise the skin.

How does it work?
Kojic acid reduces melanin production by inhibiting tyrosinase, an enzyme involved in skin pigmentation. Honey can help retain moisture on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and broken or irritated skin. Use sunscreen during the day when using kojic acid products.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, redness, itching, dryness or a burning sensation may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before regular use. Stop using it if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops. Avoid using on damaged skin and keep away from the eyes. Consult a dermatologist if pigmentation persists or worsens.

title: Lactoeve Plus (100 ml ) Lactic Acid, Probiotic, Tea Tree Oil Vaginal Wash by Csc

searchText: Lactoeve Plus (100 ml ) Lactic Acid, Probiotic, Tea Tree Oil Vaginal Wash by Csc CSC I0289
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for gentle external intimate cleansing and helping support the vagina's natural acidic pH and freshness. It is not a treatment for vaginal infections.

Lactic acid helps maintain an acidic environment, while probiotics are intended to support the natural balance of vaginal microorganisms. Tea tree oil provides cleansing properties but may irritate sensitive skin.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Apply to the external intimate area and rinse thoroughly. Do not douche or insert it into the vagina unless the label specifically instructs this.

Common side effects
Some people may experience temporary stinging, burning, itching, dryness, redness or an allergic skin reaction.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes and broken or irritated skin. Stop using it if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Seek medical advice for persistent itching, unusual discharge, strong odour, sores or pain, as these may require specific treatment.

title: Lactoeve Wash (100ml) Lactoserum, Lactic Acid, Sea Buckthorn Oil Vaginal Wash by Csc
name: Lactoeve Wash (100ml) Lactoserum, Lactic Acid, Sea Buckthorn Oil Vaginal Wash by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for vaginal and intimate hygiene and to help maintain the vagina’s natural acidic pH. It may help cleanse the area and provide soothing moisture, but it should not be used as a substitute for treatment of a vaginal infection.

How does it work?
Lactic acid helps support the vagina’s naturally acidic environment. Sea buckthorn oil may help moisturise and soothe the vaginal area.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Use it only for vaginal/intimate application and avoid contact with the eyes. Do not swallow it. Stop using it if significant irritation occurs.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, itching, redness or irritation may occur. Allergic reactions are possible.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Seek medical advice for unusual discharge, unpleasant odour, significant itching, pain, sores, bleeding or symptoms that do not improve. This product does not replace medical treatment for vaginal infections. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or if the vaginal area is injured or inflamed.

title: Levitech 500 (10x10) Levofloxacin 500 mg Tab by Csc
name: Levitech 500 (10x10) Levofloxacin 500 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Levitech 500 (10x10) Levofloxacin 500 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0101
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levofloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as some infections of the lungs, urinary tract, skin and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking enzymes that bacteria need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the course unless a healthcare professional advises otherwise. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not take it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc; follow the prescribed spacing instructions.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and sleep disturbance may occur.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice. Stop taking it and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe mood or nerve-related changes, a fast or irregular heartbeat, or a serious allergic reaction. Tell the healthcare professional if there is a history of tendon problems, seizures, heart-rhythm problems, kidney disease, or if pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid unnecessary sun exposure and report severe skin reactions.

title: Lipsy (10g) Raspberry Flavour Lipbalm with SPF by Csc
name: Lipsy (10g) Raspberry Flavour Lipbalm with SPF by Csc
searchText: Lipsy (10g) Raspberry Flavour Lipbalm with SPF by Csc CSC I0102
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Raspberry-flavoured lip balm with SPF helps moisturise and protect the lips from the sun’s ultraviolet (UV) rays. It can help prevent sun-related dryness and damage to the lips.

How does it work?
The balm forms a protective layer on the lips, while its SPF ingredients help reduce exposure to UV rays.

How to take/use it
Apply evenly to the lips before sun exposure and use as directed on the product label. Avoid applying inside the mouth or to damaged skin.

Common side effects
Mild irritation, burning or an allergic reaction may occur in sensitive individuals.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes. Stop use if irritation or a rash develops. SPF protection does not completely block UV exposure; avoid prolonged sun exposure and use other sun-protection measures.

title: Lulirid Cream (10g) (10g) Luliconazole 1% Cream by Csc
name: Lulirid Cream (10g) (10g) Luliconazole 1% Cream by Csc
searchText: Lulirid Cream (10g) (10g) Luliconazole 1% Cream by Csc CSC I0105
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Luliconazole 1% cream is used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, jock itch and athlete’s foot.

How does it work?
It stops the growth of fungi by interfering with the production of an essential part of the fungal cell membrane.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to the affected skin and nearby skin only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Wash hands before and after applying it. For external use only; avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the vagina.

Common side effects
Mild application-site irritation, redness, itching or burning may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to luliconazole or any ingredient in the cream. Avoid applying it to the eyes, mouth, open wounds or other sensitive areas unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens, causes severe irritation, or does not improve with treatment.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Luliconazole cream is used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, jock itch and athlete’s foot.

How does it work?
It stops the growth of fungi by blocking the formation of an essential part of their cell membrane.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to the affected, clean and dry skin as directed by the doctor or pharmacist. For external use only. Wash hands after applying, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild application-site irritation, redness, itching, burning or stinging may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to luliconazole or any of its ingredients. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the vagina. Do not apply to broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

What is it used for?
Luliconazole cream is used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and jock itch.

How does it work?
It stops the growth of fungi by interfering with the formation of an essential part of the fungal cell membrane.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to the affected, clean and dry skin exactly as directed by the doctor. For external use only. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Do not stop treatment early without medical advice.

Common side effects
Mild burning, itching, redness, irritation or discomfort at the application site.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the vagina. Do not apply to broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a doctor. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs. Consult a doctor if the infection worsens or does not improve.

name: Lulirid Lotion (15ml) Luliconazole 1% Lotion by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Luliconazole lotion is used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, jock itch and athlete’s foot.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, which helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to clean, dry, affected skin exactly as prescribed. Use it only on the skin, wash hands after applying, and complete the prescribed course even if symptoms improve. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild burning, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site may occur.

Precautions
For external use only. Do not apply to the eyes, mouth, inside the vagina or on open wounds unless specifically directed. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs. Consult a doctor if the infection worsens or does not improve.

title: Lulirid OC (15g) Luliconazole 1%, Ofloxacin 0.75%, Ornidazole 2%, Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% by Csc
name: Lulirid OC (15g) Luliconazole 1%, Ofloxacin 0.75%, Ornidazole 2%, Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% by Csc
searchText: Lulirid OC (15g) Luliconazole 1%, Ofloxacin 0.75%, Ornidazole 2%, Clobetasol Propionate 0.05% by Csc CSC I0951
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This prescription skin medicine is used for certain inflamed skin infections involving fungi and, when prescribed, associated bacterial or other susceptible infections. It should be used only for the condition diagnosed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Luliconazole fights fungal infections, while ofloxacin and ornidazole act against certain bacteria and other susceptible organisms. Clobetasol reduces redness, swelling and itching, but it can also mask or worsen an infection if used improperly.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry affected skin exactly as prescribed. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the nose. Do not cover the area with a tight dressing unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, redness, itching, irritation or dryness at the application site. Prolonged or improper use may cause skin thinning or other steroid-related skin changes.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice, especially on the face, groin, skin folds, children or large areas of skin. Do not use for longer than prescribed or on untreated rashes. Clobetasol may hide or worsen fungal infections. Avoid use on broken skin and keep away from the eyes. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads or does not improve.

title: Lulirid SB Shampoo (100 ml ) Luliconazole, Salicylic Acid, Zinc Pyrithione Shampoo by Csc
name: Lulirid SB Shampoo (100 ml ) Luliconazole, Salicylic Acid, Zinc Pyrithione Shampoo by Csc
searchText: Lulirid SB Shampoo (100 ml ) Luliconazole, Salicylic Acid, Zinc Pyrithione Shampoo by Csc CSC I0954
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the scalp to help treat dandruff and fungal scalp conditions, including seborrhoeic dermatitis, when recommended by a doctor or pharmacist.

How does it work?
Luliconazole and zinc pyrithione help control the fungi that can contribute to scalp infections and dandruff. Salicylic acid helps loosen and remove flaky, scaly skin.

How to take/use it
Use on the scalp and hair exactly as directed on the label or by the doctor. Apply to the affected scalp, gently massage, and rinse thoroughly. Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes.

Common side effects
Scalp irritation, burning, itching, redness, dryness, or peeling may occur.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes; rinse thoroughly with water if contact occurs. Do not apply to severely irritated or broken skin unless advised by a doctor. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, or an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Lulirid SB Shampoo Sachet (7ml) Luliconazole, Salicylic Acid, Zinc Pyrithione Shampoo by Csc
name: Lulirid SB Shampoo Sachet (7ml) Luliconazole, Salicylic Acid, Zinc Pyrithione Shampoo by Csc
searchText: Lulirid SB Shampoo Sachet (7ml) Luliconazole, Salicylic Acid, Zinc Pyrithione Shampoo by Csc CSC I0803
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the scalp to help treat fungal scalp conditions and reduce dandruff, scaling and flaking.

How does it work?
Luliconazole and zinc pyrithione help control fungal growth. Salicylic acid helps loosen and remove excess scalp scales.

How to take/use it
Use only on the scalp and follow the instructions on the label or from a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and rinse thoroughly if contact occurs.

Common side effects
Mild scalp irritation, itching, burning, dryness or redness may occur.

Precautions
For external use only. Do not use on broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs. Consult a healthcare professional before use in children, during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

How does it work?
It stops the growth of fungi by interfering with the formation of an essential part of the fungal cell membrane.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to clean, completely dry affected skin exactly as prescribed. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. For spray application, avoid inhaling the spray and do not spray near the eyes or face.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness or irritation at the application site.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, inside of the nose, genital areas and broken skin. Do not use if allergic to luliconazole or any ingredient. title: Lulirid XL (30g) (30 gm ) Luliconazole 1% Cream by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Luliconazole 1% cream is used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, jock itch and athlete’s foot. It helps relieve the associated itching, redness and scaling.

How does it work?
It prevents the fungus from making an essential part of its cell membrane, stopping its growth and clearing the infection.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to the clean, dry affected skin as directed by the doctor or product instructions. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. For external use only; avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the nose.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site may occur.

Precautions
Do not apply to the eyes, mouth, or broken skin. Avoid covering the area with tight or airtight dressings unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical advice if the irritation is severe, the infection worsens, or there is no improvement. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Lycomato (10x1x10) Lycopene, Vitamins, Multiminerals by Csc
name: Lycomato (10x1x10) Lycopene, Vitamins, Multiminerals by Csc
searchText: Lycomato (10x1x10) Lycopene, Vitamins, Multiminerals by Csc CSC I0108
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement is used to provide vitamins, minerals, lycopene and antioxidant support when dietary intake may be inadequate. It may help prevent or correct nutrient deficiencies, but it is not a substitute for a balanced diet or a treatment for a specific disease.

How does it work?
It supplies essential vitamins and minerals needed for normal body functions. Lycopene and some vitamins have antioxidant properties that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount or use it with other multivitamin or mineral supplements unless advised.

Common side effects
May cause mild nausea, stomach upset, constipation or diarrhoea. Side effects can vary depending on the ingredients and amounts present.

Precautions
Check the ingredients if there is an allergy or sensitivity. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or with kidney or liver disease. Ask a healthcare professional about possible interactions with regular medicines. Avoid taking multiple products containing the same vitamins or minerals.

title: Lycomato (200ml) Lycopene, Vitamins, Multiminerals by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This is a multivitamin and mineral supplement used to help provide essential nutrients when dietary intake is insufficient. It also contains antioxidant nutrients such as lycopene, vitamins C and E, and selenium.

How does it work?
It supplies vitamins and minerals needed for normal body functions, including energy metabolism, immunity, vision and antioxidant protection.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount or combine it with other multivitamin supplements unless advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea may occur. Urine may become bright yellow due to riboflavin and is usually harmless.

Precautions
Check with a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is thyroid, kidney or liver disease. Seek advice if taking other vitamin or mineral supplements or regular medicines, particularly because this product contains vitamin A and iodine. Stop use and seek medical help if an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Mankast LC (10x1x15) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
name: Mankast LC (10x1x15) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Mankast LC (10x1x15) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc CSC I0235
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis (nasal allergy), such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine reduces the effects of histamine, which causes allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals that contribute to swelling and congestion in the airways and nose.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not take more than the recommended amount. This medicine is not meant to provide immediate relief during an acute asthma attack.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach discomfort, nausea, or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
May cause sleepiness; use caution while driving and avoid alcohol until its effects are known. Seek medical advice if there are mood or behaviour changes, unusual dreams, anxiety, depression, or suicidal thoughts. Inform the doctor about liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or any other medicines being taken.

title: Mankast LC (60 ml ) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
name: Mankast LC (60 ml ) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Mankast LC (60 ml ) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc CSC I0963
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose, and itchy or watery eyes. It may also be prescribed as part of treatment for allergy-related breathing symptoms.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a substance that causes allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals involved in allergic inflammation and airway narrowing.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Follow the instructions on the label, and do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. This medicine does not provide immediate relief during a sudden asthma attack.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach pain, nausea, and diarrhoea.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving or alcohol until its effects are known. Contact a doctor promptly if mood or behaviour changes, unusual dreams, anxiety, depression, irritability, or suicidal thoughts occur. Inform the doctor about kidney or liver problems, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Seek medical advice if breathing suddenly worsens.

title: Maxstam (10x2x15) Antioxidant+Multivitamin & Multiminerals by Csc

What is it used for?
Used to supplement the diet and help prevent or correct vitamin and mineral deficiencies. It may also provide antioxidant nutritional support when dietary intake is inadequate or requirements are increased.

How does it work?
It supplies essential vitamins and minerals needed for normal body functions. Antioxidant ingredients help protect cells from oxidative damage.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. It may be taken with food if it causes stomach discomfort.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation, diarrhoea, or an unpleasant taste may occur. Urine may become bright yellow with some vitamin formulations.

Precautions
Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other vitamin and mineral supplements without medical advice. Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is kidney disease, liver disease, or ongoing medical treatment. Keep out of reach of children.

What is it used for?
This product is a dietary supplement that provides omega-3 fatty acids, vitamins, minerals, plant extracts and antioxidant compounds for general nutritional and wellness support. It is not intended to diagnose or treat a specific disease.

How does it work?
The vitamins and minerals help support normal body functions, while omega-3 fatty acids and the included plant-derived ingredients provide additional nutritional compounds.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Swallow the softgel with water.

Common side effects
Possible effects include nausea, stomach upset, loose stools, fishy aftertaste or bad breath. Some ingredients may cause headache, sleeplessness or increased blood pressure in sensitive people.

Precautions
Check the ingredients before use if allergic to fish, seafood or any listed ingredient. Seek medical advice before use if taking blood thinners, medicines for diabetes or blood pressure, or if surgery is planned. People with high blood pressure, kidney or heart problems, or those who are pregnant or breastfeeding should consult a healthcare professional before use. Do not combine with other vitamin or supplement products without advice.

How does it work?
It supplies essential vitamins, minerals and vitamin B12 needed for normal body functions. Antioxidant nutrients help protect cells from oxidative damage.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement the diet with vitamins, minerals, antioxidants and ginseng. It may help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies when dietary intake is inadequate. It is not a substitute for a varied, balanced diet.

How does it work?
The vitamins and minerals support normal body functions, while antioxidant nutrients help protect cells from oxidative damage. Ginseng is a herbal ingredient traditionally used as a general wellness supplement.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label, preferably with food if it causes stomach discomfort. Do not exceed the recommended amount or take other multivitamin products at the same time unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, nausea, diarrhoea, headache or allergic reactions may occur. Ginseng may cause restlessness or difficulty sleeping in some people.

Precautions
Check with a doctor or pharmacist before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is diabetes, a bleeding disorder, insomnia, or another medical condition. Ask for advice if taking blood thinners, diabetes medicines or other regular medicines. Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Maxstam Omega 3 (10x1x10) Omega 3 Fatty Acid 1000 mg by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Omega-3 fatty acid 1000 mg is used as a dietary supplement to help provide omega-3 fats when intake from food is insufficient. Omega-3 fats support normal heart and overall health.

How does it work?
Omega-3 fatty acids are essential fats used by the body for cell function and other normal processes. EPA and DHA, when present, may also help support healthy triglyceride levels.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach discomfort. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Fishy aftertaste or burping, indigestion, nausea, loose stools or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to fish or seafood unless advised by a healthcare professional. Consult a doctor before use if taking blood thinners, having a bleeding disorder, or before surgery. Seek medical advice during pregnancy or breastfeeding. This supplement should not replace prescribed treatment for high triglycerides or other medical conditions.

May be intended to supplement the diet with vitamin C, fatty acids and other nutrients. Exact benefits depend on the finished product and formulation.

Vitamin C contributes to normal collagen formation and antioxidant protection. Fatty acids provide nutrients used in normal cellular functions.

How to take/use it
Follow the product label. Confirm whether it is intended for oral or topical use.

Cannot be reliably determined from the ingredient list alone.

What is it used for?
This is a nutritional supplement providing vitamins, minerals, antioxidants and plant extracts such as ginseng, evening primrose oil, grape seed extract and lycopene. It is used to help supplement the diet when nutritional intake may be inadequate. It is not intended to diagnose or treat a specific disease based on the information available.

How does it work?
The vitamins and minerals support normal body functions, while the botanical ingredients provide naturally occurring plant compounds with antioxidant activity. The exact benefit depends on the amounts of each ingredient in the product.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not exceed the recommended amount, and avoid taking other multivitamin products at the same time unless advised by a healthcare professional.
