title: Meganam SB (Vial) Meropenem, Sulbactam by Csc
name: Meganam SB (Vial) Meropenem, Sulbactam by Csc
searchText: Meganam SB (Vial) Meropenem, Sulbactam by Csc CSC I0369
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This antibiotic combination is used under medical supervision for certain bacterial infections. Appropriate use depends on the formulation and infection being treated.

How does it work?
Meropenem kills susceptible bacteria by interfering with bacterial cell-wall formation. Sulbactam inhibits certain bacterial enzymes that can contribute to antibiotic resistance.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed. If supplied as an injection, it should be administered by a qualified healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, rash or injection-site reactions may occur.

Precautions
Tell the treating clinician about antibiotic allergies, kidney problems and other medicines. Seek urgent help for breathing difficulty or severe allergic reactions.

title: Meganam (Vial) Meropenem 1000 mg by Csc
name: Meganam (Vial) Meropenem 1000 mg by Csc
searchText: Meganam (Vial) Meropenem 1000 mg by Csc CSC I0473
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Meropenem is a strong antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, such as severe infections of the lungs, abdomen, urinary tract, skin, blood, or brain. It does not treat viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall, which stops the infection from spreading.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection or infusion into a vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection and kidney function. Complete the prescribed course unless the treating doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea or vomiting, headache, skin rash, and pain, redness, or swelling at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to meropenem, penicillins, cephalosporins, or other antibiotics. Inform the doctor about kidney disease, a history of seizures, or use of valproate medicines. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, seizures, facial swelling, breathing difficulty, or a severe skin reaction. Use only under medical supervision.

title: Meterin Soap (75g) Permethrin 1% Soap by Csc
name: Meterin Soap (75g) Permethrin 1% Soap by Csc
searchText: Meterin Soap (75g) Permethrin 1% Soap by Csc CSC I0115
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Permethrin soap 1% is used to help treat parasitic infestations of the skin, such as scabies or lice, when recommended for that use. Follow the product label or medical advice, as the exact use may vary by product.

How does it work?
Permethrin kills parasites by affecting their nervous system. It works on parasites present on the skin or hair.

How to take/use it
Use only on the skin and follow the product label or healthcare professional’s instructions. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Rinse thoroughly if directed, wash hands after use, and do not use more often than recommended.

Common side effects
Temporary skin irritation, burning, redness, dryness or itching may occur.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid use on broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs. Keep away from children and avoid contact with the eyes. If symptoms continue or return, consult a healthcare professional.

title: Metrosalic Lotion (25ml) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05%, Salicylic Acid 2% Lotion by Csc
name: Metrosalic Lotion (25ml) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05%, Salicylic Acid 2% Lotion by Csc
searchText: Metrosalic Lotion (25ml) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05%, Salicylic Acid 2% Lotion by Csc CSC I0116
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to reduce redness, swelling, itching and thick, scaly skin in steroid-responsive conditions such as psoriasis, eczema and dermatitis, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Clobetasol is a very strong corticosteroid that reduces skin inflammation and itching. Salicylic acid helps soften and remove thick, scaly skin, allowing the medicine to work better.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected area exactly as prescribed. Wash hands after applying, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid the eyes, face, groin, underarms and broken or infected skin unless specifically advised. Do not cover the treated area with a tight dressing unless directed by a doctor.

Common side effects
Burning, stinging, irritation, dryness, itching, skin thinning, stretch marks or small bumps around hair follicles may occur at the application site.

Precautions
Clobetasol is a very potent steroid and should not be used on large areas or for longer than prescribed. Avoid prolonged use, especially in children. Do not use on untreated skin infections or near the eyes. Stop and seek medical advice if the condition worsens or signs of infection develop. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Metrosalic Ointment (20g) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05%, Salicylic Acid 2% Oint by Csc
name: Metrosalic Ointment (20g) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05%, Salicylic Acid 2% Oint by Csc
searchText: Metrosalic Ointment (20g) Clobetasol Propionate 0.05%, Salicylic Acid 2% Oint by Csc CSC I0117
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain inflamed, itchy, thickened or scaly skin conditions, including psoriasis and eczema, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Clobetasol reduces skin inflammation, redness and itching. Salicylic acid softens and removes thick scales, helping the medicine reach the affected skin.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to the affected skin exactly as prescribed. Use it only on the affected areas and do not cover with a bandage or dressing unless directed. Wash hands after applying, unless the hands are being treated.

Common side effects
Burning, stinging, itching, irritation, dryness or redness at the application site. Prolonged or excessive use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid the eyes, face, groin, armpits and broken or infected skin unless specifically advised by a doctor. Do not use for longer or on larger areas than prescribed, as clobetasol is a very potent steroid. Stop and seek medical advice if the condition worsens or signs of infection develop. Use in children only under medical supervision.

title: Metrozox (30ml) Ofloxacin, Metronidazole, Simethicone Susp by Csc
name: Metrozox (30ml) Ofloxacin, Metronidazole, Simethicone Susp by Csc
searchText: Metrozox (30ml) Ofloxacin, Metronidazole, Simethicone Susp by Csc CSC I0118
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used when prescribed for certain bacterial or protozoal intestinal infections that may cause diarrhoea, dysentery, stomach discomfort and gas.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin and metronidazole act against certain bacteria and parasites causing intestinal infection. Simethicone helps break up gas bubbles and may relieve bloating and discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with the supplied measuring device. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not self-medicate for diarrhoea.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, metallic taste, headache and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney problems, seizures, heart-rhythm problems or tendon disorders. Keep antacids and supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc separate from this medicine as advised by the doctor or pharmacist. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe rash, breathing difficulty, or severe watery or bloody diarrhoea.

title: Metrozox XL (60ml) Ofloxacin, Metronidazole, Simethicone Susp by Csc
name: Metrozox XL (60ml) Ofloxacin, Metronidazole, Simethicone Susp by Csc
searchText: Metrozox XL (60ml) Ofloxacin, Metronidazole, Simethicone Susp by Csc CSC I0119
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections of the stomach and intestines, which may cause diarrhoea, loose motions, dysentery or stomach infection. Simethicone helps relieve gas and bloating.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin kills susceptible bacteria, while metronidazole acts against certain anaerobic bacteria and parasites. Simethicone helps gas bubbles join together so they can pass more easily.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by the doctor. Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with the supplied measuring device. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not take antacids or iron, calcium or zinc supplements at the same time without medical advice, as they may reduce ofloxacin absorption.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, metallic taste, headache or dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Tell the doctor if pregnant, breastfeeding, or if there is kidney disease, epilepsy, nerve problems or a history of tendon problems. Seek medical help for a serious allergic reaction, severe or persistent diarrhoea, tendon pain or swelling, or numbness and tingling. Use in children only when specifically prescribed.

title: Micellar Gel Hydrating Facewash (90 ml ) Liquorice Micelles 3%, Green Tea Extract, Jojoba Esters Gel by Csc
name: Micellar Gel Hydrating Facewash (90 ml ) Liquorice Micelles 3%, Green Tea Extract, Jojoba Esters Gel by Csc
searchText: Micellar Gel Hydrating Facewash (90 ml ) Liquorice Micelles 3%, Green Tea Extract, Jojoba Esters Gel by Csc CSC I0579
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical skincare formulation is typically used to help improve the appearance of uneven skin tone and dullness while supporting skin moisturisation. The exact intended use should be confirmed from the product label.

How does it work?
Liquorice and green tea extracts are commonly used in skincare for their skin-soothing and antioxidant properties. Jojoba esters help soften and moisturise the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply as directed on the product label to clean, dry skin. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not apply to broken or irritated skin.

Common side effects
Mild irritation, redness, itching or dryness may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before wider use. Stop using if significant irritation or an allergic reaction develops. Avoid contact with the eyes. Keep out of reach of children and follow the product label instructions.

title: Mineral SPF 50 Light Sunscreen (50 gm ) Zinc Oxide Sunscreen by Csc
name: Mineral SPF 50 Light Sunscreen (50 gm ) Zinc Oxide Sunscreen by Csc
searchText: Mineral SPF 50 Light Sunscreen (50 gm ) Zinc Oxide Sunscreen by Csc CSC I1044
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Zinc oxide sunscreen is used to protect the skin from harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays and help prevent sunburn and sun-related skin damage.

How does it work?
It forms a mineral barrier on the skin that reflects and scatters UV rays, reducing their exposure to the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply evenly to all exposed skin before sun exposure, following the product label. Reapply as directed, especially after swimming, sweating or towel drying. Use protective clothing and avoid prolonged direct sun exposure.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, dryness or itching may occur. Serious allergic reactions are uncommon.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes. Stop use if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Do not apply to significantly damaged skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Sunscreen does not provide complete protection from UV rays.

title: Minific D (20x10) Drotaverine 80 mg, Mefenamic Acid 250 mg by Csc
name: Minific D (20x10) Drotaverine 80 mg, Mefenamic Acid 250 mg by Csc
searchText: Minific D (20x10) Drotaverine 80 mg, Mefenamic Acid 250 mg by Csc CSC I0120
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of painful cramps and spasmodic pain, especially menstrual cramps. It may also be prescribed for cramp-like abdominal pain.

How does it work?
Drotaverine relaxes spasming muscles in the abdomen and uterus. Mefenamic acid reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow with or after food to reduce stomach irritation. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness, headache, or skin rash.

Precautions
Avoid if there is an allergy to mefenamic acid, drotaverine, aspirin, or other painkillers. Tell the doctor about stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart problems, asthma triggered by painkillers, or low blood pressure. Avoid combining it with other NSAID painkillers unless advised. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, or swelling. It should generally be avoided in the last 3 months of pregnancy unless specifically prescribed.

title: Minific P (20x10) Paracetamol 325 mg, Mefenamic Acid 500 mg by Csc
name: Minific P (20x10) Paracetamol 325 mg, Mefenamic Acid 500 mg by Csc
searchText: Minific P (20x10) Paracetamol 325 mg, Mefenamic Acid 500 mg by Csc CSC I0121
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and fever. It may help with pain where inflammation is also present, but it should be used only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Mefenamic acid is an anti-inflammatory painkiller that reduces substances involved in pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed or as directed on the label, with water and preferably after food. Do not take more than the recommended amount, use it for longer than advised, or take other medicines containing paracetamol or mefenamic acid/NSAIDs unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, vomiting, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine or seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma or allergy triggered by painkillers, or use of blood thinners. Avoid alcohol. Do not use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, unless specifically prescribed. Stop and seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe skin rash, vomiting blood or black stools.

title: Minific P (60ml) Mefenamic Acid 100 mg, Paracetamol 250 mg Susp by Csc
name: Minific P (60ml) Mefenamic Acid 100 mg, Paracetamol 250 mg Susp by Csc
searchText: Minific P (60ml) Mefenamic Acid 100 mg, Paracetamol 250 mg Susp by Csc CSC I0122
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve mild to moderate pain, reduce fever and help ease inflammation.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist, especially for children. Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with an accurate measuring device. Taking it with or after food may help reduce stomach upset. Do not take more than recommended or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to mefenamic acid, paracetamol or other painkillers such as ibuprofen or aspirin. Seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, heart problems or dehydration. Avoid combining it with other paracetamol-containing or anti-inflammatory medicines unless advised. Avoid excessive alcohol. Seek urgent help for black stools, vomiting blood, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash.

title: Minific Spas (4x5x10) Mefenamic Acid 250 mg, Dicyclomine 10 mg by Csc
name: Minific Spas (4x5x10) Mefenamic Acid 250 mg, Dicyclomine 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Minific Spas (4x5x10) Mefenamic Acid 250 mg, Dicyclomine 10 mg by Csc CSC I0123
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve painful menstrual cramps and spasmodic abdominal pain. It should be used only for the condition and duration advised by a doctor.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces pain and inflammation, while dicyclomine relaxes spasms in the muscles of the abdomen and intestines.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with or after food and with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea or constipation, dizziness, dry mouth and blurred vision may occur.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if allergic to mefenamic acid, dicyclomine or similar painkillers. Inform the doctor about stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, or bowel blockage. Avoid alcohol and driving if dizzy or if vision is blurred. Do not use during pregnancy, especially the last three months, unless specifically advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for severe stomach pain, black stools, vomiting blood, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

title: Monodust (100g) Clotrimazole 1% Dusting Powder by Csc
name: Monodust (100g) Clotrimazole 1% Dusting Powder by Csc
searchText: Monodust (100g) Clotrimazole 1% Dusting Powder by Csc CSC I0124
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Clotrimazole 1% Dusting Powder is used to treat fungal skin infections such as athlete’s foot, ringworm, jock itch and fungal rashes in skin folds. It helps reduce itching, redness and irritation caused by these infections.

How does it work?
Clotrimazole is an antifungal medicine that damages the protective outer layer of fungi, stopping their growth and helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply the powder to clean, completely dry affected skin and nearby skin as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Keep the area dry and wash hands before and after use. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and do not inhale the powder.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, burning, stinging, itching or dryness may occur at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to clotrimazole or any ingredient. Avoid applying to the eyes, mouth, open wounds or severely irritated skin. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops. Consult a healthcare professional if the infection worsens or does not improve with treatment.

title: Monodust Lavander (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc
name: Monodust Lavander (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc
searchText: Monodust Lavander (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc CSC I0284
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Prickly heat powder is used to help relieve itching, irritation and discomfort caused by prickly heat or heat rash. It also helps keep the skin dry and reduce friction in sweaty areas.

How does it work?
The powder absorbs excess moisture from the skin and helps reduce rubbing, which may soothe irritation associated with heat and sweating.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin, especially in areas prone to sweating. Avoid inhaling the powder and keep it away from the eyes, nose and mouth.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, dryness or an allergic rash may occur in sensitive people.

Precautions
Do not apply to broken, infected or severely irritated skin. Stop use if irritation or rash develops. Avoid inhaling the powder, and keep away from children. Seek medical advice if the rash is severe, spreading or does not improve.

title: Monodust Lime Prickly Heat Powder (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc
name: Monodust Lime Prickly Heat Powder (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc
searchText: Monodust Lime Prickly Heat Powder (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc CSC I1053
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help prevent and relieve prickly heat (heat rash), sweating-related skin discomfort and irritation.

How does it work?
The powder helps absorb excess moisture and reduce friction on the skin, which may soothe irritation caused by heat and sweating.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a light layer to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid inhaling the powder.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, dryness or an allergic reaction may occur in sensitive individuals.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and broken or damaged skin. Do not inhale the powder. Stop use if irritation or rash worsens. Seek medical advice if the heat rash is severe or does not improve.

title: Monodust Sandal (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc
name: Monodust Sandal (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc
searchText: Monodust Sandal (125g) Prickly Heat Powder by Csc CSC I0588
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help relieve prickly heat-related itching, skin irritation and discomfort, while helping keep the skin dry.

How does it work?
The powder helps absorb moisture and reduce friction on the skin, which may help relieve discomfort associated with prickly heat.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid inhaling the powder and keep it away from the eyes.

Common side effects
Skin dryness or irritation may occur in sensitive individuals.

Precautions
Do not apply to broken, infected or severely irritated skin. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and nose, and do not inhale the powder. Stop use if irritation or an allergic reaction develops.

title: Montudol BL 40 (10x1x10) Bilastine 40 mg, Montelukast 10 mg Tab by Csc
name: Montudol BL 40 (10x1x10) Bilastine 40 mg, Montelukast 10 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Montudol BL 40 (10x1x10) Bilastine 40 mg, Montelukast 10 mg Tab by Csc CSC I1036
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergies, especially allergic rhinitis such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose, and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Bilastine blocks histamine, a substance responsible for many allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, which can contribute to swelling and inflammation in the airways and nose.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor and follow the instructions on the label. Swallow the tablet with water. Bilastine is generally taken on an empty stomach, as food or fruit juice may reduce its absorption. Do not take more or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, drowsiness, dizziness, stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Use cautiously if there is a history of severe liver or kidney problems, or allergy to either ingredient. Montelukast may rarely cause sleep problems, mood changes, unusual behaviour, anxiety, depression, or suicidal thoughts; contact a doctor promptly if these occur. This medicine is not a substitute for a prescribed quick-relief inhaler during an asthma attack. Avoid driving or operating machinery if drowsiness or dizziness occurs.

title: Montudol D (10x1x10) Montelukast 10 mg, Desloratadine 5 mg by Csc
name: Montudol D (10x1x10) Montelukast 10 mg, Desloratadine 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Montudol D (10x1x10) Montelukast 10 mg, Desloratadine 5 mg by Csc CSC I0421
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, a runny or blocked nose, nasal itching, and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Desloratadine blocks histamine, a chemical involved in allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, substances that contribute to allergic inflammation and nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not change the dose or duration without medical advice. It is not intended to provide immediate relief during a sudden asthma attack.

Common side effects
Headache, dry mouth, tiredness, stomach pain, nausea, or dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding before use. Montelukast may rarely cause mood or behaviour changes, disturbed sleep, agitation, depression, or suicidal thoughts; seek medical advice promptly if these occur. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizziness or sleepiness occurs. Seek urgent help for signs of a serious allergic reaction, such as facial swelling or difficulty breathing.

title: Montudol FX (10x1x10) Fexofenadine 120 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
name: Montudol FX (10x1x10) Fexofenadine 120 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Montudol FX (10x1x10) Fexofenadine 120 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc CSC I0305
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose, and watery or itchy eyes.

How does it work?
Fexofenadine blocks histamine, a chemical that causes allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, substances that contribute to inflammation and nasal allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water and do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid taking it with apple, orange, or grapefruit juice, and ask a pharmacist about the timing of aluminium- or magnesium-containing antacids.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach pain, dizziness, or tiredness may occur.

Precautions
Montelukast may rarely cause mood or behaviour changes, sleep problems, depression, or suicidal thoughts; seek medical help promptly if these occur. Use only under medical advice during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in liver disease. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizziness or sleepiness occurs. This medicine is not a rescue treatment for a sudden asthma attack.

title: Montudol LC (10x1x10) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
name: Montudol LC (10x1x10) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Montudol LC (10x1x10) Levocetirizine 5 mg, Montelukast 10 mg by Csc CSC I0125
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is mainly used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, nasal itching, and itchy or watery eyes. It may also be prescribed as an add-on treatment for some people with asthma. It is not meant to relieve a sudden asthma attack.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals that can cause swelling and narrowing of the airways and contribute to allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Avoid driving or operating machinery if it causes drowsiness.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving if drowsy. Inform the doctor about kidney or liver problems, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or other medicines being used. Stop the medicine and seek medical advice promptly if unusual dreams, sleep problems, agitation, depression, aggressive behaviour, or thoughts of self-harm occur. Do not use it as a rescue medicine for a sudden asthma attack.

title: Montudol LC (30ml) Montelukast, Levocetirizine Syr by Csc
name: Montudol LC (30ml) Montelukast, Levocetirizine Syr by Csc
searchText: Montudol LC (30ml) Montelukast, Levocetirizine Syr by Csc CSC I0126
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergies such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose, and watery or itchy eyes. It may also be prescribed as an add-on treatment for asthma, but it does not relieve a sudden asthma attack.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a substance that causes allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals involved in allergic inflammation and airway narrowing.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed. Measure the syrup with the supplied measuring device and do not use a household spoon. Shake the bottle well before use. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Sleepiness may occur; avoid driving or alcohol until the effect is known. Seek medical advice promptly if mood or behaviour changes, disturbing dreams, agitation, depression, or suicidal thoughts occur. This medicine is not a rescue treatment for a sudden asthma attack. Inform the doctor about kidney disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding, and about other medicines that may cause drowsiness.

title: Montudol LC Kid (10x1x10) Levocetirizine 2.5 mg, Montelukast 4 mg by Csc
name: Montudol LC Kid (10x1x10) Levocetirizine 2.5 mg, Montelukast 4 mg by Csc
searchText: Montudol LC Kid (10x1x10) Levocetirizine 2.5 mg, Montelukast 4 mg by Csc CSC I0420
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergies, such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, and itchy or watery eyes. It may be prescribed for allergic rhinitis, including seasonal or dust-related allergies.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a chemical involved in allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, which can contribute to inflammation and nasal or breathing symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take only in the dose and frequency prescribed by the doctor. Follow the product label, and do not take more than recommended. This medicine is not intended to relieve a sudden asthma attack.

Common side effects
Drowsiness or sleepiness, headache, tiredness, dry mouth, stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Levocetirizine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or activities requiring alertness until its effect is known. Tell the doctor about kidney disease or a history of seizures. Stop the medicine and seek medical advice if unusual mood or behaviour changes, nightmares, agitation, depression, or suicidal thoughts occur. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Mosfilm (50g) N,N-Diethylbenzamide 12% w/w by Csc
name: Mosfilm (50g) N,N-Diethylbenzamide 12% w/w by Csc
searchText: Mosfilm (50g) N,N-Diethylbenzamide 12% w/w by Csc CSC I0913
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
N,N-Diethylbenzamide 12% w/w is used as a topical insect repellent to help protect exposed skin from insect bites, such as mosquito bites.

How does it work?
It works by interfering with the ability of insects to detect and approach the smell of human skin. It repels insects rather than killing them.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to exposed skin or clothing as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and broken or irritated skin. Wash hands after application.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or a burning sensation may occur. Eye irritation can occur if the product gets into the eyes.

Precautions
Do not swallow or apply near the eyes or mouth. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Keep out of reach of children and follow the product label for age restrictions and reapplication instructions.

title: Moxinil 375 (10x1x10) Amoxycillin 250 mg, Clavulanic Acid 125 mg by Csc
name: Moxinil 375 (10x1x10) Amoxycillin 250 mg, Clavulanic Acid 125 mg by Csc
searchText: Moxinil 375 (10x1x10) Amoxycillin 250 mg, Clavulanic Acid 125 mg by Csc CSC I0532
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxycillin with clavulanic acid is a prescription antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the ears, sinuses, throat, lungs, urinary tract, skin and teeth. It does not treat viral infections such as common colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxycillin kills susceptible bacteria. Clavulanic acid helps protect amoxycillin from bacterial enzymes that can make the antibiotic ineffective.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and preferably at the start of a meal to reduce stomach upset. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not double the next dose if a dose is missed.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, indigestion and skin rash may occur. Fungal infections such as oral or vaginal thrush can also occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin, amoxycillin, other beta-lactam antibiotics or this medicine. Inform the doctor about previous antibiotic-related jaundice or liver problems, kidney disease, allergies, or glandular fever. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe rash. Contact a doctor for severe, persistent or bloody diarrhoea, or yellowing of the skin or eyes. Use only when prescribed and do not share leftover antibiotics.

title: Moxinil 625 (10x1x10) Amoxycillin 500 mg, Clavulanic Acid 125 mg by Csc
name: Moxinil 625 (10x1x10) Amoxycillin 500 mg, Clavulanic Acid 125 mg by Csc
searchText: Moxinil 625 (10x1x10) Amoxycillin 500 mg, Clavulanic Acid 125 mg by Csc CSC I0130
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxycillin with clavulanic acid is an antibiotic used to treat a range of bacterial infections, such as infections of the ears, sinuses, throat, lungs, skin, urinary tract and teeth. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxycillin kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall. Clavulanic acid helps protect amoxycillin from enzymes that can make some bacteria resistant to it.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. Take it with a meal or snack to reduce stomach upset. Do not share this medicine or use leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, indigestion, skin rash and thrush may occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin, amoxycillin, other beta-lactam antibiotics or this medicine. Inform the doctor about liver disease, kidney disease, previous antibiotic-related jaundice or liver problems, and any medicines being used. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling, a severe skin rash, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or severe or persistent diarrhoea.

title: Moxinil CV + (30 ml ) Amoxycillin 200 mg, Clavulanic Acid 28.5 mg by Csc
name: Moxinil CV + (30 ml ) Amoxycillin 200 mg, Clavulanic Acid 28.5 mg by Csc
searchText: Moxinil CV + (30 ml ) Amoxycillin 200 mg, Clavulanic Acid 28.5 mg by Csc CSC I0132
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxicillin with clavulanic acid is a prescription antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the ear, sinuses, throat, chest, skin, urinary tract and teeth. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxicillin kills susceptible bacteria. Clavulanic acid helps protect amoxicillin from enzymes made by some bacteria, allowing it to work against a wider range of infections.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not use leftover antibiotics or stop treatment early, even if symptoms improve. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort and skin rash may occur. Mild thrush can also occur.

Precautions
Do not use it if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin, amoxicillin, other beta-lactam antibiotics or clavulanic acid. Tell the doctor about liver disease, kidney disease, previous antibiotic-related diarrhoea, or a history of jaundice or liver problems with antibiotics. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe skin rash, or severe or persistent diarrhoea.

title: Moxinil CV Duo (30 ml ) Amoxycillin 400 mg, Clavulanic Acid 57 mg by Csc
name: Moxinil CV Duo (30 ml ) Amoxycillin 400 mg, Clavulanic Acid 57 mg by Csc
searchText: Moxinil CV Duo (30 ml ) Amoxycillin 400 mg, Clavulanic Acid 57 mg by Csc CSC I0133
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxicillin with clavulanic acid is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the ear, sinuses, throat, lungs, skin, urinary tract and teeth, when prescribed by a doctor. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxicillin kills susceptible bacteria. Clavulanic acid helps protect amoxicillin from enzymes made by some bacteria, allowing it to work against a wider range of infections.

How to take/use it
Take or give it exactly as prescribed. If it is a liquid suspension, shake the bottle well before each use and measure it with an oral syringe or measuring device. Taking it with a meal may help reduce stomach upset. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve, unless a healthcare professional advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort and skin rash may occur. Thrush can also develop.

Precautions
Do not use it if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin, amoxicillin, clavulanic acid or related cephalosporin antibiotics. Inform the doctor about previous antibiotic-related jaundice or liver problems, kidney disease, liver disease, glandular fever, or any history of severe allergy. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling, a severe rash, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or severe or persistent diarrhoea. Use only when prescribed, as unnecessary antibiotic use can cause resistance.

title: Moxitech (5 ml) Moxifloxacin Eye Drops by Csc
name: Moxitech (5 ml) Moxifloxacin Eye Drops by Csc
searchText: Moxitech (5 ml) Moxifloxacin Eye Drops by Csc CSC I0395
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Moxifloxacin eyedrops are used to treat bacterial eye infections, including bacterial conjunctivitis (eye infection causing redness and discharge).

How does it work?
It is an antibiotic that stops the growth of bacteria causing the eye infection.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed. Wash hands before and after use, and do not touch the dropper tip to the eye or any surface. Remove contact lenses before use and do not wear them until advised by a doctor. Complete the prescribed course unless told otherwise.

Common side effects
Temporary eye irritation, burning, stinging, itching, redness, discomfort or blurred vision may occur after use.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to moxifloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics. Stop using it and seek medical help if there is severe eye pain, worsening vision, marked swelling, rash or difficulty breathing. Seek medical advice if symptoms do not improve or become worse.

title: Moxitech D (5 ml) Moxifloxacin, Dexamethasone Eye Drops by Csc
name: Moxitech D (5 ml) Moxifloxacin, Dexamethasone Eye Drops by Csc
searchText: Moxitech D (5 ml) Moxifloxacin, Dexamethasone Eye Drops by Csc CSC I0417
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial eye infections that are accompanied by inflammation, when prescribed by an eye specialist. It may also be prescribed after eye procedures when both infection and inflammation need treatment.

How does it work?
Moxifloxacin is an antibiotic that stops the growth of bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces swelling, redness and inflammation in the eye.

How to take/use it
Use in the affected eye(s) exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Wash hands before use and do not let the dropper tip touch the eye or any surface. Use it for the prescribed duration and do not share the bottle. If using other eye medicines, ask the doctor or pharmacist about the correct order and timing.

Common side effects
Temporary burning or stinging, blurred vision, eye irritation, dryness, redness or discomfort may occur after application.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision, as the steroid component can increase eye pressure, delay healing or increase the risk of cataracts with prolonged use. It may be unsuitable for some viral or fungal eye infections unless specifically prescribed. Contact an eye doctor promptly for worsening pain, vision changes, severe redness, swelling or an allergic reaction. Contact lens wearers should follow their doctor’s advice during treatment.

title: Moxitech KT (10 ml ) Moxifloxacin 0.5%, Ketorolac Tromethamine 0.4% Eye Drops by Csc
name: Moxitech KT (10 ml ) Moxifloxacin 0.5%, Ketorolac Tromethamine 0.4% Eye Drops by Csc
searchText: Moxitech KT (10 ml ) Moxifloxacin 0.5%, Ketorolac Tromethamine 0.4% Eye Drops by Csc CSC I0382
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This eye medicine is used to treat bacterial eye infections and reduce associated eye pain and inflammation. It may also be prescribed after eye surgery to help prevent infection and control inflammation.

How does it work?
Moxifloxacin is an antibiotic that stops the growth of bacteria. Ketorolac is an anti-inflammatory medicine that reduces substances responsible for pain, redness and swelling.

How to take/use it
Use in the affected eye(s) exactly as prescribed by the eye specialist. Wash hands before use, avoid touching the dropper tip to the eye or any surface, and close the bottle after use. Do not wear contact lenses unless specifically advised. If vision is blurred after application, avoid driving until vision clears.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging or burning, eye irritation, redness, watery eyes, discomfort, itching or blurred vision may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to moxifloxacin, ketorolac, other quinolone antibiotics or NSAID medicines. Use only under medical supervision, especially after eye surgery or if there is a corneal problem. Seek medical help for severe or worsening eye pain, marked redness, swelling, rash, breathing difficulty, reduced vision or persistent irritation. Do not use longer than prescribed.

title: Moxitech L (5 ml) Moxifloxacin, Loteprednol Eye Drops by Csc
name: Moxitech L (5 ml) Moxifloxacin, Loteprednol Eye Drops by Csc
searchText: Moxitech L (5 ml) Moxifloxacin, Loteprednol Eye Drops by Csc CSC I0418
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat bacterial eye infections accompanied by redness, swelling or inflammation. It may also be prescribed after eye surgery to help control inflammation and prevent or treat infection.

How does it work?
Moxifloxacin stops the growth of susceptible bacteria. Loteprednol is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation in the eye.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by the doctor. Wash hands before use, avoid touching the dropper tip to the eye or other surfaces, and do not wear contact lenses unless advised. If using other eye medicines, use them as directed and leave an appropriate gap between products.

Common side effects
Temporary burning or stinging, eye irritation, blurred vision, watery eyes, itching or discomfort may occur. Contact an eye doctor if these are severe or do not improve.

Precautions
Use under medical supervision, especially if treatment is prolonged. Corticosteroid-containing eye drops can increase eye pressure, delay healing or worsen some eye infections. Do not use for an untreated viral or fungal eye infection unless specifically advised. Seek medical advice for worsening pain, redness, swelling, vision changes or signs of an allergic reaction.

title: Mupinate (5g) Mupirocin 2.0% w/w by Csc
name: Mupinate (5g) Mupirocin 2.0% w/w by Csc
searchText: Mupinate (5g) Mupirocin 2.0% w/w by Csc CSC I0135
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Mupirocin 2% is a topical antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial skin infections, such as impetigo and infected minor cuts or wounds.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, helping to clear the skin infection.

How to take/use it
Use only on the skin and apply as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Clean and dry the affected area before application, and wash hands before and after use. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and inside of the nose unless specifically prescribed for that area.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness or irritation at the application site. Skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to mupirocin or any of its ingredients. Stop use and seek medical help if severe irritation, swelling, breathing difficulty or a widespread rash occurs. Do not use for longer than prescribed or on large areas of skin without medical advice. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens or does not improve.

title: MyoGloss (10x1x10) Myo-Inositol, D-Chiro-Inositol, L-Methylfolate, Vitamin D3 Chewable Tab by Csc
name: MyoGloss (10x1x10) Myo-Inositol, D-Chiro-Inositol, L-Methylfolate, Vitamin D3 Chewable Tab by Csc
searchText: MyoGloss (10x1x10) Myo-Inositol, D-Chiro-Inositol, L-Methylfolate, Vitamin D3 Chewable Tab by Csc CSC I0268
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is commonly used as a nutritional supplement for polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and related hormonal or metabolic imbalance. It also provides folate and vitamin D when supplementation is advised.

How does it work?
Myo-inositol and D-chiro-inositol support cell signalling and insulin metabolism. L-methylfolate supports normal cell division and blood formation, while vitamin D supports calcium absorption and bone health.

How to take/use it
Chew the tablet as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount. If pregnant, planning pregnancy, or taking it for PCOS, use it under medical advice.

Common side effects
Mild nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating, diarrhoea, headache or dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell a doctor about diabetes, kidney disease, high blood calcium, or any regular medicines or supplements. Seek medical advice if side effects are severe or persistent. Do not use additional folic acid or vitamin D supplements without checking the total daily amount with a healthcare professional.

title: Nactyle 600 (10x1x10) Acetylcysteine 600 mg by Csc
name: Nactyle 600 (10x1x10) Acetylcysteine 600 mg by Csc
searchText: Nactyle 600 (10x1x10) Acetylcysteine 600 mg by Csc CSC I0392
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Acetylcysteine is a mucolytic medicine used to loosen thick, sticky mucus in the airways, making it easier to cough up. It may be used in conditions with excess mucus, such as some chest and respiratory illnesses.

How does it work?
It breaks down the structure of thick mucus, making it thinner and easier to clear from the lungs.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as directed by the doctor or medicine label. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If it is an effervescent tablet, dissolve it in water as instructed and drink it after it has dissolved; do not swallow it whole.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, skin rash and unpleasant taste or smell. Rarely, it may cause wheezing or breathing difficulty.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is asthma, a history of stomach ulcers, or an allergy to acetylcysteine. Stop use and seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe rash. Seek medical advice if mucus or breathing symptoms worsen or do not improve.

title: Nactyle A (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg, N-Acetyl L-Cysteine 600 mg by Csc
name: Nactyle A (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg, N-Acetyl L-Cysteine 600 mg by Csc
searchText: Nactyle A (10x1x10) Acebrophylline 100 mg, N-Acetyl L-Cysteine 600 mg by Csc CSC I0487
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help manage breathing problems in conditions such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), especially when thick mucus, wheezing or breathing difficulty is present.

How does it work?
Acebrophylline helps widen the airways and improve airflow. N-acetylcysteine thins thick mucus, making it easier to clear from the airways.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not take extra doses or stop treatment without medical advice. This medicine is not a substitute for a quick-relief inhaler during a sudden breathing attack.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache or dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer, heart rhythm problems, seizures, or liver or kidney disease. Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding and all other medicines being taken, particularly theophylline or other medicines for breathing problems. Seek urgent medical help for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, a fast or irregular heartbeat, or an allergic reaction.

title: Nanofen (20x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg by Csc
name: Nanofen (20x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg by Csc
searchText: Nanofen (20x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg by Csc CSC I0136
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve pain, swelling and inflammation associated with muscle, joint and other musculoskeletal conditions, including arthritis. It may also help reduce fever.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor, preferably with or after food. Swallow with water. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or other painkillers such as NSAIDs unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an allergy to NSAIDs. Avoid excessive alcohol, as it may increase the risk of liver damage and stomach problems. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin rash, breathing difficulty or yellowing of the skin or eyes. Avoid use during pregnancy, especially the last three months, unless specifically prescribed.

title: Niacinamide 10% Serum (30 ml) Niacinamide 10%, Hyaluronic Acid, N-Acetyl Glucosamine Serum by Csc
name: Niacinamide 10% Serum (30 ml) Niacinamide 10%, Hyaluronic Acid, N-Acetyl Glucosamine Serum by Csc
searchText: Niacinamide 10% Serum (30 ml) Niacinamide 10%, Hyaluronic Acid, N-Acetyl Glucosamine Serum by Csc CSC I0902
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to support joint health and help relieve symptoms such as joint discomfort and stiffness associated with osteoarthritis.

How does it work?
N-acetyl glucosamine and hyaluronic acid are natural components of cartilage and joint fluid. They may help support cartilage structure and joint lubrication.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Mild stomach upset, nausea, bloating, diarrhoea or constipation may occur.

Precautions
Check the product ingredients if there is an allergy to fish, shellfish or other marine-derived ingredients. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in diabetes, or when taking blood thinners such as warfarin. Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Niacinamide 5% Fluid Sunscreen SPF 50 (50 gm ) Niacinamide 5%, Yuzu 2%, Vitamin C 0.2%, Hyaluronic Acid 1% Fluid Sunscreen SPF 50 by Csc
name: Niacinamide 5% Fluid Sunscreen SPF 50 (50 gm ) Niacinamide 5%, Yuzu 2%, Vitamin C 0.2%, Hyaluronic Acid 1% Fluid Sunscreen SPF 50 by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This product is intended for topical skincare to help hydrate the skin and support a brighter, more even-looking appearance. It is not a treatment for a specific skin disease.

How does it work?
Hyaluronic acid helps attract and retain water in the skin. Vitamin C and yuzu-derived ingredients provide antioxidant and skin-conditioning benefits.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. If intended for topical use, apply to clean, dry skin and avoid contact with the eyes. Do not use more often than recommended.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, itching or irritation may occur, especially on sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before wider use. Avoid use on broken or irritated skin and keep away from the eyes. Stop use if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Use sun protection during the day.

title: Niacinamide 5% Fluid sunscreen (Travel Pack) New (10 ml ) Niacinamide 5%, Yuzu 2%, Ascorbic Acid 0.2%, Hyaluronic Acid 1% Fluid by Csc
name: Niacinamide 5% Fluid sunscreen (Travel Pack) New (10 ml ) Niacinamide 5%, Yuzu 2%, Ascorbic Acid 0.2%, Hyaluronic Acid 1% Fluid by Csc
