bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical skincare product is used to help hydrate the skin and improve the appearance of dull or uneven-looking skin.

How does it work?
Hyaluronic acid helps attract and retain moisture in the skin. Vitamin C and yuzu provide antioxidant support and may help improve the appearance of skin tone.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin according to the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not apply to irritated or broken skin.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, dryness or irritation may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch test before regular use. Stop use if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Avoid contact with the eyes. Use sun protection during the day, particularly when using products containing vitamin C.

title: Nimsfen P (20x15) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Bilayered Tab by Csc
name: Nimsfen P (20x15) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Bilayered Tab by Csc
searchText: Nimsfen P (20x15) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Bilayered Tab by Csc CSC I0138
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and fever, such as body aches, muscle or joint pain, dental pain and painful injuries, when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Nimesulide reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Swallow the bilayered tablet whole with water, preferably with or after food if advised. Do not take more than the prescribed amount or use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain or indigestion, diarrhoea, and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or other painkillers unless advised. Tell the doctor if there is liver or kidney disease, stomach ulcer or bleeding, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an allergy to painkillers. Seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe skin rash, breathing difficulty, or unusual bleeding. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Nimsfen Plus (20x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Tab by Csc
name: Nimsfen Plus (20x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Nimsfen Plus (20x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0139
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and fever, such as body aches, muscle or joint pain, and other painful conditions when prescribed.

How does it work?
Nimesulide reduces substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or as stated on the label. It is generally best taken with or after food. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or other painkillers unless advised by a doctor. Do not use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is liver disease, severe kidney disease, stomach ulcer or bleeding, or an allergy to its ingredients, unless specifically prescribed. Avoid alcohol. Seek medical advice for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, unusual bleeding, severe stomach pain or a serious skin rash. Do not use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, or in children unless prescribed. Check with a doctor before use if taking blood thinners or other pain medicines.

title: NoDef D3 (10x1x4) Cholecalciferol 60000 IU by Csc
name: NoDef D3 (10x1x4) Cholecalciferol 60000 IU by Csc
searchText: NoDef D3 (10x1x4) Cholecalciferol 60000 IU by Csc CSC I0140
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Vitamin D3 60000 IU is used to prevent or treat vitamin D deficiency. It helps support calcium absorption and maintain healthy bones and muscles.

How does it work?
Vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine. These minerals are important for healthy bones and normal muscle function.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed by a doctor. Do not take this high-strength supplement more often or for longer than advised. Avoid taking additional vitamin D or calcium supplements unless recommended by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
It is usually well tolerated when used as directed. Excessive intake may cause nausea, vomiting, constipation, stomach pain, weakness, increased thirst or frequent urination.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, kidney stones, high calcium levels, or a condition that may increase calcium levels. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy, or if taking calcium supplements, digoxin, or other vitamin D products. This high-strength dose should be used only under medical guidance.

title: Noratech D3 (10x1x10) Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Vitamin D3 1000 IU, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Chromium 200 mcg by Csc
name: Noratech D3 (10x1x10) Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Vitamin D3 1000 IU, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Chromium 200 mcg by Csc
searchText: Noratech D3 (10x1x10) Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Vitamin D3 1000 IU, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Chromium 200 mcg by Csc CSC I0413
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This is a nutritional supplement that provides several B vitamins, vitamin D3, chromium and alpha-lipoic acid. It may be used to help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies and support normal nerve, blood-cell and general body functions.

How does it work?
It supplies vitamins and chromium needed for normal energy production, nerve function and other body processes. Alpha-lipoic acid provides antioxidant activity.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other vitamin supplements without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset or skin rash may occur. Stop use and seek medical advice if a severe allergic reaction develops.

Precautions
Tell a doctor if pregnant, breastfeeding, diabetic, or taking medicines for diabetes or thyroid problems. Alpha-lipoic acid and chromium may affect blood sugar, so people with diabetes should monitor their blood glucose. Avoid taking additional vitamin or mineral supplements containing the same ingredients unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Noratech LC (10x1x10) L-Carnitine 500 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg by Csc
name: Noratech LC (10x1x10) L-Carnitine 500 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg by Csc
searchText: Noratech LC (10x1x10) L-Carnitine 500 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg by Csc CSC I0926
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This product provides L-carnitine, vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin) and folic acid. It is used as nutritional supplementation when these nutrients are inadequate or when supplementation is advised, including for supporting normal nerve and red blood cell function.

How does it work?
L-carnitine helps the body use fatty acids for energy. Vitamin B12 and folic acid support normal nerve function and the formation of healthy red blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed or directed on the product label. Do not take more than the recommended amount. If it causes stomach discomfort, taking it with food may help.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, abdominal cramps, diarrhoea or vomiting may occur. L-carnitine can occasionally cause a fish-like body odour.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about kidney disease or a history of seizures before use. Do not use it if allergic to any of its ingredients. Seek medical advice if it is being used for suspected vitamin deficiency, anaemia or nerve symptoms, as the underlying cause may need evaluation. During pregnancy or breastfeeding, use only on medical advice.

title: Noratech Plus (10x1x10) Mecobalamin 1500 mcg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Benfotiamine 50 mg, Biotin 5 mg, Chromium Picolinate 200 mcg Cap by Csc
name: Noratech Plus (10x1x10) Mecobalamin 1500 mcg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Benfotiamine 50 mg, Biotin 5 mg, Chromium Picolinate 200 mcg Cap by Csc
searchText: Noratech Plus (10x1x10) Mecobalamin 1500 mcg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Benfotiamine 50 mg, Biotin 5 mg, Chromium Picolinate 200 mcg Cap by Csc CSC I0423
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This capsule is a nutritional supplement that provides B vitamins, folic acid, biotin, chromium and alpha-lipoic acid. It is used to support normal nerve function and energy metabolism, especially when these nutrients are needed.

How does it work?
The B vitamins and folic acid help support nerve function and energy production. Alpha-lipoic acid provides antioxidant support, while chromium helps support normal glucose metabolism.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow the capsule with water and do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, vomiting, headache or skin rash may occur. Alpha-lipoic acid may sometimes cause low blood sugar, particularly in people taking diabetes medicines.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional if taking medicines for diabetes, as blood sugar may need monitoring. Biotin can interfere with some blood and heart-related laboratory tests; inform the doctor or laboratory before testing. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or if there is a medical condition or ongoing medication. Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Nortigab M (10x1x10) Pregabalin 75 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Nortriptyline 10 mg by Csc
name: Nortigab M (10x1x10) Pregabalin 75 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Nortriptyline 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Nortigab M (10x1x10) Pregabalin 75 mg, Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Nortriptyline 10 mg by Csc CSC I0378
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve neuropathic pain (nerve pain), such as burning, tingling, shooting or electric-shock-like pain caused by nerve damage.

How does it work?
Pregabalin and nortriptyline reduce abnormal pain signals from the nerves. Methylcobalamin, a form of vitamin B12, helps support normal nerve function.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not change the dose or stop treatment suddenly, as this may cause problems. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known.

Common side effects
Dizziness, drowsiness, sleepiness, dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, swelling of the hands or feet, increased appetite or weight gain, and tiredness.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol because it can increase drowsiness. Tell the doctor about kidney disease, heart problems or abnormal heart rhythm, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use caution when driving. Seek medical help for severe allergic swelling, fainting, unusual heartbeat, or new or worsening suicidal thoughts. Do not stop it suddenly without medical advice.

title: Nutritin Ultra Butter Scotch Shake (200g) Protein Powder by Csc
name: Nutritin Ultra Butter Scotch Shake (200g) Protein Powder by Csc
searchText: Nutritin Ultra Butter Scotch Shake (200g) Protein Powder by Csc CSC I0961
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Protein powder is used to supplement dietary protein when regular food intake may not provide enough. It may support normal muscle maintenance and overall nutritional needs, but it is not a treatment for a specific disease.

How does it work?
It provides protein, which the body breaks down into amino acids needed for muscle, tissue repair and other normal body functions.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Mix the recommended amount with water, milk or another suitable beverage. Do not use it as a replacement for a balanced diet unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Bloating, gas, stomach discomfort, nausea or loose stools may occur, particularly in people sensitive to ingredients such as milk or sweeteners.

Precautions
Check the ingredient list for allergens before use. Seek medical advice before using if there is kidney disease, liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding or a medically restricted diet. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of an allergic reaction occur.

title: Nutritin Ultra Choco Shake (200g) Protein Powder, Chocolate Flavour by Csc
name: Nutritin Ultra Choco Shake (200g) Protein Powder, Chocolate Flavour by Csc
searchText: Nutritin Ultra Choco Shake (200g) Protein Powder, Chocolate Flavour by Csc CSC I0244
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Protein powder is used to supplement dietary protein when normal food intake may not provide enough. Protein supports muscle maintenance, growth and repair, and general nutritional needs.

How does it work?
It provides protein that is broken down into amino acids and used by the body for muscle and tissue maintenance and repair.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Mix the recommended amount with water, milk or another suitable beverage. Do not use it as a complete replacement for a balanced diet unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Some people may experience bloating, gas, stomach discomfort, nausea or loose stools. Reactions may depend on the protein source and other ingredients.

Precautions
Check the ingredient list for milk, soy, gluten, sweeteners or other allergens. Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney or liver disease, a known food allergy, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if it is intended for a child. Stop use and seek urgent help if signs of a serious allergic reaction occur.

title: Nutritin Ultra Diabetic (200g) Whey Protein Powder by Csc
name: Nutritin Ultra Diabetic (200g) Whey Protein Powder by Csc
searchText: Nutritin Ultra Diabetic (200g) Whey Protein Powder by Csc CSC I0389
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
It is a protein and nutrition supplement designed for people with diabetes. It may help add protein to the diet, but it is not a treatment for diabetes and should not replace prescribed medicines or a balanced meal plan.

How does it work?
The whey protein provides amino acids needed for maintaining and repairing body tissues. The product is formulated for use in diabetes, but its effect on blood glucose depends on the full formulation and serving size.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Mix the recommended amount with the specified liquid. Do not exceed the suggested serving, and include it in the daily meal plan advised by a doctor or dietitian.

Common side effects
Bloating, gas, nausea, stomach discomfort or diarrhoea may occur, particularly in people sensitive to milk or lactose. Allergic reactions to milk proteins are possible.

Precautions
Check blood glucose regularly, especially when starting the product or changing the amount used. Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, milk-protein allergy, lactose intolerance, or other significant medical conditions. Do not use it as a substitute for prescribed diabetes treatment. Stop use and seek urgent help for swelling, breathing difficulty or other signs of a severe allergy.

title: Nutritin Ultra Protien Dry Fruit Shake (200g) Protein Powder With Real Dry Fruits by Csc
name: Nutritin Ultra Protien Dry Fruit Shake (200g) Protein Powder With Real Dry Fruits by Csc
searchText: Nutritin Ultra Protien Dry Fruit Shake (200g) Protein Powder With Real Dry Fruits by Csc CSC I0243
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to help increase daily protein and calorie intake. It may be useful when dietary protein intake is inadequate or when extra nutrition is needed.

How does it work?
It provides protein, which is broken down into amino acids used by the body for tissue maintenance and other normal functions. The dry fruits may also provide additional calories and nutrients.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Mix the recommended amount with the suggested liquid or food, and do not exceed the stated serving size.

Common side effects
May cause bloating, gas, stomach discomfort, nausea or loose stools in some people. Allergic reactions may occur in people sensitive to its ingredients, including certain nuts or other protein sources.

Precautions
Check the ingredient list for nuts, milk, soy or other allergens. Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, a prescribed protein restriction, food allergy, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of a serious allergic reaction occur.

title: Ometech (20x20) Omeprazole 20 mg Gastro-Resistant by Csc
name: Ometech (20x20) Omeprazole 20 mg Gastro-Resistant by Csc
searchText: Ometech (20x20) Omeprazole 20 mg Gastro-Resistant by Csc CSC I0144
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Omeprazole reduces excess stomach acid. It is used mainly to treat acidity, heartburn and acid reflux, and may also be prescribed for stomach or duodenal ulcers and other acid-related conditions.

How does it work?
It blocks the stomach’s acid-producing pumps, reducing the amount of acid released into the stomach. This helps relieve symptoms and allows acid-damaged tissues to heal.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, usually before food. Swallow the gastro-resistant capsule or tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Follow the product label or doctor’s instructions for the dose and treatment duration.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, gas, diarrhoea or constipation.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies, pregnancy or breastfeeding, liver disease, or long-term use of omeprazole. Seek medical advice for unexplained weight loss, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, persistent vomiting or severe symptoms. Long-term use may require medical monitoring. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about other medicines, especially clopidogrel, blood thinners, seizure medicines, HIV medicines or methotrexate.

title: Ometech D (20x20) Omeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 10 mg by Csc
name: Ometech D (20x20) Omeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Ometech D (20x20) Omeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 10 mg by Csc CSC I0145
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux (GERD), especially when these symptoms are associated with nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Omeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Domperidone helps stomach contents move forward and can reduce nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually before food. Swallow the capsule or tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not use it for a prolonged period without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, stomach pain or discomfort, nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, gas and dry mouth.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of heart rhythm problems, heart disease, liver disease, low potassium or magnesium, or if medicines that affect heart rhythm are being used. Avoid self-use and seek medical advice for prolonged or recurrent symptoms. Seek urgent help for fainting or a fast or irregular heartbeat. Consult a doctor during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Omyrol (20g) Amorolfine 0.25% w/w Cream by Csc
name: Omyrol (20g) Amorolfine 0.25% w/w Cream by Csc
searchText: Omyrol (20g) Amorolfine 0.25% w/w Cream by Csc CSC I0146
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amorolfine cream is used to treat fungal infections of the skin, such as athlete’s foot, ringworm and fungal infections in skin folds.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, helping to kill the fungus and clear the infection.

How to take/use it
For use on the skin only. Clean and dry the affected area before applying the cream, and use it exactly as directed on the pack or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands after applying, unless the hands are the treated area. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching, burning or stinging may occur at the application site. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation or an allergic reaction develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to amorolfine or any of its ingredients. Avoid applying to the eyes, mouth or broken skin. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads or does not improve. Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should seek medical advice before use.

title: Oracure Gel (10g) Choline Salicylate 8.70% w/w, Lignocaine 2.0% w/w Gel by Csc
name: Oracure Gel (10g) Choline Salicylate 8.70% w/w, Lignocaine 2.0% w/w Gel by Csc
searchText: Oracure Gel (10g) Choline Salicylate 8.70% w/w, Lignocaine 2.0% w/w Gel by Csc CSC I0147
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of pain and inflammation from mouth ulcers, sore or inflamed gums, and minor dental or mouth irritation.

How does it work?
Choline salicylate helps reduce pain and inflammation. Lignocaine temporarily numbs the area to provide local pain relief.

How to take/use it
For use inside the mouth only. Apply a small amount to the affected area using a clean finger, as directed on the product label or by a dentist or pharmacist. Avoid eating or drinking immediately after application while the area is numb.

Common side effects
Temporary numbness, mild stinging or irritation, altered taste, or redness at the application site. Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction occurs.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to salicylates such as aspirin, lignocaine, or any ingredient in the product. Use in children, especially infants, only on medical advice. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow large amounts. Seek dental or medical advice if symptoms are severe, keep returning, or do not improve. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Oracure Tab. (30x10) Riboflavin, Folic Acid, Niacinamide, Lactic Acid Bacillus Tab by Csc
name: Oracure Tab. (30x10) Riboflavin, Folic Acid, Niacinamide, Lactic Acid Bacillus Tab by Csc
searchText: Oracure Tab. (30x10) Riboflavin, Folic Acid, Niacinamide, Lactic Acid Bacillus Tab by Csc CSC I0148
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement riboflavin, folic acid and niacinamide, and to help prevent or correct deficiencies of these nutrients. The lactic acid bacillus component may help support normal intestinal bacteria.

How does it work?
These B vitamins support energy production, healthy blood cells and normal cell function. Lactic acid bacillus provides beneficial bacteria that help maintain intestinal balance.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If taking other vitamin or mineral supplements, check with a doctor or pharmacist to avoid unnecessary duplication.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or loose stools may occur. Riboflavin may harmlessly turn urine bright yellow.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or if there is a serious illness or weakened immune system. Seek medical advice if symptoms of deficiency continue or worsen.

title: Oracure Ultra Gel ( Pan Flavour ) (15 gm ) Chlorhexidine Gluconate 1.0%, Lignocaine 2.0% w/w, Metronidazole 1.0% w/w Gel by Csc
name: Oracure Ultra Gel ( Pan Flavour ) (15 gm ) Chlorhexidine Gluconate 1.0%, Lignocaine 2.0% w/w, Metronidazole 1.0% w/w Gel by Csc
searchText: Oracure Ultra Gel ( Pan Flavour ) (15 gm ) Chlorhexidine Gluconate 1.0%, Lignocaine 2.0% w/w, Metronidazole 1.0% w/w Gel by Csc CSC I0912
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This oral gel is generally used for bacterial gum and other mouth infections, such as gum inflammation, and to relieve pain at the affected area.

How does it work?
Chlorhexidine and metronidazole help reduce infection-causing bacteria. Lignocaine produces temporary local numbness to relieve pain.

How to take/use it
Use only on the affected mouth or gum area, exactly as directed by a dentist or the product label. Do not swallow the gel, and do not use more or for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Temporary numbness, mild burning or irritation, altered taste, and tooth or tongue staining may occur. Stop using it and seek medical help if signs of an allergic reaction develop.

Precautions
Avoid swallowing the gel or getting it in the eyes. Because lignocaine can numb the mouth, avoid hot food and drinks and take care not to bite the cheek or tongue until sensation returns. Do not use it if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a dentist or doctor before use in children, during pregnancy, or while breastfeeding.

title: Oral Ease Mouthwash (100 ml ) Chlorhexidine Gluconate, Zinc Chloride, Sodium Fluoride Mouthwash by Csc
name: Oral Ease Mouthwash (100 ml ) Chlorhexidine Gluconate, Zinc Chloride, Sodium Fluoride Mouthwash by Csc
searchText: Oral Ease Mouthwash (100 ml ) Chlorhexidine Gluconate, Zinc Chloride, Sodium Fluoride Mouthwash by Csc CSC I0859
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as an antiseptic mouthwash to help reduce dental plaque and gum inflammation (gingivitis). It may also help control mouth bacteria, bad breath and tooth decay.

How does it work?
Chlorhexidine reduces harmful bacteria in the mouth. Zinc chloride may help control mouth odour, while sodium fluoride helps strengthen tooth enamel and protect against cavities.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a dentist. Rinse the mouth and spit out; do not swallow. Do not dilute unless instructed. Avoid using it immediately after brushing, as toothpaste may reduce chlorhexidine’s effect.

Common side effects
Temporary taste changes, mouth irritation, tongue irritation and staining of the teeth or tongue may occur, especially with prolonged use.

Precautions
Do not swallow. Stop using it and seek medical advice if swelling, rash, breathing difficulty or other signs of an allergic reaction occur. Use in children only if advised by a dentist or doctor. Prolonged use may cause staining, so follow the recommended course and dental advice.

title: Oral Ease Toothgel (50g) Potassium Nitrate 5.0% w/w, Sodium Monofluorophosphate 0.75% Gel by Csc
name: Oral Ease Toothgel (50g) Potassium Nitrate 5.0% w/w, Sodium Monofluorophosphate 0.75% Gel by Csc
searchText: Oral Ease Toothgel (50g) Potassium Nitrate 5.0% w/w, Sodium Monofluorophosphate 0.75% Gel by Csc CSC I0149
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used in toothpaste to help relieve tooth sensitivity and protect teeth against cavities.

How does it work?
Potassium nitrate helps reduce the sensitivity of tooth nerves to triggers such as hot, cold or sweet foods. Sodium monofluorophosphate helps strengthen tooth enamel and prevent decay.

How to take/use it
Use as directed on the product label. Brush the teeth regularly with the toothpaste and spit after brushing. Do not swallow. Do not use more often than recommended.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Some people may experience mild mouth irritation, changes in taste or an allergic reaction.

Precautions
Do not swallow the toothpaste. Keep out of reach of young children and seek medical advice if a large amount is swallowed. Stop use and seek advice if mouth irritation, swelling or a rash occurs. Consult a dentist if tooth sensitivity continues or worsens.

title: Oral Ease With Clove (80g) Clove Toothpaste by Csc
name: Oral Ease With Clove (80g) Clove Toothpaste by Csc
searchText: Oral Ease With Clove (80g) Clove Toothpaste by Csc CSC I0808
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for cleaning the teeth and gums as part of daily oral hygiene. It may also help leave the mouth feeling fresh.

How does it work?
Brushing with toothpaste helps remove food particles and plaque from the teeth and gum line. Clove provides flavour and may have soothing properties, but this product should not be considered a treatment for dental disease.

How to take/use it
Use for brushing as directed on the product packaging. Spit out after brushing and avoid swallowing. Rinse the mouth if needed.

Common side effects
Mouth irritation or an allergic reaction may occur in sensitive individuals.

Precautions
Do not swallow. Stop using it if burning, swelling, rash or other irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of young children. Dental pain, bleeding gums or persistent mouth problems require dental evaluation.

title: Oxyness Nasal Spray (10 ml ) Oxymetazoline 0.05%, Benzalkonium Chloride 0.01% Nasal Spray by Csc
name: Oxyness Nasal Spray (10 ml ) Oxymetazoline 0.05%, Benzalkonium Chloride 0.01% Nasal Spray by Csc
searchText: Oxyness Nasal Spray (10 ml ) Oxymetazoline 0.05%, Benzalkonium Chloride 0.01% Nasal Spray by Csc CSC I1025
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nasal decongestant to temporarily relieve a blocked or stuffy nose associated with the common cold, allergies, or sinus congestion.

How does it work?
Oxymetazoline narrows swollen blood vessels in the lining of the nose, helping reduce swelling and improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Use in the nose only and follow the instructions on the package or those given by a healthcare professional. Do not use more often or for longer than recommended, as prolonged use can make nasal congestion worse. Avoid sharing the bottle and avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Nasal dryness, irritation, burning, sneezing, headache, or a temporary increase in nasal blockage after the effect wears off. Palpitations or a rise in blood pressure may occur, especially if overused.

Precautions
Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, overactive thyroid, glaucoma, or prostate problems. Check before use with antidepressants such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors or tricyclic antidepressants. Stop and seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, do not improve, or if severe irritation, fast heartbeat, or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Pantafiz DSR (10x1x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
name: Pantafiz DSR (10x1x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Pantafiz DSR (10x1x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc CSC I0150
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat acidity, heartburn and acid reflux (GERD), particularly when these symptoms are associated with nausea, bloating or a feeling of fullness.

How does it work?
Pantoprazole reduces the production of stomach acid. Domperidone helps stomach contents move forward and can reduce nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the sustained-release capsule or tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Follow the prescribed timing in relation to meals.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, bloating, dry mouth and dizziness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart rhythm problems, liver or kidney disease, or low potassium or magnesium levels. Domperidone may rarely cause serious heartbeat problems; seek urgent medical help for a fast or irregular heartbeat, fainting or severe dizziness. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially those affecting heart rhythm. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Pantaness 40 (20x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg by Csc
name: Pantaness 40 (20x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg by Csc
searchText: Pantaness 40 (20x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg by Csc CSC I0151
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pantoprazole is used to reduce excess stomach acid and treat acidity, heartburn and acid reflux (GERD). It is also used for some acid-related stomach or duodenal ulcers, as prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It is a proton pump inhibitor that blocks the final step of stomach-acid production, reducing the amount of acid released into the stomach.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow the tablet whole with water. Do not crush or chew it. It is generally taken before food; follow the instructions on the prescription or pack.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, vomiting and gas may occur. Contact a doctor if side effects are severe or persistent.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, an allergy to pantoprazole or other acid-reducing medicines, or if it is being used for a long period. Long-term use may require medical monitoring. Seek medical advice for difficulty swallowing, repeated vomiting, vomiting blood, black stools or unexplained weight loss, as these may need urgent assessment. Tell the doctor about all other medicines being taken.

title: Pantaness D (20x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 10 mg by Csc
name: Pantaness D (20x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Pantaness D (20x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 10 mg by Csc CSC I0152
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat acid reflux, heartburn and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), especially when these symptoms are associated with nausea, vomiting or delayed stomach emptying.

How does it work?
Pantoprazole reduces the production of stomach acid. Domperidone helps the stomach empty more effectively and can reduce nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not crush or chew it. Follow the prescribed timing in relation to meals.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth or dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice, especially for prolonged treatment. Tell the doctor about heart rhythm problems, liver disease, or a history of gastrointestinal blockage or bleeding. Domperidone may increase the risk of serious irregular heartbeats and can interact with some medicines, including certain antibiotics, antifungals and heart-rhythm medicines. Seek medical help for fainting, fast or irregular heartbeat, vomiting blood or black stools.

title: Pantaness DSR (10x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
name: Pantaness DSR (10x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Pantaness DSR (10x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc CSC I0153
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux (GERD), particularly when these symptoms occur with nausea, vomiting or a feeling of delayed stomach emptying.

How does it work?
Pantoprazole reduces the production of stomach acid. Domperidone helps stomach contents move forward and helps control nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed. It is generally taken before food when directed by the doctor. Swallow the sustained-release capsule/tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, gas, dry mouth or abdominal cramps.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice, especially if there is a history of irregular heartbeat, heart disease, liver or kidney problems, or low potassium or magnesium levels. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, particularly medicines that affect heart rhythm. Seek urgent medical help for a fast or irregular heartbeat, fainting, severe diarrhoea or an allergic reaction. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Pantaness L (10x1x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Levosulpiride 75 mg SR by Csc
name: Pantaness L (10x1x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Levosulpiride 75 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Pantaness L (10x1x10) Pantoprazole 40 mg, Levosulpiride 75 mg SR by Csc CSC I0245
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acid reflux, heartburn and indigestion-related symptoms such as fullness, bloating, nausea or discomfort when these are associated with slow stomach emptying or reflux. It should be used only when prescribed.

How does it work?
Pantoprazole reduces the production of stomach acid. Levosulpride helps improve movement of the stomach and intestines, supporting the passage of food and reducing reflux-related symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually before a meal. Swallow the tablet whole with water; do not crush, chew or break the sustained-release form. Do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, constipation, nausea, stomach discomfort, dizziness, drowsiness or restlessness. Levosulpride may also cause breast tenderness, milk discharge or menstrual changes.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about pregnancy or breastfeeding, Parkinson’s disease, epilepsy, heart-rhythm problems, intestinal blockage or bleeding, and any history of hormone-sensitive tumours. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizzy or drowsy. Seek medical advice for involuntary movements, severe abdominal pain, vomiting blood or black stools.

title: Pantotech IV (Vial) Pantoprazole 40 mg IV Inj by Csc
name: Pantotech IV (Vial) Pantoprazole 40 mg IV Inj by Csc
searchText: Pantotech IV (Vial) Pantoprazole 40 mg IV Inj by Csc CSC I0155
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pantoprazole 40 mg IV reduces excess stomach acid. It is used in hospitals for acid-related conditions such as acidity, acid reflux (GERD) and ulcers when treatment by mouth is not suitable.

How does it work?
It blocks the stomach’s acid-producing proton pumps, thereby reducing the amount of acid made in the stomach.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given slowly into a vein by a doctor or nurse. It is not meant for self-administration. The dose and duration depend on the condition being treated and the medical advice provided.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach discomfort, gas and irritation or pain at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to pantoprazole or similar medicines, liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Inform the healthcare provider about all medicines being used, especially blood thinners and high-dose methotrexate. Prolonged or repeated treatment may rarely cause low magnesium or vitamin B12 levels. Seek medical attention for severe diarrhoea, rash, swelling or breathing difficulty.

title: Picohop (100 ml ) Sodium Picosulfate 5 mg by Csc
name: Picohop (100 ml ) Sodium Picosulfate 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Picohop (100 ml ) Sodium Picosulfate 5 mg by Csc CSC I0627
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sodium picosulfate is a stimulant laxative used for short-term relief of occasional constipation.

How does it work?
It stimulates the bowel to increase its movement and helps more water remain in the stool, making it easier to pass.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not use it for longer than recommended, and drink adequate fluids unless fluid restriction has been advised.

Common side effects
Abdominal cramps, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, nausea, bloating and increased bowel movements. Excessive use may cause dehydration or changes in body salts.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if there is severe or unexplained abdominal pain, vomiting, suspected bowel obstruction or blood in the stool. Avoid prolonged or frequent use, as it may worsen bowel problems or cause dehydration and electrolyte imbalance. Seek medical advice if constipation persists or keeps returning.

title: Piodine 10 (15g) Povidone Iodine 10% Oint by Csc
name: Piodine 10 (15g) Povidone Iodine 10% Oint by Csc
searchText: Piodine 10 (15g) Povidone Iodine 10% Oint by Csc CSC I0158
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine ointment is an antiseptic used to help prevent infection in minor cuts, grazes, burns and other superficial wounds.

How does it work?
It releases iodine, which kills or reduces many bacteria, viruses and fungi on the skin.

How to take/use it
Clean and dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands before and after use. For external use only.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or dryness may occur. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation or an allergic reaction develops.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other internal areas. Do not use on deep or extensive wounds, serious burns or animal bites without medical advice. Seek advice before use on large areas, for prolonged periods, in infants, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is thyroid disease or iodine sensitivity.

title: Piodine (20g) Povidone Iodine 5% Oint by Csc
name: Piodine (20g) Povidone Iodine 5% Oint by Csc
searchText: Piodine (20g) Povidone Iodine 5% Oint by Csc CSC I0157
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine ointment is a topical antiseptic used to help prevent infection in minor cuts, scrapes and minor burns.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or reduces many microorganisms on the skin and helps prevent infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean and dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow it. Do not use on deep wounds, serious burns or large areas unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or dryness may occur. Stop using it and seek medical advice if a severe rash, swelling or breathing difficulty develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine. Ask a doctor before use on large or deep wounds, for prolonged treatment, or if there is thyroid disease. Use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in young children only on medical advice. Seek medical care if the wound is deep, heavily contaminated, worsening or not healing.

title: Piodin-O (15g) Povidone Iodine, Ornidazole by Csc
name: Piodin-O (15g) Povidone Iodine, Ornidazole by Csc
searchText: Piodin-O (15g) Povidone Iodine, Ornidazole by Csc CSC I0159
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain vaginal infections caused by bacteria or parasites, including mixed infections, when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Povidone iodine acts as an antiseptic against many germs. Ornidazole works against certain parasites and bacteria that can cause infection.

How to take/use it
Use only in the form and by the route prescribed. Follow the product label or doctor’s instructions, and do not use it for longer than advised. Do not swallow a product meant for local use.

Common side effects
Local burning, irritation, itching or discomfort may occur. Nausea, a metallic taste or dizziness may occur with ornidazole-containing products.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to povidone iodine, iodine or ornidazole. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is thyroid disease, liver disease or a history of seizures or other neurological problems. Stop use and seek advice if severe irritation, rash or worsening symptoms occur.

title: Prebiotic Underarm Roll- On (45 ml ) Arbutin, Lactic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Mandelic Acid Roll-On by Csc
name: Prebiotic Underarm Roll- On (45 ml ) Arbutin, Lactic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Mandelic Acid Roll-On by Csc
searchText: Prebiotic Underarm Roll- On (45 ml ) Arbutin, Lactic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Mandelic Acid Roll-On by Csc CSC I0445
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical combination is generally used to help reduce dark spots, uneven skin tone and rough skin texture. The exfoliating acids may also help keep pores clear and improve the appearance of blemish-prone skin.

How does it work?
Arbutin helps reduce the formation of melanin, which contributes to pigmentation. Lactic acid, mandelic acid and salicylic acid exfoliate dead skin cells; salicylic acid can also help clear blocked pores.

How to take/use it
Use only on clean, dry skin and follow the product label or healthcare professional’s instructions, as the correct frequency depends on the formulation. Avoid the eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Use sunscreen during the day.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, burning, redness, dryness, irritation, peeling or increased sensitivity may occur.

Precautions
Patch-test before wider use. Stop using it if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops. Avoid combining it with other strong exfoliants or irritating skincare products unless advised by a healthcare professional. Keep away from the eyes and rinse well if contact occurs.

title: ProGlo Advance (15 gm) Tetrahydrocurcuminoids, 4-Butylresorcinol Cream by Csc
name: ProGlo Advance (15 gm) Tetrahydrocurcuminoids, 4-Butylresorcinol Cream by Csc
searchText: ProGlo Advance (15 gm) Tetrahydrocurcuminoids, 4-Butylresorcinol Cream by Csc CSC I0160
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help reduce the appearance of dark spots, uneven skin tone and other areas of skin pigmentation, giving the skin a brighter, more even appearance.

How does it work?
SabiWhite and 4-n-butylresorcinol help reduce melanin production in the skin. This can gradually improve the appearance of excess pigmentation.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry, affected skin as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Use sunscreen during the day to help prevent pigmentation from becoming darker.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, burning, dryness or itching may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before wider use. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops. Avoid applying it to broken or inflamed skin, and keep it away from the eyes. Do not use more often or in larger amounts than directed.

title: Pro-Glo Ultra (15 gm) Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone Cream by Csc
name: Pro-Glo Ultra (15 gm) Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone Cream by Csc
searchText: Pro-Glo Ultra (15 gm) Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone Cream by Csc CSC I1029
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This prescription cream is mainly used to treat melasma and other dark patches or uneven skin pigmentation. It should be used only for the skin condition diagnosed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Hydroquinone reduces melanin production, tretinoin helps remove pigmented skin cells and improves skin renewal, and mometasone reduces inflammation and irritation.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer only to the affected areas, exactly as directed by the doctor. Avoid the eyes, lips, inside of the nose, broken skin and other sensitive areas. Wash hands after applying unless the hands are being treated. Use sunscreen and avoid unnecessary sun exposure during treatment.

Common side effects
Redness, burning, stinging, dryness, peeling, itching or irritation may occur. Increased sensitivity to sunlight is possible. Prolonged or improper use may cause skin thinning, acne-like spots or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision and do not use for longer than prescribed, as it contains a steroid. Avoid use during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless specifically approved by a doctor. Stop and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, blistering or worsening skin changes occur. Do not apply to infected skin or cover the treated area with a tight dressing unless advised.

title: Raboness DSR (10x1x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR Cap by Csc
name: Raboness DSR (10x1x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR Cap by Csc
searchText: Raboness DSR (10x1x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR Cap by Csc CSC I0161
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux (GERD), especially when these symptoms are associated with nausea, vomiting or a feeling of fullness.

How does it work?
Rabeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Domperidone helps improve movement of the stomach and food through the digestive tract and can help relieve nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed. Swallow the SR capsule whole with water; do not crush, chew or open it. Follow the prescribed timing in relation to meals and do not take it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, nausea, dry mouth, dizziness or constipation. Seek medical help for a fast or irregular heartbeat, fainting or severe diarrhoea.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart disease, an irregular heartbeat, liver or kidney problems, or low potassium or magnesium levels. Domperidone may increase the risk of abnormal heart rhythms, particularly with higher doses, prolonged use or certain medicines. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially medicines that affect heart rhythm. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Rabonet DSR (10x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
name: Rabonet DSR (10x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Rabonet DSR (10x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Domperidone 30 mg SR by Csc CSC I0162
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat acid reflux, heartburn and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), especially when associated with indigestion, nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Rabeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Domperidone helps improve movement of the upper digestive tract and reduces nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed. Swallow the sustained-release capsule or tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Follow the prescribed timing in relation to meals.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain or discomfort, nausea, dry mouth, dizziness and constipation may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart disease, irregular heartbeat, liver problems or low potassium or magnesium levels. Domperidone may affect heart rhythm, so inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially medicines that affect heart rhythm or interact with domperidone. Seek urgent medical help for palpitations, fainting or severe dizziness. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if prolonged treatment is needed.

title: Rabonet L (10x1x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Levosulpiride 75 mg SR by Csc
name: Rabonet L (10x1x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Levosulpiride 75 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Rabonet L (10x1x10) Rabeprazole 20 mg, Levosulpiride 75 mg SR by Csc CSC I0164
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat acid reflux and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), often with related indigestion, bloating, nausea or a feeling of fullness.

How does it work?
Rabeprazole reduces the production of stomach acid. Levosulpride helps improve movement of the stomach and food through the digestive tract.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed. It is generally taken before food. Swallow the sustained-release tablet/capsule whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhoea or constipation, dizziness and drowsiness. Levosulpride may also cause breast tenderness or menstrual changes due to increased prolactin.

Precautions
Use under medical supervision, especially during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or with a history of seizures, Parkinson’s disease, heart rhythm problems or hormone-sensitive conditions. Avoid driving or alcohol if dizziness or drowsiness occurs. Seek medical advice for unusual movements, severe diarrhoea, persistent abdominal symptoms or breast changes. Prolonged use should be reviewed by a doctor.

title: Ranifiz Spas (20x10) Ranitidine 150 mg, Dicyclomine 10 mg, Simethicone 20 mg by Csc
name: Ranifiz Spas (20x10) Ranitidine 150 mg, Dicyclomine 10 mg, Simethicone 20 mg by Csc
searchText: Ranifiz Spas (20x10) Ranitidine 150 mg, Dicyclomine 10 mg, Simethicone 20 mg by Csc CSC I0397
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for acidity, heartburn, indigestion, stomach cramps and bloating caused by excess stomach acid, intestinal spasms and gas.

How does it work?
Ranitidine reduces the production of stomach acid. Dicyclomine relaxes intestinal muscles to reduce cramps, while simethicone helps break up gas bubbles and relieve bloating.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist or keep returning.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, headache, dizziness or drowsiness. Blurred vision may occur due to dicyclomine.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or an enlarged prostate, intestinal blockage, or kidney or liver disease. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizziness, drowsiness or blurred vision occurs. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent abdominal pain, vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood.

title: Raxophin-S (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1000 mg, Sulbactam 500 mg by Csc
name: Raxophin-S (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1000 mg, Sulbactam 500 mg by Csc
searchText: Raxophin-S (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1000 mg, Sulbactam 500 mg by Csc CSC I1048
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ceftriaxone with sulbactam is an injectable antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, such as infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, skin, blood, bones or joints, when prescribed by a doctor. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Ceftriaxone kills bacteria by preventing them from forming their protective cell wall. Sulbactam helps ceftriaxone work against bacteria that can otherwise resist certain antibiotics.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection and should be followed exactly as prescribed. Do not stop treatment early unless advised by the doctor.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, skin rash and headache may occur. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin reaction.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about any allergy to ceftriaxone, penicillins, cephalosporins or other antibiotics, and about liver, kidney or gallbladder problems. Contact the doctor for severe or persistent diarrhoea, especially during or after treatment. Use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in newborn babies only on medical advice. Take only for a confirmed or strongly suspected bacterial infection and only as prescribed.

title: Raxophin TZ (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1 g, Tazobactam 125 mg Inj by Csc
name: Raxophin TZ (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1 g, Tazobactam 125 mg Inj by Csc
searchText: Raxophin TZ (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1 g, Tazobactam 125 mg Inj by Csc CSC I0045
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ceftriaxone with tazobactam is a prescription injectable antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Ceftriaxone kills susceptible bacteria by stopping them from forming their protective cell wall. Tazobactam helps ceftriaxone work against bacteria that produce enzymes capable of reducing the effect of some antibiotics.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose and duration depend on the type and severity of infection and should be decided by the prescriber. Do not self-inject or stop treatment early unless advised.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; diarrhoea; nausea; rash; and changes in liver or blood test results. Serious allergic reactions can occur rarely.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to ceftriaxone, penicillins, cephalosporins or other antibiotics, and about liver, kidney or gallbladder problems. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash. Contact a doctor for severe or persistent diarrhoea, as antibiotic-associated colitis can occur. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Raxophin (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1 g by Csc
name: Raxophin (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1 g by Csc
searchText: Raxophin (Vial) Ceftriaxone 1 g by Csc CSC I0165
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ceftriaxone is an injectable antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, such as infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, skin, blood, bones and joints, and certain sexually transmitted infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from building their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
Ceftriaxone 1 g is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection. Use it only as prescribed and complete the recommended course.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; diarrhoea; nausea; rash; and changes in liver blood tests.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to ceftriaxone, penicillins or other antibiotics. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, severe rash, or severe or persistent diarrhoea. It should be used carefully in newborn babies and in people with liver or kidney problems. Do not self-administer this medicine.

title: Rayfilm Sunscreen (50g) Vitamin C, Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 by Csc
name: Rayfilm Sunscreen (50g) Vitamin C, Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 by Csc
searchText: Rayfilm Sunscreen (50g) Vitamin C, Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 by Csc CSC I0892
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help protect exposed skin from sunburn and harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation during sun exposure.

How does it work?
Sunscreen filters help absorb, reflect or scatter UV rays before they reach the skin. Vitamin C and niacinamide are included as skin-care ingredients.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to exposed skin before sun exposure and reapply as directed on the product label, especially after swimming, sweating or towel drying. Use other sun-protection measures such as protective clothing and shade.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, stinging or itching may occur. Allergic reactions are uncommon.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes and rinse with water if contact occurs. Test on a small area first, especially if the skin is sensitive. Stop use if significant irritation or an allergic reaction develops. Sunscreen does not provide complete protection from UV radiation.

title: Redensyl 3% Hair Growth Serum (10 ml ) Procapil, Anagain, Saw Palmetto Serum by Csc
name: Redensyl 3% Hair Growth Serum (10 ml ) Procapil, Anagain, Saw Palmetto Serum by Csc
searchText: Redensyl 3% Hair Growth Serum (10 ml ) Procapil, Anagain, Saw Palmetto Serum by Csc CSC I0388
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used in hair-care products intended to support hair growth and help reduce hair fall. It may be used for common pattern-related hair thinning, but results can vary and it is not a guaranteed treatment for hair loss.

How does it work?
Procapil and Anagain are plant-derived ingredients used to support the hair-growth cycle. Saw palmetto may reduce the conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT), a hormone linked with pattern hair loss, although evidence for these ingredients is limited.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label, as the correct instructions depend on whether it is an oral supplement or a topical hair product. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Possible side effects may include scalp irritation or allergic reactions with topical products, or stomach upset and headache with oral products. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe or persistent symptoms occur.

Precautions
Check with a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, before surgery, or if taking blood-thinning or hormone-related medicines. Avoid use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a dermatologist if hair loss is sudden, patchy, severe, or associated with scalp symptoms.

title: Retinol 0.1% Face Serum New (25 ml) Bakuchiol 0.1%, Niacinamide 1%, Lactobionic Acid 0.5% Serum by Csc
name: Retinol 0.1% Face Serum New (25 ml) Bakuchiol 0.1%, Niacinamide 1%, Lactobionic Acid 0.5% Serum by Csc
searchText: Retinol 0.1% Face Serum New (25 ml) Bakuchiol 0.1%, Niacinamide 1%, Lactobionic Acid 0.5% Serum by Csc CSC I0575
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical combination is used for general skin care and to support smoother-looking, more even-toned skin.

How does it work?
Bakuchiol helps support skin renewal and has antioxidant properties. Niacinamide supports the skin barrier, while lactobionic acid provides gentle exfoliation and hydration.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not apply to broken or irritated skin.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, dryness, itching or irritation may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before wider use. Stop using it if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Avoid contact with the eyes. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is an existing skin condition.

title: Retro 10 (60ml) Minoxidil 10% Solution by Csc
name: Retro 10 (60ml) Minoxidil 10% Solution by Csc
searchText: Retro 10 (60ml) Minoxidil 10% Solution by Csc CSC I0536
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Minoxidil 10% solution is applied to the scalp to help treat pattern hair loss and support hair regrowth. It is not usually suitable for sudden, patchy or unexplained hair loss without medical advice.

How does it work?
It helps improve blood flow around hair follicles and may prolong the hair-growth phase, helping some follicles produce thicker hair.

How to take/use it
Use only on the scalp and follow the product label or prescriber's instructions. Apply to a clean, dry scalp, wash hands after use, and avoid contact with the eyes, face and broken or irritated skin. Do not use more than recommended.

Common side effects
Scalp itching, dryness, redness or irritation; unwanted facial or body hair; headache or dizziness. Rarely, fast heartbeat or swelling may occur.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid use on an irritated or sunburned scalp. Stop use and seek medical advice if chest pain, fainting, severe dizziness, rapid heartbeat or swelling develops. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if hair loss is sudden, patchy or due to another medical condition.

title: Retro 5 (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Solution by Csc
name: Retro 5 (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Solution by Csc
searchText: Retro 5 (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Solution by Csc CSC I0167
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Minoxidil 5% solution is used on the scalp to help promote hair regrowth and reduce hair loss in pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia) in adults.

How does it work?
It may stimulate hair follicles and help prolong the hair-growth phase. The exact way it works is not fully understood.

How to take/use it
For external use on the scalp only. Apply it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Use on a clean, dry scalp, avoid contact with the eyes, and wash hands after application. Do not apply more than directed.

Common side effects
Scalp irritation, itching, dryness, redness or burning; unwanted hair growth on the face or other body areas; and temporary increased hair shedding when starting treatment.

Precautions
Do not apply to broken, inflamed or infected skin. Avoid contact with the eyes and mouth. Do not use for sudden or patchy hair loss, or hair loss with an unknown cause, without medical advice. Stop using it and seek medical help for chest pain, fast heartbeat, dizziness, swelling or severe skin irritation. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Retro 5 Pro (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Solution by Csc
name: Retro 5 Pro (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Solution by Csc
searchText: Retro 5 Pro (60ml) Minoxidil 5% Solution by Csc CSC I0468
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the scalp to help reduce hereditary (pattern) hair loss and support hair regrowth in some people.

How does it work?
Minoxidil may stimulate hair follicles and help keep them in the growth phase for longer. Its exact action is not fully understood.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to the dry scalp exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands after applying and avoid contact with the eyes, face, and other body areas. Do not apply to broken, irritated, or infected skin.

Common side effects
Scalp itching, dryness, redness, irritation, or flaking. Unwanted hair growth on the face or other nearby areas may occur.

Precautions
Stop use and seek medical advice if severe scalp irritation, chest pain, fast heartbeat, dizziness, swelling, or sudden unexplained hair loss occurs. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is heart disease or a scalp condition. Keep away from children and avoid swallowing.

title: Retro F (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% v/v Solution by Csc
name: Retro F (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% v/v Solution by Csc
searchText: Retro F (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% v/v Solution by Csc CSC I0320
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the scalp to help treat pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia) and support hair regrowth.

How does it work?
Minoxidil helps improve blood flow and prolongs the hair-growth phase. Finasteride reduces dihydrotestosterone (DHT), a hormone linked to pattern hair loss.

How to take/use it
For external use on the scalp only. Apply exactly as prescribed or directed on the product label, usually to a clean, dry scalp. Avoid contact with the eyes, face and broken or irritated skin, and wash hands after application. Do not stop or change treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Scalp irritation, itching, dryness, redness or flaking; unwanted facial or body hair; headache or dizziness. Finasteride may rarely cause reduced sexual desire, erectile or ejaculation problems, breast tenderness, or mood changes.

Precautions
Do not use during pregnancy or if pregnancy is possible; finasteride can harm a developing male baby. Women who are pregnant or may become pregnant should not handle leaking or spilled solution. Keep away from children and pets. Seek medical advice for chest pain, rapid heartbeat, fainting, severe dizziness, swelling, or persistent mood or sexual changes. Avoid applying to inflamed, infected or damaged scalp unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Retro F Pro (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% v/v Solution by Csc
name: Retro F Pro (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% v/v Solution by Csc
searchText: Retro F Pro (60ml) Minoxidil 5%, Finasteride 0.1% v/v Solution by Csc CSC I0456
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the scalp to help treat pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia) and support hair regrowth.

How does it work?
Minoxidil helps stimulate and prolong the hair-growth phase. Finasteride reduces the effect of dihydrotestosterone (DHT), a hormone involved in pattern hair loss.

How to take/use it
Apply to the scalp only, exactly as prescribed. Use on a clean, dry scalp and wash hands after application. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and broken or irritated skin. Do not swallow. Regular use may be needed to maintain results; follow the prescriber's instructions.

Common side effects
Scalp irritation, itching, dryness, redness or flaking; increased hair growth on the face or other unwanted areas. Headache or dizziness may occur. Finasteride may rarely cause reduced sexual desire or other sexual problems.

Precautions
For external use only. Do not use on a damaged or inflamed scalp unless advised by a clinician. Stop and seek medical advice for chest pain, fast heartbeat, fainting, severe dizziness or swelling. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should not use it or handle leaking solution because finasteride may harm a male fetus. Keep away from children and pets, and avoid sharing the product.

title: Retro Hair Forte (10x1x10) Biotin 10 mg, N-Acetylcysteine 50 mg, Cupric Oxide 3 mg, Zinc Oxide 22.5 mg, Calcium Pantothenate 100 mg, Sodium Selenite 65 mcg by Csc
name: Retro Hair Forte (10x1x10) Biotin 10 mg, N-Acetylcysteine 50 mg, Cupric Oxide 3 mg, Zinc Oxide 22.5 mg, Calcium Pantothenate 100 mg, Sodium Selenite 65 mcg by Csc
searchText: Retro Hair Forte (10x1x10) Biotin 10 mg, N-Acetylcysteine 50 mg, Cupric Oxide 3 mg, Zinc Oxide 22.5 mg, Calcium Pantothenate 100 mg, Sodium Selenite 65 mcg by Csc CSC I0218
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This is a vitamin, mineral and antioxidant supplement used to help provide nutrients when dietary intake is inadequate or nutritional supplementation is recommended. It is not possible to confirm a specific condition or purpose from the ingredients alone.

How does it work?
Its vitamins, minerals and N-acetylcysteine provide nutrients involved in normal metabolism, antioxidant protection and other body functions. It helps supplement the diet; it does not replace a balanced diet.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other supplements containing zinc, selenium, copper or biotin unless advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, vomiting, diarrhoea or constipation may occur. Zinc or N-acetylcysteine may sometimes cause an unpleasant taste.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional about all medicines and supplements being taken. Biotin can interfere with some blood test results; inform the laboratory or doctor before testing. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or in kidney or liver disease. Avoid prolonged or excessive use because excess zinc, selenium or copper can be harmful. Stop and seek help if an allergic reaction occurs.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This is a nutritional supplement that provides biotin, borage oil, vitamins and antioxidant nutrients to help supplement the diet. It is not intended to diagnose or treat a specific disease.

How does it work?
The vitamins and biotin support normal body functions, including nutrient metabolism and maintenance of skin, hair and nails. Borage oil provides gamma-linolenic acid, while antioxidant nutrients help protect cells from oxidative stress.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label. Do not exceed the recommended amount or combine it with other multivitamins unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Possible side effects include nausea, stomach upset, bloating, constipation or loose motions. Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction occurs.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is liver disease, a bleeding disorder, seizure disorder, or use of blood-thinning or seizure medicines. Biotin may interfere with some laboratory blood tests; inform the doctor or laboratory that it is being taken. Keep out of reach of children, as excessive vitamin intake can be harmful.

title: Retronox 2.5 mg (1x30) Minoxidil 2.5 mg Tab by Csc

searchText: Retronox 2.5 mg (1x30) Minoxidil 2.5 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0835
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Minoxidil tablets are used with other medicines to treat very high blood pressure when other treatments are not effective enough. In some cases, doctors prescribe low-dose oral minoxidil for hair loss; this use requires medical supervision.

How does it work?
It relaxes and widens blood vessels, helping blood flow more easily and lowering blood pressure. Its effect on hair growth is not fully understood.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Regular blood pressure monitoring may be needed.

Common side effects
Increased hair growth, fluid retention or swelling, fast heartbeat, headache, dizziness, and nausea. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, severe breathlessness, or fainting.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision. Tell the doctor about heart disease, kidney disease, or a history of fluid retention. Minoxidil may cause a significant fall in blood pressure and may require other medicines to control fast heartbeat and fluid retention. Rise slowly if dizziness occurs, and seek medical advice for sudden weight gain or swelling.

name: Ridfiz MPS (Mint) (170 ml) Dried Aluminium Hydroxide 250 mg, Magnesium Hydroxide 250 mg, Activated Simethicone 50 mg, Sorbitol Solution 1.25 g by Csc

What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of acidity, heartburn, indigestion, gas and bloating.

How does it work?
Aluminium hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide neutralise excess stomach acid. Simethicone helps break up gas bubbles, reducing bloating and discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Measure the liquid carefully if supplied as a suspension, and do not take more than recommended. Keep a 2–4 hour gap from other medicines unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Constipation, loose stools or diarrhoea, stomach cramps, nausea, or changes in bowel movements may occur.

Precautions
Ask a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, severe or persistent stomach pain, repeated vomiting, or unexplained weight loss. Do not use for prolonged periods without medical advice. Seek medical advice if symptoms continue or worsen.

title: Rifatech 400 (10x1x10) Rifaximin 400 mg by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rifaximin is used to treat certain bacterial infections in the intestine, including some types of bacterial diarrhoea. It may also be prescribed for other bowel or liver-related conditions by a doctor.

How does it work?
It acts mainly inside the intestine and stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins needed for their growth.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not self-medicate or share this medicine.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain or discomfort, bloating, flatulence, constipation, headache and dizziness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about rifamycin antibiotic allergies, liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. This medicine may not be suitable for diarrhoea with fever or blood in the stool, or for infections affecting the whole body. Seek medical advice if diarrhoea worsens, persists, or returns after treatment. Severe or persistent diarrhoea after using an antibiotic requires prompt medical attention.

title: Romiside D (10x1x10) Trypsin, Bromelain, Rutoside, Diclofenac Tab by Csc

searchText: Romiside D (10x1x10) Trypsin, Bromelain, Rutoside, Diclofenac Tab by Csc CSC I0398
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to relieve pain, inflammation and swelling associated with muscle or joint injuries, arthritis and other musculoskeletal conditions.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Trypsin, bromelain and rutoside may help reduce inflammation and swelling.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed. Swallow the tablet whole with water, preferably with or after food. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is a history of stomach ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, or allergy to diclofenac, other NSAID painkillers, bromelain, trypsin or rutoside. Inform the doctor about kidney, liver or heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or bleeding disorders. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy, especially the third trimester, or while taking blood thinners, steroids or other painkillers. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe allergic reactions or breathing difficulty.

title: Rosuglaz 10 (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg by Csc
name: Rosuglaz 10 (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg by Csc
searchText: Rosuglaz 10 (10x15) Rosuvastatin 10 mg by Csc CSC I0704
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rosuvastatin is used to lower high cholesterol, especially LDL (bad) cholesterol, and to help reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke in people at increased cardiovascular risk.

How does it work?
It blocks an enzyme in the liver involved in making cholesterol. This lowers LDL cholesterol and can modestly increase HDL (good) cholesterol.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually once daily, with or without food. Swallow the tablet whole with water and take it at about the same time each day. Continue a healthy diet and do not stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach pain, constipation, dizziness, and muscle aches or weakness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver or kidney disease, thyroid problems, or a history of muscle problems. Seek medical advice promptly for unexplained or severe muscle pain, weakness, fever, or dark urine. It is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, as some can increase the risk of side effects. Liver tests may be advised during treatment.

title: Rosuglaz 20 (10x15) Rosuvastatin 20 mg by Csc
