bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rosuvastatin is used to lower high cholesterol, especially LDL (“bad”) cholesterol, and to help reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke in suitable patients.

How does it work?
It blocks an enzyme in the liver involved in making cholesterol. This lowers LDL cholesterol and may help prevent fatty deposits from building up in blood vessels.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Swallow the tablet whole and take it at the same time each day. Continue diet and lifestyle measures advised by the doctor.

Common side effects
Headache, muscle pain, nausea, stomach pain, constipation and weakness. Seek medical advice promptly for unexplained or severe muscle pain or weakness.

Precautions
Do not use during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless specifically advised by a doctor. Tell the doctor about liver disease, kidney disease, thyroid problems, or a history of muscle problems. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, as some medicines can increase the risk of muscle injury. Liver tests and cholesterol checks may be recommended.

title: Rosuglaz F (10x10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg by Csc
name: Rosuglaz F (10x10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg by Csc
searchText: Rosuglaz F (10x10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 160 mg by Csc CSC I0706
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to manage high cholesterol and high triglyceride levels, especially mixed lipid disorders, along with a healthy diet and lifestyle. It helps reduce the risk of complications related to abnormal blood fat levels.

How does it work?
Rosuvastatin reduces the liver’s production of cholesterol and helps remove LDL (“bad”) cholesterol from the blood. Fenofibrate mainly lowers triglycerides and can help increase HDL (“good”) cholesterol.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Follow the recommended diet and attend scheduled cholesterol and blood tests.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach pain, constipation, and muscle aches may occur. Liver enzyme changes can also occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about liver or kidney disease, gallbladder problems, thyroid disorders, a history of muscle problems, or regular alcohol use. Seek medical help for unexplained or severe muscle pain, weakness, cramps, or dark-coloured urine. Avoid use during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless specifically advised. Tell the doctor about all other medicines, especially other cholesterol medicines, blood thinners, and medicines affecting the kidneys or liver.

title: Rosuglaz Gold (10X10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Clopidogrel 75 mg, Aspirin 75 mg by Csc
name: Rosuglaz Gold (10X10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Clopidogrel 75 mg, Aspirin 75 mg by Csc
searchText: Rosuglaz Gold (10X10) Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Clopidogrel 75 mg, Aspirin 75 mg by Csc CSC I0629
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to help reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke and blood-clot-related problems in people with coronary artery disease, including after a heart attack, acute coronary syndrome, angioplasty or stent placement. It also helps lower high cholesterol.

How does it work?
Rosuvastatin lowers harmful LDL cholesterol and helps protect blood vessels. Clopidogrel and aspirin reduce the sticking together of blood platelets, helping prevent harmful blood clots.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day, with water. Do not stop it without medical advice, as stopping the antiplatelet medicines may increase the risk of a blood clot. Tell the doctor before any surgery or dental procedure.

Common side effects
Easy bruising or bleeding, nosebleeds, indigestion, stomach discomfort, nausea, headache and muscle pain may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about a history of stomach ulcers, bleeding disorders, liver or kidney disease, or aspirin allergy. Seek urgent medical help for vomiting blood, black stools, unusually heavy bleeding, severe headache, or severe muscle pain or weakness with dark urine. Avoid starting painkillers such as ibuprofen or other blood-thinning medicines unless advised by a doctor. Rosuvastatin should not be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless specifically advised by a doctor.

title: Roxsin (100ml) Ambroxol, Guaiphenesin, Terbutaline Syr by Csc

searchText: Roxsin (100ml) Ambroxol, Guaiphenesin, Terbutaline Syr by Csc CSC I0370
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This syrup is used to relieve a phlegmy or mucus-producing cough and chest congestion. It may also help ease wheezing or breathing difficulty caused by narrowing of the airways.

How does it work?
Ambroxol thins and loosens mucus, while guaifenesin helps clear it from the airways. Terbutaline relaxes the airway muscles and helps improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or as stated on the product label. Shake the bottle well before use and measure the syrup with the supplied measuring device. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, shakiness, nervousness, fast heartbeat or palpitations.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, seizures, or a history of irregular heartbeat. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical advice if breathing difficulty is severe, worsening, or not improving.

What is it used for?
It is used to relieve cough with mucus and chest congestion. It also helps loosen thick phlegm and relax narrowed airways when coughing is associated with breathing difficulty.

How does it work?
Terbutaline helps relax the muscles around the airways. Bromhexine and guaiphenesin help thin and loosen mucus so it can be coughed out, while menthol may soothe throat irritation.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Measure liquid doses with the supplied measuring device, if applicable, and do not take more than recommended. Consult a doctor if the cough persists, worsens, or is accompanied by significant breathing difficulty.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, nervousness, shakiness or tremor, and a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is heart disease, an irregular heartbeat, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, or a history of seizures. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Seek medical help for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, or a very fast or irregular heartbeat. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Shake the bottle well before use and measure the syrup with a proper measuring device. Do not take more than recommended. Avoid combining it with cough-suppressant medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, headache, shakiness or tremor, nervousness, and a fast or pounding heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, or a history of seizures. bodyHtml:

Used to relieve cough with mucus and chest congestion, especially when airway narrowing or wheezing is also present. It helps loosen mucus so it can be coughed out more easily.

How does it work?
Levosalbutamol relaxes and opens the airways. Ambroxol thins mucus, while guaiphenesin helps loosen and clear phlegm.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist, especially for children. Measure the drops with the supplied dropper and do not exceed the recommended amount. Drink adequate fluids unless medically restricted.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, shakiness or tremors, and fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use medical advice is important for children, and for people with heart disease, high blood pressure, overactive thyroid, diabetes, seizures, or low potassium. Levosalbutamol relaxes the muscles of the airways to help improve breathing. Ambroxol thins mucus, while guaifenesin helps loosen and clear phlegm.

Take by mouth exactly as advised by the doctor or as directed on the label. Shake the bottle well before use and measure each dose with the provided measuring device. Do not take more than recommended.

Ambroxol thins and loosens mucus, while guaiphenesin helps clear phlegm. Terbutaline relaxes the airway muscles, helping to improve airflow.

Use the drops exactly as directed by the doctor or on the product label. Measure the dose carefully with the supplied dropper or measuring device, and do not take more or use it more often than recommended.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Triamcinolone acetonide is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and allergic reactions. Depending on the formulation and doctor's diagnosis, it may be used for joint inflammation, severe allergies, and other inflammatory skin or medical conditions.

How does it work?
It reduces the activity of substances in the body that cause inflammation, swelling, redness and allergic symptoms.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. The route of use depends on the formulation; a 40 mg product may be given by a healthcare professional and should not be self-injected. Do not use it more often or for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Pain or irritation at the injection site, increased blood sugar, stomach discomfort, mood changes, increased appetite, fluid retention and increased risk of infections may occur. Side effects depend on the route and duration of treatment.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, glaucoma, mental health conditions or any current infection. Steroids can weaken the immune system and may mask infection symptoms. Avoid live vaccines unless advised by a doctor. Prolonged treatment should not be stopped suddenly without medical advice.

Sertaconazole stops the growth of fungi that cause skin infections. Zinc pyrithione has antifungal and anti-flaking properties.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to the affected area exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Keep the area clean and dry, wash hands before and after use, and avoid contact with the eyes and mouth.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, dryness or irritation at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to sertaconazole, zinc pyrithione or any ingredient. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Rose water is used as a cosmetic skin refresher and toner. It may be applied to the skin to provide a cooling, refreshing feel.

How does it work?
It lightly hydrates and refreshes the skin. Its effects may vary depending on the other natural ingredients in the product.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply or spray onto clean skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, redness, itching or an allergic reaction may occur in sensitive individuals.

Precautions
Check the ingredient list before use, especially if prone to allergies or sensitive skin. Test on a small area first and stop use if irritation occurs. Keep away from the eyes and out of reach of children.

title: Shauna Onion Hair Oil (100 ml ) Shauna Onion Hair Oil by Csc
name: Shauna Onion Hair Oil (100 ml ) Shauna Onion Hair Oil by Csc
searchText: Shauna Onion Hair Oil (100 ml ) Shauna Onion Hair Oil by Csc CSC .
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
A hair-care oil intended to condition the hair and scalp. Specific hair-growth benefits cannot be confirmed from the product name alone.

How does it work?
Hair oil coats hair fibres and may help reduce dryness and improve manageability. Effects depend on the complete formulation.

How to take/use it
Apply to the hair and scalp as directed on the label. Wash off according to product instructions.

Common side effects
Scalp irritation, itching or allergic reactions may occur.

Precautions
Patch-test before use. Avoid contact with the eyes and discontinue if irritation develops.

title: Shauna Soft Deep Moisturising Lotion (Tube) (100 ml ) Squalene, Glycerine Lotion by Csc
name: Shauna Soft Deep Moisturising Lotion (Tube) (100 ml ) Squalene, Glycerine Lotion by Csc
searchText: Shauna Soft Deep Moisturising Lotion (Tube) (100 ml ) Squalene, Glycerine Lotion by Csc CSC I0584
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to moisturise dry, rough or dehydrated skin and help keep the skin soft and smooth.

How does it work?
Glycerine attracts and helps retain water in the skin. Squalene helps soften the skin and support its protective barrier.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin and gently massage until absorbed. Use as directed on the product label and reapply when needed.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Mild irritation, redness, itching or a stinging sensation may occur, especially on sensitive skin.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes. Do not use if there is a known allergy to any ingredient. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops.

title: Shauna Soft Lotion(Pump) (100ml) Soft Moisturising Lotion by Csc
name: Shauna Soft Lotion(Pump) (100ml) Soft Moisturising Lotion by Csc
searchText: Shauna Soft Lotion(Pump) (100ml) Soft Moisturising Lotion by Csc CSC I0215
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Soft moisturising lotion is used to moisturise and soften dry or rough skin and help relieve dryness-related tightness or discomfort.

How does it work?
It helps increase the skin’s moisture content and forms a protective layer that reduces moisture loss.

How to take/use it
Apply gently to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or stinging may occur in some people.

Precautions
For external use only. Do not apply to broken or infected skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop use and seek advice if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Check the product label for any specific warnings.

title: Shauna Soft Moisturizing Lotion (200ml) Shea Butter, Vitamin E Lotion by Csc
name: Shauna Soft Moisturizing Lotion (200ml) Shea Butter, Vitamin E Lotion by Csc
searchText: Shauna Soft Moisturizing Lotion (200ml) Shea Butter, Vitamin E Lotion by Csc CSC I0314
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to moisturise and soften dry or rough skin. It helps keep the skin feeling smooth and hydrated.

How does it work?
Shea butter and vitamin E help condition the skin and reduce moisture loss, supporting the skin’s natural protective barrier.

How to take/use it
Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin and gently massage until absorbed. Use as directed on the product label. For external use only.

Common side effects
Some people may experience mild skin irritation, redness, itching or an allergic reaction.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes. Do not apply if the product causes irritation or an allergic reaction; stop use and seek medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen. Do not apply to infected or seriously damaged skin unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Shiny Woo Conditioner (150 ml ) Shea Butter, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Keratin Conditioner by Csc
name: Shiny Woo Conditioner (150 ml ) Shea Butter, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Keratin Conditioner by Csc
searchText: Shiny Woo Conditioner (150 ml ) Shea Butter, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Keratin Conditioner by Csc CSC I0908
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for moisturising, conditioning and improving the feel and appearance of dry, rough or damaged hair. It may help make hair softer, smoother and easier to manage.

How does it work?
Shea butter helps soften and moisturise the hair. Pro-vitamin B5 helps retain moisture, while hydrolysed keratin can coat the hair surface and improve smoothness.

How to take/use it
Use on the hair as directed on the product label. Apply only to the hair or scalp if the label permits, and avoid contact with the eyes. Do not swallow.

Common side effects
May cause scalp or skin irritation, itching or an allergic reaction in sensitive individuals.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes; rinse thoroughly with water if contact occurs. Stop use if irritation or allergy develops. Check the ingredient list before use if allergic to any component.

title: Shiny Woo Shampoo (200 ml ) Argan Oil, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydrolyzed Keratin Shampoo by Csc
name: Shiny Woo Shampoo (200 ml ) Argan Oil, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydrolyzed Keratin Shampoo by Csc
searchText: Shiny Woo Shampoo (200 ml ) Argan Oil, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydrolyzed Keratin Shampoo by Csc CSC I0367
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a hair-conditioning and moisturising product to help improve the softness, smoothness and manageability of dry, rough or damaged-looking hair.

How does it work?
Argan oil helps condition and soften the hair. Hyaluronic acid helps retain moisture, while hydrolysed keratin coats the hair and may improve its smooth, conditioned feel.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Use on the hair as directed on the product label. Do not swallow and avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Mild scalp or skin irritation, itching or redness may occur in sensitive individuals. The product may make hair feel greasy or heavy if too much is used.

Precautions
Check the ingredients before use if there is a known allergy to any component. Stop use if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Avoid contact with the eyes; rinse with water if contact occurs. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Shudh Shilajeet Resign (20 gm ) Shilajit Resin by Csc
name: Shudh Shilajeet Resign (20 gm ) Shilajit Resin by Csc
searchText: Shudh Shilajeet Resign (20 gm ) Shilajit Resin by Csc CSC I0457
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Shilajit resin is a traditional Ayurvedic mineral-rich supplement used to support general energy, vitality and wellness. It is not a proven treatment for any specific medical condition.

How does it work?
Its exact effects are not well established. Shilajit contains naturally occurring organic and mineral compounds, but reliable evidence for its health benefits is limited.

How to take/use it
Use only the amount and method stated on the product label or advised by a healthcare professional. Do not use unpurified or unknown-quality shilajit products.

Common side effects
Safety information is limited. Possible effects include stomach upset, nausea, headache, dizziness or an allergic reaction.

Precautions
Avoid use during pregnancy or breastfeeding and in children unless advised by a healthcare professional. People with gout, iron-overload disorders, chronic illnesses or those taking regular medicines should seek medical advice before use. Stop using it and seek medical help if an allergic reaction or severe symptoms occur.

title: Silicone Matt Sunscreen gel SPF50 (50 gm) SPF50 Silicone Sunscreen by Csc
name: Silicone Matt Sunscreen gel SPF50 (50 gm) SPF50 Silicone Sunscreen by Csc
searchText: Silicone Matt Sunscreen gel SPF50 (50 gm) SPF50 Silicone Sunscreen by Csc CSC I0576
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help protect the skin from sunburn and harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays during sun exposure.

How does it work?
It forms a protective layer on the skin that helps reduce the amount of UV radiation reaching the skin.

How to take/use it
Apply evenly to clean, exposed skin before sun exposure. Use sufficient coverage and reapply as directed on the product label, especially after swimming, sweating or towel drying. For external use only.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or rash may occur in sensitive individuals.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes. Stop use if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Sunscreen does not replace protective clothing, shade and avoiding excessive sun exposure.

title: Sipera-SB 1.5 gm (Vial) Cefoperazone 1 g, Sulbactam 500 mg Inj by Csc
name: Sipera-SB 1.5 gm (Vial) Cefoperazone 1 g, Sulbactam 500 mg Inj by Csc
searchText: Sipera-SB 1.5 gm (Vial) Cefoperazone 1 g, Sulbactam 500 mg Inj by Csc CSC I0480
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This injection is used to treat serious bacterial infections, such as infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, skin and soft tissues, bones and joints, or blood. It does not work against viral infections such as cold or flu.

How does it work?
Cefoperazone kills bacteria by stopping them from building their protective cell wall. Sulbactam helps cefoperazone work against bacteria that can otherwise resist certain antibiotics.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney and liver function, and the patient’s response. Complete the prescribed course unless the doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, rash, itching, and pain or irritation at the injection site may occur. Seek urgent medical help for severe diarrhoea, facial swelling, breathing difficulty, or a severe skin rash.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about any allergy to cefoperazone, sulbactam, penicillins, cephalosporins, or other antibiotics. Tell the doctor about liver disease, kidney disease, bleeding or clotting problems, or use of blood thinners. Medical monitoring may be needed during prolonged treatment. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for the period advised by the doctor, as cefoperazone may cause an unpleasant reaction. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Stancet (30x10) Levocetirizine 5 mg by Csc
name: Stancet (30x10) Levocetirizine 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Stancet (30x10) Levocetirizine 5 mg by Csc CSC I0175
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levocetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching or hives on the skin.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a chemical released during an allergic reaction. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. It may be taken with or without food. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, tiredness, headache, and dry mouth.

Precautions
It may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase sleepiness. Inform the doctor about kidney problems, pregnancy, or breastfeeding before use.

title: Sterilone 4 (20X10) Methylprednisolone 4 mg by Csc
name: Sterilone 4 (20X10) Methylprednisolone 4 mg by Csc
searchText: Sterilone 4 (20X10) Methylprednisolone 4 mg by Csc CSC I0317
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylprednisolone is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and suppress overactive immune responses in conditions such as severe allergies, asthma, arthritis, autoimmune disorders and certain skin conditions.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and allergic or immune reactions.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed, preferably with food or milk to reduce stomach upset. Do not change the dose or stop treatment suddenly, especially if it has been used for a longer period.

Common side effects
Increased appetite, indigestion, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, facial puffiness, fluid retention and increased blood sugar may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, glaucoma, mental health problems or an ongoing infection. This medicine can reduce resistance to infections; avoid contact with people who have contagious infections and ask the doctor before receiving vaccines. Seek medical advice for signs of infection or severe mood changes.

title: Sterilone 8 (20X10) Methylprednisolone 8 mg by Csc
name: Sterilone 8 (20X10) Methylprednisolone 8 mg by Csc
searchText: Sterilone 8 (20X10) Methylprednisolone 8 mg by Csc CSC I0318
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylprednisolone is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and control overactive immune reactions in conditions such as severe allergies, asthma-related inflammation, arthritis, and some autoimmune disorders. It should be used only for the condition and duration prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and suppresses excessive immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with food to reduce stomach upset. Do not change the dose or stop treatment suddenly unless advised by a doctor, especially after prolonged use.

Common side effects
Indigestion, increased appetite, mood changes, difficulty sleeping, headache, fluid retention, and increased blood sugar may occur. The risk of side effects is higher with higher doses or longer treatment.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental-health conditions, eye problems, or any infection. Methylprednisolone can reduce resistance to infection and may mask infection symptoms. Avoid contact with people who have contagious infections and consult a doctor before receiving vaccines. Seek medical advice if signs of infection, severe mood changes, vision problems, or unusual swelling occur.

title: Stress Nil Capsules (1x30) Relieves Stress & Anxiety by Csc
name: Stress Nil Capsules (1x30) Relieves Stress & Anxiety by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help relieve stress and anxiety.

How does it work?
The way it works depends on the active ingredient or ingredients, which are not provided here.

How to take/use it
Use only according to the product label or advice from a doctor or pharmacist. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Product-specific side effects cannot be determined from the information provided. Check the product label.

Precautions
Check the ingredients and product warnings before use. Seek medical advice if stress or anxiety is severe, persistent, or affects daily life. Product-specific precautions cannot be determined from the information provided.

title: Sucralfiz-O (200ml) Sucralfate 1 g, Oxetacaine 20 mg by Csc
name: Sucralfiz-O (200ml) Sucralfate 1 g, Oxetacaine 20 mg by Csc
searchText: Sucralfiz-O (200ml) Sucralfate 1 g, Oxetacaine 20 mg by Csc CSC I0669
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve pain and discomfort caused by acid-related stomach problems such as gastritis, peptic ulcers and heartburn. It helps protect irritated areas in the stomach and food pipe.

How does it work?
Sucralfate forms a protective coating over irritated or ulcerated tissue, shielding it from stomach acid. Oxetacaine is a local anaesthetic that helps reduce pain in the affected area.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as prescribed by the doctor. If it is a liquid, shake the bottle well before use. Take other medicines at a different time as advised, because sucralfate can reduce their absorption.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, dry mouth and stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, difficulty swallowing, or a history of bowel blockage. Take medical advice during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist, worsen, or there is vomiting blood or black stools.

title: Tacroness Forte (10 gm ) Tacrolimus 1 mg by Csc
name: Tacroness Forte (10 gm ) Tacrolimus 1 mg by Csc
searchText: Tacroness Forte (10 gm ) Tacrolimus 1 mg by Csc CSC I0880
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Tacrolimus 1 mg is mainly used after an organ transplant to help prevent the body from rejecting the transplanted organ. It is prescribed and monitored by a specialist.

How does it work?
It suppresses certain immune system reactions that can attack a transplanted organ.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed by the transplant specialist, at the same time each day. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice unless the doctor advises otherwise. Regular blood tests are needed to check tacrolimus levels, kidney function and other effects.

Common side effects
Trembling, headache, diarrhoea, nausea, high blood pressure, increased blood sugar and kidney problems. It can also increase the risk of infections.

Precautions
Tacrolimus can interact with many medicines, including some antibiotics, antifungals and herbal products. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken. Seek medical advice for fever, sore throat, unusual bruising, reduced urine, severe headache or confusion. Avoid close contact with people who have infections and do not receive vaccines without medical advice.

title: Taggrel 90 (10x1x14) Ticagrelor 90 mg by Csc
name: Taggrel 90 (10x1x14) Ticagrelor 90 mg by Csc
searchText: Taggrel 90 (10x1x14) Ticagrelor 90 mg by Csc CSC I0929
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ticagrelor is used to reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke and other serious problems caused by blood clots in people with acute coronary syndrome or after certain heart procedures such as coronary stent placement. It is usually used with another antiplatelet medicine as prescribed.

How does it work?
It prevents platelets in the blood from sticking together and forming harmful clots.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Do not stop it suddenly unless the prescribing doctor advises this, especially after a stent. If a dose is missed, follow the doctor’s or pharmacist’s instructions rather than taking extra medicine.

Common side effects
Bleeding or bruising, shortness of breath, headache, dizziness, nausea and diarrhoea.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any unusual or prolonged bleeding, black stools, vomiting blood or severe headache. Inform the doctor before surgery or dental treatment. Use with caution if there is a history of bleeding, stomach ulcer, stroke, liver disease or breathing problems. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, as some medicines can increase bleeding or affect ticagrelor. Seek urgent medical help for severe bleeding or serious breathing difficulty.

title: Tamsulag -D (10x15) Tamsulosin 0.4 mg SR, Dutasteride 0.5 mg by Csc
name: Tamsulag -D (10x15) Tamsulosin 0.4 mg SR, Dutasteride 0.5 mg by Csc
searchText: Tamsulag -D (10x15) Tamsulosin 0.4 mg SR, Dutasteride 0.5 mg by Csc CSC I0019
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat symptoms of an enlarged prostate (benign prostatic hyperplasia, or BPH) in adult men. It can help with difficulty starting urination, weak urine flow, frequent urination and the urgent need to urinate.

How does it work?
Tamsulosin relaxes the muscles around the prostate and bladder outlet, making it easier to pass urine. Dutasteride lowers the hormone that contributes to prostate enlargement and may gradually reduce prostate size.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the modified-release medicine whole with water; do not crush, chew or open it unless specifically instructed. Take it regularly and do not stop without medical advice.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, reduced sexual desire, difficulty getting or maintaining an erection, ejaculation problems, breast tenderness or enlargement, and stomach upset may occur.

Precautions
This medicine may cause dizziness or a drop in blood pressure when standing up, especially when starting treatment; rise slowly and be careful while driving. Tell the doctor about liver disease, low blood pressure, or any previous allergy to similar medicines. Inform the eye surgeon before cataract or glaucoma surgery. Dutasteride can affect PSA blood test results, so tell the doctor that this medicine is being used. Pregnant women should not handle leaking or damaged tablets/capsules. This medicine is not intended for women or children.

title: Techrax (20x15) Hydroxyzine 25 mg Tab by Csc
name: Techrax (20x15) Hydroxyzine 25 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Techrax (20x15) Hydroxyzine 25 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0177
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Hydroxyzine is used for short-term relief of anxiety and tension, and to relieve itching caused by allergies or certain skin conditions. It may also be used for its sedating effect before some medical procedures.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergic itching and symptoms. It also reduces activity in the brain, which can produce a calming and drowsy effect.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Swallow the tablet with water and do not take more or more often than directed. Avoid driving or operating machinery until its effect is known.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, headache, constipation and difficulty passing urine may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that cause drowsiness unless approved by a doctor. Use medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or prostate enlargement, heart rhythm problems, or liver or kidney disease. Older adults may be more sensitive to its sedating effects. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek urgent help for fainting, a fast or irregular heartbeat, severe breathing difficulty or a serious allergic reaction.

title: Telmifit 40 (10x10) Telmisartan 40 mg by Csc
name: Telmifit 40 (10x10) Telmisartan 40 mg by Csc
searchText: Telmifit 40 (10x10) Telmisartan 40 mg by Csc CSC I0178
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Telmisartan 40 mg is mainly used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). It may also be prescribed to help reduce the risk of certain heart and blood-vessel problems in selected high-risk adults.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of a hormone called angiotensin II, which normally narrows blood vessels and raises blood pressure. This helps relax the blood vessels and lower blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, usually at the same time each day, with or without food. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not stop treatment without medical advice, even if feeling well.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, low blood pressure, tiredness, diarrhoea, and back pain may occur. Contact a doctor if side effects are severe or persistent.

Precautions
Do not use during pregnancy; inform the doctor immediately if pregnancy occurs. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, dehydration, or high potassium levels. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially lithium, diuretics, or painkillers such as ibuprofen. Rise slowly if dizziness occurs.

title: Telmifit AM (5x3x10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Amlodipine 5 mg by Csc
name: Telmifit AM (5x3x10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Amlodipine 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Telmifit AM (5x3x10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Amlodipine 5 mg by Csc CSC I0179
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). It may be prescribed when one medicine alone does not control blood pressure adequately.

How does it work?
Telmisartan relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of a hormone that causes blood vessels to tighten. Amlodipine also relaxes and widens blood vessels, helping blood flow more easily and lowering blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day, and swallow with water. It may be taken with or without food. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, flushing, tiredness, ankle or leg swelling, palpitations, and low blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
May cause dizziness, especially when starting treatment or standing up quickly. Inform the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, heart problems, or high potassium levels. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised. Do not use during pregnancy; inform the doctor immediately if pregnancy occurs. Tell the doctor about all other medicines, especially blood-pressure medicines, diuretics, painkillers such as ibuprofen, and lithium.

title: Telminess AM-H40 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg, Amlodipine 5 mg by Csc
name: Telminess AM-H40 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg, Amlodipine 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Telminess AM-H40 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg, Amlodipine 5 mg by Csc CSC I0471
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension), especially when blood pressure is not adequately controlled with one or two medicines. Controlling blood pressure helps reduce the risk of serious heart and blood vessel problems.

How does it work?
Telmisartan and amlodipine relax and widen blood vessels. Hydrochlorothiazide helps the kidneys remove extra salt and water, which lowers blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, usually at the same time each day, with or without food. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not stop treatment or change the dose without medical advice.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, tiredness, ankle or leg swelling, increased urination, nausea, and stomach upset. Changes in blood salts or kidney function may also occur.

Precautions
May cause dizziness, especially when starting treatment or when standing up; rise slowly and avoid driving if affected. Medical advice is important if there is kidney or liver disease, dehydration, gout, diabetes, or an imbalance of body salts. Blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolytes may need monitoring. Do not use during pregnancy; inform the doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, including potassium supplements or salt substitutes.

title: Telminess Beta 50 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Metoprolol Succinate 50 mg SR by Csc
name: Telminess Beta 50 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Metoprolol Succinate 50 mg SR by Csc
searchText: Telminess Beta 50 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Metoprolol Succinate 50 mg SR by Csc CSC I0750
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) when treatment with both telmisartan and metoprolol is needed.

How does it work?
Telmisartan relaxes and widens blood vessels, while metoprolol slows the heart rate and reduces the heart's workload. Together, they help lower blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor and at the same time each day. Swallow the sustained-release tablet whole; do not crush or chew it. Do not stop taking it suddenly without medical advice.

Common side effects
Dizziness, tiredness, headache, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, and stomach upset may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is asthma or breathing difficulty, a slow heartbeat, heart conduction problems, diabetes, kidney or liver disease, or high potassium levels. Telmisartan should not be used during pregnancy. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised by a doctor. Dizziness may occur, especially when standing up; rise slowly and avoid driving if affected.

title: Telminess CHM 50/12.5 (10x1x10) Metoprolol Tartrate 50 mg, Chlorthalidone 12.5 mg, Telmisartan 40 mg by Csc
name: Telminess CHM 50/12.5 (10x1x10) Metoprolol Tartrate 50 mg, Chlorthalidone 12.5 mg, Telmisartan 40 mg by Csc
searchText: Telminess CHM 50/12.5 (10x1x10) Metoprolol Tartrate 50 mg, Chlorthalidone 12.5 mg, Telmisartan 40 mg by Csc CSC I0844
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination medicine is used to lower high blood pressure (hypertension) and help reduce the risk of related heart and blood vessel problems. It combines three blood-pressure medicines and is generally used when more than one medicine is needed.

How does it work?
Telmisartan relaxes blood vessels, chlorthalidone helps remove extra salt and water through urine, and metoprolol slows the heart rate and reduces the heart's workload. Together, they help lower blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day, with or without food. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not stop it suddenly, especially because it contains metoprolol. If a dose is missed, follow the prescriber's instructions rather than taking extra medicine.

Common side effects
Dizziness, tiredness, headache, slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, increased urination, nausea, and changes in blood salt levels may occur.

Precautions
Regular monitoring of blood pressure, pulse, kidney function, and electrolytes may be needed. Rise slowly if dizziness occurs and maintain adequate fluids unless fluid restriction has been advised. Tell the doctor about diabetes, asthma or breathing problems, kidney or liver disease, gout, or a slow heartbeat. This medicine should not be used during pregnancy; inform the doctor immediately if pregnancy occurs. Do not stop treatment suddenly without medical advice.

title: Telminess CL 40 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Cilnidipine 10 mg Tab by Csc
name: Telminess CL 40 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Cilnidipine 10 mg Tab by Csc
searchText: Telminess CL 40 (10X3X10) Telmisartan 40 mg, Cilnidipine 10 mg Tab by Csc CSC I0747
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). Controlling blood pressure helps reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke and other complications.

How does it work?
Telmisartan relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of a substance that causes them to tighten. Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessel walls through calcium-channel blocking, helping blood flow more easily and lowering blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take this medicine exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not stop it suddenly or change the dose without medical advice.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, flushing, ankle or foot swelling, palpitations and tiredness may occur. Contact a doctor if side effects are severe or persistent.

Precautions
May cause dizziness, especially when standing up; rise slowly and avoid driving until the effect is known. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, dehydration, low blood pressure, or high potassium levels. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised. Do not use during pregnancy; inform the doctor if pregnant or planning pregnancy. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially other blood-pressure medicines and anti-inflammatory painkillers.

Telmisartan relaxes and widens blood vessels, while chlorthalidone helps the kidneys remove extra salt and water. Together, they lower blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day, with or without food. Swallow with water. Do not stop treatment or take an extra dose without medical advice. If a dose is missed, follow the instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Dizziness, light-headedness, increased urination, headache, nausea, tiredness, and changes in blood salts such as low sodium or potassium may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision during pregnancy; telmisartan can seriously harm an unborn baby. Inform the doctor about kidney or liver disease, dehydration, low blood pressure, diabetes, high uric acid or gout, or electrolyte problems. Regular blood pressure, kidney-function and blood-salt checks may be needed. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised. Rise slowly if dizzy and seek medical help for fainting, severe weakness, swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day. It may be taken with or without food. Do not stop it or change the dose without medical advice. Because it may increase urination, avoid taking it close to bedtime unless advised otherwise.

Dizziness, headache, tiredness, increased urination, nausea, diarrhoea, and changes in blood salt or potassium levels may occur. Dizziness may be more noticeable when standing up.

Precautions

Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water and take it at the same time each day. Do not stop it or change the dose without medical advice. Since it may increase urination, follow the timing advised by the doctor.

Dizziness, headache, tiredness, ankle or leg swelling, increased urination, and stomach upset may occur. Low blood pressure, dehydration, or changes in blood sodium or potassium can also occur.

Teneligliptin is used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes. It is not used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis.

How does it work?
It belongs to a group of medicines called DPP-4 inhibitors. It helps the body release more insulin after meals and reduce the amount of glucose produced by the liver, helping lower blood sugar.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed. It may generally be taken with or without food. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. If a dose is missed, take it when remembered unless it is nearly time for the next dose; do not take an extra dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and cold-like symptoms may occur. Low blood sugar is more likely when used with insulin or sulfonylurea medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, a history of pancreatitis, heart failure, or allergies to diabetes medicines. Seek medical help for severe or persistent stomach pain, swelling of the face or breathing difficulty, or a severe blistering skin rash. Pregnancy and breastfeeding require medical advice. Monitor blood sugar regularly as advised.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to protect exposed skin from the sun’s ultraviolet (UV) rays and help prevent sunburn and sun-related skin damage.

How does it work?
It forms a protective layer on the skin and contains sunscreen protection that helps reduce the amount of UV radiation reaching the skin.

How to take/use it
Apply evenly and generously to all exposed skin before sun exposure. Reapply after swimming, sweating or towelling, and follow the product label instructions. Sunscreen does not replace protective clothing, shade or avoiding strong midday sun.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or a stinging sensation may occur. Eye irritation can occur if the product gets into the eyes.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes and broken or irritated skin. Stop use if a rash or significant irritation develops. Keep out of reach of children and follow the product label instructions.

title: Tynzolac (100ml) Lactulose 10 g by Csc
name: Tynzolac (100ml) Lactulose 10 g by Csc
searchText: Tynzolac (100ml) Lactulose 10 g by Csc CSC I0018
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Lactulose is mainly used to relieve constipation by making stools softer and easier to pass. It may also be prescribed under medical supervision to help reduce high ammonia levels in people with certain liver conditions.

How does it work?
It draws water into the bowel, softening the stool and helping bowel movements. Gut bacteria break it down into substances that stimulate bowel movement.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Measure the liquid carefully using a proper measuring device. It may be taken alone or mixed with water or another suitable drink. Drink enough fluids unless fluid restriction has been advised.

Common side effects
Gas, bloating, stomach cramps, nausea and diarrhoea. These effects may be more likely if too much is taken.

Precautions
Do not use it without medical advice if there is severe or unexplained abdominal pain, suspected bowel blockage, or vomiting. Prolonged or severe diarrhoea can cause dehydration and electrolyte imbalance. People with diabetes or those following a low-sugar diet should ask a doctor or pharmacist before use, as some formulations contain sugars. Seek medical advice if constipation persists or worsens.

title: Udiness-150 (5x3x15) Ursodeoxycholic Acid 150 mg by Csc
name: Udiness-150 (5x3x15) Ursodeoxycholic Acid 150 mg by Csc
searchText: Udiness-150 (5x3x15) Ursodeoxycholic Acid 150 mg by Csc CSC I0740
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ursodeoxycholic acid is used for certain liver and bile-flow disorders. In selected patients, it is also used to dissolve cholesterol gallstones and help prevent some gallstones.

How does it work?
It makes bile less likely to form cholesterol deposits and helps improve the flow of bile. This may reduce the harmful effects of bile acids on liver cells.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow the medicine with water. It is usually taken with food; follow the instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist. Do not stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, loose stools, abdominal discomfort, nausea and vomiting. Itching or worsening of existing itching may also occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision, as liver function and the condition of the gallbladder or bile ducts may need monitoring. Tell the doctor about gallbladder inflammation, bile-duct blockage, severe liver disease or frequent abdominal pain. Antacids containing aluminium and some cholesterol-binding medicines can reduce its absorption, so ask about suitable spacing between medicines.

title: Udiness-300 (5x3x15) Ursodeoxycholic Acid 300 mg by Csc
name: Udiness-300 (5x3x15) Ursodeoxycholic Acid 300 mg by Csc
searchText: Udiness-300 (5x3x15) Ursodeoxycholic Acid 300 mg by Csc CSC I0741
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ursodeoxycholic acid is used under medical supervision to treat certain chronic liver and bile-flow conditions, including primary biliary cholangitis. It may also be used to dissolve certain small cholesterol gallstones when surgery is not suitable.

How does it work?
It improves the flow and composition of bile, helping reduce cholesterol buildup in bile. This can help protect liver cells and dissolve some cholesterol gallstones.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow the tablet with water. The dose and treatment duration depend on the condition being treated. Regular liver tests or scans may be needed during treatment.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea or loose stools, abdominal discomfort, nausea and indigestion. Itching may occur, especially in people being treated for liver disease.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision. Tell the doctor about liver disease, blockage of the bile ducts, gallbladder inflammation or other gallbladder problems. It is not suitable for all types of gallstones. Antacids containing aluminium and some cholesterol-lowering medicines may reduce its absorption, so they may need to be taken separately. Seek medical advice if diarrhoea is severe or persistent, or if jaundice or worsening abdominal pain occurs.

title: Unkold Ace (30x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Cetirizine 10 mg, Caffeine 25 mg by Csc
name: Unkold Ace (30x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Cetirizine 10 mg, Caffeine 25 mg by Csc
searchText: Unkold Ace (30x10) Aceclofenac 100 mg, Paracetamol 325 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Cetirizine 10 mg, Caffeine 25 mg by Csc CSC I0932
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of common cold symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, headache, fever, body aches and other mild pain.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac and paracetamol help reduce pain and fever. Phenylephrine relieves nasal blockage, while cetirizine reduces allergy symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose; caffeine may enhance pain relief and help reduce drowsiness.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed or directed on the pack. Swallow with water, preferably after food. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Avoid taking other medicines containing paracetamol, aceclofenac or similar painkillers unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, difficulty sleeping, palpitations or increased blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery, as dizziness or drowsiness may occur. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver or kidney disease, stomach ulcer, asthma triggered by painkillers, or pregnancy or breastfeeding. Do not use with other cold, pain or allergy medicines without checking with a healthcare professional. Stop and seek help for severe stomach pain, allergic reactions, breathing difficulty or black stools.

title: Unkold AM (20x10) Paracetamol 325 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Guaifenesin 50 mg, Ambroxol 15 mg, Cetirizine 5 mg by Csc
name: Unkold AM (20x10) Paracetamol 325 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Guaifenesin 50 mg, Ambroxol 15 mg, Cetirizine 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Unkold AM (20x10) Paracetamol 325 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Guaifenesin 50 mg, Ambroxol 15 mg, Cetirizine 5 mg by Csc CSC I0577
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used for temporary relief of common cold and upper respiratory symptoms such as cough with mucus, blocked or runny nose, sneezing, fever and body aches. It helps relieve symptoms but does not cure the underlying infection.

How does it work?
Paracetamol reduces fever and pain. Phenylephrine helps reduce nasal blockage, while cetirizine helps relieve allergy-related sneezing and runny nose. Guaifenesin helps loosen mucus, and ambroxol helps make phlegm thinner and easier to clear.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Do not combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol or cough-and-cold ingredients unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, stomach upset, headache or restlessness may occur. Phenylephrine may rarely cause a fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Avoid driving or operating machinery if drowsy or dizzy, and avoid alcohol. Ask a doctor before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, or prostate problems. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Consult a doctor if symptoms are severe, worsen, last longer than expected, or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Unkold D (4x5x10) Paracetamol 500 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Diphenhydramine 25 mg, Caffeine 30 mg by Csc
name: Unkold D (4x5x10) Paracetamol 500 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Diphenhydramine 25 mg, Caffeine 30 mg by Csc
searchText: Unkold D (4x5x10) Paracetamol 500 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Diphenhydramine 25 mg, Caffeine 30 mg by Csc CSC I0190
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of common cold and flu symptoms such as fever, headache, body aches, blocked or runny nose, sneezing and watery eyes.

How does it work?
Paracetamol reduces fever and pain. Phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion, while diphenhydramine reduces allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose; caffeine may support the pain-relieving effect.

How to take/use it
Follow the dose and frequency stated on the product label or prescribed by a healthcare professional. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol, diphenhydramine, phenylephrine or similar cold-medicine ingredients. Do not exceed the recommended dose.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, restlessness, difficulty sleeping, headache, fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving, operating machinery and alcohol. Seek medical advice before use if there is liver disease, high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, prostate or urinary problems. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice. Avoid taking other paracetamol-containing products, and seek advice if symptoms are severe, worsen or do not improve.

title: Unkold DS Plus (60ml) Paracetamol 250 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg Susp by Csc
name: Unkold DS Plus (60ml) Paracetamol 250 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg Susp by Csc
searchText: Unkold DS Plus (60ml) Paracetamol 250 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg Susp by Csc CSC I0548
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold symptoms such as fever, body ache, runny nose, sneezing and blocked nose.

How does it work?
Paracetamol reduces fever and pain. Chlorpheniramine helps reduce sneezing and runny nose, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Shake the suspension well before use. Measure it with the supplied measuring device and use only the dose advised on the label or by a doctor. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol, chlorpheniramine or decongestants.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, headache, nervousness or fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving or activities requiring alertness. Seek medical advice before use in children, or in people with high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, thyroid problems or difficulty passing urine. Avoid alcohol. Do not exceed the recommended dose.

title: Unkold Inhaler (5 ml ) Camphor 42%, Menthol 40.5%, Methyl Salicylate 12%, Gandhabiroja Oil 3.5%, Cajuput Oil 1%, Nutmeg Oil 0.5%, Eucalyptus Oil 0.5% Inhaler by Csc
name: Unkold Inhaler (5 ml ) Camphor 42%, Menthol 40.5%, Methyl Salicylate 12%, Gandhabiroja Oil 3.5%, Cajuput Oil 1%, Nutmeg Oil 0.5%, Eucalyptus Oil 0.5% Inhaler by Csc
searchText: Unkold Inhaler (5 ml ) Camphor 42%, Menthol 40.5%, Methyl Salicylate 12%, Gandhabiroja Oil 3.5%, Cajuput Oil 1%, Nutmeg Oil 0.5%, Eucalyptus Oil 0.5% Inhaler by Csc CSC I0535
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used externally for temporary relief of minor muscle and joint aches, stiffness, sprains and strains.

How does it work?
Camphor, menthol and the aromatic oils produce a cooling or warming sensation that helps relieve the feeling of minor muscle and joint pain.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a small amount to the affected area and gently massage, following the product label instructions. Do not apply to broken, irritated or infected skin.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, redness, itching or skin irritation may occur.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not swallow or use with a heating pad, tight bandage or on large areas of the body. Wash hands after use and keep out of reach of children. Stop use if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

name: Unkold N Flu Ultra (20x10) Paracetamol 500 mg, Phenylephrine 12.5 mg, Caffeine 30 mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 mg by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used for temporary relief of common cold and flu symptoms such as fever, headache, body aches, blocked or runny nose, sneezing and nasal congestion.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce fever and pain. The decongestant helps clear a blocked nose, chlorpheniramine reduces sneezing and runny nose, and caffeine may support the pain-relieving effect.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or similar cold ingredients. Swallow with water.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, headache, nervousness, difficulty sleeping, increased heartbeat or increased blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Avoid driving or operating machinery if drowsy or dizzy, and avoid alcohol. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, difficulty passing urine, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Do not exceed the recommended amount of paracetamol.

title: Unkold Plus (20x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Levocetirizine 5 mg by Csc
name: Unkold Plus (20x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Levocetirizine 5 mg by Csc
searchText: Unkold Plus (20x10) Nimesulide 100 mg, Phenylephrine 5 mg, Levocetirizine 5 mg by Csc CSC I0259
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of cold and allergy-related symptoms such as blocked or runny nose, sneezing, fever, headache and body aches. It does not treat the underlying infection.

How does it work?
Nimesulide helps reduce pain, fever and inflammation. Phenylephrine relieves nasal blockage, while levocetirizine reduces allergy symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, preferably after food, and do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Avoid combining it with other painkillers, cold medicines or antihistamines unless advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, indigestion, dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness, headache or palpitations may occur.

Precautions
Avoid use or seek medical advice if there is liver disease, stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney disease, high blood pressure or heart disease. Avoid alcohol and driving if drowsy or dizzy. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or in children. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for severe skin reactions, breathing difficulty, unusual bleeding or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Uptitude Charcoal Facewash (100 gm) Charcoal Facewash by Csc
name: Uptitude Charcoal Facewash (100 gm) Charcoal Facewash by Csc
searchText: Uptitude Charcoal Facewash (100 gm) Charcoal Facewash by Csc CSC I0793
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Men’s charcoal face wash is used to cleanse the face by removing dirt, excess oil and surface impurities. It may be suitable for oily or combination skin, depending on the product formulation.

How does it work?
Cleansing ingredients help lift dirt and oil from the skin so they can be rinsed away. Charcoal may help absorb some surface impurities.

How to take/use it
Wet the face, apply a small amount, gently massage, and rinse thoroughly. Use only as directed on the product label and avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Skin dryness, tightness, mild irritation or redness may occur, especially on sensitive skin. Allergic reactions are uncommon but possible.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes and broken or irritated skin. Stop use if significant irritation, swelling or rash develops. Seek medical advice if the reaction persists.

title: Uptitude Charcoal Facewash (60g) Charcoal Facewash by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Men Charcoal Facewash is used to cleanse facial skin by removing dirt, sweat and excess oil, leaving the skin feeling fresh.

How does it work?
Cleansing ingredients loosen and wash away surface impurities and oil. Charcoal may help absorb some surface oil and impurities, depending on the formulation.

How to take/use it
Wet the face, apply a small amount, gently massage, and rinse thoroughly. Use as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Dryness, tightness, redness or mild skin irritation may occur, especially on sensitive skin.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid the eyes and broken or irritated skin. Stop use if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Patch testing is advisable for sensitive skin.

title: Vagatone + (10x1x10) Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg by Csc
name: Vagatone + (10x1x10) Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg by Csc
searchText: Vagatone + (10x1x10) Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg, Pyridoxine 3 mg, Folic Acid 1.5 mg by Csc CSC I0197
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help manage vitamin B12, B6 and folate deficiency and to support nerve health. It is commonly used as part of treatment for nerve-related symptoms such as tingling, numbness or burning sensations in peripheral neuropathy.

How does it work?
Methylcobalamin, pyridoxine and folic acid support normal nerve function and blood-cell formation. Alpha lipoic acid has antioxidant properties and may help protect nerves from oxidative stress.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Swallow with water and do not exceed the recommended amount. Do not use it for longer than advised without medical guidance.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, diarrhoea, headache or skin rash may occur. Alpha lipoic acid may sometimes lower blood sugar.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about any allergy to its ingredients, diabetes, pregnancy or breastfeeding. People taking diabetes medicines should monitor blood sugar carefully. Consult a doctor before use with levodopa or other long-term medicines. Seek medical advice if numbness, weakness or pain worsens or does not improve.

title: Vagatone Plus (Amp. ) Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Pyridoxine 100 mg, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Benzyl Alcohol 2% v/v by Csc
name: Vagatone Plus (Amp. ) Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg, Pyridoxine 100 mg, Nicotinamide 100 mg, Benzyl Alcohol 2% v/v by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to prevent or treat deficiencies of vitamin B12, vitamin B6 and nicotinamide (vitamin B3). It may be prescribed to support red blood cell production and nerve function, including in some vitamin-related nerve problems.

How does it work?
It replenishes important B vitamins needed for energy metabolism, healthy blood cells and normal nerve function.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. If this is the injectable product, it should be administered by a healthcare professional; do not self-inject. The dose and treatment duration depend on the medical condition and should be decided by the prescriber.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site, nausea, headache, skin rash or itching may occur. Seek urgent medical help for swelling of the face or breathing difficulty.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about any allergy to these ingredients or previous reactions to injections. Prolonged or repeated use of high-dose vitamin B6 can cause nerve problems, so use it only under medical supervision. Products containing benzyl alcohol should not be used in newborns or young infants unless specifically advised. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should seek medical advice before use.

title: Velo E 50 g Jar (50 gm) Vitamin E, Aloe Vera Cream by Csc

What is it used for?
Vitamin E cream with aloe vera is used to moisturise and soothe dry, rough or mildly irritated skin.

How does it work?
It helps soften the skin and reduce moisture loss. Aloe vera may provide a soothing effect, while vitamin E helps support the skin barrier.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. For external use only.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, itching or skin irritation may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes and do not apply to deep wounds or severely damaged skin. Test on a small area first if the skin is sensitive. Stop use if irritation or an allergic reaction develops. Seek medical advice if symptoms are severe or persistent.

What is it used for?
Vitamin E cream with aloe vera is used to moisturise and soften dry, rough skin and help soothe minor dryness-related irritation.

How does it work?
It forms a moisturising layer that helps reduce water loss from the skin. Vitamin E and aloe vera may help support and soothe the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not apply to broken or infected skin unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Mild burning, redness, itching or skin irritation may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Stop use if a rash or significant irritation develops. Keep away from the eyes and out of reach of children. Seek medical advice if skin symptoms are severe, persistent or worsening.

title: Velo E Omega (10x1x10) Vitamin E, Wheat Germ Oil, Omega 3 Fatty Acids Softgel Cap by Csc

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement provides vitamin E, wheat germ oil and omega-3 fatty acids to help supplement the diet when nutritional intake is inadequate. It is a nutritional supplement and is not intended to treat a specific disease unless advised by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant, while omega-3 fatty acids provide essential fats needed for normal body functions. Wheat germ oil is a source of vitamin E and other dietary fats.

How to take/use it
Take the softgel as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow it whole with food. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
May cause nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort, loose stools or a fishy aftertaste. Stop use and seek medical advice if signs of an allergic reaction occur.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use if taking blood thinners, having a bleeding disorder, or before surgery, as vitamin E and omega-3 supplements may increase bleeding risk. Seek advice during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Avoid it if allergic to wheat or any ingredient. Tell the healthcare professional about other vitamin or omega-3 supplements being used.

Vitamin E with aloe vera moisturising soap is used to cleanse the skin while helping it feel soft and moisturised. It may be suitable for normal to dry skin.

How does it work?
The soap removes dirt, sweat and excess oil from the skin. Aloe vera and vitamin E help support the skin’s moisture and softness.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Wet the skin, apply the soap to form a lather, rinse thoroughly and dry gently. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Some people may experience skin dryness, irritation, redness or an allergic reaction.

Precautions
Avoid using it on broken or severely irritated skin. Stop using it if a rash, burning or persistent irritation develops. Keep out of the eyes; rinse well with clean water if contact occurs.

What is it used for?
May help soften rough, thickened or dry skin. Confirm the intended application area from the product label.

How does it work?
Urea helps soften and hydrate the outer skin layer. Lactic acid helps loosen accumulated dead skin cells.

How to take/use it
Apply only to the intended area according to the product instructions. Avoid broken or irritated skin unless directed by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Burning, stinging, redness or irritation may occur.

Precautions
Avoid the eyes and mucous membranes. Stop if significant irritation develops. Seek professional advice before use on sensitive skin or on diabetes-related foot problems.

title: Vildatech M 500 (5x2x15) Vildagliptin 50 mg, Metformin 500 mg by Csc
name: Vildatech M 500 (5x2x15) Vildagliptin 50 mg, Metformin 500 mg by Csc
searchText: Vildatech M 500 (5x2x15) Vildagliptin 50 mg, Metformin 500 mg by Csc CSC I0299
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes. It is not used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis.

How does it work?
Vildagliptin helps the body release more insulin when blood sugar is high and reduces the release of hormones that raise blood sugar. Metformin reduces glucose production by the liver and helps the body use insulin more effectively.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually with or after food to reduce stomach upset. Swallow with water and do not crush or chew unless advised. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain or discomfort, vomiting, headache, dizziness and reduced appetite. Low blood sugar may occur, especially when used with insulin or certain other diabetes medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, heart failure, heavy alcohol use, or a history of pancreatitis. Kidney function may need to be checked during treatment. Seek medical help for severe or persistent abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, unusual weakness, breathing difficulty or extreme sleepiness. Avoid excessive alcohol. Inform the doctor before surgery or an X-ray scan using an iodinated contrast dye.

title: Viniferine 2% Skin Brightening Cream (25 gm ) Yuzu 0.5%, Niacinamide 2%, Nano Resveratrol and Vitamin C Complex 0.5% Cream by Csc

What is it used for?
This skin-care formulation is used to support a brighter, more even-looking complexion and overall skin conditioning. It may be helpful for the appearance of dull or uneven skin tone.

How does it work?
Niacinamide helps support the skin barrier and improve the appearance of uneven skin tone. Vitamin C and resveratrol provide antioxidant activity that helps protect skin from oxidative stress.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes. Do not use more often than recommended.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, redness, dryness or irritation may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Patch-test before regular use. Stop using if significant irritation or an allergic reaction develops. Avoid applying to broken or inflamed skin and keep away from the eyes. Use sunscreen during the day when using products intended to improve uneven skin tone.

title: Vitamin B5 10% Moisturizer (50 gm) Collagen 1%, Hydrofence 1%, Lactobionic Acid 0.5% by Csc
name: Vitamin B5 10% Moisturizer (50 gm) Collagen 1%, Hydrofence 1%, Lactobionic Acid 0.5% by Csc
searchText: Vitamin B5 10% Moisturizer (50 gm) Collagen 1%, Hydrofence 1%, Lactobionic Acid 0.5% by Csc CSC I0379
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This topical skincare formulation is used to help moisturise, soften and condition dry or dehydrated skin. It may also support a smoother-looking skin surface.

How does it work?

It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and multiply.

It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from forming their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably after food, and swallow the tablet with water. Complete the prescribed course even if symptoms improve. Do not share antibiotics or use leftover medicine.

Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, headache and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to cefuroxime, cephalosporins or other penicillin-type antibiotics, unless specifically advised by a doctor. What is it used for?
Sodium valproate and valproic acid controlled-release tablets are used mainly to control seizures in epilepsy. They may also be prescribed for bipolar disorder or to help prevent migraines, depending on the doctor's advice.

How does it work?
It increases the activity of calming signals in the brain and helps reduce abnormal electrical activity that can cause seizures.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and at the same time each day. Swallow the controlled-release tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not stop taking it suddenly, as this may trigger seizures.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, sleepiness, dizziness, tremor, increased appetite, weight gain and hair thinning may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, pancreatic problems, bleeding or blood disorders, or kidney problems. Valproate can seriously harm an unborn baby and may affect a child's development; it should generally be avoided during pregnancy unless specifically advised by a specialist. Women who could become pregnant should discuss effective contraception and pregnancy planning with their doctor. Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving until its effects are known. Seek urgent medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, severe or persistent abdominal pain, unusual bruising or bleeding, severe weakness, or thoughts of self-harm.

Betahistine is used to help relieve vertigo (a spinning or dizzy sensation), especially vertigo associated with Ménière’s disease. It may also help reduce related symptoms such as ringing in the ears and hearing difficulty.

Betahistine acts on histamine receptors and may improve blood flow in the inner ear, helping to reduce pressure and balance-related symptoms. Its exact action is not fully understood.

Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow the tablet with water. Taking it with or after food may help reduce stomach upset. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort, headache and bloating may occur. These are often less troublesome when taken with food.
