Shakiness, nervousness, headache, fast heartbeat or palpitations, dry mouth, throat irritation and cough.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, glaucoma, prostate or urinary problems, diabetes, thyroid disease, or a history of medicine allergies. Avoid getting the medicine into the eyes. Seek medical help if severe eye pain, blurred vision, difficulty passing urine, allergic reactions or worsening breathing occurs.

title: Duoler Respoules (6X2Ml) Ipratropium 500 Mcg, Levosalbutamol 1.25 Mg Nebuliser Solution By Elder
name: Duoler Respoules (6X2Ml) Ipratropium 500 Mcg, Levosalbutamol 1.25 Mg Nebuliser Solution By Elder
searchText: Duoler Respoules (6X2Ml) Ipratropium 500 Mcg, Levosalbutamol 1.25 Mg Nebuliser Solution By Elder Elder I4305
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This nebuliser solution helps relieve bronchospasm, wheezing and breathing difficulty in conditions such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It relaxes narrowed airway muscles to make breathing easier.

How does it work?
Levosalbutamol and ipratropium are bronchodilators. They relax the muscles around the airways through different actions, helping open the air passages.

How to take/use it
Use only by nebulisation and exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Follow the nebuliser device instructions carefully. Do not swallow or inject the solution, and do not change the dose or frequency without medical advice.

Common side effects
Trembling, nervousness, headache, dry mouth, throat irritation, cough, dizziness, nausea and fast or pounding heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart disease, high blood pressure, glaucoma, thyroid problems, diabetes or difficulty passing urine, including prostate problems. Avoid getting the mist in the eyes. Seek urgent medical help for severe or worsening breathing difficulty, chest pain, a very fast or irregular heartbeat, swelling or an allergic reaction. If breathing suddenly worsens after use, stop and seek medical advice immediately.

title: Dutader 0.5 Tabs (20X10) Dutasteride 0.5 Mg Tab By Elder
name: Dutader 0.5 Tabs (20X10) Dutasteride 0.5 Mg Tab By Elder
searchText: Dutader 0.5 Tabs (20X10) Dutasteride 0.5 Mg Tab By Elder Elder I1575
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dutasteride is used to treat an enlarged prostate (benign prostatic hyperplasia, or BPH). It can help improve urinary symptoms such as difficulty starting urination, weak urine flow and frequent or urgent urination, and may reduce the risk of urinary retention.

How does it work?
It blocks an enzyme that converts testosterone into dihydrotestosterone (DHT). Lower DHT levels help shrink the enlarged prostate and improve urine flow.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Swallow the capsule whole; do not chew or open it. Take it regularly and do not stop without medical advice.

Common side effects
Reduced sex drive, difficulty getting or maintaining an erection, ejaculation problems, breast tenderness or enlargement, and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease or any history of prostate problems. Dutasteride lowers PSA blood-test levels, so inform the doctor before prostate screening. Women who are pregnant or may become pregnant should not handle leaking capsules, as the medicine may harm a male baby. Do not donate blood during treatment and for 6 months after the last dose. Seek medical advice for breast lumps or nipple discharge.

title: Eberzole Oint (30Gm) Eberconazole 1% W/W Oint By Elder
name: Eberzole Oint (30Gm) Eberconazole 1% W/W Oint By Elder
searchText: Eberzole Oint (30Gm) Eberconazole 1% W/W Oint By Elder Elder I0968
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Eberconazole 1% cream is used to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, jock itch, skin candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

How does it work?
It is an antifungal medicine that damages the fungal cell membrane, stopping the growth of fungi on the skin.

How to take/use it
Apply a thin layer to the affected and surrounding skin exactly as directed by the doctor or product instructions. Wash and dry the area before application, wash hands after use, and use it for the prescribed course. For external use only; avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes.

Common side effects
Mild burning, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to eberconazole or similar antifungal medicines. Avoid applying to the eyes, mouth, broken skin or inside the vagina unless specifically prescribed. Keep the affected area clean and dry, and do not share towels or clothing. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens or does not improve with treatment.

title: Ecosach Sachet (30X10Gm) Saccharomyces Boulardii 250 Mg Sachet By Elder
name: Ecosach Sachet (30X10Gm) Saccharomyces Boulardii 250 Mg Sachet By Elder
searchText: Ecosach Sachet (30X10Gm) Saccharomyces Boulardii 250 Mg Sachet By Elder Elder I2458
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Saccharomyces boulardii is a probiotic used to help manage diarrhoea, including diarrhoea associated with antibiotic use. It may also help restore the balance of helpful microorganisms in the intestine.

How does it work?
It is a beneficial yeast that helps support the normal balance of microorganisms in the gut and may reduce the effects of some harmful organisms that contribute to diarrhoea.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow with water; avoid mixing it with very hot liquids. Do not use it as a substitute for oral rehydration during diarrhoea.

Common side effects
Gas, bloating, abdominal discomfort, or constipation may occur.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if immunocompromised, seriously ill, or fitted with a central venous catheter, as rare serious fungal infections have been reported. Avoid use if allergic to Saccharomyces boulardii or other yeasts. Seek medical care for severe diarrhoea, blood in the stool, high fever, signs of dehydration, or diarrhoea that does not improve.

title: Elbidryl Syp (100Ml) Diphenhydramine 14.08 Mg, Ammonium Chloride 138 Mg, Sodium Citrate 57.03 Mg, Menthol 1.14 Mg Syr By Elder
name: Elbidryl Syp (100Ml) Diphenhydramine 14.08 Mg, Ammonium Chloride 138 Mg, Sodium Citrate 57.03 Mg, Menthol 1.14 Mg Syr By Elder
searchText: Elbidryl Syp (100Ml) Diphenhydramine 14.08 Mg, Ammonium Chloride 138 Mg, Sodium Citrate 57.03 Mg, Menthol 1.14 Mg Syr By Elder Elder I3416
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of cough and related cold or allergy symptoms. It may help loosen mucus, soothe throat irritation and reduce allergy-related symptoms.

How does it work?
Diphenhydramine helps reduce allergy symptoms and can suppress coughing. Ammonium chloride and sodium citrate help loosen mucus, while menthol provides a cooling, soothing effect in the throat.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Measure liquid doses carefully if supplied as a syrup. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea or stomach upset may occur.

Precautions
Diphenhydramine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol after taking it. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use in young children, older adults, pregnancy, breastfeeding, glaucoma, breathing problems or difficulty passing urine. Avoid combining it with other medicines that cause sleepiness unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Elbiol Lotion (100Ml) Gamma Benzene Hexachloride 0.1%, Cetrimide 0.1% Lotion By Elder
name: Elbiol Lotion (100Ml) Gamma Benzene Hexachloride 0.1%, Cetrimide 0.1% Lotion By Elder
searchText: Elbiol Lotion (100Ml) Gamma Benzene Hexachloride 0.1%, Cetrimide 0.1% Lotion By Elder Elder I1644
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to treat scabies, an itchy skin infestation caused by mites. It may also be used for certain lice infestations when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Gamma benzene hexachloride (lindane) kills mites and lice. Cetrimide is an antiseptic that helps reduce germs on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist, and do not use more often or for longer than advised. Avoid the eyes, mouth, inside of the nose and other sensitive areas. Wash hands after applying, unless the hands are being treated.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, burning, redness, dryness or increased itching may occur. Stop use and seek medical help if severe irritation, dizziness, unusual drowsiness, muscle twitching or seizures occur.

Precautions
Do not use on broken, inflamed or extensively irritated skin unless advised by a doctor. Use only under medical advice in children, older adults, pregnancy, breastfeeding or people with a history of seizures. Avoid repeated or excessive use, as lindane can be toxic. Keep away from children and do not swallow.

title: El-Biotic Caps (10X1X10) Prebiotic, Probiotic Cap By Elder
name: El-Biotic Caps (10X1X10) Prebiotic, Probiotic Cap By Elder
searchText: El-Biotic Caps (10X1X10) Prebiotic, Probiotic Cap By Elder Elder I0982
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to support healthy gut bacteria and overall digestive health. It may also help maintain gut balance when it has been disturbed, such as after antibiotic use.

How does it work?
Probiotics provide beneficial live microorganisms, while prebiotics provide nourishment for helpful bacteria already present in the gut. Together, they support a balanced gut environment.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Follow any storage instructions on the pack, as some products may require refrigeration.

Common side effects
Gas, bloating, abdominal discomfort, constipation or loose stools may occur, usually temporarily.

Precautions
Ask a doctor before use if seriously ill, immunocompromised, or if the product is intended for a premature or seriously ill infant. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe or persistent symptoms occur.

title: El-Biotic Sachet (30X1.5Gm) Prebiotic, Probiotic By Elder
name: El-Biotic Sachet (30X1.5Gm) Prebiotic, Probiotic By Elder
searchText: El-Biotic Sachet (30X1.5Gm) Prebiotic, Probiotic By Elder Elder I1973
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Prebiotics and probiotics are used to support the balance of beneficial bacteria in the gut and promote digestive health. They may also help support gut health during or after antibiotic treatment, depending on the specific product and probiotic strain.

How does it work?
Probiotics provide live beneficial microorganisms, while prebiotics are fibres that help nourish these microorganisms in the gut.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If taking antibiotics, ask a pharmacist whether the product should be taken at a different time.

Common side effects
Gas, bloating, abdominal discomfort, constipation or loose stools may occur, especially when starting treatment.

Precautions
Ask a doctor before use if there is a weakened immune system, serious illness or a severe underlying medical condition. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe or persistent symptoms occur. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: El-Biotic Z Suspn (10X60Ml) Zinc Gluconate, Prebiotic, Probiotic Dry Susp By Elder
name: El-Biotic Z Suspn (10X60Ml) Zinc Gluconate, Prebiotic, Probiotic Dry Susp By Elder
searchText: El-Biotic Z Suspn (10X60Ml) Zinc Gluconate, Prebiotic, Probiotic Dry Susp By Elder Elder EL0197
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to provide zinc and support healthy gut function with prebiotics and probiotics.

How does it work?
Zinc supports normal immune function and other essential body processes. Probiotics add beneficial microorganisms to the gut, while prebiotics help support their growth.

How to take/use it
Prepare and take the dry suspension exactly as directed on the product label or by the healthcare professional. Do not guess the dose or duration. Use the supplied measuring device if provided.

Common side effects
May cause nausea, stomach discomfort, vomiting, gas or bloating. Zinc may cause an unpleasant or metallic taste, especially at higher amounts.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Avoid taking more than the recommended amount, as excess zinc can be harmful. If taking antibiotics or other regular medicines, ask a doctor or pharmacist about possible interactions. People with severely weakened immunity should seek medical advice before using probiotic products.

title: Elbugesic Plus Susp (L) (36X100Ml) Ibuprofen 100 Mg, Paracetamol 162.5 Mg Susp By Elder
name: Elbugesic Plus Susp (L) (36X100Ml) Ibuprofen 100 Mg, Paracetamol 162.5 Mg Susp By Elder
searchText: Elbugesic Plus Susp (L) (36X100Ml) Ibuprofen 100 Mg, Paracetamol 162.5 Mg Susp By Elder Elder I3293
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain, such as body aches, headache, toothache, muscle pain and pain associated with colds.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Ibuprofen reduces pain, fever and inflammation by blocking the production of substances involved in these symptoms.

How to take/use it
Use only the dose and schedule directed on the product label or by a doctor, based on age and weight. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or ibuprofen unless advised by a healthcare professional. Use the measuring device supplied with the product if it is a liquid.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ibuprofen, paracetamol, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory medicines. Seek medical advice before use in children with dehydration, asthma triggered by painkillers, stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver problems. Avoid use during pregnancy, especially the later months, unless prescribed. Stop use and seek urgent help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, vomiting blood or black stools.

title: Elbugesic Plus Suspn (25X60Ml) Ibuprofen 100 Mg, Paracetamol 162.5 Mg Susp By Elder
name: Elbugesic Plus Suspn (25X60Ml) Ibuprofen 100 Mg, Paracetamol 162.5 Mg Susp By Elder
searchText: Elbugesic Plus Suspn (25X60Ml) Ibuprofen 100 Mg, Paracetamol 162.5 Mg Susp By Elder Elder I3280
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for the short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and reduction of fever.

How does it work?
Ibuprofen reduces the production of substances that cause pain, swelling and fever. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or ibuprofen unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to ibuprofen, paracetamol, aspirin or other similar medicines. Seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, heart disease, dehydration, or use of blood thinners. Ibuprofen should generally be avoided during the last 3 months of pregnancy unless specifically prescribed. Stop use and seek help for signs of stomach bleeding, severe allergic reaction or a serious skin rash.

title: Elbugesic Plus Tabs (20X15) Ibuprofen 400 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg Tab By Elder
name: Elbugesic Plus Tabs (20X15) Ibuprofen 400 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg Tab By Elder
searchText: Elbugesic Plus Tabs (20X15) Ibuprofen 400 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg Tab By Elder Elder I3454
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain, such as headache, toothache, muscle or body pain, menstrual pain, and pain associated with inflammation. It can also help reduce fever.

How does it work?
Ibuprofen reduces the production of substances that cause pain, swelling and fever. Paracetamol helps relieve pain and reduce fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the package or by a doctor. Take with or after food and swallow with water if it causes stomach upset. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol, ibuprofen or other NSAIDs.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, heartburn, dizziness or headache. Skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid or seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart problems, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to ibuprofen, paracetamol or other NSAIDs. Avoid excessive alcohol. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy, especially in the last 3 months, or if taking blood thinners or other regular medicines. Stop and seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe allergic reactions, breathing difficulty or a serious skin rash.

title: Elcal 500 Tabs (20X15) Calcium, Phosphorus, Zinc, Cholecalciferol Tab By Elder
name: Elcal 500 Tabs (20X15) Calcium, Phosphorus, Zinc, Cholecalciferol Tab By Elder
searchText: Elcal 500 Tabs (20X15) Calcium, Phosphorus, Zinc, Cholecalciferol Tab By Elder Elder I1694
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement provides calcium, phosphorus, zinc and vitamin D3 to support healthy bones and teeth and help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies. It may be used when dietary intake is inadequate or when supplementation is recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Calcium and phosphorus are important minerals for bones and teeth. Vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium and phosphorus, while zinc supports normal growth, tissue repair and immune function.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Tell a doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines and supplements being taken.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, constipation or diarrhoea may occur. Excessive use can cause high calcium levels, which may lead to marked thirst, frequent urination, weakness or vomiting.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, high calcium levels or other mineral-balance problems. Calcium can reduce the absorption of some medicines, so ask a pharmacist about suitable spacing from other medicines. Avoid taking additional calcium or vitamin D supplements unless advised.

title: Elcal Gummies (6X30 Gummies) Calcium Magnesium,D3,Zinc By Elder
name: Elcal Gummies (6X30 Gummies) Calcium Magnesium,D3,Zinc By Elder
searchText: Elcal Gummies (6X30 Gummies) Calcium Magnesium,D3,Zinc By Elder Elder EL0143
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Provides calcium, magnesium, vitamin D3 and zinc to supplement dietary intake. Calcium and vitamin D support normal bone health.

How does it work?
These nutrients support normal bone mineralisation and several normal body functions.

How to take/use it
Use as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
May cause stomach discomfort or constipation in some people.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, or use of other mineral supplements or medicines.

title: Elcal Hd Forte Tabs (10X15) Elemental Calcium 500 Mg, Vitamin D3 500 Iu Tab By Elder
name: Elcal Hd Forte Tabs (10X15) Elemental Calcium 500 Mg, Vitamin D3 500 Iu Tab By Elder
searchText: Elcal Hd Forte Tabs (10X15) Elemental Calcium 500 Mg, Vitamin D3 500 Iu Tab By Elder Elder EL0061
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement calcium and vitamin D when dietary intake is insufficient, and to support healthy bones and teeth.

How does it work?
Calcium provides the mineral needed for bones, teeth and normal muscle and nerve function. Vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Calcium carbonate is usually best taken with food. Do not take more than recommended or combine with other calcium or vitamin D supplements unless advised.

Common side effects
Constipation, gas, bloating, nausea or stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, or high calcium levels. Calcium can reduce the absorption of some medicines, including iron supplements, thyroid medicines and certain antibiotics; these may need to be taken at different times as advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Elcal Super Tab (10X15) Calcium Citrate 1000 Mg, Magnesium 100 Mg, Zinc 4 Mg, Vitamin D3 200 Iu Tab By Elder
name: Elcal Super Tab (10X15) Calcium Citrate 1000 Mg, Magnesium 100 Mg, Zinc 4 Mg, Vitamin D3 200 Iu Tab By Elder
searchText: Elcal Super Tab (10X15) Calcium Citrate 1000 Mg, Magnesium 100 Mg, Zinc 4 Mg, Vitamin D3 200 Iu Tab By Elder Elder I1393
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement provides calcium, vitamin D3, magnesium and zinc to help meet nutritional needs and support healthy bones and teeth. It may be used to help prevent or correct calcium and vitamin D deficiency, as advised by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Calcium and vitamin D3 support bone and tooth strength; vitamin D3 also helps the body absorb calcium. Magnesium and zinc support normal muscle, nerve and bone function.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional, with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount. If stomach upset occurs, taking it with food may help.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, stomach upset, abdominal discomfort, bloating or diarrhoea may occur. Excessive use may increase the risk of high calcium levels or kidney stones.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, high calcium levels, or other medical conditions. Calcium, magnesium and zinc can reduce the absorption of some medicines, including thyroid medicines, iron supplements and certain antibiotics; these may need to be taken at a different time. Inform a healthcare professional if pregnant or breastfeeding, or if taking other vitamin or mineral supplements.

title: Elcal Xt Tabs (10X15) Calcium Carbonate 1250 Mg, Cholecalciferol 2000 Iu, Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, L-5-Methylfolate 1 Mg, Pyridoxal 5-Phosphate 20 Mg Tab By Elder
name: Elcal Xt Tabs (10X15) Calcium Carbonate 1250 Mg, Cholecalciferol 2000 Iu, Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, L-5-Methylfolate 1 Mg, Pyridoxal 5-Phosphate 20 Mg Tab By Elder
searchText: Elcal Xt Tabs (10X15) Calcium Carbonate 1250 Mg, Cholecalciferol 2000 Iu, Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, L-5-Methylfolate 1 Mg, Pyridoxal 5-Phosphate 20 Mg Tab By Elder Elder I1585
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement provides calcium, vitamin D3 and B vitamins to support bone health and help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies when dietary intake is inadequate or supplementation is recommended.

How does it work?
Calcium supports bones and teeth, while vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium. Methylcobalamin, methylfolate and pyridoxal 5-phosphate support normal nerve function and blood-cell formation.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Calcium carbonate is generally best taken with food. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Constipation, gas, bloating, nausea or stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, high calcium levels or other calcium or vitamin D supplements are being taken. Calcium can reduce the absorption of some medicines, including thyroid medicines, iron supplements and certain antibiotics; timing may need to be separated. Inform a doctor about all medicines and supplements being used.

title: Elcefol Z Caps * (10X(2X15)) Carbonyl Iron 50 Mg, Zinc 22.5 Mg, Folic Acid 0.5 Mg Cap By Elder
name: Elcefol Z Caps * (10X(2X15)) Carbonyl Iron 50 Mg, Zinc 22.5 Mg, Folic Acid 0.5 Mg Cap By Elder
searchText: Elcefol Z Caps * (10X(2X15)) Carbonyl Iron 50 Mg, Zinc 22.5 Mg, Folic Acid 0.5 Mg Cap By Elder Elder I1458
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat iron and folic acid deficiency and support the production of healthy red blood cells. It also provides zinc, which supports normal body functions and immune health.

How does it work?
Iron helps the body make haemoglobin, which carries oxygen in the blood. Folic acid supports red blood cell formation, while zinc helps support several enzymes and normal immune function.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by a doctor or as stated on the product label. Swallow with water. If it causes stomach upset, taking it with food may help. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea, metallic taste, and dark-coloured stools may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is iron overload, a blood disorder, or an allergy to any ingredient. Iron supplements may interact with antacids, calcium supplements, thyroid medicines and some antibiotics; medical advice may be needed about separating doses. Keep out of reach of children, as an overdose of iron can be dangerous.

title: Elceplex L Syp (200Ml) Vitamin B Complex, Vitamin B12 Syr By Elder
name: Elceplex L Syp (200Ml) Vitamin B Complex, Vitamin B12 Syr By Elder
searchText: Elceplex L Syp (200Ml) Vitamin B Complex, Vitamin B12 Syr By Elder Elder I1583
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Vitamin B Complex with B12 is used to prevent or treat deficiency of B vitamins and to support normal energy metabolism, red blood cell formation and nerve function. It may be recommended when dietary intake is inadequate or when there is an increased need for these vitamins.

How does it work?
B vitamins act as co-factors in processes that help the body use carbohydrates, fats and proteins for energy. They also support healthy nerves and blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Possible effects include nausea, stomach discomfort or headache. Bright yellow urine may occur and is generally harmless.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Tell a healthcare professional about pregnancy, breastfeeding, medical conditions or other medicines being taken. Avoid prolonged use of higher-than-recommended doses, as excess vitamin B6 may cause nerve problems. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen.

title: Elcid Mps Liq (Mint) (6X170Ml) Aluminium Hydroxide 250 Mg, Magnesium Hydroxide 250 Mg, Simethicone 50 Mg, Sorbitol 1.25 G Liquid By Elder
name: Elcid Mps Liq (Mint) (6X170Ml) Aluminium Hydroxide 250 Mg, Magnesium Hydroxide 250 Mg, Simethicone 50 Mg, Sorbitol 1.25 G Liquid By Elder
searchText: Elcid Mps Liq (Mint) (6X170Ml) Aluminium Hydroxide 250 Mg, Magnesium Hydroxide 250 Mg, Simethicone 50 Mg, Sorbitol 1.25 G Liquid By Elder Elder I1584
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of acidity, heartburn and indigestion. It may also help relieve gas, bloating and abdominal discomfort.

How does it work?
Aluminium hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide neutralise excess stomach acid. Simethicone helps break up gas bubbles, while sorbitol may help soften stools and promote bowel movement.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Keep a gap between this medicine and other medicines unless a doctor or pharmacist advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Constipation, loose stools or diarrhoea, abdominal cramps, nausea and changes in bowel movements may occur.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, severe or persistent stomach pain, repeated vomiting, black stools or difficulty swallowing. Consult a doctor if symptoms continue or recur frequently. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Elcid Mps Tab (Mint) (20X15) Magnesium Aluminium 50 Mg, Dried Aluminium Hydroxide Gel 300 Mg, Magnesium Hydroxide 25 Mg, Simethicone 25 Mg Tab By Elder
name: Elcid Mps Tab (Mint) (20X15) Magnesium Aluminium 50 Mg, Dried Aluminium Hydroxide Gel 300 Mg, Magnesium Hydroxide 25 Mg, Simethicone 25 Mg Tab By Elder
searchText: Elcid Mps Tab (Mint) (20X15) Magnesium Aluminium 50 Mg, Dried Aluminium Hydroxide Gel 300 Mg, Magnesium Hydroxide 25 Mg, Simethicone 25 Mg Tab By Elder Elder I0395
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of acidity, heartburn and indigestion, including discomfort caused by excess gas, bloating or abdominal fullness.

How does it work?
The aluminium and magnesium hydroxides neutralise excess stomach acid. Simethicone helps gas bubbles combine and pass more easily, reducing bloating and gas-related discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Keep a gap between this medicine and other medicines, as antacids may affect their absorption.

Common side effects
Constipation or diarrhoea, nausea, stomach discomfort and a chalky taste may occur.

Precautions
Ask a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, persistent or severe stomach pain, repeated vomiting, difficulty swallowing, black stools or vomiting blood. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or keep returning. Consult a healthcare professional during pregnancy or breastfeeding, and before use in children. Avoid prolonged or excessive use.

title: Elciloc 150 Tabs (20X30) Ranitidine 150 Mg Tab By Elder
name: Elciloc 150 Tabs (20X30) Ranitidine 150 Mg Tab By Elder
searchText: Elciloc 150 Tabs (20X30) Ranitidine 150 Mg Tab By Elder Elder I0931
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine reduces excess stomach acid. It may be used for acidity, heartburn, acid reflux (GERD), and some stomach or intestinal ulcers.

How does it work?
It blocks H2 receptors in the stomach, which reduces the production of stomach acid.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Swallow with water and do not exceed the recommended amount or duration. Ranitidine has been withdrawn or restricted in many countries; check current local regulatory advice before use.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation, or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Tell a doctor if there is kidney or liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or use of other medicines. Seek medical advice for persistent or recurrent symptoms, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, unexplained weight loss, or severe stomach pain. Clobetasol reduces skin inflammation, redness and itching. Salicylic acid softens and removes thick, scaly skin, helping the medicine reach the affected area.

Use only on the skin and apply as directed by the doctor. Apply a thin layer to the affected area and wash hands after use, unless the hands are being treated. Do not use more often, for longer, or over larger areas than advised.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Propranolol is used to lower high blood pressure and manage certain heart-related problems, such as a fast or irregular heartbeat and angina. It may also be prescribed for migraine prevention, tremors, or physical symptoms of anxiety, depending on the doctor's advice.

How does it work?
It is a beta-blocker that slows the heartbeat and reduces the force with which the heart pumps. This helps lower blood pressure and reduces the heart's workload.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and swallow it with water. Take it consistently at the same time each day. Do not stop it suddenly unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Tiredness, dizziness, light-headedness, slow heartbeat, cold hands or feet, sleep disturbances, or nausea.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is asthma or wheezing, a very slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, heart failure, circulation problems, diabetes, or liver or kidney disease. Propranolol can hide some warning signs of low blood sugar. Seek medical advice for breathing difficulty, fainting, or an unusually slow heartbeat.

What is it used for?
Propranolol is a beta-blocker used for high blood pressure, certain heart rhythm problems and other heart-related conditions. It may also be prescribed to prevent migraine attacks, control physical symptoms of anxiety, or reduce tremors, depending on medical advice.

How does it work?
It slows the heart rate and reduces the force with which the heart pumps. This lowers the workload on the heart and can reduce some physical symptoms such as a fast heartbeat and tremor.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Take doses at the same time each day and follow the instructions on the prescription or package. Do not stop treatment suddenly without medical advice.

Common side effects
Tiredness, dizziness, cold hands or feet, slow heartbeat, sleep disturbances and nausea may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor before use if there is asthma or wheezing, a very slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, heart failure, diabetes or circulation problems. Propranolol can mask some warning signs of low blood sugar. Avoid stopping it suddenly, and seek medical advice if breathing difficulty, fainting or an unusually slow heartbeat occurs.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Bimatoprost and timolol eye drops are used to lower raised pressure inside the eye in open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension. Lowering eye pressure helps protect the optic nerve and reduce the risk of vision loss.

How does it work?
Timolol reduces the production of fluid inside the eye. Bimatoprost increases the drainage of this fluid, helping lower eye pressure.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by the ophthalmologist. Wash hands, avoid touching the dropper tip to the eye or other surfaces, and close the eye gently after applying the drop. Remove contact lenses before use and reinsert them only as directed. If using other eye drops, separate them as advised by the doctor. Do not stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Eye redness, irritation, itching, dryness, watering, temporary blurred vision, headache, and increased eyelash growth. Darkening of the skin around the eye or the iris may occur with bimatoprost.

Precautions
Tell the doctor before use if there is asthma or other breathing disease, a slow heartbeat, heart block, heart failure, low blood pressure, diabetes, or other eye disease. Timolol may rarely affect breathing or heart rate and may mask some signs of low blood sugar. Inform the doctor about all medicines and other eye drops being used. Avoid driving until blurred vision clears. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, fainting, severe dizziness, or a serious allergic reaction.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Allopurinol is used to lower high uric acid levels and prevent gout attacks, including the formation of uric acid kidney stones in some patients. It helps prevent future attacks but does not provide quick relief from pain during an acute gout attack.

How does it work?
It blocks an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, reducing the body’s production of uric acid.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, regularly, and preferably after food with plenty of water. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. It may take time to reduce gout attacks, and attacks can sometimes occur when treatment is first started.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Stop taking it and seek urgent medical help if a rash, blistering, peeling skin, mouth sores, facial swelling or breathing difficulty develops. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, and provide a complete list of medicines, especially azathioprine or mercaptopurine. Do not start, stop or change treatment without medical advice.

bodyHtml:

Allopurinol is used to lower high uric acid levels and prevent gout attacks. It may also be prescribed to prevent uric acid kidney stones or uric acid build-up during some cancer treatments.

How does it work?

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision if there is kidney, liver or heart disease. Pioglitazone may worsen heart failure and cause fluid retention. Glimepiride can cause low blood sugar, especially if meals are skipped, alcohol is consumed or exercise is increased. Tell the doctor before surgery, serious illness or an imaging test using contrast dye. Seek medical help for severe weakness, breathing difficulty, unusual sleepiness, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or marked swelling. Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the recommended course, even if symptoms improve. Taking it with a fatty meal may improve absorption. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Headache, nausea, stomach upset, diarrhoea, dizziness and skin rash. Increased sensitivity to sunlight may occur.

Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically advised by a doctor. Inform the doctor about liver disease, lupus, porphyria or a history of allergy to griseofulvin. How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Follow the instructions on the label regarding timing, and swallow the tablet as directed. Do not stop it suddenly or change the dose without medical advice. Use the prescribed fast-acting medicine for sudden chest pain, if available.

Montelukast is used to help prevent and control asthma symptoms, including symptoms triggered by exercise. It may also help relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, a blocked or runny nose, and itchy nose. It is not a rescue medicine for a sudden asthma attack.

How does it work?
It blocks leukotrienes, substances involved in airway swelling, tightening and allergy symptoms. This helps keep the airways more open and reduces inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed. Do not take extra doses, and do not use it instead of a prescribed rescue inhaler during a sudden asthma attack. Continue other asthma medicines unless the prescriber advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Headache, stomach pain, nausea and diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Stop the medicine and seek medical advice promptly if there are significant mood or behaviour changes, unusual dreams, sleep problems, anxiety, depression or thoughts of self-harm. Tell the prescriber about any previous mental health problems, allergies or liver disease. Seek urgent help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe allergic reaction.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed and complete the recommended course. It works best when started early after symptoms begin.

Nausea, vomiting and headache may occur.

Dose adjustment may be needed in kidney problems. It does not replace annual influenza vaccination.

What is it used for?
Oxymetazoline nasal spray provides short-term relief from a blocked or stuffy nose caused by the common cold, allergies or sinus congestion.

How does it work?
It narrows swollen blood vessels inside the nose, helping reduce swelling and improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Use in the nose only and follow the product label or healthcare professional’s instructions. Do not use it more often or for longer than recommended, as prolonged use can make nasal congestion worse. Do not share the spray with others.

Common side effects
Nasal dryness, burning or irritation, sneezing, headache, and throat irritation may occur. Fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure can occur rarely.

Precautions
Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, glaucoma or prostate enlargement. Seek advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if taking monoamine oxidase inhibitors or certain antidepressants. Stop and seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, persist, or if severe palpitations occur.

For nasal use only. Clear the nose gently and use the spray exactly as directed on the label or by a doctor. Use only in the child and age group specified on the pack. Do not share the spray, and do not use it for longer than recommended, as this may worsen nasal blockage.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combined oral contraceptive is used to prevent pregnancy when taken correctly. It may also help make menstrual bleeding more regular and reduce period pain in some people. It does not protect against sexually transmitted infections.

How does it work?
Levonorgestrel and ethinylestradiol prevent ovulation and make cervical mucus thicker, making it harder for sperm to reach an egg. They also change the lining of the womb.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and follow the order and instructions in the pack leaflet. Take it at the same time each day. If a tablet is missed, or vomiting or severe diarrhoea occurs, follow the missed-tablet instructions or ask a pharmacist or doctor for advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, headache, breast tenderness, mood changes, and changes in menstrual bleeding or spotting may occur, especially during the first few months.

Precautions
Do not use or start this medicine without medical advice if there is a history of blood clots, stroke, heart disease, migraine with aura, uncontrolled high blood pressure, serious liver disease, or breast cancer. Smoking increases the risk of serious cardiovascular side effects, particularly in people over 35 years. Seek urgent medical help for sudden chest pain, breathlessness, coughing blood, severe headache, vision changes, or painful swelling in one leg. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines, as some can reduce contraceptive effectiveness.

What is it used for?
Oxcarbazepine 300 mg is mainly used to control seizures in epilepsy, including focal (partial) seizures. It is usually taken regularly as prescribed to help prevent seizures.

How does it work?
It reduces abnormal electrical activity in the brain by affecting sodium channels in nerve cells, helping to prevent seizures.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same times each day, with or without food. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not stop taking it suddenly, as this may worsen seizures. If a dose is missed, follow the advice provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, headache, nausea, vomiting, blurred or double vision, difficulty with coordination, and shaking may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney, liver or heart problems, low blood sodium, or an allergy to oxcarbazepine or carbamazepine. Seek medical help for severe rash, swelling of the face or throat, unusual confusion, severe weakness, worsening seizures, or thoughts of self-harm. Oxcarbazepine may reduce the effectiveness of hormonal contraceptives. Discuss pregnancy or breastfeeding with a doctor before using it. Avoid driving or alcohol until its effects are known.

Used to treat bacterial infections of the eye that are accompanied by redness, swelling or other inflammation. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor.

Ofloxacin is an antibiotic that stops the growth of susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces eye inflammation.

How to take/use it
Use in the affected eye(s) exactly as prescribed. Wash hands before use and do not touch the dropper tip to the eye or other surfaces. Do not use more often or for longer than directed. Avoid wearing contact lenses unless advised by a doctor.

Temporary burning or stinging, eye irritation, watering and blurred vision may occur after use.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision, especially in children or people with glaucoma or other eye problems. Do not use for undiagnosed red eye or suspected viral or fungal infection. Ofloxacin and metronidazole act against susceptible bacteria and parasites in the intestine. Simethicone helps break up gas bubbles and may relieve bloating and discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Take the prescribed amount at the recommended times and complete the course, even if symptoms improve. Do not self-medicate or use leftover antibiotics.

Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, metallic taste and gas may occur.

Tell the doctor about allergies to quinolone antibiotics or metronidazole, liver or kidney problems, seizure disorders, nerve problems, or a history of tendon problems. Avoid alcohol during treatment with metronidazole and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Seek medical advice for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe dizziness, or persistent or bloody diarrhoea. Pregnant or breastfeeding patients should use it only on medical advice. Keep a gap from antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc if advised by the doctor or pharmacist.

Pioglitazone is used to help control high blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes, along with a suitable diet and exercise. It may be used alone or with other diabetes medicines.

It helps the body's cells respond better to insulin, allowing more sugar to move from the blood into the cells. This helps lower blood sugar levels.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Take it regularly and do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Continue the recommended diet, exercise and blood sugar monitoring.

Weight gain, swelling of the ankles or legs, headache, muscle aches and symptoms of an upper respiratory infection may occur. Low blood sugar is more likely when it is taken with certain other diabetes medicines.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart failure, liver disease, bladder cancer or blood in the urine before using it. Seek medical help for sudden weight gain, increasing swelling or breathing difficulty, as these may indicate fluid retention or heart problems. Liver function may need monitoring. Pioglitazone may increase the risk of bone fractures and is not used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis. Inform the doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.

Piperacillin kills susceptible bacteria by stopping them from building their protective cell wall. Tazobactam helps protect piperacillin from enzymes that can make some bacteria resistant to it.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and duration depend on the type and severity of infection and kidney function. Complete the prescribed course unless the treating doctor advises otherwise.

Precautions
Do not use if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin, other beta-lactam antibiotics or any ingredient. Tell the doctor about kidney disease, previous antibiotic-related diarrhoea, bleeding or blood disorders, or other medicines being taken. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash or unusual bleeding. Unnecessary use can promote antibiotic resistance.

What is it used for?
This medicine is used to lower high blood pressure (hypertension) when treatment with one or more blood-pressure medicines is not sufficient.

How does it work?
Telmisartan relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of a hormone that raises blood pressure. Amlodipine relaxes blood vessels, while hydrochlorothiazide helps the body remove extra salt and water through urine.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, usually at the same time each day. Swallow the tablet with water and do not stop it without medical advice. Continue regular blood-pressure checks as advised.

Common side effects
Dizziness, headache, tiredness, ankle or leg swelling, flushing, increased urination, and stomach upset may occur. Contact a doctor if side effects are severe or persistent.

Precautions
This medicine may cause dizziness, especially when starting treatment or standing up quickly. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, dehydration, diabetes, gout, or abnormal potassium or sodium levels. Do not use during pregnancy; inform the doctor immediately if pregnancy occurs. Avoid potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes unless advised. Tell the doctor about all medicines being used, especially lithium, other blood-pressure medicines, water tablets, painkillers such as ibuprofen, or medicines affecting potassium. Medical monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolytes may be needed.

Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, a history of pancreatitis, or any allergy to this medicine. Monitor blood sugar as advised. Tell the doctor about liver disease, kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being taken. Liver function tests may be needed, especially during longer treatment. What is it used for?
Thyroxine is used as thyroid hormone replacement to treat an underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism). It replaces the hormone that the thyroid gland does not produce in sufficient amounts.

How does it work?
It supplies synthetic thyroid hormone, helping restore normal thyroid hormone levels and support the body's metabolism and energy functions.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, usually on an empty stomach with water. Take it at the same time each day and do not stop or change the dose without medical advice. Side effects are more likely if the dose is too high and may include palpitations, fast heartbeat, trembling, nervousness, sweating, difficulty sleeping, headache, diarrhoea and weight loss.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart disease, diabetes, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical advice for chest pain, severe or persistent palpitations, or marked shortness of breath. Do not use thyroxine for weight loss. Many medicines and supplements can affect its absorption, so provide a complete medicine list to the doctor or pharmacist.

Stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, headache and dizziness may occur. Mild diarrhoea can also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, a blood disorder, or an allergy to albendazole. Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically prescribed; people who could become pregnant may need contraception during treatment. Longer treatments may require liver function and blood-count monitoring. Seek medical advice for yellowing of the skin or eyes, unusual bruising, severe weakness or persistent abdominal pain.

Used to treat certain parasitic worm infections, including intestinal worms. It should be used only for the type of infection diagnosed or suspected by a healthcare professional.

Albendazole and ivermectin act against susceptible parasites by interfering with their essential functions, helping to kill or remove them from the body.

Precautions
Inform the doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy, breastfeeding, or if there is liver disease. Tell the doctor about all other medicines being taken. Seek medical advice if severe dizziness, persistent vomiting, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or unusual weakness occurs. Avoid driving if dizzy.

Used as a dietary supplement to provide essential vitamins, minerals and zinc when dietary intake is inadequate or to help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies.

How to take/use it

What is it used for?
Used to supplement vitamins and minerals, including zinc, when dietary intake may be inadequate or when extra nutritional support is needed. It may help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies when recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It provides essential vitamins and minerals needed for normal energy production, immunity, growth, and other body functions. Zinc also supports immune function and wound healing.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Shake the syrup well before use and measure it with the supplied measuring device. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, vomiting, constipation, or diarrhoea may occur. An unpleasant or metallic taste can occur due to zinc.

Precautions
Check the ingredients if there is a history of allergy to any vitamin, mineral, or other ingredient. Avoid taking it along with other multivitamin or zinc supplements unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice before use in children, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or with kidney or liver disease. Keep out of reach of children; accidental overdose can be harmful.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Zinc acetate is used to treat zinc deficiency. Under medical supervision, it is also used in Wilson’s disease, a condition in which copper builds up in the body.

How does it work?
It provides zinc to the body. In Wilson’s disease, zinc reduces the absorption of copper from the intestine.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Do not change the dose or duration without medical advice. If being used for Wilson’s disease, follow the prescribed instructions about taking it with or without food. Keep it separate from iron, calcium and certain antibiotics if advised by the doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, vomiting and a metallic taste may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision, especially at this strength. Long-term or excessive use may cause copper deficiency and blood-related problems. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver disease, other medicines and mineral supplements. Seek medical advice if severe or persistent stomach symptoms occur.

Zinc acetate is used to provide zinc when there is a confirmed or suspected zinc deficiency, as directed by a healthcare professional. The exact reason for use depends on the product and prescription.

How does it work?
It supplies zinc, a mineral needed for normal immune function, wound healing, growth and many body enzymes.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the label or by the doctor. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. If it causes stomach discomfort, ask a healthcare professional whether it should be taken with food. Keep it away from children.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, abdominal discomfort and a metallic taste may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about all medicines and supplements being taken. Zinc can reduce the absorption of some antibiotics and penicillamine; separate doses as advised. Iron, calcium and magnesium supplements may also interact with zinc. Long-term or excessive use can cause copper deficiency. Seek medical advice if severe vomiting, persistent stomach pain or an allergic reaction occurs.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Diclofenac is used to relieve pain and reduce inflammation, including muscle, joint and arthritis-related pain.

How does it work?
It is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine (NSAID). It reduces substances in the body that cause pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the product label. The correct route, dose and duration depend on the formulation. If this is an injectable product, it should be given by a healthcare professional; do not self-inject.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and skin rash.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver problems, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or if taking blood thinners or other NSAIDs. Avoid during the last 3 months of pregnancy unless specifically advised. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, chest pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash.

What is it used for?
Albendazole is used to treat certain parasitic worm infections, including intestinal worm infections and some infections caused by worms in body tissues.

How does it work?
It stops parasitic worms from using glucose and producing energy, causing them to die.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and follow the instructions on the product label. Do not change the dose, repeat treatment or stop early without medical advice. Follow any instructions about taking it with food.

Common side effects
Stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, headache and dizziness. Mild diarrhoea may also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is pregnancy, planned pregnancy, liver disease or a history of blood disorders. Long or repeated treatment may require blood and liver-function tests. Seek medical advice for yellowing of the skin or eyes, unusual bleeding, severe weakness or a severe skin reaction.

What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat certain parasitic worm infections, including some intestinal worm infections. The exact infection and treatment plan should be determined by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Albendazole damages the parasite’s ability to use nutrients, while ivermectin affects the parasite’s nerve and muscle activity, causing it to become paralysed and die.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed. Swallow the tablet with water and follow the prescribed instructions carefully. Do not repeat the dose or use it for another infection without medical advice.

Common side effects
Abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver disease, neurological problems or other medicines being taken. Seek medical help for severe dizziness, confusion, breathing difficulty, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or a severe allergic reaction. Do not self-medicate for suspected worm infection.

What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat certain parasitic worm infections, including intestinal worm infections. The exact use depends on the type of parasite diagnosed.

How does it work?
Albendazole damages the parasite's ability to use nutrients, while ivermectin affects the parasite's nerve and muscle activity. Together, they help kill or remove susceptible parasites from the body.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Measure the liquid carefully with a measuring device and follow the prescribed dose and duration. Do not repeat treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness or vomiting may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding or other medicines being taken. Use during pregnancy only if specifically advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for severe dizziness, breathing difficulty, a widespread rash, yellowing of the eyes or skin, or severe abdominal pain.

title: Abd Suspension 10Ml (Albendazole 200 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas

searchText: Abd Suspension 10Ml (Albendazole 200 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400000041
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Albendazole is used to treat worm infections, including roundworm, pinworm, hookworm and whipworm infections. It may also be prescribed for certain other parasitic infections.

How does it work?
It damages the worms' internal structures and prevents them from using glucose for energy, causing them to die.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed. Shake the suspension well before use and measure each dose with a proper measuring device. The dose and treatment duration vary according to the type of infection, age and body weight.

Common side effects
Stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, headache and dizziness may occur. Short-term treatment is usually well tolerated.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Albendazole should generally be avoided during pregnancy unless specifically prescribed. Longer treatment may require blood-count and liver-function monitoring. Seek medical advice for severe allergic reactions, yellowing of the skin or eyes, unusual bruising, or persistent severe symptoms.

title: Actigesic 1 Ml (Diclofenac Sodium 75 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Diclofenac injection is used for short-term relief of moderate to severe pain and inflammation, especially in muscle, joint and arthritis-related conditions. It may be used when an injection is needed under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional, usually by injection, exactly as prescribed. Do not self-inject or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and pain or irritation at the injection site.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an allergy to aspirin or other NSAIDs. Avoid using it with other NSAID painkillers unless advised. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, chest pain or swelling. It should generally be avoided during the last 3 months of pregnancy unless specifically prescribed.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Disodium hydrogen citrate is used to make urine less acidic. It may help relieve burning or discomfort while passing urine and may be used in the management of certain kidney stones, as directed by a healthcare professional. It does not treat a urinary infection itself.

How does it work?
It is converted in the body to alkaline substances that reduce urine acidity and increase urinary pH.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth only as directed by a doctor or the product label. Measure the liquid accurately and dilute it if instructed. Do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, or bloating may occur.

Precautions
Use only with medical advice if there is kidney disease, heart failure, high blood pressure, swelling, or a need to restrict salt. Seek medical care for fever, severe pain, blood in the urine, difficulty passing urine, or persistent burning, as these may need specific treatment.

title: Amitas 100 Inj 2 Ml (Amikacin 100 Mg/2 Ml Inj) By Intas

searchText: Amitas 100 Inj 2 Ml (Amikacin 100 Mg/2 Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 400008113
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amikacin injection is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, including certain infections of the lungs, blood, abdomen, urinary tract, bones and joints. It is usually used when other antibiotics may not be suitable and is given under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which kills the bacteria and helps control the infection.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a muscle or vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type of infection, body weight and kidney function. Do not self-inject or stop treatment early unless advised by the doctor.

Common side effects
Pain at the injection site, nausea, vomiting and headache may occur. Kidney problems, hearing loss, ringing in the ears, dizziness or balance problems can occur and require prompt medical attention.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and any previous allergy to aminoglycoside antibiotics. Kidney function and, when needed, hearing should be monitored during treatment. Inform the doctor about all other medicines, especially medicines that may affect the kidneys or hearing. Seek urgent medical help for reduced urination, swelling, unusual weakness, ringing in the ears, hearing changes, severe dizziness or breathing difficulty.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amikacin injection is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, especially infections caused by certain bacteria that may be resistant to other antibiotics. It is commonly used in hospitals or under close medical supervision.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking their ability to make essential proteins needed for growth and survival.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a muscle or vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function and other medical factors. Do not self-inject or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Pain at the injection site, nausea or vomiting may occur. More serious effects include kidney problems, hearing loss, ringing in the ears, dizziness or balance problems.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and any muscle or nerve disorder. Kidney function and, when needed, hearing may be monitored during treatment. Inform the doctor about other medicines, especially those that may affect the kidneys or hearing. Seek urgent medical help for reduced urination, swelling, ringing in the ears, hearing changes, severe dizziness or breathing difficulty.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amikacin injection is an aminoglycoside antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, including infections of the lungs, blood, abdomen, urinary tract, bones and joints. It is usually used in hospitals or under close medical supervision.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the production of proteins they need to survive. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a healthcare professional. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, body weight and kidney function. Do not self-inject or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Pain at the injection site, nausea, vomiting and headache may occur. This medicine can also cause serious kidney problems or hearing and balance problems.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, or pregnancy. Kidney function and, when needed, hearing should be monitored during treatment. Inform the doctor about other medicines, especially those that may affect the kidneys or hearing. Seek urgent medical help for reduced urination, ringing in the ears, hearing loss, severe dizziness, breathing difficulty or unusual muscle weakness.

title: Antegy 10 Tab (71) (Bilastine 20 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Antegy 10 Tab (71) (Bilastine 20 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Antegy 10 Tab (71) (Bilastine 20 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400025080
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Bilastine is an antihistamine used to relieve symptoms of allergies, such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, itchy or watery eyes, and skin itching or hives (urticaria).

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a chemical involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the label or by a doctor. Swallow with water, preferably on an empty stomach. Avoid taking it with food or fruit juice, as this may reduce its absorption.

Common side effects
Headache, sleepiness, dizziness, tiredness and nausea.

Precautions
Use only as advised during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Avoid driving or operating machinery if it causes sleepiness or dizziness. Tell a doctor about kidney problems or other medicines being taken. Seek medical help for severe allergic reactions such as swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

title: Antegy M 10 Tab (71) (Bilastine 20 Mg, Montelukast 10 Mg Tab) By Intas

searchText: Antegy M 10 Tab (71) (Bilastine 20 Mg, Montelukast 10 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400025081
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Bilastine 20 mg + montelukast 10 mg is used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Bilastine blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, which can contribute to inflammation and congestion in the airways and nose.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water and follow the product instructions about food and fruit juice, as these may affect bilastine absorption. Do not take extra doses.

Common side effects
Headache, sleepiness or tiredness, dizziness, stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Montelukast may rarely cause mood or behaviour changes, nightmares, sleep problems, anxiety, depression, or suicidal thoughts. Stop the medicine and seek medical advice promptly if these occur. This medicine is not intended for the immediate relief of an acute asthma attack. Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver or kidney problems, and all other medicines being used.

title: Anzyme 15 Tab (Fungal Diastase 100 Mg, Papain 60 Mg, Activated Charcoal 75 Mg Tab) By Intas

searchText: Anzyme 15 Tab (Fungal Diastase 100 Mg, Papain 60 Mg, Activated Charcoal 75 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400007049
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a digestive aid to help relieve indigestion, bloating and gas related to the digestion of food.

How does it work?
Fungal diastase and papain are digestive enzymes that help break down carbohydrates and proteins. Activated charcoal may help adsorb substances that contribute to gas and bloating in the gut.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow with water and keep it at least 2 hours apart from other oral medicines, as activated charcoal may reduce their absorption.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, vomiting or black-coloured stools may occur.

Precautions
Do not use for suspected poisoning unless advised by a medical professional. Avoid use if allergic to any ingredient, including papaya or papain. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, blood in the stool or ongoing digestive symptoms. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Anzyme Plus 200Ml (Fungal Diastase 12.5 Mg, Pepsin 7.5 Mg, Sorbitol 70% Syr) By Intas

searchText: Anzyme Plus 200Ml (Fungal Diastase 12.5 Mg, Pepsin 7.5 Mg, Sorbitol 70% Syr) By Intas Intas 400023911
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a digestive aid for indigestion, poor digestion and feelings of fullness or bloating after meals.

How does it work?
Fungal diastase helps break down carbohydrates, while pepsin helps digest proteins. Sorbitol is included as part of the formulation and may have a mild laxative effect in some people.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
May include stomach discomfort, nausea, abdominal cramps, loose stools or diarrhoea, especially due to sorbitol.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to any ingredient. People with hereditary fructose intolerance should avoid sorbitol-containing products. Stop use and seek medical advice for severe or persistent abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, blood in the stool or symptoms that do not improve.

What is it used for?
Cyproheptadine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy or watery eyes, skin itching and hives.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce itching, swelling and other allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. It may be taken with or without food. Do not take more than the recommended amount, and avoid driving until its effect is known.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and increased appetite or weight gain.

Precautions
It may cause sleepiness; avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or using machinery. Consult a doctor before use if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, asthma or other breathing problems. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cyproheptadine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itching, watery eyes, hives and other allergic skin reactions. It may also be prescribed for other conditions, such as poor appetite, only when directed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. It also has antiserotonin effects, which may contribute to some of its other prescribed uses.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed by the doctor or as stated on the label. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not take more than recommended. Avoid driving or operating machinery until its effect is known.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and increased appetite or weight gain.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that cause sleepiness unless advised by a doctor. Use medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate enlargement, asthma, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe drowsiness, confusion, breathing difficulty or a serious allergic reaction.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cyproheptadine syrup is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy or watery eyes, and skin itching or hives.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a chemical involved in allergic reactions. It may also cause drowsiness and increase appetite.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Measure the syrup with the supplied measuring device, and do not use a household spoon. Shake the bottle well before use. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, nausea, and increased appetite or weight gain.

Precautions
It may cause sleepiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Check with a doctor before use in young children, older adults, glaucoma, urinary retention, asthma, or liver or kidney problems. Avoid combining it with sleeping tablets, sedatives, or other medicines that cause drowsiness unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, severe dizziness, or swelling of the face or throat.

title: App Up Plus Syp 100 Ml (Cyproheptadine 2 Mg, Tricholine Citrate 275 Mg Syr) By Intas

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to stimulate appetite and support weight gain in people with poor appetite, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Cyproheptadine can increase appetite by blocking certain histamine and serotonin effects in the body. Tricholine citrate is included as a nutritional adjunct.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by the doctor or pharmacist. Measure the syrup with a proper measuring device and do not take more than recommended. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, increased appetite and weight gain. Nausea or stomach discomfort may also occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol because it can increase drowsiness. Use only after medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate enlargement, liver disease, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Do not use in children under 2 years unless specifically prescribed. Seek medical help for severe drowsiness, confusion, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

Used to help increase appetite in people with poor appetite or inadequate food intake. It may be prescribed to support weight gain when medically appropriate.

Cyproheptadine helps stimulate appetite and also has antihistamine activity. Tricholine citrate supports the formulation and may help improve appetite and digestion.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Measure the syrup with the supplied measuring device and do not take more than recommended. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving until its effects are known.

Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, increased appetite, nausea and stomach discomfort.

Avoid alcohol and use caution with driving or operating machinery. Inform the doctor if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, asthma, liver disease, or if sedative medicines are being taken. Seek medical advice if excessive sleepiness, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction occurs.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Atenolol is mainly used to treat high blood pressure. It may also be prescribed for angina (heart-related chest pain), certain irregular heartbeats and to help prevent migraine attacks.

How does it work?
It is a beta-blocker that slows the heart rate and reduces the force of the heartbeat. This lowers blood pressure and reduces the heart’s workload.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably at the same time each day. Do not stop taking it suddenly without medical advice, as this may worsen heart problems.

Common side effects
Feeling tired, dizziness, cold hands or feet, slow heartbeat, nausea and diarrhoea.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is asthma or other breathing disease, a slow heartbeat, heart conduction problems, diabetes or kidney disease. Atenolol may mask some warning signs of low blood sugar. Seek medical help for severe breathing difficulty, fainting, very slow heartbeat or worsening chest pain.

searchText: Atrotas 1Ml Inj (Atropine 0.6 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 400006821
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Atropine sulphate injection is used in hospitals and emergency care to increase a dangerously slow heart rate, reduce excessive saliva and airway secretions before some procedures, and help treat certain poisonings, such as organophosphate poisoning.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine on certain nerves. This can increase heart rate and reduce saliva, airway and other body secretions.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a doctor or nurse by injection. The dose and route depend on the condition being treated. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, blurred vision, sensitivity to light, fast heartbeat, constipation, difficulty passing urine, flushing and dizziness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is glaucoma, prostate or urinary difficulty, heart disease, bowel obstruction, fever, or thyroid problems. Seek urgent medical help for severe confusion, very fast or irregular heartbeat, difficulty passing urine, or vision problems.

title: Azintas 250 6 Tab (Azithromycin 250 Mg Tab) By Intas
