bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Belladonna plaster is used for temporary relief of local muscle and joint aches, including some rheumatic or nerve-related pain.

How does it work?
It releases belladonna extract through the skin. Belladonna contains substances that can reduce nerve-related pain and muscle spasm in the treated area.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply the plaster to clean, dry, unbroken skin as directed on the product pack or by a healthcare professional. Do not apply it to the eyes, mouth, wounds or irritated skin. Wash hands after applying or removing it.

Common side effects
Skin redness, itching, irritation or a rash at the application site. Stop use if severe irritation occurs.

Precautions
Do not use on broken skin or over large areas. Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes. Belladonna can rarely cause dry mouth, blurred vision, dizziness, fast heartbeat or confusion if absorbed in excess; remove the plaster and seek medical help if these occur. Keep away from children and do not use during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless advised by a healthcare professional.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to treat scabies and lice infestations. The cetrimide component also provides antiseptic action.

How does it work?
Gamma benzene hexachloride kills scabies mites and lice by affecting their nervous system. Cetrimide helps reduce germs on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid the eyes, mouth, mucous membranes and broken or inflamed skin. Wash hands after use unless the hands are the treated area. Do not swallow.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, burning, itching, redness or dryness may occur. Stop use and seek medical help for severe irritation, dizziness, tremors, confusion or seizures.

Precautions
Use only when specifically advised, as excessive use or application to large areas can cause serious toxicity. Avoid use in infants and young children, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or in people with a history of seizures unless prescribed by a healthcare professional. Keep away from children and avoid contact with the eyes.

title: Intas Compressor Nebulizer (Compressor Nebulizer) By Intas
name: Intas Compressor Nebulizer (Compressor Nebulizer) By Intas
searchText: Intas Compressor Nebulizer (Compressor Nebulizer) By Intas Intas 400027474
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
A compressor nebulizer is used to deliver prescribed liquid medicines into the lungs as a fine mist. It may be used to help manage breathing conditions such as asthma and other respiratory illnesses, when recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
The compressor pushes air through the liquid medicine, changing it into a mist that can be inhaled through a mask or mouthpiece.

How to take/use it
Use only the medicine and amount prescribed by a healthcare professional. Add the medicine to the nebulizer cup, attach the tubing and mask or mouthpiece, and breathe in the mist as directed. Sit upright during treatment. Clean and dry the nebulizer parts after each use according to the product instructions, and do not share the device.

Common side effects
The nebulizer itself usually does not cause side effects. The inhaled medicine may cause effects such as throat irritation, coughing, shakiness or a fast heartbeat, depending on the medicine used.

Precautions
Use the device only as instructed and do not use unprescribed solutions or oils. Keep the equipment clean to reduce the risk of infection. Seek urgent medical help if breathing difficulty becomes severe, symptoms suddenly worsen, or the prescribed treatment does not provide relief.

title: Intas Neem Soap 75Gm (Combo) (Neem Soap) By Intas
name: Intas Neem Soap 75Gm (Combo) (Neem Soap) By Intas
searchText: Intas Neem Soap 75Gm (Combo) (Neem Soap) By Intas Intas 400026809
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Neem soap is used for cleansing the skin and removing dirt, oil and sweat. It may be used as part of a routine skin-care regimen.

How does it work?
Soap cleans the skin by helping loosen oil, dirt and other substances so they can be rinsed away. The neem ingredient does not establish a specific medical treatment use from the information provided.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Wet the skin, apply the soap to form a lather, rinse thoroughly and dry gently. Avoid contact with the eyes.

Common side effects
Skin dryness, irritation, redness or itching may occur, especially in sensitive skin.

Precautions
Stop using it if significant irritation, rash or swelling develops. Avoid use on broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Keep away from the eyes and do not swallow.

title: Intas Ns 100 Ml (Sodium Chloride 0.9% W/V Infusion) By Intas
name: Intas Ns 100 Ml (Sodium Chloride 0.9% W/V Infusion) By Intas
searchText: Intas Ns 100 Ml (Sodium Chloride 0.9% W/V Infusion) By Intas Intas 400022383
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sodium chloride 0.9% is an isotonic saline solution. Depending on the product and route, it may be used by healthcare professionals to replace fluids and sodium, or for rinsing/irrigating areas such as the nose, eyes or wounds. The exact use depends on the product label.

How does it work?
It contains sodium and chloride in a concentration similar to body fluids. This helps replace fluid and electrolytes or gently rinse affected areas.

How to take/use it
Use only by the route and for the purpose stated on the product label or advised by a healthcare professional. Injectable products should be given only by trained healthcare professionals and must not be self-injected.

Common side effects
Side effects depend on how it is used. Mild irritation may occur with rinsing products. When given by injection, swelling or fluid overload may occur.

Precautions
Do not use an injectable product without medical supervision. Extra care is needed in people with heart failure, kidney problems or a tendency to retain fluid. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, marked swelling or worsening symptoms.

title: Intas Ors (Apple) 200 Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas
name: Intas Ors (Apple) 200 Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas
searchText: Intas Ors (Apple) 200 Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas Intas 400020060
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Oral rehydration solution is used to prevent or treat dehydration caused by diarrhoea, loose motions, vomiting or excessive fluid loss. It replaces water and essential salts lost from the body.

How does it work?
It contains water, electrolytes and glucose. These help the intestines absorb fluid and salts, restoring the body's fluid and electrolyte balance.

How to take/use it
Drink it as directed on the label, taking small, frequent sips. It is ready to drink, so do not dilute it unless the product instructions say otherwise. Use the product within the recommended period after opening.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting or mild stomach discomfort may occur, especially if it is consumed too quickly.

Precautions
Seek medical care for severe or persistent diarrhoea or vomiting, blood in the stool, very little urination, extreme weakness, confusion or signs of severe dehydration. People with kidney disease, heart failure or conditions requiring fluid or salt restriction should seek medical advice before use. This solution does not treat the underlying cause of diarrhoea.

title: Intas Ors (Nimbu Pani) 200 Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas
name: Intas Ors (Nimbu Pani) 200 Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas
searchText: Intas Ors (Nimbu Pani) 200 Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas Intas 400026896
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Oral rehydration solution helps prevent and treat dehydration caused by diarrhoea, vomiting, or excessive fluid loss. It replaces water and essential salts lost from the body.

How does it work?
It contains water, salts and glucose. The glucose and salts help the intestine absorb fluids more effectively.

How to take/use it
Drink by mouth in small, frequent sips. Use the ready-to-drink solution as supplied and follow the product label or healthcare professional’s advice. Do not add extra water or other ingredients unless instructed.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, bloating or mild stomach discomfort may occur, especially if taken too quickly.

Precautions
Seek medical help for severe dehydration, persistent vomiting, very little or no urination, blood in the stool, worsening symptoms or inability to drink. People with kidney disease, heart failure, or conditions requiring fluid or salt restriction should seek medical advice before use.

title: Intas Ors (Orange) 200Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas
name: Intas Ors (Orange) 200Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas
searchText: Intas Ors (Orange) 200Ml (Oral Rehydration Salts Oral Solution) By Intas Intas 400016910
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat dehydration caused by diarrhoea, vomiting, or excessive fluid loss by replacing lost water and salts.

How does it work?
It contains water, salts, and glucose. These help the body absorb fluids and restore the balance of water and electrolytes.

How to take/use it
Drink as directed on the product label. Take small, frequent sips, especially if feeling nauseous. Do not dilute or mix with other drinks unless the label instructs otherwise. Once opened, follow the storage and use instructions on the pack.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, or mild bloating may occur, particularly if consumed too quickly.

Precautions
Seek medical help if there are signs of severe dehydration, such as very little urine, extreme weakness, confusion, or drowsiness. Medical advice is also needed for persistent vomiting or diarrhoea, blood in the stool, high fever, or if the person cannot drink. People with kidney disease, heart failure, or conditions requiring fluid or salt restriction should consult a doctor before use.

title: Intaspas 10 Tab (Mefenamic Acid 250 Mg, Dicyclomine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Intaspas 10 Tab (Mefenamic Acid 250 Mg, Dicyclomine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Intaspas 10 Tab (Mefenamic Acid 250 Mg, Dicyclomine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas TW900011054
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used mainly to relieve menstrual cramps and abdominal pain caused by muscle spasms.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces the chemicals that cause pain and inflammation. Dicyclomine relaxes intestinal and abdominal muscles to reduce spasms and cramping.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed, preferably with or after food and with water. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Avoid taking other painkillers containing NSAIDs unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness, dry mouth and blurred vision.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to mefenamic acid, other NSAIDs or dicyclomine. Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, glaucoma, or difficulty passing urine. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially from 20 weeks onwards and in the last trimester. Seek urgent medical help for severe stomach pain, black stools, vomiting blood, breathing difficulty or facial swelling.

title: Intasporin Powder 10 Gm (Neomycin 5 Mg, Bacitracin 250 Iu, Sulphacetamide 60 Mg Sprinkling Powder) By Intas
name: Intasporin Powder 10 Gm (Neomycin 5 Mg, Bacitracin 250 Iu, Sulphacetamide 60 Mg Sprinkling Powder) By Intas
searchText: Intasporin Powder 10 Gm (Neomycin 5 Mg, Bacitracin 250 Iu, Sulphacetamide 60 Mg Sprinkling Powder) By Intas Intas 400013490
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to help treat superficial bacterial skin infections and infected minor wounds, cuts, abrasions or burns, as directed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It contains three antibacterial ingredients that work in different ways to stop the growth of bacteria and help control infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean and gently dry the affected area, then apply the powder as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not apply it to the eyes or mouth, and avoid breathing in the powder. Wash hands after use.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, redness, itching or skin irritation. Allergic skin reactions such as rash or swelling may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to neomycin, bacitracin, sulfonamides or any ingredient in the product. Avoid prolonged use or applying it over large areas unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop using it and seek medical help if severe rash, swelling, breathing difficulty or worsening infection occurs.

title: Intavital 15 Cap (Ginseng Extract 42.5 Mg, Multivitamin, Multiminerals Softgel Cap) By Intas
name: Intavital 15 Cap (Ginseng Extract 42.5 Mg, Multivitamin, Multiminerals Softgel Cap) By Intas
searchText: Intavital 15 Cap (Ginseng Extract 42.5 Mg, Multivitamin, Multiminerals Softgel Cap) By Intas Intas 400026747
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement helps provide vitamins, minerals and ginseng to support general nutritional health, especially when dietary intake may be inadequate. It is not a substitute for a balanced diet.

How does it work?
Vitamins and minerals support normal body functions such as energy production, immunity and metabolism. Ginseng is an herbal ingredient traditionally used as a general tonic, but its benefits may vary.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow the softgel with water and do not exceed the recommended amount. Avoid taking other multivitamin products at the same time unless advised.

Common side effects
Possible side effects include nausea, stomach discomfort, headache, difficulty sleeping or allergic reactions.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is diabetes, high blood pressure, kidney or liver disease. Consult a healthcare professional if taking blood thinners, diabetes medicines or other regular medicines. Stop use and seek medical help if a severe allergic reaction occurs.

title: Intazin 10 (20T) (Oval) (Cetirizine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Intazin 10 (20T) (Oval) (Cetirizine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Intazin 10 (20T) (Oval) (Cetirizine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400026574
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, itchy or watery eyes, and skin allergies such as hives.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance released during an allergic reaction. This helps reduce itching, sneezing, runny nose and other allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take this tablet exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow it with water; it may be taken with or without food. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Drowsiness or sleepiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, nausea and dizziness.

Precautions
It may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase sleepiness. Consult a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek urgent medical help for swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty or a severe rash.

title: Intazin-Am 10 Tab (Cetirizine 5 Mg, Ambroxol 60 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Intazin-Am 10 Tab (Cetirizine 5 Mg, Ambroxol 60 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Intazin-Am 10 Tab (Cetirizine 5 Mg, Ambroxol 60 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 7I900011054
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve cough with mucus (phlegm), especially when it occurs with allergy-related symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose or an itchy nose and throat.

How does it work?
Ambroxol helps loosen and thin mucus, making it easier to clear. Cetirizine is an antihistamine that reduces allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the label or by a doctor. Swallow with water and do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid driving or operating machinery if drowsiness occurs.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dry mouth, headache, nausea, stomach upset or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is kidney or liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Avoid alcohol and be cautious with other medicines that cause drowsiness. Stop use and seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, a severe rash or worsening symptoms.

title: Intazin-L 10 Tab (Levocetirizine 5 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Intazin-L 10 Tab (Levocetirizine 5 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Intazin-L 10 Tab (Levocetirizine 5 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400011541
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levocetirizine is used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, and itchy or watery eyes. It is also used to relieve itching and hives (urticaria).

How does it work?
It blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Swallow the tablet with water, with or without food, as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, tiredness, headache, and dry mouth.

Precautions
This medicine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid or limit alcohol, as it may increase drowsiness. Consult a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or a history of difficulty passing urine. Seek medical help for signs of a serious allergic reaction, such as swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

title: Intazin Syrup 30Ml (Cetirizine 5 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas
name: Intazin Syrup 30Ml (Cetirizine 5 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas
searchText: Intazin Syrup 30Ml (Cetirizine 5 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas Intas IZ109071274
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cetirizine oral solution is used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, itchy or watery eyes, and skin hives (urticaria).

How does it work?
It is an antihistamine that blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce itching, swelling, sneezing and watery discharge.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Measure the liquid with the supplied measuring device, and do not take more than recommended. It may cause drowsiness in some people.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, nausea and dizziness.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Consult a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if taking other medicines that cause drowsiness. Seek medical help urgently for swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty or a severe allergic reaction.

title: Interotas 5Ml (Bacillus Clausii 2 Billion Spores/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
name: Interotas 5Ml (Bacillus Clausii 2 Billion Spores/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
searchText: Interotas 5Ml (Bacillus Clausii 2 Billion Spores/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400025760
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Bacillus clausii is a probiotic used to help restore the natural balance of beneficial bacteria in the intestines, including during or after diarrhoea or other disturbances of gut flora.

How does it work?
It provides beneficial bacterial spores that can reach the intestine and help support the normal balance of gut bacteria.

How to take/use it
For oral use only. Take the suspension exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not mix it with hot liquids. Do not use a vial if it is damaged or the contents look unusual.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Occasional gas, bloating, nausea or stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if the person has a severely weakened immune system, is seriously ill or has a central venous catheter. Stop use and seek urgent medical help if signs of a serious allergic reaction occur. Medical advice is needed for severe, persistent or bloody diarrhoea, or signs of dehydration.

title: Kelac 10 Tab (Ketorolac Tromethamine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Kelac 10 Tab (Ketorolac Tromethamine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Kelac 10 Tab (Ketorolac Tromethamine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400003014
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketorolac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine used for short-term relief of moderate to severe acute pain, such as pain after surgery or injury. It is not intended for long-term or mild pain relief.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed, with a glass of water. Taking it with food may reduce stomach upset. Use the lowest effective amount for the shortest prescribed period. Do not take it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen, diclofenac, naproxen or aspirin unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Stomach pain or discomfort, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache and dizziness.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, severe kidney disease, or allergy to aspirin or other NSAIDs. Tell the doctor about heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma, dehydration, bleeding disorders, or use of blood thinners. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling, chest pain or markedly reduced urination. It should generally be avoided in pregnancy, especially from 20 weeks onwards and during the third trimester, unless specifically prescribed.

title: Kelac 1Ml Inj. (Ketorolac 30 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
name: Kelac 1Ml Inj. (Ketorolac 30 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
searchText: Kelac 1Ml Inj. (Ketorolac 30 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 400001882
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketorolac injection is used for the short-term relief of moderate to severe acute pain, such as pain after surgery. It is not intended for long-term pain treatment.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of prostaglandins, substances involved in pain, inflammation and fever. This helps reduce pain and swelling.

How to take/use it
This injection must be given by a doctor or nurse. Use it only as prescribed and do not take it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen, diclofenac or aspirin unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Stomach pain or indigestion, nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness and drowsiness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, dehydration, or allergy to aspirin or other NSAIDs. It may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and kidney problems. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or very little urine. Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically advised, especially after 20 weeks and in the last trimester.

title: Kelac Dt 15 Tab (Ketorolac Tromethamine 10 Mg Dt Tab) By Intas

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketorolac is used for short-term relief of moderate to severe acute pain, such as pain after surgery or injury. It is not intended for long-term or chronic pain relief.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed, with a full glass of water. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset. Do not take it for longer than prescribed or combine it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen, diclofenac or aspirin unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Stomach pain or discomfort, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness and diarrhoea.

Precautions
Avoid use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, severe kidney disease, or allergy to aspirin or other NSAIDs, unless specifically advised by a doctor. Use caution with heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma, dehydration or blood-thinning medicines. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or reduced urination. Avoid during pregnancy, especially from 20 weeks onwards, unless prescribed by a doctor.

title: Ketocort Inj 1 Ml (Triamcinolone Acetonide 40 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
name: Ketocort Inj 1 Ml (Triamcinolone Acetonide 40 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
searchText: Ketocort Inj 1 Ml (Triamcinolone Acetonide 40 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 400009200
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Triamcinolone acetonide injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and swelling in conditions such as painful or inflamed joints, allergic disorders, and other inflammatory conditions. The exact use depends on the condition and the injection site.

How does it work?
It reduces the activity of substances in the body that cause inflammation and allergic reactions. It also suppresses some immune responses.

How to take/use it
This injection must be given by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The route and injection site depend on the condition being treated. It should not be self-injected.

Common side effects
Pain or irritation at the injection site, increased blood sugar, indigestion, mood or sleep changes, and increased risk of infections may occur. Repeated or prolonged use can cause additional corticosteroid-related effects.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, glaucoma, osteoporosis, stomach ulcers, infections, or any other medical condition. Corticosteroids may worsen or hide infections and can affect blood sugar. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, and all medicines being used. Seek medical help for signs of a serious infection, severe allergic reaction, or vision changes.

title: Ketol 10 Gm (Ketoconazole 2% W/W) By Intas
name: Ketol 10 Gm (Ketoconazole 2% W/W) By Intas
searchText: Ketol 10 Gm (Ketoconazole 2% W/W) By Intas Intas 400018180
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% is an antifungal medicine used to treat fungal infections of the skin. Depending on the product form, it may also be used for dandruff or seborrhoeic dermatitis.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, helping to control and clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Use only on the affected area and follow the instructions on the product label or those given by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow it.

Common side effects
Application-site burning, stinging, itching, redness or irritation.

Precautions
For external use only. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs. Consult a healthcare professional if the infection worsens or does not improve.

title: Ketol 2% Shampoo 100 Ml (Ketoconazole 2% W/V Shampoo) By Intas
name: Ketol 2% Shampoo 100 Ml (Ketoconazole 2% W/V Shampoo) By Intas
searchText: Ketol 2% Shampoo 100 Ml (Ketoconazole 2% W/V Shampoo) By Intas Intas 400007159
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% is an antifungal medicine used to treat fungal infections of the skin and scalp, including conditions such as dandruff and seborrhoeic dermatitis when prescribed or labelled for these uses.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making ergosterol, an essential part of their cell membrane. This helps stop the growth of the fungus.

How to take/use it
Use it only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. If it is a topical preparation, use it on the affected skin or scalp as directed and avoid contact with the eyes. Do not use more often or for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, dryness or irritation at the application site.

Precautions
For external use only if supplied as a topical preparation. Avoid contact with the eyes and broken skin. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs. Tell a doctor if the infection does not improve or gets worse.

title: Ketol 2% Shampoo (7.5 Ml) (Combo) (Ketoconazole 2% W/V Shampoo) By Intas
name: Ketol 2% Shampoo (7.5 Ml) (Combo) (Ketoconazole 2% W/V Shampoo) By Intas
searchText: Ketol 2% Shampoo (7.5 Ml) (Combo) (Ketoconazole 2% W/V Shampoo) By Intas Intas 400027937
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 2% is a topical antifungal medicine used to treat fungal infections of the skin or scalp, including dandruff and seborrhoeic dermatitis when prescribed or recommended for these conditions.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making ergosterol, a substance they need to maintain their cell membranes. This helps control and clear the fungal infection.

How to take/use it
Use only on the skin or scalp, as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes and wash hands after use unless the hands are being treated. Do not swallow.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, dryness or irritation at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ketoconazole or any ingredient. Avoid applying to the eyes, mouth or severely damaged skin. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Ketolac Inj 1 Ml (Ketorolac Tromethamine 30 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
name: Ketolac Inj 1 Ml (Ketorolac Tromethamine 30 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
searchText: Ketolac Inj 1 Ml (Ketorolac Tromethamine 30 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 400007814
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketorolac injection is used for the short-term relief of moderate to severe acute pain, usually when an injection is needed.

How does it work?
It is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID). It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional as an injection. Use it only as prescribed and for the shortest duration advised. Do not take other NSAID painkillers, such as ibuprofen or diclofenac, unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain or indigestion, headache, dizziness, and pain or irritation at the injection site.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney disease, bleeding problems, heart disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an allergy to NSAIDs. It may increase the risk of stomach bleeding, kidney problems and allergic reactions. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling, or very little urine. It is generally avoided during pregnancy, especially in the later months, unless specifically advised by a doctor.

title: Ketol-B 10 Gm (Ketoconazole 2% W/W, Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025% W/W Cream) By Intas
name: Ketol-B 10 Gm (Ketoconazole 2% W/W, Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025% W/W Cream) By Intas
searchText: Ketol-B 10 Gm (Ketoconazole 2% W/W, Beclomethasone Dipropionate 0.025% W/W Cream) By Intas Intas 400018181
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to treat fungal infections accompanied by redness, itching or inflammation, such as ringworm and similar fungal rashes.

How does it work?
Ketoconazole stops the growth of fungi. Beclomethasone reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by skin inflammation.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to the affected skin exactly as prescribed, usually after cleaning and drying the area. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not cover the area tightly unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, irritation, dryness or redness at the application site. Prolonged or inappropriate use may cause skin thinning, stretch marks or changes in skin colour.

Precautions
Use only for the condition diagnosed by a healthcare professional, as the steroid may mask or worsen some infections. Do not use for longer than recommended. Avoid applying to large areas, broken skin, the face, skin folds or the genital area unless advised. Seek medical advice if the infection worsens, spreads or does not improve. Children, pregnant or breastfeeding women should use it only on medical advice.

It is an antihistamine that blocks the effects of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. It can also reduce alertness and cause drowsiness.

Take by mouth with water and swallow the softgel whole. Follow the dosage and frequency on the package or as directed by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than recommended.

Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty passing urine.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and do not drive or operate machinery if drowsy or less alert. Do not combine with other antihistamines, sleeping medicines or sedatives unless advised by a healthcare professional. It stops bacteria from making and repairing their genetic material, which kills the bacteria and helps clear the infection.

Use only as prescribed. Swallow the tablet whole with water and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not take it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc; follow the recommended time gap advised by the prescriber or pharmacist.

Precautions
Tell the prescriber about kidney problems, heart rhythm problems, tendon disorders, seizures, nerve problems or a history of reactions to quinolone antibiotics. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, irregular heartbeat, severe allergic symptoms or unusual mood or nerve-related changes. Levofloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the lungs, urinary tract, skin and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking enzymes they need to copy and repair their genetic material.

Precautions

searchText: Lycotas Syrup 200 Ml (Lycopene, Multivitamin, Multiminerals Syr) By Intas Intas 400007042
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This syrup is a nutritional supplement used to help prevent or correct vitamin and mineral deficiencies and support general nutritional needs when the diet is inadequate. Lycopene provides an antioxidant nutrient. It is not a treatment for a specific disease unless prescribed for that purpose.

How does it work?
The vitamins and minerals support normal body functions, including energy production, immunity and tissue maintenance. Lycopene acts as an antioxidant.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Use the measuring device provided and do not exceed the recommended amount. Do not use it as a substitute for a balanced diet.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, constipation or diarrhoea may occur. Some formulations may also cause temporary changes in stool or urine colour.

Precautions
Check the ingredients if there is an allergy or sensitivity to any component. Avoid taking other multivitamin or mineral supplements at the same time unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or in people with kidney or liver disease or other long-term medical conditions. Keep out of reach of children; accidental overdose of some vitamins or minerals can be harmful.

title: L- Zine 10 Tab (Levocetirizine 5 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: L- Zine 10 Tab (Levocetirizine 5 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: L- Zine 10 Tab (Levocetirizine 5 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400007655
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levocetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, itchy or watery eyes, and skin hives (urticaria).

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take the tablet exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow it with water; it may generally be taken with or without food. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Drowsiness or sleepiness, tiredness, headache, and dry mouth.

Precautions
Drowsiness may occur; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase sleepiness. People with kidney problems, or those who are pregnant or breastfeeding, should seek medical advice before use. Seek medical help for signs of a serious allergic reaction, such as swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

title: Mecofol 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 500 Mcg Tab) By Intas
name: Mecofol 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 500 Mcg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Mecofol 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 500 Mcg Tab) By Intas Intas 400001990
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylcobalamin is a form of vitamin B12 used to prevent or treat vitamin B12 deficiency. Vitamin B12 deficiency can contribute to certain types of anaemia and nerve-related symptoms such as tingling or numbness.

How does it work?
It supplies vitamin B12, which is needed for healthy red blood cell formation and normal nerve function.

How to take/use it
Use it only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount. The appropriate treatment depends on the cause and severity of vitamin B12 deficiency.

Common side effects
It is generally well tolerated. Nausea, diarrhoea, headache or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it if allergic to methylcobalamin or any ingredient in the product. Seek medical advice if symptoms such as persistent tiredness, numbness or tingling continue, as the underlying cause may need evaluation. People with significant anaemia or nerve symptoms should use it under medical guidance.

title: Mecofol Forte Inj 2 Ml (Methylcobalamin 2500 Mcg, Pyridoxine 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg Inj 2 Ml) By Intas
name: Mecofol Forte Inj 2 Ml (Methylcobalamin 2500 Mcg, Pyridoxine 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg Inj 2 Ml) By Intas
searchText: Mecofol Forte Inj 2 Ml (Methylcobalamin 2500 Mcg, Pyridoxine 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg Inj 2 Ml) By Intas Intas 400011740
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat deficiencies of vitamin B12, vitamin B6 and niacinamide. These vitamins help support normal nerve function, red blood cell formation and energy metabolism.

How does it work?
It replenishes important B vitamins needed for healthy nerves, blood cells and normal energy production.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as directed by the doctor or according to the product label. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Swallow with water.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset or headache may occur.

Precautions
This product contains a high dose of vitamin B6. Prolonged or excessive use may cause nerve problems such as tingling, numbness or burning sensations; stop use and seek medical advice if these occur. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is liver or kidney disease. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken.

title: Mecofol-Od 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg Tab) By Intas
name: Mecofol-Od 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Mecofol-Od 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg Tab) By Intas Intas 400001991
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylcobalamin is a form of vitamin B12 used to prevent or treat vitamin B12 deficiency. Vitamin B12 deficiency can lead to megaloblastic anaemia and nerve-related symptoms such as tingling or numbness.

How does it work?
It supplies vitamin B12, which the body needs to make healthy red blood cells and maintain normal nerve function.

How to take/use it
Take or use it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. The dose and duration depend on the severity and cause of vitamin B12 deficiency and the product form.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, headache or skin rash may occur. Seek medical help for signs of a serious allergic reaction, such as facial swelling or difficulty breathing.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional about any previous allergy to vitamin B12 or cobalt. The cause of vitamin B12 deficiency should be assessed, especially if there is anaemia, persistent tingling or numbness, or weakness. Do not self-treat ongoing symptoms without medical advice.

title: Mecofol Plus D3 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mcg, Pyridoxine 3 Mg, Cholecalciferol 1000 Iu Tab) By Intas
name: Mecofol Plus D3 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mcg, Pyridoxine 3 Mg, Cholecalciferol 1000 Iu Tab) By Intas
searchText: Mecofol Plus D3 10 Tab (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mcg, Pyridoxine 3 Mg, Cholecalciferol 1000 Iu Tab) By Intas Intas 400022281
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination provides vitamins and alpha-lipoic acid to support normal nerve function and help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies. It may be used as a nutritional supplement for symptoms such as tingling or numbness when recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Methylcobalamin, folic acid and pyridoxine help support healthy nerve function and blood-cell formation. Alpha-lipoic acid provides antioxidant support, while vitamin D supports normal muscle and bone function.

How to take/use it
Use only in the amount and for the duration recommended on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount or combine it with other vitamin supplements without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache or skin rash may occur. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of a serious allergic reaction occur.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional about all medicines and supplements being used. People taking diabetes medicines should seek advice before use because alpha-lipoic acid may affect blood sugar. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in case of a known allergy to any ingredient.

title: Mecofol Plus Inj 2Ml (Dispo Pack) (Methylcobalamin 1000 Mcg, Vitamin B6 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg Inj) By Intas
name: Mecofol Plus Inj 2Ml (Dispo Pack) (Methylcobalamin 1000 Mcg, Vitamin B6 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg Inj) By Intas
searchText: Mecofol Plus Inj 2Ml (Dispo Pack) (Methylcobalamin 1000 Mcg, Vitamin B6 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg Inj) By Intas Intas 400026407
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat deficiencies of vitamin B12, vitamin B6 and nicotinamide. It may also be used when these deficiencies contribute to nerve-related symptoms or certain blood-related problems.

How does it work?
It replenishes important B vitamins needed for normal nerve function, red blood cell formation and energy metabolism.

How to take/use it
This is an injectable medicine and should be given by a healthcare professional. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the medical condition and should be followed as prescribed. Do not self-inject.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site, nausea, headache or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to vitamin B12, vitamin B6, nicotinamide or similar injections. Use only under medical supervision, especially if repeated doses are needed, as prolonged high-dose vitamin B6 may affect the nerves. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe rash after the injection.

title: Mecofol Plus Inj 2 Ml (Methylcobalamin 1000 Mcg, Vitamin B6 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg/2 Ml Inj) By Intas
name: Mecofol Plus Inj 2 Ml (Methylcobalamin 1000 Mcg, Vitamin B6 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg/2 Ml Inj) By Intas
searchText: Mecofol Plus Inj 2 Ml (Methylcobalamin 1000 Mcg, Vitamin B6 100 Mg, Nicotinamide 100 Mg/2 Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 400026405
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used when prescribed for vitamin B-group deficiency and related nerve problems, including symptoms such as tingling or numbness.

How does it work?
It replenishes methylcobalamin (vitamin B12), vitamin B6 and nicotinamide, which support normal nerve function and blood-cell formation.

How to take/use it
This is an injection and should be given by a healthcare professional. The dose and treatment schedule depend on the medical condition and should be followed exactly as prescribed.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; nausea, headache or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to vitamin B12, vitamin B6, nicotinamide or injection ingredients. Do not use repeatedly or for a long period without medical supervision, as high-dose vitamin B6 can cause or worsen nerve damage. Seek medical help for severe rash, breathing difficulty or worsening numbness or tingling.

title: Mecofol Plus Nf 10 Cap (Combo) (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mcg, Pyridoxine 3 Mg Cap) By Intas
name: Mecofol Plus Nf 10 Cap (Combo) (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mcg, Pyridoxine 3 Mg Cap) By Intas
searchText: Mecofol Plus Nf 10 Cap (Combo) (Methylcobalamin 1500 Mcg, Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mcg, Pyridoxine 3 Mg Cap) By Intas Intas 400026359
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used as nutritional support for nerve health and to supplement vitamins involved in normal nerve function and blood-cell formation. It may be used when additional vitamin B12, vitamin B6, folic acid or alpha lipoic acid is needed. It should not replace medical treatment for diagnosed nerve problems.

How does it work?
Methylcobalamin, pyridoxine and folic acid support normal nerve function and red blood cell formation. Alpha lipoic acid is an antioxidant involved in energy metabolism and may help protect cells from oxidative stress.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Swallow with water and do not exceed the recommended amount. Do not continue for a long period without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, diarrhoea, headache or skin rash may occur. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of a serious allergic reaction occur.

Precautions
People with diabetes should monitor their blood sugar, as alpha lipoic acid may lower blood sugar when used with diabetes medicines. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is a known allergy to any ingredient. Seek medical advice for persistent numbness, weakness, burning pain or other worsening nerve symptoms.

title: Meflotas Tab 2 Tab (D) (71) (Mefloquine 250 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Meflotas Tab 2 Tab (D) (71) (Mefloquine 250 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Meflotas Tab 2 Tab (D) (71) (Mefloquine 250 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 800007202
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Mefloquine is used to prevent and treat malaria, a serious infection spread by mosquito bites.

How does it work?
It kills the malaria parasite in the blood by interfering with processes the parasite needs to survive.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by a doctor. The dose and schedule depend on whether it is being used for prevention or treatment. Take it with food and plenty of water, and complete the prescribed course. Do not self-medicate or use it for unexplained fever.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain, dizziness, headache, sleep disturbance, vivid dreams and tiredness.

Precautions
Mefloquine can cause serious mental, neurological or balance-related effects. Contact a doctor urgently for severe anxiety, depression, confusion, hallucinations, suicidal thoughts, seizures, fainting, severe dizziness or palpitations. Tell the doctor about any history of depression, anxiety or other psychiatric illness, seizures, heart rhythm problems, or liver disease. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizzy or affected by sleep or mood changes. Seek medical care promptly for fever during or after travel to a malaria-risk area, even if mefloquine has been taken.

title: Megamentin-1200 Inj (Amoxycillin 1 G, Potassium Clavulanate 200 Mg Inj) By Intas
name: Megamentin-1200 Inj (Amoxycillin 1 G, Potassium Clavulanate 200 Mg Inj) By Intas
searchText: Megamentin-1200 Inj (Amoxycillin 1 G, Potassium Clavulanate 200 Mg Inj) By Intas Intas 400001916
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxycillin with clavulanate is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the lungs, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxycillin kills bacteria by preventing them from building their protective cell wall. Clavulanate helps protect amoxycillin from enzymes made by some bacteria, allowing it to work against a wider range of bacteria.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or other healthcare professional. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of the infection, kidney function and other medical factors. Complete the prescribed course unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, skin rash and pain or redness at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if there is a history of serious allergy to penicillin, amoxycillin, clavulanate or related antibiotics. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, previous antibiotic-related jaundice or liver problems, and any medicines being taken. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe skin rash, persistent or bloody diarrhoea, or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Megamentin-375 10 Tab (Amoxycillin 250 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 125 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Megamentin-375 10 Tab (Amoxycillin 250 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 125 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Megamentin-375 10 Tab (Amoxycillin 250 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 125 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400026738
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxycillin with potassium clavulanate is an antibiotic used to treat various bacterial infections, such as infections of the ears, sinuses, throat, chest, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxycillin kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from forming their protective cell wall. Potassium clavulanate helps amoxycillin work against bacteria that can otherwise resist it.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and preferably with a meal to reduce stomach upset. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not share leftover antibiotics or use them for a future illness.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, indigestion and skin rash may occur. Thrush can also develop.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has previously been a serious allergy to penicillin, amoxycillin, clavulanate or related antibiotics. Tell the healthcare professional about previous antibiotic-related diarrhoea, liver problems or kidney problems. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, a severe skin reaction, persistent or bloody diarrhoea, or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Megamentin-625 10 Tab (Amoxycillin 500 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 125 Mg Tab) By Intas

searchText: Megamentin-625 10 Tab (Amoxycillin 500 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 125 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400013921
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the ear, sinuses, throat, lungs, skin, urinary tract and teeth, when prescribed by a healthcare professional. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxycillin kills susceptible bacteria by stopping them from building their protective cell wall. Potassium clavulanate helps protect amoxycillin from enzymes made by some bacteria, allowing it to work against a wider range of infections.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed, preferably with a meal to reduce stomach upset. Complete the prescribed course even if symptoms improve. Do not share it or use leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, indigestion, skin rash and thrush may occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to amoxycillin, penicillins or related antibiotics. Inform the healthcare professional about kidney or liver problems and any previous antibiotic-related jaundice or liver problems. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, a severe skin reaction, or severe or persistent diarrhoea. Tell the healthcare professional about other medicines, especially blood thinners such as warfarin or methotrexate.

searchText: Megamentin Duo 30Ml (Amoxycillin 200 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 28.5 Mg/5 Ml Dry Syr) By Intas Intas 400002960
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxycillin with clavulanate is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the ears, throat, sinuses, chest, urinary tract, skin and teeth. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxycillin damages the protective cell wall of bacteria. Clavulanate helps protect amoxycillin from substances made by some bacteria that can otherwise make the antibiotic ineffective.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by the doctor. If it is a liquid suspension, shake the bottle well before each use and measure the dose with an appropriate measuring device. Take it with food if advised, and complete the prescribed course even if symptoms improve. Do not use leftover antibiotics or share them with others.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort and skin rash may occur. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset.

Precautions
Do not use it if there has been a serious allergy to penicillin, amoxycillin, or similar antibiotics. Inform the doctor about liver disease, kidney disease, or previous diarrhoea related to antibiotic use. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, severe rash, persistent or bloody diarrhoea, or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Merotas 1 Gm (Meropenem 1000 Mg) By Intas
name: Merotas 1 Gm (Meropenem 1000 Mg) By Intas
searchText: Merotas 1 Gm (Meropenem 1000 Mg) By Intas Intas 400009682
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Meropenem is a strong antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, such as infections of the lungs, abdomen, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, blood, or brain. It does not work against viral infections.

How does it work?
It kills bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall, helping stop the infection from spreading.

How to take/use it
Meropenem is given into a vein by a doctor or nurse, usually in a hospital or healthcare setting. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function, and medical advice.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea or vomiting, headache, rash, and pain, redness or swelling at the injection site.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about allergies to meropenem, penicillins, cephalosporins or other antibiotics, kidney problems, seizures, or nervous-system disorders. Tell the doctor about all medicines being used, especially valproate. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, facial swelling, breathing difficulty, seizures, or a severe skin rash.

title: Methygin 10 T (Methylergometrine 0.125 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Methygin 10 T (Methylergometrine 0.125 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Methygin 10 T (Methylergometrine 0.125 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400026781
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylergometrine maleate is used after childbirth or certain pregnancy-related procedures to help the uterus contract and control or prevent heavy bleeding caused by poor uterine contraction.

How does it work?
It increases the strength of uterine contractions, helping the uterus tighten and reduce bleeding.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor, usually after childbirth or a pregnancy-related procedure. Do not use it during pregnancy unless specifically directed by a specialist. Do not self-medicate for heavy bleeding; seek urgent medical care.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, abdominal cramps and increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if there is high blood pressure, pre-eclampsia or eclampsia, heart or blood-vessel disease, or a history of stroke. Seek urgent medical help for severe headache, chest pain, breathing difficulty, seizures, or very heavy or persistent bleeding.

title: Mifucet 500 10 Tab (Mefenamic Acid 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Mifucet 500 10 Tab (Mefenamic Acid 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Mifucet 500 10 Tab (Mefenamic Acid 500 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400011932
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Mefenamic acid is used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain, including menstrual cramps and other body pain.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed, preferably with or after food and with water. Use the lowest effective amount for the shortest time advised. Do not take it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen, naproxen or aspirin unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Stomach pain or indigestion, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, dizziness and headache.

Precautions
Avoid or seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to NSAID medicines. Inform the doctor if taking blood thinners or other medicines. Avoid during pregnancy unless specifically prescribed, especially from 20 weeks onwards and in the last 3 months. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a serious skin rash.

title: Mifucet Sus 60 Ml (Mefenamic Acid 50 Mg/5 Ml, Paracetamol 125 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
name: Mifucet Sus 60 Ml (Mefenamic Acid 50 Mg/5 Ml, Paracetamol 125 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
searchText: Mifucet Sus 60 Ml (Mefenamic Acid 50 Mg/5 Ml, Paracetamol 125 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400009202
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and fever.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Mefenamic acid is an anti-inflammatory medicine that reduces substances involved in pain, swelling and fever.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Shake the bottle well and measure the liquid with the supplied measuring device. Do not take more than prescribed or use it with other medicines containing paracetamol or mefenamic acid/other NSAIDs.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, indigestion or dizziness.

Precautions
Use cautiously in children with dehydration, stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver problems, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an allergy to NSAIDs. Avoid use with other paracetamol-containing or NSAID medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, vomiting blood or black stools.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve occasional constipation and make stools easier to pass.

How does it work?
Milk of magnesia draws water into the bowel to soften the stool and promote bowel movement. Liquid paraffin lubricates the stool and bowel, helping it pass more easily.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than recommended or use it for a prolonged period without medical advice. Drink adequate fluids unless fluid restriction has been advised.

Common side effects
Loose stools or diarrhoea, abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea and stomach discomfort. Liquid paraffin may occasionally cause oily leakage from the rectum.

Precautions
Do not use it for severe or persistent abdominal pain, vomiting, or suspected bowel blockage unless advised by a doctor. Ask a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, difficulty swallowing, or ongoing constipation. Avoid prolonged or frequent use without medical advice, as it may cause fluid or electrolyte problems and reduce absorption of some nutrients or medicines. Seek medical advice if constipation does not improve or if there is blood in the stool.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of constipation and to help make stools softer and easier to pass.

How does it work?
Milk of magnesia draws water into the bowel, liquid paraffin lubricates and softens the stool, and sodium picosulphate stimulates bowel movement.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Measure the liquid carefully, do not exceed the recommended amount, and drink adequate fluids unless otherwise advised. Do not use it for a prolonged period without medical advice.

Common side effects
Abdominal cramps, loose stools or diarrhoea, nausea, bloating and increased bowel movements.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if there is severe or unexplained abdominal pain, vomiting, suspected bowel blockage or rectal bleeding. Use cautiously in kidney disease or if dehydrated. Stop and seek medical advice if constipation continues, diarrhoea is severe, or there is weakness, dizziness or reduced urination.

What is it used for?
Used to relieve mild to moderate pain and reduce fever.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces the production of substances that cause pain, inflammation and fever. Paracetamol also helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth only as directed by a doctor or the product label. Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with an accurate measuring device. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or another NSAID painkiller unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Use in children only according to medical advice or the recommended age and weight-based instructions. Avoid or seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to NSAIDs. Avoid use during the last three months of pregnancy unless specifically prescribed. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe skin rash, black stools, vomiting blood, or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Monoloc-150 30 Tab (Ranitidine 150 Mg Tab) By Intas

searchText: Monoloc-150 30 Tab (Ranitidine 150 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400025669
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine is used to reduce excess stomach acid and relieve heartburn, acid indigestion and symptoms of acid reflux (GERD). It may also be prescribed for treating or preventing stomach and intestinal ulcers.

How does it work?
It blocks H2 receptors in the stomach, reducing the amount of acid produced. This helps relieve acid-related symptoms and allows ulcers to heal.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. It may be taken with or without food. Do not take more or use it for longer than advised. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or return frequently.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach pain, constipation or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney or liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if other medicines are being taken. Seek urgent medical help for vomiting blood, black stools, severe stomach pain, difficulty swallowing, or unexplained weight loss. Ranitidine use or availability may be restricted in some countries because of safety concerns about impurities; use it only when advised by a qualified healthcare professional.

title: Monoloc Inj 2Ml Amp (Ranitidine 25 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine injection is used to reduce excess stomach acid in conditions such as acidity, heartburn, stomach ulcers and acid reflux. It may be used when medicine cannot be taken by mouth.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine H2 receptors in the stomach, which reduces the production of stomach acid.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or nurse. It should not be self-administered. The dose and duration depend on the condition and should be decided by the treating doctor.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhoea or constipation, and pain or irritation at the injection site.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, a history of acute porphyria, allergies, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being used. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, severe rash, confusion, or an irregular heartbeat. Persistent or unexplained stomach symptoms should be medically assessed.

title: Montas-Ab 10 Tab (Montelukast 10 Mg, Acebrophylline 200 Mg Sr Tab) By Intas

searchText: Montas-Ab 10 Tab (Montelukast 10 Mg, Acebrophylline 200 Mg Sr Tab) By Intas Intas 400021330
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help control asthma and other obstructive airway conditions, such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), by reducing airway narrowing, breathing difficulty and mucus-related symptoms. It is not intended to provide immediate relief during a sudden breathing attack.

How does it work?
Montelukast blocks substances that cause airway inflammation and narrowing. Acebrophylline helps relax the airways and improve mucus clearance, making breathing easier.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed. Swallow the sustained-release tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Use it regularly as directed and do not take an extra dose if one is missed without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, dizziness, tremor or palpitations.

Precautions
This medicine is not a substitute for a rescue inhaler during an acute asthma or breathing attack. Inform the doctor about liver, kidney, heart or seizure problems, peptic ulcers, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being taken. Seek medical advice promptly for worsening breathing, severe palpitations, allergic reactions, or mood or behaviour changes such as agitation, depression or suicidal thoughts.

title: Montas-Al 10 Tab (Montelukast 10 Mg, Levocetirizine 5 Mg, Ambroxol 75 Mg Sr Tab) By Intas
name: Montas-Al 10 Tab (Montelukast 10 Mg, Levocetirizine 5 Mg, Ambroxol 75 Mg Sr Tab) By Intas
searchText: Montas-Al 10 Tab (Montelukast 10 Mg, Levocetirizine 5 Mg, Ambroxol 75 Mg Sr Tab) By Intas Intas 400027884
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for allergy-related nose and airway symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, and cough with thick mucus. It may be prescribed when allergy symptoms occur along with mucus in the airways.

How does it work?
Montelukast reduces allergy-related airway inflammation, while levocetirizine blocks histamine to relieve allergy symptoms. Ambroxol helps thin and loosen mucus so it can be cleared more easily.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed. Swallow the sustained-release tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not take more or use it for longer than advised. This medicine is not a rescue treatment for a sudden asthma or breathing attack.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, stomach discomfort, indigestion or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Drowsiness may occur; avoid driving or alcohol if affected. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being used. Seek medical advice promptly for mood or behaviour changes, unusual thoughts, severe rash, facial swelling or difficulty breathing. Do not use it to treat a sudden asthma attack.

title: Montas-Fx 10 Tab (Montelukast 10 Mg, Fexofenadine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas

searchText: Montas-Fx 10 Tab (Montelukast 10 Mg, Fexofenadine 10 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400019220
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis (hay fever), such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Fexofenadine blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals that can contribute to inflammation and nasal allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed and swallow the tablet whole with water. Do not take it with apple, orange or grapefruit juice, as these may reduce fexofenadine absorption. Avoid taking aluminium- or magnesium-containing antacids close to this medicine unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Headache, dizziness, nausea, tiredness, dry mouth and stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Montelukast has been linked to mood or behaviour changes, unusual dreams, sleep problems, anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts. Seek medical advice promptly if any such changes occur. This medicine is not intended for sudden asthma attacks. Tell the doctor about kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and any other medicines being taken.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis (hay fever), such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, nose or throat itching, and watery or itchy eyes. It may also be prescribed as an add-on treatment for asthma in some patients.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, which can contribute to nasal swelling and breathing-related symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not take more than the recommended amount. This medicine does not relieve a sudden asthma or breathing attack.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, headache, dry mouth, tiredness, abdominal pain, nausea, or sore throat may occur.

Precautions
Drowsiness may occur; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effect is known. Contact a doctor promptly if there are unusual mood or behaviour changes, sleep problems, agitation, depression, or thoughts of self-harm. Inform the doctor about kidney disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Do not stop prescribed asthma treatment without medical advice.

bodyHtml:

This medicine is used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, nasal itching and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Montelukast blocks substances called leukotrienes that contribute to allergy-related inflammation. Levocetirizine blocks histamine, another substance responsible for allergy symptoms.

Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed. Swallow the film-coated tablet whole with water. Do not take more than recommended. This medicine is not meant to provide immediate relief during a sudden asthma attack.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, headache, tiredness, dry mouth, stomach discomfort or abdominal pain may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful with driving or operating machinery until the effect on alertness is known. Tell the doctor about kidney problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or a history of mental health problems. Contact the doctor promptly if unusual mood or behaviour changes, nightmares, sleep problems, anxiety, depression or thoughts of self-harm occur. Seek urgent medical help for signs of a severe allergic reaction, such as swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

bodyHtml:

Used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, and itchy or watery eyes.

How does it work?
Montelukast blocks substances involved in allergy-related inflammation. Levocetirizine is an antihistamine that reduces allergy symptoms such as sneezing, itching and a runny nose.

Take by mouth exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Use regularly as directed and do not stop or change treatment without medical advice.

Sleepiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth and stomach discomfort may occur.

Levocetirizine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or alcohol until its effects are known. Inform the doctor about kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, and itchy or watery eyes. It may also be prescribed as an add-on treatment for some people with asthma, but it does not relieve a sudden asthma attack.

How does it work?
Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals that contribute to allergy and airway inflammation. Levocetirizine is an antihistamine that reduces allergy symptoms such as sneezing, itching and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed. Shake the bottle well before use and measure the liquid with the supplied measuring device. Do not take more than the prescribed amount. Follow the prescribed schedule and duration.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach pain or discomfort, and nausea may occur.

Precautions
Levocetirizine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or alcohol until its effects are known. Tell the doctor about kidney disease or any previous allergy to this medicine. Montelukast may rarely cause mood or behaviour changes, nightmares, sleep problems, depression or suicidal thoughts; stop the medicine and seek medical help promptly if these occur. This medicine should not be used to treat a sudden asthma attack.

name: Montas-L Syp 60 Ml (Montelukast 4 Mg/5 Ml, Levocetirizine 2.5 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas
searchText: Montas-L Syp 60 Ml (Montelukast 4 Mg/5 Ml, Levocetirizine 2.5 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas Intas 400015970
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergies such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose or throat, and watery or itchy eyes. It may also be prescribed as an add-on treatment for certain breathing problems related to asthma, but it does not provide quick relief during an asthma attack.

How does it work?
Montelukast blocks chemicals involved in airway inflammation and allergy symptoms. Levocetirizine is an antihistamine that reduces the effects of histamine, helping relieve common allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by the doctor. Measure the liquid with the provided measuring device and do not exceed the prescribed amount. Do not use it as a rescue medicine for sudden breathing difficulty.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid activities requiring alertness if affected. Tell the doctor about kidney problems or other medicines being used. Seek medical advice if there are mood or behaviour changes, unusual dreams, agitation, or thoughts of self-harm. Seek urgent help for severe breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

searchText: Moxiflotas 100 Ml (Moxifloxacin 400 Mg) By Intas Intas 400022481
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Moxifloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections. It does not work for viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops bacteria from making the genetic material they need to grow and survive.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow the tablet with water, with or without food. Do not take it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc; ask a pharmacist about suitable spacing.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, headache and dizziness.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice. Seek urgent medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, fainting or a fast/irregular heartbeat, or signs of a serious allergic reaction. Tell the doctor about heart-rhythm problems, tendon disorders, nerve problems, myasthenia gravis, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all medicines being used.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxycillin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the ear, throat, chest, skin, urinary tract and teeth. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by stopping them from building their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. It may be taken with or without food. Do not share leftover antibiotics with others.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and skin rash.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been a serious allergy to amoxycillin, penicillin or related antibiotics. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, or a severe skin reaction. Contact a doctor if diarrhoea is severe or persistent. Use only under medical advice, especially during pregnancy, breastfeeding or if there is kidney disease.

title: Moxinta Clav 625 (10 T) (Amoxycillin 500 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 125 Mg Tab) By Intas

searchText: Moxinta Clav 625 (10 T) (Amoxycillin 500 Mg, Potassium Clavulanate 125 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400026736
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Amoxycillin with potassium clavulanate is a prescription antibiotic used to treat a range of bacterial infections, such as infections of the ear, sinuses, lungs, skin, urinary tract or teeth. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Amoxycillin kills susceptible bacteria by stopping them from building their protective cell wall. Potassium clavulanate helps protect amoxycillin from enzymes made by some bacteria, allowing it to work against more bacterial strains.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with a meal, and complete the prescribed course even if symptoms improve. Do not share it or use leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach discomfort, headache, skin rash and fungal infections such as oral or vaginal thrush.

Precautions
Do not use it if there has been a serious allergy to amoxycillin, penicillins, cephalosporins or similar antibiotics. Inform the doctor about kidney or liver problems, previous antibiotic-related jaundice or colitis, or glandular fever. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, a severe blistering rash, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or severe or persistent diarrhoea.

What is it used for?
Amoxycillin is an antibiotic used to treat infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It does not work for viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from forming their protective cell wall.
