Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. It may be taken with or without food. Do not share leftover antibiotics with others.

Used for temporary relief of acidity, heartburn and acid-related stomach discomfort or pain.

How does it work?

How to take/use it
Use by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Ask a pharmacist about spacing it from other medicines, as antacids can affect their absorption.

title: Nausetil 10 Tab (Prochlorperazine 5 Mg Tab) By Intas

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Prochlorperazine is mainly used to control nausea and vomiting. It may also be prescribed for severe dizziness or vertigo.

How does it work?
It blocks dopamine signals in areas of the brain that trigger nausea and vomiting. It also reduces abnormal signals involved in vertigo.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet with water and do not take more than directed. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or using machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision and headache. It may also cause restlessness, muscle stiffness or tremors.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is Parkinson’s disease, epilepsy, glaucoma, prostate or urinary problems, liver disease, heart rhythm problems, or a history of involuntary movements. Seek urgent medical help for severe muscle stiffness, high fever, confusion, fainting, or uncontrolled movements.

bodyHtml:

This topical antibiotic combination is used to help prevent or treat bacterial infection in minor cuts, scrapes, and other small skin wounds.

How does it work?
Neomycin, polymyxin B, and bacitracin work together to stop the growth of susceptible bacteria on the skin.

How to take/use it
Clean and dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, redness, itching, or rash. Neomycin may cause allergic skin reactions in some people.

Precautions
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, and inside of the nose. Do not apply to large areas, deep wounds, serious burns, or animal bites unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop using it and seek medical help if severe rash, swelling, breathing difficulty, worsening infection, or no improvement occurs.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and fever.

title: Nimucet-Mr 10 Tab (Nimesulide 100 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg, Chlorzoxazone 375 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Nimucet-Mr 10 Tab (Nimesulide 100 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg, Chlorzoxazone 375 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Nimucet-Mr 10 Tab (Nimesulide 100 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg, Chlorzoxazone 375 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400000097
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of painful muscle and joint conditions, especially pain associated with muscle stiffness or spasms.

How does it work?
Nimesulide and paracetamol help reduce pain, while nimesulide also reduces inflammation. Chlorzoxazone acts on the central nervous system to help relax muscles and relieve spasms.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor, preferably with or after food. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol, nimesulide or similar painkillers unless advised by a doctor. Avoid alcohol and do not drive if drowsy or dizzy.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, diarrhoea, dizziness and drowsiness may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice if there is liver or kidney disease, stomach ulcer, a history of gastrointestinal bleeding, or regular alcohol use. Avoid prolonged use unless specifically advised. Stop and seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, severe skin rash, breathing difficulty, unusual bleeding or severe stomach pain. Not usually recommended during pregnancy, especially late pregnancy, unless prescribed.

title: Nizol 10 Tab (Alu-Alu) (Ketoconazole 200 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Nizol 10 Tab (Alu-Alu) (Ketoconazole 200 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Nizol 10 Tab (Alu-Alu) (Ketoconazole 200 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400022733
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketoconazole 200 mg tablets are prescription antifungal medicine used to treat certain serious or difficult-to-treat fungal infections when other suitable treatments are not available or appropriate. They should only be used under close medical supervision because of the risk of liver damage.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making ergosterol, a substance needed to build and maintain their cell membranes. This weakens the fungi and helps control the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, usually with food, and swallow it with water. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. Tell the doctor about all other medicines being taken, including antacids and acid-reducing medicines.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache and changes in liver function tests may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it without medical supervision if there is liver disease. Seek urgent medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe tiredness, persistent vomiting or severe abdominal pain. Ketoconazole can cause serious liver injury, affect adrenal hormone production, alter heart rhythm and interact with many medicines. Medical advice is especially important during pregnancy, breastfeeding or when taking other prescription medicines.

title: Nor- 400 Tz 10 Tab (Norfloxacin 400 Mg, Tinidazole 600 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Nor- 400 Tz 10 Tab (Norfloxacin 400 Mg, Tinidazole 600 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Nor- 400 Tz 10 Tab (Norfloxacin 400 Mg, Tinidazole 600 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400026377
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections of the digestive system, including infectious diarrhoea and dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Norfloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Tinidazole damages the genetic material of certain bacteria and parasites, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed and complete the course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water. Avoid taking it with milk or dairy products, and separate it from antacids or mineral supplements as advised by the doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol during treatment or for at least 3 days after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney problems, seizures, heart-rhythm problems, or previous reactions to quinolone antibiotics. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe rash, breathing difficulty, or persistent or bloody diarrhoea.

title: Novarich 10 Cap (Multivitamin, Multiminerals, Antioxidant Softgel Cap) By Intas
name: Novarich 10 Cap (Multivitamin, Multiminerals, Antioxidant Softgel Cap) By Intas
searchText: Novarich 10 Cap (Multivitamin, Multiminerals, Antioxidant Softgel Cap) By Intas Intas 400013370
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a dietary supplement to provide a combination of vitamins, minerals and antioxidants when dietary intake may be insufficient or when additional nutritional support is needed.

How does it work?
It supplies essential vitamins and minerals needed for normal body functions. Antioxidants help protect cells from damage caused by free radicals.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow the softgel with water and do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset, constipation or diarrhoea may occur. Some vitamins or minerals may change the colour or smell of urine.

Precautions
Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or if there is a medical condition. Tell the healthcare professional about other supplements or medicines being taken. Avoid taking more than the recommended amount, as excessive vitamin or mineral intake can be harmful.

title: Nozeclear 20 Ml (Sodium Chloride 0.65% W/V, Benzalkonium Chloride 0.001% W/V, Phenylmercuric Acetate 0.002% W/V Nasal Drops) By Intas
name: Nozeclear 20 Ml (Sodium Chloride 0.65% W/V, Benzalkonium Chloride 0.001% W/V, Phenylmercuric Acetate 0.002% W/V Nasal Drops) By Intas
searchText: Nozeclear 20 Ml (Sodium Chloride 0.65% W/V, Benzalkonium Chloride 0.001% W/V, Phenylmercuric Acetate 0.002% W/V Nasal Drops) By Intas Intas 400007496
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as saline nasal drops to moisten dry nasal passages, loosen mucus and help relieve a blocked or stuffy nose.

How does it work?
Sodium chloride solution moisturises the lining of the nose and helps thin and loosen mucus, making it easier to clear. Benzalkonium chloride and phenylmercuric acetate act as preservatives.

How to take/use it
Use only in the nose and follow the instructions on the product label or from a healthcare professional. Do not touch the dropper tip to the nose or other surfaces, and do not share the bottle.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, irritation, sneezing or increased nasal discharge may occur.

Precautions
Stop use and seek medical advice if significant irritation, swelling, nosebleeds or an allergic reaction occurs. Avoid prolonged or frequent use if it causes irritation, and seek medical advice if nasal blockage persists or worsens.

title: N.T. Cold Ds 60Ml (Paracetamol 250 Mg/5 Ml, Phenylephrine 5 Mg/5 Ml, Chlorpheniramine 2 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas
name: N.T. Cold Ds 60Ml (Paracetamol 250 Mg/5 Ml, Phenylephrine 5 Mg/5 Ml, Chlorpheniramine 2 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas
searchText: N.T. Cold Ds 60Ml (Paracetamol 250 Mg/5 Ml, Phenylephrine 5 Mg/5 Ml, Chlorpheniramine 2 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas Intas 400026898
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold symptoms such as fever, body aches, blocked or runny nose, sneezing and related nasal congestion.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce fever and relieve pain. Phenylephrine helps reduce nasal congestion, while chlorpheniramine helps relieve allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or according to the package label. Measure the liquid with a suitable measuring device. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol, phenylephrine or chlorpheniramine unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea or stomach discomfort. Phenylephrine may sometimes cause palpitations or nervousness.

Precautions
May cause sleepiness; avoid driving or operating machinery if affected. Avoid alcohol. Seek medical advice before use in people with high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid problems, liver disease or difficulty passing urine. Do not exceed the recommended amount, as too much paracetamol can cause serious liver damage.

title: N. T. Cold Plus (15 T) (Paracetamol 500 Mg, Phenylephrine 10 Mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: N. T. Cold Plus (15 T) (Paracetamol 500 Mg, Phenylephrine 10 Mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: N. T. Cold Plus (15 T) (Paracetamol 500 Mg, Phenylephrine 10 Mg, Chlorpheniramine 2 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400028360
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold and flu symptoms such as fever, headache, body aches, blocked or runny nose, and sneezing.

How does it work?
Paracetamol reduces fever and relieves pain. Phenylephrine helps reduce nasal congestion, while chlorpheniramine helps relieve runny nose and sneezing.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the package or by a healthcare professional. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or other cold-and-flu ingredients. Chlorpheniramine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery if affected.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, and stomach discomfort. Phenylephrine may cause palpitations or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, liver disease, difficulty passing urine, or prostate problems. Avoid alcohol. Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe symptoms, breathing difficulty, or symptoms that do not improve.

title: Nt Spas Inj. 2Ml (Dicyclomine 10 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
name: Nt Spas Inj. 2Ml (Dicyclomine 10 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
searchText: Nt Spas Inj. 2Ml (Dicyclomine 10 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 8N111051204
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dicyclomine is used to relieve stomach and intestinal cramps, spasms and pain, including symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

How does it work?
It relaxes the muscles of the stomach and intestines and reduces spasms by blocking certain nerve signals.

How to take/use it
Use only in the dose and by the route prescribed by the doctor. Do not use more often or for longer than advised. If it is a liquid medicine, measure it with a proper measuring device rather than a household spoon.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness, blurred vision, constipation, nausea and weakness may occur.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate enlargement, blockage of the stomach or intestine, severe ulcerative colitis, or myasthenia gravis. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizzy, drowsy or experiencing blurred vision. Seek medical help for severe abdominal pain, swelling, vomiting, inability to pass stools or gas, or vision problems.

title: Nucet Syrup. 60 Ml (Levocetirizine 2.5 Mg/Ml Syr) By Intas
name: Nucet Syrup. 60 Ml (Levocetirizine 2.5 Mg/Ml Syr) By Intas
searchText: Nucet Syrup. 60 Ml (Levocetirizine 2.5 Mg/Ml Syr) By Intas Intas 400006831
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levocetirizine oral solution is used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching or hives on the skin.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance released during an allergic reaction. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed by the doctor or as stated on the package. Measure the liquid with the supplied measuring device; do not use a household spoon. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, and stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Drowsiness may occur, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase sleepiness. Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease or a previous allergy to levocetirizine, cetirizine, or any ingredient. Seek medical help for signs of a serious allergic reaction, such as swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

title: Oflogyl-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
name: Oflogyl-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
searchText: Oflogyl-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400016663
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used when prescribed for certain bacterial or protozoal intestinal infections that cause diarrhoea, loose motions or dysentery. Simethicone helps relieve associated gas and bloating.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin and metronidazole act against susceptible bacteria and certain parasites by interfering with their growth and DNA. Simethicone helps break up gas bubbles in the stomach and intestine.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Measure the liquid accurately and shake the bottle well if it is a suspension. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not take antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc at the same time; follow the product label or medical advice for spacing.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, metallic taste, headache, dizziness and gas may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours afterwards. Tell the doctor about allergies to quinolone antibiotics or metronidazole, pregnancy or breastfeeding, kidney or liver problems, seizures, heart rhythm problems, or use of other medicines. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, rash or breathing difficulty, numbness or tingling, confusion, or tendon pain or swelling.

title: Oflotas 200 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Oflotas 200 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Oflotas 200 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400005891
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ofloxacin 200 mg is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the urinary tract, respiratory system, skin, or digestive system, when prescribed by a doctor. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops bacteria from making essential enzymes needed for their growth and reproduction, helping to clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water. Do not take it at the same time as antacids or mineral supplements containing aluminium, magnesium, calcium, iron or zinc; follow the recommended time gap from the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and sleep problems may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies to quinolone antibiotics, tendon problems, seizures, kidney disease, heart rhythm problems, or nerve disorders. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, a severe rash, breathing difficulty, or palpitations. Avoid unnecessary sun exposure. Use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in children only on medical advice.

title: Oflotas Inj 100Ml (Ofloxacin 200 Mg Inj) By Intas
name: Oflotas Inj 100Ml (Ofloxacin 200 Mg Inj) By Intas
searchText: Oflotas Inj 100Ml (Ofloxacin 200 Mg Inj) By Intas Intas 400005560
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain serious bacterial infections when ofloxacin is prescribed for intravenous treatment. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin is an antibiotic that stops bacteria from making the enzymes needed for their growth and reproduction. Sodium chloride provides the sterile saline solution for infusion.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given slowly into a vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function and medical advice. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and pain or irritation at the infusion site.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about any allergy to ofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics, kidney problems, epilepsy, heart rhythm problems or a history of tendon problems. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe dizziness, palpitations, breathing difficulty or a serious rash. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only if specifically prescribed.

title: Oflotas Inj 100Ml (Without Carton) (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Sodium Chloride 900 Mg Inj) By Intas
name: Oflotas Inj 100Ml (Without Carton) (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Sodium Chloride 900 Mg Inj) By Intas
searchText: Oflotas Inj 100Ml (Without Carton) (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Sodium Chloride 900 Mg Inj) By Intas Intas 400012090
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial infections when ofloxacin treatment by intravenous infusion is appropriate. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin is an antibiotic that stops bacteria from making and repairing their genetic material, which prevents them from growing. Sodium chloride provides the infusion solution.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given into a vein by a healthcare professional. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection and kidney function. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, difficulty sleeping, and pain or irritation at the infusion site.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to ofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics, kidney problems, heart rhythm problems, seizures, diabetes, or previous tendon problems caused by antibiotics. Avoid strenuous exercise and report tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe diarrhoea, severe rash, breathing difficulty, or unusual palpitations promptly. Use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in children only when specifically prescribed.

title: Oflotas-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
name: Oflotas-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
searchText: Oflotas-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400016660
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to treat certain infectious diarrhoea and loose motions, including infections caused by bacteria or parasites. Simethicone helps relieve gas, bloating and abdominal discomfort that may occur with these digestive infections.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin fights susceptible bacteria, while metronidazole acts against certain bacteria and parasites. Simethicone helps gas bubbles join together so they can pass more easily.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Shake the suspension well before use and measure each dose with the supplied measuring device. Complete the prescribed course unless a doctor advises otherwise. Drink enough fluids to help prevent dehydration.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, metallic taste or dry mouth may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for the period advised by the doctor after the last dose. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver or kidney problems, seizures, tendon disorders, or a history of nerve problems. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially blood thinners, antacids and mineral supplements. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, blood in the stool, severe abdominal pain, allergic reactions, tendon pain or numbness and tingling.

title: Oflotas-Oz 10 Tab (Alu - Alu ) (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Oflotas-Oz 10 Tab (Alu - Alu ) (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Oflotas-Oz 10 Tab (Alu - Alu ) (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400027899
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ofloxacin + ornidazole is used to treat certain mixed bacterial and protozoal infections, especially infectious diarrhoea and dysentery, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin kills susceptible bacteria by blocking enzymes they need to multiply. Ornidazole damages the genetic material of certain parasites and anaerobic bacteria.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed and complete the recommended course. Swallow the tablet whole with water. Avoid taking it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing aluminium, magnesium, calcium or iron; ask a pharmacist about suitable spacing. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 3 days after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic or unpleasant taste.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ofloxacin, other quinolone antibiotics, ornidazole or similar medicines. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, seizures, confusion, or severe allergic symptoms. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver disease, seizures, nerve problems, or a history of tendon disorders before use.

title: Oflotas-Oz 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Oflotas-Oz 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Oflotas-Oz 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400012231
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections, including some cases of infectious diarrhoea and dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Ornidazole damages the genetic material of certain parasites and bacteria, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with water, and complete the prescribed course even if symptoms improve. Do not self-medicate or use it for ordinary diarrhoea without medical advice. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 3 days after the last dose. Ask a pharmacist about separating antacids or iron, calcium and other mineral supplements from this medicine.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic or bitter taste.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney or liver problems, seizures, nerve problems, or a history of tendon disorders. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe dizziness, confusion, or an allergic reaction. Avoid driving if dizzy or if vision or coordination is affected.

title: Omey 10 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg Cap) By Intas
name: Omey 10 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg Cap) By Intas
searchText: Omey 10 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg Cap) By Intas Intas 1Y114031171
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Omeprazole reduces excess stomach acid and is used for acidity, heartburn, acid reflux (GERD), and stomach or duodenal ulcers. It may also be used with antibiotics for Helicobacter pylori infection or to prevent ulcers caused by some painkillers, when prescribed.

How does it work?
It blocks the acid-producing pumps in the stomach, reducing the amount of acid released. This helps relieve heartburn and allows acid-related irritation or ulcers to heal.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed by the doctor or package instructions. It is usually taken before food. Swallow the capsule or tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea, constipation and gas.

Precautions
Seek medical advice for difficulty swallowing, repeated vomiting, unexplained weight loss, vomiting blood or black stools. Inform the doctor about other medicines, especially clopidogrel, warfarin, phenytoin, diazepam, some HIV medicines or methotrexate. Long-term use should be supervised, as it may affect vitamin B12 or magnesium levels and bone health.

title: Omey 20 Cap (Combo) (Omeprazole 20 Mg Cap) By Intas
name: Omey 20 Cap (Combo) (Omeprazole 20 Mg Cap) By Intas
searchText: Omey 20 Cap (Combo) (Omeprazole 20 Mg Cap) By Intas Intas 400026356
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Omeprazole is used to reduce excess stomach acid and relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux. It is also used for stomach or intestinal ulcers and, with other medicines, for certain Helicobacter pylori infections.

How does it work?
It blocks a stomach enzyme that produces acid, thereby reducing acid levels and helping relieve symptoms and heal acid-related irritation.

How to take/use it
Swallow the capsule or tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Take it exactly as directed by a doctor or pharmacist, preferably at the recommended time before food. Do not take more than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea, constipation, vomiting and gas.

Precautions
Tell a doctor if there is unexplained weight loss, difficulty swallowing, repeated vomiting, vomiting blood or black stools. Consult a doctor before prolonged use, or if pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other medicines, especially blood thinners or medicines affected by stomach acid. Seek medical help for signs of an allergic reaction or severe, persistent diarrhoea.

title: Omey-Dm 10 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg, Domperidone 10 Mg Cap) By Intas
name: Omey-Dm 10 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg, Domperidone 10 Mg Cap) By Intas
searchText: Omey-Dm 10 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg, Domperidone 10 Mg Cap) By Intas Intas YD900031174
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux, especially when accompanied by nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Omeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Domperidone helps improve movement of the upper digestive tract and can reduce nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed or directed on the label. Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not take more or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, stomach pain or discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, nausea, and dry mouth.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of heart rhythm problems, heart disease, liver disease, or low potassium or magnesium levels. Domperidone may interact with some medicines, including certain antibiotics, antifungals and medicines affecting heart rhythm. Seek medical help for fainting, a fast or irregular heartbeat, vomiting blood, black stools, difficulty swallowing, or unexplained weight loss.

title: Omey Dm 20 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg, Domperidone 10 Mg Cap) By Intas
name: Omey Dm 20 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg, Domperidone 10 Mg Cap) By Intas
searchText: Omey Dm 20 Cap (Omeprazole 20 Mg, Domperidone 10 Mg Cap) By Intas Intas 400022392
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acid reflux, heartburn and indigestion, particularly when these symptoms are accompanied by nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Omeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. Domperidone helps food move through the upper digestive system and can help reduce nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed. Swallow the capsule or tablet whole with water and do not crush or chew it. Follow the prescribed timing, which may be before a meal. Do not take more or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, stomach pain, diarrhoea, constipation, nausea, dry mouth or dizziness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, heart problems, an irregular heartbeat, or a history of low potassium or magnesium. Domperidone may cause serious heart-rhythm problems and can interact with some medicines; disclose all medicines being taken. Seek urgent medical help for fainting, a fast or irregular heartbeat, severe allergic symptoms, vomiting blood or black stools. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Ondet-2 Inj. 2Ml (Ondansetron 2 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
name: Ondet-2 Inj. 2Ml (Ondansetron 2 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas
searchText: Ondet-2 Inj. 2Ml (Ondansetron 2 Mg/Ml Inj) By Intas Intas 400003475
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ondansetron is used to prevent and treat nausea and vomiting, including nausea and vomiting related to chemotherapy, radiotherapy or surgery.

How does it work?
It blocks serotonin signals in the body that can trigger nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
This 2 mg/ml medicine is generally given by a healthcare professional. Use only as prescribed; the dose and method of administration depend on the cause of nausea or vomiting.

Common side effects
Headache, constipation, diarrhoea, dizziness and tiredness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of abnormal heart rhythm, low potassium or magnesium levels, liver disease, or allergy to ondansetron. Seek urgent medical help for fainting, a fast or irregular heartbeat, breathing difficulty, swelling, or a severe rash. Inform the doctor about other medicines, especially those that affect heart rhythm or serotonin levels.

title: Ondet 30Ml (Ondansetron 2 Mg/5 Ml) By Intas
name: Ondet 30Ml (Ondansetron 2 Mg/5 Ml) By Intas
searchText: Ondet 30Ml (Ondansetron 2 Mg/5 Ml) By Intas Intas 400005601
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ondansetron is used to prevent and treat nausea and vomiting, including nausea and vomiting related to medical treatments or surgery.

How does it work?

Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Follow the instructions on the label for the correct route and method of use. Do not use more than prescribed or for longer than recommended. Avoid combining it with other painkillers such as ibuprofen or diclofenac unless advised by a doctor.

For external use only. Apply to the affected area as directed on the product label and massage gently. Do not apply to broken or irritated skin.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching or rash may occur in sensitive people.

Precautions
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Stop use if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Seek medical advice if pain is severe, follows an injury, or does not improve.

title: Sensotas (100 Gm) (Potassium Nitrate 5%, Sodium Monofluorophosphate 0.7%, Triclosan 0.3%) By Intas
name: Sensotas (100 Gm) (Potassium Nitrate 5%, Sodium Monofluorophosphate 0.7%, Triclosan 0.3%) By Intas
searchText: Sensotas (100 Gm) (Potassium Nitrate 5%, Sodium Monofluorophosphate 0.7%, Triclosan 0.3%) By Intas Intas 400027639
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a toothpaste for relief of sensitive teeth and for daily protection against tooth decay, plaque and gum problems.

How does it work?
Potassium nitrate helps reduce the sensitivity of tooth nerves. Sodium monofluorophosphate strengthens tooth enamel and helps prevent cavities, while triclosan helps reduce bacteria and plaque.

How to take/use it
Use for brushing according to the product label. Brush thoroughly and spit out after use. Do not swallow. Children should use it only with adult supervision.

Common side effects
Mild mouth irritation, burning, dryness or an altered taste may occur in some people.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to any ingredient. Stop using it and seek dental advice if irritation develops or sensitivity persists or worsens. Do not swallow. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Silentt 100 Ml (Terbutaline 1.25 Mg, Bromhexine 2 Mg, Guaiphenesin 50 Mg/5 Ml) By Intas
name: Silentt 100 Ml (Terbutaline 1.25 Mg, Bromhexine 2 Mg, Guaiphenesin 50 Mg/5 Ml) By Intas
searchText: Silentt 100 Ml (Terbutaline 1.25 Mg, Bromhexine 2 Mg, Guaiphenesin 50 Mg/5 Ml) By Intas Intas 400006710
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve cough with mucus and chest congestion, especially when airway tightening or breathing difficulty is also present. It helps loosen and clear phlegm from the airways.

How does it work?
Terbutaline relaxes the muscles of the airways to help breathing. Bromhexine and guaiphenesin thin and loosen mucus, making it easier to cough out.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Measure the syrup with the supplied measuring device and do not use a household spoon. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Shakiness, nervousness, headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, or a history of seizures. Seek medical help for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, a very fast or irregular heartbeat, or an allergic reaction. Consult a doctor if the cough worsens or does not improve.

title: Sofratas 15 Gm (Combo) (Fradiomycin) By Intas
name: Sofratas 15 Gm (Combo) (Fradiomycin) By Intas
searchText: Sofratas 15 Gm (Combo) (Fradiomycin) By Intas Intas 400023920
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Fradiomycin sulphate is a topical antibacterial used to treat or prevent bacterial infections of the skin, including infected minor cuts, wounds and burns.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which prevents their growth.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to the affected area as directed by a doctor or the product label. Clean and dry the area first, and wash hands before and after use. Do not apply in the eyes or swallow it.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, redness, itching or rash. Allergic contact dermatitis may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to fradiomycin, neomycin or similar aminoglycoside antibiotics. Avoid prolonged use or applying to large areas, deep wounds or severely damaged skin unless advised by a doctor. Stop use and seek medical advice if the infection worsens or a severe rash or swelling develops.

title: Soregel 10Gm (Combo) (Choline Salicylate 8.7%, Lignocaine 2% Gel) By Intas
name: Soregel 10Gm (Combo) (Choline Salicylate 8.7%, Lignocaine 2% Gel) By Intas
searchText: Soregel 10Gm (Combo) (Choline Salicylate 8.7%, Lignocaine 2% Gel) By Intas Intas 400026351
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of pain and discomfort from mouth ulcers, sore gums and minor irritation inside the mouth.

How does it work?
Choline salicylate helps reduce pain and inflammation. Lignocaine locally numbs the area, while benzalkonium chloride helps limit the growth of some germs.

How to take/use it
For use in the mouth only. Apply or use exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not swallow it or use more than recommended. Avoid eating or drinking very hot foods and drinks while the area is numb.

Common side effects
Temporary numbness, mild burning or stinging, and irritation at the application site. Stop using it and seek medical help if swelling, rash or breathing difficulty occurs.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to choline salicylate, aspirin, other salicylates or lignocaine. Use cautiously in children and only with appropriate medical advice. Avoid prolonged or excessive use and seek medical advice if symptoms persist, worsen or keep returning.

title: Soregel Mouth Paint (Clotrimazole 1% W/V Mouth Paint) By Intas
name: Soregel Mouth Paint (Clotrimazole 1% W/V Mouth Paint) By Intas
searchText: Soregel Mouth Paint (Clotrimazole 1% W/V Mouth Paint) By Intas Intas 400028208
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Clotrimazole is used to treat fungal infections of the skin, such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and jock itch.

How does it work?
It is an antifungal medicine that damages the protective outer layer of fungal cells, helping stop the growth of the fungus.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply to clean, dry, affected skin as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, itching, redness, irritation or dryness at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to clotrimazole or any ingredient. Avoid applying to the eyes or broken skin. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops. Consult a doctor if the infection worsens or does not improve with treatment.

title: Soregel Tablet (10T) (Riboflavin 10 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mg, Niacinamide 100 Mg, Lactic Acid Bacillus 60 Million Spores Tab) By Intas
name: Soregel Tablet (10T) (Riboflavin 10 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mg, Niacinamide 100 Mg, Lactic Acid Bacillus 60 Million Spores Tab) By Intas
searchText: Soregel Tablet (10T) (Riboflavin 10 Mg, Folic Acid 1.5 Mg, Niacinamide 100 Mg, Lactic Acid Bacillus 60 Million Spores Tab) By Intas Intas 400027632
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used as a nutritional supplement to help provide riboflavin (vitamin B2), folic acid and niacinamide (vitamin B3), along with beneficial Lactobacillus bacteria. It may be recommended when these nutrients or beneficial gut bacteria need supplementation.

How does it work?
The vitamins support energy production, healthy blood cells and normal body functions. Lactobacillus helps support the balance of beneficial bacteria in the intestines.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or changes in bowel movements may occur. Riboflavin may harmlessly turn urine bright yellow.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any vitamin supplements or medicines being taken. Folic acid may mask some signs of vitamin B12 deficiency. Seek medical advice before using it if pregnant, breastfeeding, allergic to any ingredient or severely immunocompromised.

title: Spaz 10 Tab (Diclofenac Potassium 50 Mg, Dicyclomine 20 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Spaz 10 Tab (Diclofenac Potassium 50 Mg, Dicyclomine 20 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Spaz 10 Tab (Diclofenac Potassium 50 Mg, Dicyclomine 20 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 5Z900011054
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of painful abdominal cramps and spasms, including intestinal colicky pain. It may also be prescribed for other types of spasmodic pain when advised by a doctor.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces pain and inflammation. Dicyclomine relaxes spasming muscles in the intestine, helping to relieve cramps.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, preferably with or after food, and do not exceed the recommended dose or duration. Do not take other diclofenac or similar painkillers unless advised.

Common side effects
Indigestion, nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea or constipation, dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness and blurred vision.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or bowel obstruction. Avoid during pregnancy, especially after 20 weeks and in the last 3 months, unless specifically prescribed. Avoid alcohol and driving if dizzy, drowsy or experiencing blurred vision. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash.

title: Steylong Spray 20 Gm (Lidocaine 10% W/W Spray) By Intas
name: Steylong Spray 20 Gm (Lidocaine 10% W/W Spray) By Intas
searchText: Steylong Spray 20 Gm (Lidocaine 10% W/W Spray) By Intas Intas 400009970
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Lidocaine 10% spray is a local anaesthetic used to temporarily numb the skin or mucous membranes and reduce sensation or pain. The exact area and purpose depend on the product instructions or medical advice.

How does it work?
It temporarily blocks pain signals from the nerves in the area where it is applied, causing reduced sensation or numbness.

How to take/use it
Use only on the area and in the amount directed on the label or by a doctor. Do not spray into the eyes or inhale the spray. Avoid eating or drinking until normal sensation returns after use on the mouth or throat, as numbness can increase the risk of choking or burns.

Common side effects
Temporary numbness, tingling, mild burning, redness or irritation at the application site. Drowsiness or dizziness may occur, especially if too much is absorbed.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to lidocaine or similar local anaesthetics. Do not apply large amounts, use repeatedly, or apply to large, broken or inflamed areas unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek urgent medical help for severe dizziness, ringing in the ears, blurred vision, tremors, seizures, breathing difficulty, or an irregular heartbeat.

title: Sucratas- O Sus 100Ml (Nf) (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml, Oxetacaine 20 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
name: Sucratas- O Sus 100Ml (Nf) (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml, Oxetacaine 20 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
searchText: Sucratas- O Sus 100Ml (Nf) (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml, Oxetacaine 20 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400028364
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve pain and discomfort caused by acid-related stomach conditions, such as gastritis, peptic ulcers and heartburn.

How does it work?
Sucralfate forms a protective coating over irritated or ulcerated areas in the stomach and intestine. Oxetacaine is a local anaesthetic that helps reduce pain in the affected area.

How to take/use it
Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with a proper measuring device. Take it exactly as prescribed. Sucralfate can affect the absorption of other medicines, so ask a doctor or pharmacist about separating this medicine from other medicines.

Common side effects
Constipation, dry mouth, nausea, dizziness or temporary numbness in the mouth or throat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease or an allergy to either ingredient. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for vomiting blood, black stools, severe stomach pain or symptoms that do not improve.

title: Sucratas- O Sus 200Ml (Nf) (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml, Oxetacaine 20 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
name: Sucratas- O Sus 200Ml (Nf) (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml, Oxetacaine 20 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
searchText: Sucratas- O Sus 200Ml (Nf) (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml, Oxetacaine 20 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400028363
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve pain and discomfort from acidity, heartburn, gastritis and peptic ulcers. It helps protect irritated areas in the stomach and food pipe while oxetacaine provides local relief from pain.

How does it work?
Sucralfate forms a protective coating over ulcers and irritated lining in the stomach and food pipe. Oxetacaine is a local anaesthetic that helps reduce pain in the affected area.

How to take/use it
Shake the bottle well before use and measure the medicine with a proper measuring device. Take it exactly as prescribed. Sucralfate may affect the absorption of other medicines, so inform the doctor or pharmacist about all medicines being taken and follow their advice on spacing doses.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, indigestion, dry mouth and stomach discomfort. Temporary numbness of the mouth or throat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease or an allergy to sucralfate, oxetacaine or any ingredient. Do not eat or drink very hot food or liquids if the mouth or throat feels numb. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist, worsen or there is vomiting blood, black stools or severe abdominal pain.

title: Sucratas Syrup 200 Ml (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas
name: Sucratas Syrup 200 Ml (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas
searchText: Sucratas Syrup 200 Ml (Sucralfate 1000 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas Intas 400007161
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sucralfate is used to treat and protect ulcers in the stomach or upper intestine. It may also be prescribed for other acid-related digestive problems.

How does it work?
It forms a protective coating over damaged areas of the stomach and intestine, helping shield them from acid and digestive enzymes so they can heal.

How to take/use it
Shake the suspension well before use. Take it on an empty stomach exactly as prescribed, usually before meals and at bedtime. Do not take other medicines at the same time unless advised, as sucralfate can affect their absorption.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, dry mouth and stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, difficulty swallowing, or pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical advice if severe or persistent stomach pain, vomiting blood, or black stools occur.

title: Tetmitas Soap 75Gm (Combo) (Monosulfiram 5% W/W Soap) By Intas
name: Tetmitas Soap 75Gm (Combo) (Monosulfiram 5% W/W Soap) By Intas
searchText: Tetmitas Soap 75Gm (Combo) (Monosulfiram 5% W/W Soap) By Intas Intas 400026808
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to treat scabies and may also be used for lice infestations, as directed by a doctor or the product label.

How does it work?
Monosulfiram acts against the mites or lice that cause these infestations, helping to eliminate them from the skin or hair.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Use the soap exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas, and wash hands after use. Do not use more often or for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, redness, burning, dryness or itching may occur. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation or an allergic rash develops.

Precautions
Do not swallow or apply to the eyes, mucous membranes or severely broken skin. Keep out of reach of children. Use in children, during pregnancy or while breastfeeding only after medical advice. Seek medical help if accidentally swallowed or if symptoms do not improve after treatment.

title: Thrombotas Cream 20Gm (Heparin Sodium 50 Iu/G, Benzyl Nicotinate 2 Mg/G Cream) By Intas
name: Thrombotas Cream 20Gm (Heparin Sodium 50 Iu/G, Benzyl Nicotinate 2 Mg/G Cream) By Intas
searchText: Thrombotas Cream 20Gm (Heparin Sodium 50 Iu/G, Benzyl Nicotinate 2 Mg/G Cream) By Intas Intas 400004851
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to help relieve symptoms associated with superficial vein inflammation, minor bruising and local swelling. It should not be used as a substitute for medical treatment of a suspected deep-vein clot.

How does it work?
Heparin helps reduce clotting in small superficial blood vessels. Benzyl nicotinate widens small blood vessels and may produce a temporary warming or reddening sensation.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, intact skin and spread gently. Follow the product label or a healthcare professional’s instructions for how often and how long to use it. Do not rub vigorously over a painful or swollen vein.

Common side effects
Mild skin redness, warmth, itching, burning or irritation at the application site. Local bruising or bleeding may rarely occur.

Precautions
Do not apply to open wounds, broken or infected skin, mucous membranes or near the eyes. Avoid use if allergic to heparin or any ingredient. Use medical advice if taking blood-thinning medicines or if there is a bleeding disorder. Seek urgent medical help for sudden one-sided leg swelling or pain, chest pain or breathing difficulty.

title: Tramacet 15 Tab (Tramadol 37.50 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Tramacet 15 Tab (Tramadol 37.50 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Tramacet 15 Tab (Tramadol 37.50 Mg, Paracetamol 325 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400026897
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for the short-term treatment of moderate to severe pain when a combination of tramadol and paracetamol is appropriate.

How does it work?
Tramadol acts on the central nervous system to reduce the sensation of pain. Paracetamol also reduces pain signals, providing additional pain relief.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor and swallow the tablet whole with water. Do not take more than prescribed or use it with other medicines containing paracetamol or tramadol. Do not stop or continue treatment longer than advised without medical guidance.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, dry mouth and headache.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that cause drowsiness unless advised by a doctor. Do not drive or operate machinery if dizzy or sleepy. Tell the doctor about breathing problems, seizures, liver disease, head injury, or a history of medicine dependence. Inform the doctor about antidepressants or other medicines being taken. Seek urgent medical help for slow or difficult breathing, extreme sleepiness, a seizure, severe allergic reaction or confusion.

title: Tramatas Inj 2 Ml (Tramadol 50 Mg Inj) By Intas
name: Tramatas Inj 2 Ml (Tramadol 50 Mg Inj) By Intas
searchText: Tramatas Inj 2 Ml (Tramadol 50 Mg Inj) By Intas Intas 400001500
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Tramadol injection is used to relieve moderate to severe pain when an injectable painkiller is needed.

How does it work?
It acts on opioid receptors in the brain and spinal cord to reduce the sensation of pain. It also affects certain chemical messengers involved in pain transmission.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection, usually by a doctor or nurse. Use it only as prescribed and do not self-inject. The dose and duration depend on the severity of pain and the medical condition.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, sweating, dry mouth and headache.

Precautions
It may cause sleepiness, dizziness and dependence. Avoid alcohol and do not drive or operate machinery if affected. Tell the doctor about breathing problems, seizures, liver or kidney disease, or a history of medicine or alcohol dependence. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially sleeping medicines, sedatives, antidepressants and other opioid painkillers. Seek urgent medical help for slow or difficult breathing, severe drowsiness, confusion, seizures or an allergic reaction.

title: Trantas 500 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Trantas 500 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Trantas 500 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400012546
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Tranexamic acid is used to reduce or prevent excessive bleeding, including heavy menstrual bleeding and bleeding after some medical or dental procedures. The exact use depends on the doctor's advice.

How does it work?
It helps prevent blood clots from breaking down too quickly, which helps control bleeding.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet with water and do not crush or chew it unless advised. Do not take more than the prescribed amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of blood clots, kidney disease, seizures, or problems with colour vision. Seek urgent medical help for sudden chest pain, breathlessness, coughing blood, painful swelling in a leg, or sudden changes in vision. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Trantas 5Ml Amp. (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg Inj) By Intas
name: Trantas 5Ml Amp. (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg Inj) By Intas
searchText: Trantas 5Ml Amp. (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg Inj) By Intas Intas 400007555
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Tranexamic acid injection is used to help control or reduce excessive bleeding, including bleeding associated with surgery, injury, childbirth or heavy menstrual periods. It is given when prescribed and supervised by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It helps prevent blood clots from breaking down too quickly, allowing bleeding to slow or stop.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection, usually into a vein, by a healthcare professional. The dose and treatment duration depend on the cause and severity of bleeding, kidney function and medical advice. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, dizziness and headache may occur. A temporary drop in blood pressure can occur if the injection is given too quickly.

Precautions
Tell the healthcare professional about any history of blood clots, kidney disease, seizures, blood in the urine or problems with colour vision. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, sudden breathlessness, one-sided leg swelling or pain, sudden vision changes, severe headache, seizures or signs of a serious allergic reaction.

title: Trantas-Em 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 250 Mg, Ethamsylate 250 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Trantas-Em 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 250 Mg, Ethamsylate 250 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Trantas-Em 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 250 Mg, Ethamsylate 250 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400013140
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is commonly used to reduce excessive bleeding, especially heavy menstrual bleeding. It may also be prescribed for other bleeding conditions when directed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Tranexamic acid helps prevent blood clots from breaking down too quickly. Ethamsylate helps strengthen small blood vessels and supports the body's natural clotting process.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any history of blood clots, kidney problems, vision problems or unexplained irregular bleeding. Seek medical help urgently for chest pain, breathlessness, sudden leg swelling or pain, unusual vision changes, or signs of a severe allergic reaction. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Trantas- Mf 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg, Mefenamic Acid 250 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Trantas- Mf 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg, Mefenamic Acid 250 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Trantas- Mf 10 Tab (Tranexamic Acid 500 Mg, Mefenamic Acid 250 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400008361
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to reduce heavy menstrual bleeding and relieve period pain or cramps.

How does it work?
Tranexamic acid helps reduce bleeding by stabilising blood clots. Mefenamic acid reduces the substances that cause pain, inflammation and menstrual cramps, and may also help reduce menstrual bleeding.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow with water, preferably with or after food, and do not exceed the prescribed amount. Do not use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain or indigestion, headache and dizziness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about a history of blood clots, kidney disease, stomach ulcers or gastrointestinal bleeding, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to NSAID medicines. Avoid taking other NSAID painkillers unless advised. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, breathlessness, sudden leg swelling or pain, vision changes, severe rash, or black stools. This medicine may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially late pregnancy, unless prescribed.

title: Xylostar 0.1% 10Ml (71) (Xylometazoline 0.1%) By Intas
name: Xylostar 0.1% 10Ml (71) (Xylometazoline 0.1%) By Intas
searchText: Xylostar 0.1% 10Ml (71) (Xylometazoline 0.1%) By Intas Intas 400025391
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Xylometazoline nasal medicine provides short-term relief from a blocked or stuffy nose caused by the common cold, allergic rhinitis or sinus congestion.

How does it work?
It narrows swollen blood vessels inside the nose, reducing swelling and helping air pass through more easily.

How to take/use it
Use only in the nose and follow the instructions on the package or those given by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it more often or for longer than recommended, as this can make nasal blockage worse. Do not share the product with others.

Common side effects
Temporary nasal dryness, burning or irritation, sneezing, headache and increased nasal discharge may occur. Prolonged or frequent use can cause rebound nasal congestion.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, overactive thyroid, diabetes, glaucoma or difficulty passing urine. Check with a doctor or pharmacist if taking antidepressants or other medicines. Children should use it only if specifically advised and with a product intended for their age. Stop use and seek medical help for severe palpitations, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

title: Zenotas-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
name: Zenotas-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas
searchText: Zenotas-Mz Suspension 30 Ml (Ofloxacin 50 Mg/5 Ml, Metronidazole 120 Mg/5 Ml, Simethicone 10 Mg/5 Ml Susp) By Intas Intas 400016661
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain infectious diarrhoea and loose motions, including some bacterial or parasitic intestinal infections. It may also help relieve gas-related bloating associated with these symptoms. Use only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin and metronidazole act against certain bacteria and parasites that can cause intestinal infections. Simethicone helps combine gas bubbles in the stomach and intestines, making gas easier to pass.

How to take/use it
Use only in the dose and for the duration prescribed. Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with the supplied measuring device. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Maintain adequate fluids during diarrhoea unless otherwise advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, metallic taste, and temporary changes in bowel movements may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ofloxacin, metronidazole, or similar medicines. Use only under medical advice in children, pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver disease, seizure disorders, or a history of tendon problems. Avoid alcohol during treatment with metronidazole and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, blood in the stools, dehydration, rash, breathing difficulty, seizures, or tendon pain or swelling.

title: Zenotas Oz 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
name: Zenotas Oz 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas
searchText: Zenotas Oz 10 Tab (Ofloxacin 200 Mg, Ornidazole 500 Mg Tab) By Intas Intas 400008042
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to treat certain infections caused by bacteria and parasites, including some infectious diarrhoea and dysentery caused by mixed bacterial or protozoal infections. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Ornidazole damages the DNA of certain parasites and bacteria, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water. Do not take antacids or mineral supplements containing aluminium, magnesium, iron or calcium at the same time; ask a doctor or pharmacist about the appropriate time gap.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic or unpleasant taste may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies to quinolone antibiotics or nitroimidazole medicines, kidney or liver problems, seizures, nerve problems or previous tendon disorders. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 3 days after the last dose. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe diarrhoea, seizures, or signs of an allergic reaction. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Zinkomin 100 Ml (Vitamin A 240 Mcg, Vitamin B1 0.75 Mg, Vitamin B2 0.75 Mg, Vitamin B3 7.5 Mg, Vitamin B5 0.5 Mg, Vitamin B6 0.5 Mg, Vitamin B12 0.5 Mcg, Vitamin D3 2.5 Mcg, Vitamin E 2.5 Mg, Lysine 5 Mg, Zinc 9 Mg, Copper 0.3 Mg, Iodine 38 Mcg) By Intas

What is it used for?
This multivitamin and mineral supplement helps provide essential vitamins and minerals that support normal energy metabolism, immunity, growth and overall nutritional health. It may help prevent or correct dietary deficiencies when used as advised.

How does it work?
It supplies vitamins, minerals and lysine needed for various normal body functions, including metabolism, tissue maintenance and immune function.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose or take it with other multivitamin supplements unless advised.

Common side effects
Mild nausea, stomach upset, constipation or an unpleasant taste may occur.

Precautions
Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is liver disease, kidney disease or another medical condition. Avoid combining it with other products containing vitamin A, zinc or similar vitamins and minerals unless advised. Keep out of reach of children.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to provide a combination of vitamins, minerals and grape seed extract. It may help prevent or correct nutritional deficiencies when dietary intake is inadequate.

How does it work?
The vitamins and minerals support normal body functions such as energy production, immunity and maintenance of bones, blood and tissues. Grape seed extract contains plant compounds with antioxidant activity.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset. Check the label for the exact ingredients and amounts.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea may occur. Some people may experience an allergic reaction.

Precautions
Do not take with other multivitamin or mineral products unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is a medical condition or regular medicine use, especially blood-thinning treatment. Stop use and seek medical help for signs of a serious allergic reaction. Keep out of reach of children.

It supplies essential vitamins needed for normal processes such as energy use, immunity and overall health.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects

Precautions

searchText: Zinsyp 60 Ml (Zinc 20 Mg/5 Ml Syr) By Intas Intas 400011322
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat zinc deficiency. Zinc is also important for normal immune function, growth and wound healing.

How does it work?
It provides elemental zinc, an essential mineral needed for several body processes, including immune function and tissue repair.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Measure the liquid with a suitable measuring device. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach upset and a metallic taste may occur.

Precautions
Tell a doctor or pharmacist if taking antibiotics or penicillamine, as zinc can affect their absorption. Avoid prolonged or excessive use unless medically advised. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Acefen-Mr Tab (20X10) Aceclofenac 100Mg+ Paracetamol 325 Mg + Chlorzoxazone 250 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Acefen-Mr Tab (20X10) Aceclofenac 100Mg+ Paracetamol 325 Mg + Chlorzoxazone 250 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Acefen-Mr Tab (20X10) Aceclofenac 100Mg+ Paracetamol 325 Mg + Chlorzoxazone 250 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of painful muscle and joint conditions, including pain associated with muscle stiffness or spasms, such as back pain, sprains and strains.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac reduces pain and inflammation, while paracetamol helps relieve pain and fever. Chlorzoxazone helps relax painful muscle spasms.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed, preferably with or after food, and swallow it with water. Do not take more than the prescribed amount or combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol or NSAIDs unless advised by a doctor. Avoid driving or operating machinery if it causes drowsiness or dizziness.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness, headache and drowsiness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, liver or kidney disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or regular alcohol use. Avoid use during pregnancy, especially the last three months, unless specifically prescribed. Stop taking it and seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin reactions, breathing difficulty or yellowing of the eyes or skin.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve pain, swelling and inflammation in conditions affecting the muscles, joints and bones, including arthritis and other painful musculoskeletal conditions.

How does it work?
Aceclofenac reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with or after food, and swallow it whole with water. Do not take more than the prescribed dose or combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol or anti-inflammatory painkillers unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness and headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an allergy to anti-inflammatory medicines. Avoid excess alcohol. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially in the last three months. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a serious skin rash.

Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache. Stop use and seek medical help for signs of an allergic reaction, severe skin rash, vomiting blood or black stools.

Avoid during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, unless specifically prescribed. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase the risk of liver damage and stomach-related side effects.

What is it used for?
Piperazine citrate is an anti-worm medicine used to treat intestinal worm infections, mainly roundworm and pinworm infections.

How does it work?
It temporarily paralyses the worms, allowing the body to remove them through the bowel.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. For pinworm infection, careful handwashing and cleaning of clothing and bedding can help reduce the chance of reinfection.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is a history of seizures or epilepsy, kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Stop use and seek medical help if severe dizziness, confusion, muscle weakness or a seizure occurs.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve cough with mucus and breathing difficulty caused by narrowed airways in respiratory conditions. It helps loosen phlegm and makes it easier to cough out.

How does it work?
Ambroxol and guaifenesin help thin and loosen mucus. Terbutaline relaxes the muscles around the airways, helping to improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or as stated on the product label. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Do not combine it with other cough, cold or bronchodilator medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache, shakiness, nervousness, muscle cramps or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, seizures or low potassium. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, a very fast or irregular heartbeat, or signs of an allergic reaction.

Used to relieve cough with mucus and help ease breathing when the airways are narrowed or wheezy, such as in some respiratory conditions.

How does it work?
Ambroxol and guaifenesin help loosen and clear mucus from the airways. Terbutaline relaxes the airway muscles, helping to open the airways.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Do not take more than recommended, and do not use it for longer than advised without medical guidance.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach upset, headache, shakiness or tremors, nervousness, muscle cramps, and a fast or pounding heartbeat.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, or a history of seizures. Seek medical help for worsening breathing difficulty, severe palpitations, or signs of an allergic reaction. Consult a doctor if the cough persists or worsens.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Disodium hydrogen citrate is a urinary alkaliniser. It helps reduce excess acidity in the urine and may relieve burning or discomfort during urination and support the management of certain urinary conditions, such as uric acid kidney stones.

How does it work?
It is converted in the body to alkaline substances that make the urine less acidic. This can help reduce irritation from acidic urine and make uric acid more soluble.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. If supplied as a liquid, measure it accurately and dilute it as instructed on the label. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or loose motions.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice if there is kidney disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, swelling, or a need to follow a low-sodium diet, as it contains sodium. Tell a doctor or pharmacist about other medicines being taken. Seek medical advice if urinary symptoms persist or occur with fever, blood in the urine, severe pain or difficulty passing urine.

title: Alzole 10 Ml (10Ml) Albendazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Alzole 10 Ml (10Ml) Albendazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Alzole 10 Ml (10Ml) Albendazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Albendazole is an anti-parasitic medicine used to treat infections caused by intestinal worms, such as roundworms, hookworms, pinworms and whipworms. It may also be used for certain other parasitic infections as prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It prevents parasites from absorbing and using glucose, which stops their growth and causes them to die.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type of parasitic infection. Take the tablet with food if advised, and complete the prescribed course. Do not self-medicate for suspected worm infection without medical advice.

Common side effects
Stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, headache and dizziness may occur. Longer or intensive treatment may cause abnormal liver test results.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding before use. Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically prescribed. Longer treatment courses may require liver function and blood-count monitoring. Seek medical advice for yellowing of the skin or eyes, severe abdominal pain, unusual bruising or a serious skin reaction.

title: Alzole Plus 10 Ml (10Ml) Albendazole 200Mg + Ivermectin 3Mg By Martin & Brown

searchText: Alzole Plus 10 Ml (10Ml) Albendazole 200Mg + Ivermectin 3Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to treat certain parasitic worm infections, including intestinal worm infections. The exact use depends on the type of parasite diagnosed.

How does it work?
Albendazole damages the parasite's ability to use energy, while ivermectin affects the parasite's nerve and muscle function. Together, they help kill or remove susceptible parasites from the body.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dose and treatment duration, and do not repeat treatment without medical advice. Take with or without food as instructed for the specific infection.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and tiredness may occur. Mild symptoms related to the dying parasites can also occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor if there is pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver disease, or a history of seizures or neurological problems. Children and people with low body weight may require special medical advice. Seek medical help for severe dizziness, confusion, yellowing of the skin or eyes, severe abdominal pain, or an allergic reaction.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
HCG (human chorionic gonadotropin) injection is mainly used in fertility treatment to trigger ovulation in women. It may also be prescribed for certain hormone-related fertility problems in men.

How does it work?
HCG acts similarly to luteinising hormone (LH). It helps trigger the release of an egg in women and can stimulate testosterone production and sperm development in some men.

How to take/use it
This is an injectable prescription medicine. It should be given exactly as prescribed, usually by a healthcare professional. Do not self-inject unless properly instructed.

Common side effects
Headache, tiredness, mood changes, nausea, abdominal bloating or pain, breast tenderness, and pain or redness at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Do not use during pregnancy unless specifically directed by a specialist. Women receiving HCG for fertility treatment may develop ovarian hyperstimulation or multiple pregnancy. Seek urgent medical help for severe abdominal pain or swelling, rapid weight gain, breathing difficulty, chest pain, or painful leg swelling. Tell the doctor about ovarian cysts, hormone-sensitive cancers, blood-clotting problems, or other hormone treatments.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
?-? Arteether injection is used to treat malaria, especially severe or falciparum malaria when rapid injectable treatment is needed. Severe malaria requires urgent medical care.

How does it work?
It is an artemisinin-based antimalarial. It is activated inside malaria parasites and damages them, helping clear the infection from the blood.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a healthcare professional, usually in a hospital or clinic. The dose and treatment schedule depend on the severity of malaria and must be decided by the doctor. Further antimalarial treatment may be needed after the injections.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, weakness, fever, and pain at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Do not self-administer this injection. Seek urgent medical help for worsening fever, confusion, seizures, breathing difficulty, fainting, or severe weakness. Medical follow-up may be needed after treatment because delayed breakdown of red blood cells can rarely occur. Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver or kidney problems, and all other medicines being used.
