What is it used for?
Used to relieve cough with phlegm and associated wheezing or breathing difficulty in certain respiratory conditions, only when prescribed or recommended by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Salbutamol helps relax and open the airways. Ambroxol thins mucus, while guaifenesin helps loosen phlegm so it can be coughed out more easily.

How to take/use it
Take or use only as directed by the doctor or as stated on the product label. Do not take more than recommended. Do not stop prescribed respiratory treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Shakiness or tremor, nervousness, headache, fast heartbeat or palpitations, nausea, vomiting, stomach upset and diarrhoea.

Precautions
Use cautiously and inform the doctor if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid or a history of seizures. Seek urgent medical help for severe or worsening breathing difficulty, chest pain, a very fast or irregular heartbeat, or signs of a serious allergic reaction.

Used to help relieve cough with mucus and breathing difficulty caused by narrowed airways or bronchospasm, such as in some respiratory conditions. It helps loosen mucus so it can be cleared more easily.

How does it work?
Salbutamol relaxes the muscles around the airways to make breathing easier. Ambroxol and guaifenesin help thin and loosen mucus, making it easier to cough out.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by the doctor or as directed on the label. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Measure liquid medicines with a proper measuring device if applicable.

Common side effects
Shakiness or tremor, nervousness, headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, an overactive thyroid, diabetes or a history of seizures. Seek medical help for worsening breathing difficulty, chest pain, severe or irregular heartbeat, or signs of a serious allergic reaction.

What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat vitamin C deficiency. Vitamin C is also needed for normal collagen formation, wound healing, and immune function.

How does it work?
Vitamin C acts as a water-soluble antioxidant and helps the body make collagen. It also improves the absorption of iron from plant-based foods.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth with water, with or without food, as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
High amounts may cause nausea, stomach cramps, heartburn, or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is a history of kidney stones, kidney disease, iron-overload disorders, or glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency. High doses may increase the risk of kidney stones or iron-related problems.

This combination is used to help relieve cough with thick mucus and breathing difficulty caused by narrowed airways or respiratory conditions. It may be prescribed when both airway opening and mucus clearance are needed.

How does it work?
Salbutamol relaxes the muscles around the airways to make breathing easier. Ambroxol and guaifenesin help thin and loosen mucus so it can be cleared more easily by coughing.

How to take/use it
Take or use exactly as prescribed by the doctor or pharmacist. Do not change the dose or use it for longer than advised. Measure liquid doses carefully if supplied as a liquid.

Common side effects
Shakiness or tremors, nervousness, headache, fast heartbeat or palpitations, nausea, vomiting, stomach upset and diarrhoea may occur. Skin rash can occur rarely.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is heart disease, an irregular heartbeat, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid or a history of seizures. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding or allergies. Seek urgent medical help for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, very fast or irregular heartbeat, or swelling of the face, lips or throat.

Used to relieve cough with phlegm, wheezing and breathing difficulty caused by narrowed airways. It helps loosen mucus and make it easier to cough up.

Salbutamol relaxes the muscles around the airways to help improve breathing. Ambroxol and guaifenesin thin and loosen mucus, making it easier to clear from the chest.

Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than the recommended amount. If it is a liquid, measure each dose with the supplied measuring device rather than a household spoon.

Shaking or tremors, nervousness, headache, nausea, stomach upset and a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, an overactive thyroid, diabetes or pregnancy. Seek medical help for severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, a very fast or irregular heartbeat, or signs of an allergic reaction. Do not use with other salbutamol-containing medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Terbutaline relaxes the muscles around the airways to help open them. Bromhexine and guaifenesin help thin and loosen mucus, while menthol provides a soothing sensation.

Use only as directed on the label or by a doctor. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If symptoms persist or worsen, seek medical advice.

Shakiness, nervousness, headache, nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, an overactive thyroid, or a history of seizures. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Atropine injection is mainly used in emergency care to treat an unusually slow heartbeat. It may also be used to reduce excessive saliva and airway secretions before surgery, and as part of treatment for certain poisonings, such as organophosphate poisoning.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of acetylcholine, a chemical messenger in the body. This can increase the heart rate and reduce saliva and other secretions.

How to take/use it
This injection must be given by a doctor or other trained healthcare professional. The dose and frequency depend on the condition being treated and the patient's response.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, blurred vision, increased heart rate, flushing, constipation, reduced sweating and difficulty passing urine may occur.

Precautions
Use carefully in people with glaucoma, prostate or urinary problems, heart conditions, high fever, or intestinal blockage. Seek urgent medical help for severe fast or irregular heartbeat, confusion, extreme restlessness, inability to pass urine, or breathing difficulty.

Atropine injection is used by healthcare professionals in emergencies to treat a dangerously slow heartbeat. It may also be used for certain poisonings and to reduce excessive saliva or airway secretions during medical procedures.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of acetylcholine, a natural chemical that can slow the heart and increase body secretions. This can increase the heart rate and reduce secretions.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. It is not intended for self-use. The dose and route depend on the medical condition being treated.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, blurred vision, sensitivity to light, fast heartbeat, constipation, difficulty passing urine, dizziness and confusion may occur.

Precautions
Use carefully in people with glaucoma, prostate or urinary problems, heart disease, fever, or intestinal blockage. Seek urgent medical attention for severe fast heartbeat, confusion, difficulty breathing, or inability to pass urine.

It blocks the action of acetylcholine, a chemical messenger in the body. This can increase heart rate and reduce secretions and muscle spasms in certain organs.

This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose and route depend on the condition being treated and must be decided by the treating doctor. It should not be self-administered.

Dry mouth, blurred vision, sensitivity to light, fast heartbeat, flushing, constipation, difficulty passing urine, and dizziness may occur.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Azithromycin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the throat, ear, lungs, skin and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as prescribed by the doctor and complete the recommended course, even if symptoms improve. Do not take extra doses or share this medicine with others. The dose and duration depend on the infection and the patient's age and health condition.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain, vomiting and headache may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is an allergy to azithromycin or other macrolide antibiotics, liver disease, or a history of abnormal heart rhythm or prolonged QT interval. Tell the doctor about all other medicines being used, as some medicines can interact with azithromycin. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, yellowing of the skin or eyes, a severe allergic reaction, or a fast or irregular heartbeat.

What is it used for?
Lignocaine 2% is a local anaesthetic used to temporarily numb a specific area of the body. Its exact use depends on the formulation and may include numbing the skin or tissues before a procedure or relieving local pain.

How does it work?
It temporarily blocks the nerve signals that carry pain from the treated area to the brain, causing numbness.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor, pharmacist or the product instructions. The correct method depends on whether it is a gel, cream, spray, injection or another formulation. Do not use more than recommended or apply it to large or damaged areas unless advised.

Common side effects
Temporary numbness, mild burning, stinging, redness or irritation at the application site.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to lignocaine or similar local anaesthetics. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow unless specifically instructed. Seek urgent medical help for severe dizziness, ringing in the ears, unusual drowsiness, breathing difficulty, swelling or a fast or irregular heartbeat.

What is it used for?
Lignocaine + adrenaline is used by a healthcare professional to numb a specific area during medical or dental procedures. It helps prevent pain, while adrenaline can make the numbing effect last longer and reduce bleeding in the treated area.

How does it work?
Lignocaine temporarily blocks pain signals from the nerves. Adrenaline narrows nearby blood vessels, which can slow the removal of lignocaine and help reduce bleeding.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into the treatment area by a trained healthcare professional. It must not be self-injected. The dose and injection site depend on the procedure and the person’s medical condition.

Common side effects
Temporary numbness, pain or soreness at the injection site, dizziness, trembling, or a fast or pounding heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Tell the healthcare professional about any allergy to local anaesthetics, heart disease or irregular heartbeat, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, liver disease, or medicines being taken. Seek urgent medical help for severe dizziness, difficulty breathing, seizures, severe weakness, or a very fast or irregular heartbeat.

How does it work?
It relaxes the smooth muscles in the stomach, intestines and other internal organs, helping to reduce cramping and spasmodic pain.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the pack or by a healthcare professional. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not take more than recommended. Seek medical advice if pain is severe, persistent or keeps returning.

Dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, fast heartbeat and difficulty passing urine may occur.

Use only after medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or an enlarged prostate, a fast or irregular heartbeat, bowel blockage, severe constipation, megacolon or myasthenia gravis. Dicyclomine relaxes the muscles of the intestine and reduces spasms. Simethicone helps combine gas bubbles, making them easier to pass.

Take or use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If it is a liquid, measure it with the supplied measuring device rather than a household spoon.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Betamethasone sodium injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce severe inflammation and overactive immune reactions in conditions such as severe allergies, asthma, skin or joint inflammation, and some autoimmune conditions. Its use depends on the condition being treated.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and suppresses excessive immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
This injection should be given only by a qualified healthcare professional, by the recommended route. The dose and treatment duration depend on the condition and response to treatment.

Common side effects
Injection-site pain, increased blood sugar or blood pressure, indigestion, fluid retention, mood changes, difficulty sleeping, and increased risk of infections may occur.

Precautions
Tell the healthcare professional about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, glaucoma, mental health conditions, liver or kidney problems, or any current infection. Corticosteroids can mask infection symptoms and may affect blood sugar. Avoid live vaccines unless specifically advised. Do not stop prolonged treatment suddenly without medical advice.

What is it used for?
Amikacin is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, including certain infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, blood, bones and joints. It is generally used when other antibiotics may not be suitable and is usually given in a hospital or under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the production of proteins that bacteria need to survive and multiply.

How to take/use it
Amikacin is usually given as an injection by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type of infection, body weight and kidney function. Do not self-administer or stop treatment early unless advised by the prescriber.

Common side effects
Pain or redness at the injection site, nausea and headache may occur. This medicine can also cause serious kidney or hearing-related side effects.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, or myasthenia gravis. Kidney function and, when needed, hearing should be monitored during treatment. Inform the doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding, or if taking other medicines that may affect the kidneys or hearing. Seek medical help for reduced urine, swelling, ringing in the ears, dizziness, balance problems or hearing loss.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow the capsule with water, preferably with food unless advised otherwise. Do not take additional calcium or vitamin D supplements without medical advice.

Precautions

How does it work?
Calcium and magnesium provide minerals needed for bones and muscles. Calcitriol helps the body absorb calcium, while vitamin K2 and the B vitamins support normal bone and blood-cell functions.

How to take/use it
Take only in the dose and for the duration recommended on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than recommended or combine it with other calcium or vitamin D products unless advised.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, stomach discomfort or vomiting may occur. Excess calcium may cause increased thirst, frequent urination, weakness or confusion.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, kidney stones, high blood calcium, or a history of vitamin D-related disorders. Seek medical advice if symptoms of excess calcium occur. Discuss its use with a healthcare professional if taking digoxin, thiazide diuretics, or other calcium or vitamin D products.

title: Calcy-Mb 10Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Calcium Gluconate By Martin & Brown
name: Calcy-Mb 10Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Calcium Gluconate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Calcy-Mb 10Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Calcium Gluconate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Calcium gluconate is used to treat or prevent low calcium levels in the body. Injectable calcium gluconate may be used in hospitals for urgent treatment of severe low calcium and certain medical emergencies.

How does it work?
It supplies calcium, which is needed for healthy bones and teeth, normal muscle movement, nerve function and heart activity.

How to take/use it
Use it only as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Oral forms should be taken as directed. Injectable calcium gluconate must be given by a trained healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Oral forms may cause constipation, stomach discomfort, nausea or diarrhoea. Injection-site irritation may occur with injectable forms. Rapid or incorrectly administered injections can cause serious heart-related effects.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones or high calcium levels. Inform the doctor or pharmacist about other medicines, especially thyroid medicine, iron supplements and certain antibiotics, as calcium can affect their absorption. Seek urgent medical help for irregular heartbeat, severe weakness, confusion or difficulty breathing.

title: Calcy-Mb 200 Ml (200 Ml) Each 5 Ml Contains: Calcium Phosphate Eq. To Elemental Calcium - 82 Mg Vitamin D3 - 200 Iu + Vitamin B12 - 2.5 By Martin & Brown
name: Calcy-Mb 200 Ml (200 Ml) Each 5 Ml Contains: Calcium Phosphate Eq. To Elemental Calcium - 82 Mg Vitamin D3 - 200 Iu + Vitamin B12 - 2.5 By Martin & Brown
searchText: Calcy-Mb 200 Ml (200 Ml) Each 5 Ml Contains: Calcium Phosphate Eq. To Elemental Calcium - 82 Mg Vitamin D3 - 200 Iu + Vitamin B12 - 2.5 By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to provide calcium, vitamin D3 and vitamin B12. Calcium and vitamin D3 support normal bones and teeth, while vitamin B12 supports normal nerve function and red blood cell formation.

How does it work?
Calcium provides the mineral needed for bones and teeth. Vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium, while vitamin B12 supports blood-cell and nerve function.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
May cause constipation, nausea, stomach discomfort or bloating, particularly with calcium supplements.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones or high calcium levels. Avoid taking more than the recommended amount. Seek medical advice if unusual symptoms occur.

title: Calcy-Mb 500 (20X15) Calcium With Vitamin D3 By Martin & Brown
name: Calcy-Mb 500 (20X15) Calcium With Vitamin D3 By Martin & Brown
searchText: Calcy-Mb 500 (20X15) Calcium With Vitamin D3 By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement calcium and vitamin D3 when dietary intake is insufficient, helping support healthy bones and teeth and prevent or correct deficiencies.

How does it work?
Calcium provides an essential mineral needed for bones, teeth, muscles and nerves. Vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium from the intestine.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If taking other medicines, ask a pharmacist or doctor whether they should be taken separately.

Common side effects
Constipation, gas, bloating, nausea or stomach discomfort may occur, especially with higher amounts.

Precautions
Ask a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, or high calcium or vitamin D levels. Calcium can affect the absorption of some medicines, including iron supplements, thyroid medicines and certain antibiotics; seek medical advice about suitable timing. Avoid taking multiple calcium or vitamin D products unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Ceclobiotic E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Clotrimazole,Lignocaine Hcl By Martin & Brown
name: Ceclobiotic E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Clotrimazole,Lignocaine Hcl By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ceclobiotic E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Clotrimazole,Lignocaine Hcl By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
It is used to treat fungal infections of the skin and relieve associated itching, burning and local discomfort.

How does it work?
Clotrimazole stops the growth of fungi. Lignocaine is a local anaesthetic that temporarily numbs the area and helps reduce discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only on the affected area and exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Clean and dry the area before application. Wash hands before and after use, unless treating the hands. Avoid contact with the eyes and mouth.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, redness, irritation or itching at the application site.

Precautions
For external use unless specifically directed otherwise. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling, rash or other signs of an allergic reaction occur, or if the infection does not improve. Do not use on broken skin or near the eyes unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Ceezcold C Susp. (M.Cap) (Mg60 Ml) Pcm 125Mg + Cpm 2Mg + Phenylephrine Hcl 2.5 By Martin & Brown
name: Ceezcold C Susp. (M.Cap) (Mg60 Ml) Pcm 125Mg + Cpm 2Mg + Phenylephrine Hcl 2.5 By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ceezcold C Susp. (M.Cap) (Mg60 Ml) Pcm 125Mg + Cpm 2Mg + Phenylephrine Hcl 2.5 By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold symptoms such as fever, headache or body aches, blocked or runny nose, sneezing and watery eyes.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce fever and pain. Chlorpheniramine helps reduce allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal blockage.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it with other medicines containing paracetamol or similar cold-relief ingredients.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea and mild stomach discomfort. Some people may experience a fast heartbeat or restlessness.

Precautions
Chlorpheniramine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or alcohol if affected. Ask a doctor before use in people with high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, urinary problems, liver disease or thyroid problems. Seek medical advice if symptoms are severe, worsen or do not improve.

title: Ceezcold Ds Susp. (M.C.) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Paracetamol 250Mg. Chlorpheniramine Maleate 2 Mg. Phenylephrine Hcl 5Mg. By Martin & Brown
name: Ceezcold Ds Susp. (M.C.) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Paracetamol 250Mg. Chlorpheniramine Maleate 2 Mg. Phenylephrine Hcl 5Mg. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ceezcold Ds Susp. (M.C.) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Paracetamol 250Mg. Chlorpheniramine Maleate 2 Mg. Phenylephrine Hcl 5Mg. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold symptoms such as fever, body aches, blocked or runny nose, sneezing and related nasal congestion.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce fever and relieve pain. Chlorpheniramine helps reduce allergy-related symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or additional cold and flu ingredients. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea and stomach discomfort. It may sometimes cause palpitations or a rise in blood pressure.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery because it may cause drowsiness. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease, prostate or urinary problems, liver disease, or use of antidepressants such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors. Consult a doctor if symptoms are severe, worsen or do not improve.

title: Ceez Cold Tab (30X10) Paracetamol 325 +Phenylephrine Hcl 5 Mg.+Caffeine 30 Mg +Diphenhydramine 25 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ceez Cold Tab (30X10) Paracetamol 325 +Phenylephrine Hcl 5 Mg.+Caffeine 30 Mg +Diphenhydramine 25 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ceez Cold Tab (30X10) Paracetamol 325 +Phenylephrine Hcl 5 Mg.+Caffeine 30 Mg +Diphenhydramine 25 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of cold and flu symptoms such as fever, headache, body aches, blocked nose, runny nose and sneezing.

How does it work?
Paracetamol reduces fever and pain. Phenylephrine helps relieve nasal blockage, while diphenhydramine reduces runny nose and sneezing; caffeine may enhance the pain-relieving effect of paracetamol.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount, and avoid using it with other medicines containing paracetamol, diphenhydramine or decongestants.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, restlessness, difficulty sleeping, increased blood pressure or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Diphenhydramine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, prostate or urination problems, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe palpitations, allergic reactions or symptoms that worsen or do not improve.

title: Chlordex E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Chloramphenicol+Dexa. Sod. By Martin & Brown
name: Chlordex E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Chloramphenicol+Dexa. Sod. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Chlordex E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Chloramphenicol+Dexa. Sod. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for bacterial eye infections accompanied by inflammation, redness or swelling. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Chloramphenicol stops the growth of susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone reduces inflammation, redness and swelling in the affected eye.

How to take/use it
Use in the affected eye exactly as prescribed. Wash hands before use, avoid touching the dropper tip to the eye or any surface, and complete the prescribed course. Do not wear contact lenses unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, irritation, watering or blurred vision after application. Prolonged use may increase eye pressure or cause other eye problems.

Precautions
Do not use for untreated viral or fungal eye infections unless specifically advised. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, vision changes, severe eye pain or an allergic reaction occurs. Long-term or repeated use should be medically supervised. Avoid driving until temporary blurred vision clears.

title: Chlorkem 60 Ml (60Ml) Chloramphenicol Palmitate 125Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Chlorkem 60 Ml (60Ml) Chloramphenicol Palmitate 125Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Chlorkem 60 Ml (60Ml) Chloramphenicol Palmitate 125Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Chloramphenicol palmitate is an antibiotic used to treat certain serious bacterial infections, usually when other suitable antibiotics cannot be used. It should only be used under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which prevents them from growing and multiplying.

How to take/use it
Take it only in the dose and for the duration prescribed by the doctor. Do not skip doses, stop early, or use it for viral infections such as colds or flu.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Chloramphenicol can rarely cause serious blood disorders, including bone marrow suppression. Seek urgent medical help for unusual bruising or bleeding, persistent fever, sore throat, severe weakness, or pale skin. Tell the doctor about any blood disorder, liver disease, or previous reaction to chloramphenicol. It should not be self-used and may require blood monitoring during treatment. Newborn babies and young infants require special medical caution.

title: Chlor-Mb 30Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
name: Chlor-Mb 30Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Chlor-Mb 30Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Chlorpheniramine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, and itchy or watery eyes. It may also help relieve some cold-related runny-nose symptoms.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce symptoms such as itching, sneezing and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the package or by a healthcare professional. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty passing urine.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that cause drowsiness unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek advice before use if there is glaucoma, prostate enlargement, difficulty passing urine, breathing problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe drowsiness, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

title: Ciflin-D E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown
name: Ciflin-D E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ciflin-D E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ciprofloxacin + dexamethasone is used to treat certain bacterial infections of the eye or ear that also involve inflammation. The exact use depends on the product formulation and should be confirmed on the label or by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Ciprofloxacin is an antibiotic that stops the growth of susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation, swelling and irritation.

How to take/use it
Use only in the eye or ear specified on the product label and exactly as prescribed. Do not use it in another body part, share it with others, or continue it longer than advised. Avoid touching the dropper tip to the eye, ear or other surfaces.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, burning, irritation, itching or discomfort may occur at the application site. Temporary blurred vision may occur with eye preparations.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ciprofloxacin, other quinolone antibiotics, dexamethasone or any ingredient. This medicine is not suitable for all viral or fungal infections. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, do not improve, or if severe pain, swelling, rash, breathing difficulty or vision changes occur. Contact lens wearers should follow the product instructions; eye lenses may need to be removed before use.

title: Cip Drop-D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown
name: Cip Drop-D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Cip Drop-D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This prescription combination is generally used as drops for certain bacterial infections of the eye or ear that are accompanied by inflammation. The exact use depends on the prescribed formulation and diagnosis.

How does it work?
Ciprofloxacin is an antibiotic that stops the growth of susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation, redness and swelling.

How to take/use it
Use only in the eye or ear and only as directed by a doctor. Follow the prescribed number of drops and treatment duration. Do not touch the dropper tip to the eye, ear or other surfaces. Do not use leftover drops for a new infection.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, burning, itching or irritation at the application site may occur. Eye or ear discomfort can also occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ciprofloxacin, other quinolone antibiotics, dexamethasone or similar medicines. Use only for the condition prescribed, as steroid-containing drops may worsen some viral or fungal infections or mask signs of infection. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, vision or hearing changes occur, or there is severe pain, swelling or an allergic reaction.

title: Cip-Drop Eye 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ciprofloxacin By Martin & Brown
name: Cip-Drop Eye 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ciprofloxacin By Martin & Brown
searchText: Cip-Drop Eye 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ciprofloxacin By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ciprofloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some urinary, intestinal, respiratory, skin and other infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills or stops the growth of bacteria by blocking enzymes they need to copy and repair their DNA.

How to take/use it
Use it only as prescribed and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Take with plenty of water. Do not take it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing calcium, iron, magnesium or zinc; follow the prescribed spacing instructions. Do not share leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, vomiting, headache, dizziness and skin rash.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies, pregnancy or breastfeeding, kidney problems, heart rhythm problems, seizures, tendon problems or myasthenia gravis. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, numbness or tingling, severe mood or nerve-related symptoms, palpitations, or a serious allergic reaction. Avoid unnecessary intense exercise if tendon pain develops.

title: Cipromac Tz Tab (20 X 10) Ciprofloxacin 500 + Tinidazole 600 By Martin & Brown
name: Cipromac Tz Tab (20 X 10) Ciprofloxacin 500 + Tinidazole 600 By Martin & Brown
searchText: Cipromac Tz Tab (20 X 10) Ciprofloxacin 500 + Tinidazole 600 By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This prescription combination is used to treat certain bacterial and parasitic infections of the digestive tract that may cause infectious diarrhoea or dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Ciprofloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Tinidazole damages the DNA of certain parasites and anaerobic bacteria, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water. Do not take it together with antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc; ask a pharmacist about the appropriate time gap. Avoid alcohol while taking it and for 3 days after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney problems, seizures, heart rhythm problems, tendon disorders or previous reactions to quinolone antibiotics. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe or bloody diarrhoea, rash, breathing difficulty or other serious symptoms. Do not self-medicate or use it for ordinary non-infectious diarrhoea.

title: Cipsin E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Ciprofloxacin By Martin & Brown
name: Cipsin E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Ciprofloxacin By Martin & Brown
searchText: Cipsin E/E 5 Ml (25X5 Ml) Ciprofloxacin By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ciprofloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some urinary tract, respiratory, gastrointestinal, skin, bone and joint infections. It does not work against viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking enzymes they need to copy and repair their DNA.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with plenty of water. Do not take it at the same time as antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc; follow a pharmacist or doctor’s advice about spacing them. Avoid taking it with dairy products alone.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache and dizziness.

Precautions
Tell a doctor if there is a history of tendon problems, seizures, nerve problems, heart rhythm problems, kidney disease, or if pregnant or breastfeeding. Stop taking it and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, serious rash, breathing difficulty, fainting or unusual mental or nerve-related symptoms. Avoid unnecessary strenuous exercise during treatment and shortly afterwards because of the risk of tendon injury.

title: Cirtiz Tab (100X10) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 10Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Cirtiz Tab (100X10) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 10Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Cirtiz Tab (100X10) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 10Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cetirizine is used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching or hives (urticaria).

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as directed on the label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than the recommended amount. It may cause drowsiness in some people.

Common side effects
Drowsiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, and dizziness.

Precautions
Avoid driving or using machinery until its effects are known. Avoid or limit alcohol, as it may increase drowsiness. Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding, or if taking other medicines that cause drowsiness. Seek urgent help for swelling of the face, lips or throat, or difficulty breathing.

title: Closafe Dusting Powder (100Gm) Clotrimazole Dusting Powder By Martin & Brown
name: Closafe Dusting Powder (100Gm) Clotrimazole Dusting Powder By Martin & Brown
searchText: Closafe Dusting Powder (100Gm) Clotrimazole Dusting Powder By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Clotrimazole dusting powder is used on the skin to treat fungal infections such as athlete’s foot, ringworm, jock itch and some yeast infections. It can also help keep affected skin dry.

How does it work?
It stops fungi from making an important part of their cell membrane, which helps control and clear the infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply a thin layer to clean, completely dry affected skin and use it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands before and after use. Avoid inhaling the powder and keep it away from the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching, burning or stinging may occur where it is applied.

Precautions
Do not use on broken or severely irritated skin unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop using it and seek medical advice if severe irritation, swelling or an allergic reaction occurs, or if the infection worsens or does not improve. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow.

title: Closafe Dusting Powder (75 Gm) Clotrimazole Dusting Powder By Martin & Brown
name: Closafe Dusting Powder (75 Gm) Clotrimazole Dusting Powder By Martin & Brown
searchText: Closafe Dusting Powder (75 Gm) Clotrimazole Dusting Powder By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Clotrimazole dusting powder is used to treat fungal skin infections such as athlete’s foot, ringworm and jock itch. It may also help keep affected skin dry.

How does it work?
Clotrimazole stops fungi from making an essential part of their cell membrane, which helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Apply the powder to clean, completely dry affected skin as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Wash hands before and after use. Avoid inhaling the powder and do not apply it to the eyes or mouth.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, burning, stinging, redness or itching may occur at the application site.

Precautions
For external use only. Keep away from the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Stop use and seek medical advice if severe irritation, an allergic reaction or worsening symptoms occur. Seek medical advice if the infection does not improve with treatment.

title: Cofrex-Dx 100Ml (100Ml) Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
name: Cofrex-Dx 100Ml (100Ml) Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Cofrex-Dx 100Ml (100Ml) Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of dry cough and associated cold or allergy symptoms such as a runny nose and sneezing.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the cough reflex in the brain. Chlorpheniramine is an antihistamine that helps relieve allergy-related symptoms such as a runny nose and sneezing.

How to take/use it
Take/use only as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount, and use the measuring device provided for liquid formulations. Do not use with other medicines containing dextromethorphan or chlorpheniramine unless advised.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea and constipation may occur.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Consult a healthcare professional before use in children, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is glaucoma, breathing difficulty, prostate or urinary problems, or liver disease. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines or within 14 days of stopping them. Seek medical advice if the cough lasts, worsens, or is associated with high fever, breathing difficulty or excessive mucus.

title: Cold Care Drops 15 Ml (15 Ml) Cpm 1 Mg+Para 125 Mg+ Phenylephrine 2.5 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Cold Care Drops 15 Ml (15 Ml) Cpm 1 Mg+Para 125 Mg+ Phenylephrine 2.5 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Cold Care Drops 15 Ml (15 Ml) Cpm 1 Mg+Para 125 Mg+ Phenylephrine 2.5 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used for temporary relief of common cold symptoms such as blocked or runny nose, sneezing, fever and body aches.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce fever and body aches. Chlorpheniramine reduces allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal blockage.

How to take/use it
Use only in the dose and manner stated on the product label or prescribed by a doctor. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol. Do not use it for longer than recommended without medical advice.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness, nausea, restlessness, nervousness or a fast heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Drowsiness may affect driving or operating machinery; avoid alcohol. Consult a doctor before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease or difficulty passing urine. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, persist, or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Coldcare-S Susp. 60 Ml(M.Cap) (60Ml) Pcm+Cpm+Phenylephrine Hcl By Martin & Brown
name: Coldcare-S Susp. 60 Ml(M.Cap) (60Ml) Pcm+Cpm+Phenylephrine Hcl By Martin & Brown
searchText: Coldcare-S Susp. 60 Ml(M.Cap) (60Ml) Pcm+Cpm+Phenylephrine Hcl By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of common cold symptoms such as blocked or runny nose, sneezing, headache, body aches and fever.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce fever and relieve pain. Chlorpheniramine helps reduce sneezing and a runny nose, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal blockage.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the package or by a healthcare professional. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol. Avoid alcohol and do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and stomach discomfort. Phenylephrine may sometimes cause restlessness, palpitations or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery if affected. Seek medical advice before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or an enlarged prostate. Avoid taking it with alcohol or certain antidepressants, including MAO inhibitors. Seek medical help for severe or persistent symptoms, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

title: Coloflam Tab (20X15) Ibuprofen 400Mg + Para 325Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Coloflam Tab (20X15) Ibuprofen 400Mg + Para 325Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Coloflam Tab (20X15) Ibuprofen 400Mg + Para 325Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain, such as body aches, muscle or joint pain, headache, toothache and menstrual pain. It can also help reduce fever and inflammation.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Ibuprofen reduces substances in the body that cause pain, inflammation and fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the package or by a doctor. Take with or after food and swallow with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it with other medicines containing paracetamol or ibuprofen unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, heartburn, dizziness or headache.

Precautions
Avoid use or seek medical advice if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, severe heart problems, or allergy to ibuprofen, aspirin or other painkillers. Stop use and seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin rash, breathing difficulty or swelling of the face or throat.

What is it used for?
Vitamin B-complex is used to prevent or treat deficiency of B vitamins. It supports normal energy metabolism, nerve function and red blood cell production.

How does it work?
It supplies several B vitamins that help the body convert food into energy and support the normal functioning of the nervous system and blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset.

Common side effects
Mild nausea, stomach upset or headache may occur. Bright yellow urine can occur and is usually harmless.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional if pregnant, breastfeeding, or if there is kidney or liver disease. Avoid taking more than the recommended amount, especially for long periods, because excessive vitamin B6 can cause nerve problems. Seek medical advice if unusual numbness, tingling or weakness develops.

What is it used for?
Used to improve appetite in people with poor appetite or inadequate food intake, and may help support weight gain when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Cyproheptadine can increase appetite by blocking certain histamine and serotonin effects in the body. Tricholine citrate is included as a nutritional support ingredient.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, increased appetite, nausea and stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Cyproheptadine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Use only under medical advice in children, older adults, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and in people with glaucoma, urinary retention, asthma or liver problems. Seek medical help for severe sleepiness, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

Take only in the dose and for the duration prescribed by the doctor. Do not take more than recommended. If it causes drowsiness, avoid driving or operating machinery.

Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, increased appetite, nausea and stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Cyproheptadine may cause sleepiness, which can worsen with alcohol or other sedating medicines. Seek medical advice before use if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, asthma, liver disease or pregnancy. Keep out of reach of children.

How does it work?
Cyproheptadine blocks certain histamine and serotonin effects and can stimulate appetite. Tricholine citrate and sorbitol are included as supporting ingredients in the formulation.

How to take/use it
Take only in the dose and for the duration prescribed by the doctor. Measure the liquid with the supplied measuring device and do not use a household spoon. Do not use it for weight gain without medical advice.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, increased appetite, weight gain, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or abdominal cramps.

Precautions
Cyproheptadine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Tell the doctor about glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, asthma, liver disease or other medical conditions. Use in children, during pregnancy or while breastfeeding only on medical advice. Seek medical help for severe drowsiness, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dose and duration, and do not take more than recommended.

Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, nausea, and increased appetite or weight gain.

Cyproheptadine may cause drowsiness; avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, or other ongoing medical conditions. Keep out of reach of children.

What is it used for?
Cyproheptadine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itching, watery eyes and hives. It may also be prescribed by a doctor to help stimulate appetite in some people.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions, and helps reduce allergy symptoms. It can also affect serotonin pathways, which may increase appetite.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. It may cause sleepiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Do not take more than recommended.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, increased appetite and weight gain.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that cause drowsiness unless advised by a doctor. Use cautiously if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, asthma, liver or kidney disease, or in older adults. It is generally not used in infants below 2 years unless specifically prescribed. Seek medical help for severe drowsiness, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

What is it used for?
Used for certain bacterial eye infections that are accompanied by redness, swelling or inflammation. It should be used only when prescribed, as the steroid component is not suitable for every eye infection.

How does it work?
Chloramphenicol kills susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone reduces inflammation, redness and swelling in the affected eye.

How to take/use it
Use only in the eye and exactly as directed by a doctor. Do not touch the dropper or applicator tip to the eye or any surface. Do not wear contact lenses unless advised by an eye specialist. The exact dose and treatment duration depend on the product and condition.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, irritation or blurred vision after application. Prolonged or repeated use may increase eye pressure or delay healing.

Precautions
Do not use for an undiagnosed red eye or suspected viral or fungal infection unless advised by an eye specialist. Tell the doctor about glaucoma, eye injury, or recent eye surgery. Seek medical help for worsening pain, vision changes, severe swelling, or an allergic reaction. Prolonged or repeated use should be monitored by a doctor.

What is it used for?
Dexamethasone injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce severe inflammation and overactive immune or allergic reactions. Its exact use depends on the condition being treated and must be decided by a doctor.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and suppresses excessive immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional as an injection. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the condition and medical response. Do not self-inject or use it without medical supervision.

Common side effects
Increased blood sugar, indigestion, mood or sleep changes, increased appetite, fluid retention and increased risk of infection may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental-health problems or any infection. Steroids can mask infection symptoms. With repeated or prolonged use, it should not be stopped suddenly unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for signs of a serious infection, severe mood changes or breathing difficulty.

How does it work?
It reduces the activity of substances in the body that cause inflammation and allergic or immune reactions.

How to take/use it
This strength is generally given as an injection by a doctor or other trained healthcare professional. The route, dose and duration depend on the condition being treated and should be decided by the prescriber. Do not self-administer it.

Common side effects
Indigestion, increased appetite, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, increased blood sugar, fluid retention and pain or discomfort at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, glaucoma, mental health problems or any infection. Corticosteroids can reduce the body's ability to fight infections and may mask infection symptoms. Avoid close contact with people who have contagious infections unless advised otherwise. If used for a longer period, it should not be stopped suddenly without medical advice.

What is it used for?
This combination is used to treat certain types of infectious diarrhoea or dysentery accompanied by abdominal cramps. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Metronidazole and furazolidone act against certain bacteria and other microorganisms that can cause intestinal infections. Dicyclomine relaxes intestinal muscles and helps relieve cramping and spasms.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or after food if advised. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for self-treatment of diarrhoea.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, metallic taste, dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, headache or blurred vision may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Tell the doctor about liver disease, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, bowel obstruction, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Furazolidone may interact with certain antidepressants and other medicines, so disclose all current medicines. Seek medical help for severe dehydration, blood in stools, persistent diarrhoea, severe abdominal pain, rash or unusual tingling or numbness.

What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of moderate pain and inflammation, including muscle, joint and arthritis-related pain.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol also helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Swallow with water, preferably after food. Do not take more than the prescribed amount or combine it with other medicines containing diclofenac, paracetamol or similar anti-inflammatory painkillers.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, dizziness and headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or regular alcohol use. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe allergic reactions, chest pain or difficulty breathing.

How does it work?
Dicyclomine relaxes the muscles of the stomach and intestines, helping reduce spasms. Paracetamol helps relieve pain.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Do not take more than recommended, and avoid using other medicines containing paracetamol at the same time.

Dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness, blurred vision, constipation, nausea or stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate enlargement, intestinal blockage, liver disease or regular alcohol use. Used for temporary relief of acidity, heartburn, indigestion and stomach discomfort caused by excess gas.

Magnesium hydroxide and aluminium hydroxide reduce stomach acid by neutralising it. Dimethicone helps gas bubbles combine and pass more easily, helping relieve bloating and discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Keep a gap of at least 2 hours from other medicines unless a healthcare professional advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Constipation or loose stools/diarrhoea may occur. Nausea or stomach discomfort can occasionally occur.

Precautions
Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if there is kidney disease, ongoing stomach pain, vomiting, black stools or difficulty swallowing. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist, keep returning or worsen. Antacids can affect the absorption of some medicines, so disclose all medicines being taken.

Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Antacids can affect the absorption of other medicines, so check with a pharmacist about the appropriate time gap.

Domperidone is used to relieve nausea and vomiting. It may also help improve movement of food through the upper digestive system in some digestive conditions.

It blocks dopamine signals involved in nausea and vomiting and helps increase movement of the stomach and upper intestine.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed. Follow the recommended dose and treatment duration, and do not take more or use it for longer than advised. Swallow the tablet with water.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, headache, abdominal cramps, diarrhoea, and increased breast tenderness or milk production may occur.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if there is a heart rhythm problem, significant heart disease, severe liver disease, or low potassium or magnesium levels. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially medicines that affect heart rhythm or interact with domperidone. Take it only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

What is it used for?
A PVC bag is a medical container used to store or deliver a product. Its specific purpose cannot be determined from the information provided.

How does it work?
It acts as a container or packaging material; it does not have an active medicinal effect.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not use the contents if the bag is damaged, leaking or appears contaminated.

Common side effects
No medicinal side effects are expected from the bag itself. Irritation or an allergic reaction may occur in people sensitive to the material.

Precautions
Check the bag for damage, leaks, discolouration or contamination before use. Follow the product-specific instructions and seek professional advice if the intended use is unclear.

title: Emitil 1Ml (Bl) (10X5X1Ml) Prochlorperazine Mesylate 12.5 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Emitil 1Ml (Bl) (10X5X1Ml) Prochlorperazine Mesylate 12.5 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Emitil 1Ml (Bl) (10X5X1Ml) Prochlorperazine Mesylate 12.5 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Prochlorperazine is mainly used to prevent or treat severe nausea and vomiting. It may also be prescribed for dizziness or vertigo.

How does it work?
It blocks dopamine signals in areas of the brain involved in nausea, vomiting and balance. It can also have a calming effect.

How to take/use it
Use it only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. The dose and method of use depend on the formulation and the condition being treated. Do not take more than prescribed.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty passing urine. Some people may develop restlessness, muscle stiffness or unusual movements.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery, as it may cause drowsiness or dizziness. Tell the doctor if there is glaucoma, prostate or urinary difficulty, epilepsy, heart problems, liver disease, or a history of movement disorders. Seek urgent medical help for severe muscle stiffness, high fever, confusion, fainting, or uncontrolled movements.

title: Epicin Mb 1Ml ( Bl ) (10X5X1Ml) Valethamate Bromide Injection By Martin & Brown
name: Epicin Mb 1Ml ( Bl ) (10X5X1Ml) Valethamate Bromide Injection By Martin & Brown
searchText: Epicin Mb 1Ml ( Bl ) (10X5X1Ml) Valethamate Bromide Injection By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Valethamate bromide injection is used during labour to relax spasms of the cervix and help cervical dilatation. It is given under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It has an anticholinergic action that relaxes smooth muscles, including the muscles of the cervix and uterus.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or nurse. The dose and timing are decided by the healthcare professional. Do not self-inject.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, blurred vision, dizziness, fast heartbeat, constipation and difficulty passing urine may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or prostate enlargement, heart rhythm problems, or an allergy to this medicine. Seek urgent medical help for severe palpitations, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or vision problems.

title: Erkomycin-250 Tab (20X10) Erythromycin Stearate 250Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Erkomycin-250 Tab (20X10) Erythromycin Stearate 250Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Erkomycin-250 Tab (20X10) Erythromycin Stearate 250Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Erythromycin stearate is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including infections of the lungs, throat, skin and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. Swallow the tablet with water and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not share antibiotics with others.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, loss of appetite and indigestion. Mild skin rash may also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is an allergy to erythromycin or other macrolide antibiotics, liver disease, or a history of abnormal heart rhythm. Erythromycin can interact with several medicines, so provide a complete list of medicines being taken. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, yellowing of the skin or eyes, a fast or irregular heartbeat, or signs of a serious allergic reaction.

title: Erkomycin-500 Tab (10X10) Erythromycin Stearate 500Mg By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Erythromycin Stearate is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as infections of the throat, chest, skin and other parts of the body. It does not work against viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and at evenly spaced times if directed. Swallow the tablet with water and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not share antibiotics or use leftover medicine.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, abdominal cramps, diarrhoea and loss of appetite.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, a history of abnormal heart rhythm, or allergy to erythromycin or other macrolide antibiotics. Erythromycin can interact with several medicines, so provide a complete list of medicines being taken. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, yellowing of the skin or eyes, a fast or irregular heartbeat, or signs of a serious allergic reaction.

What is it used for?
Erythromycin estolate is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some infections of the respiratory tract and skin. It does not work against viral infections such as the common cold or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Do not take more or use it for longer than directed.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea and loss of appetite may occur. Skin rash can also occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is an allergy to erythromycin or other macrolide antibiotics, liver disease, or a history of irregular heartbeat. Erythromycin can interact with several medicines, so provide a complete list of medicines being taken. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, yellowing of the skin or eyes, severe rash, fainting or an irregular heartbeat.

title: Etolate-Mb (New) (10X5X2Ml) Etamsylate 125 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Etolate-Mb (New) (10X5X2Ml) Etamsylate 125 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Etolate-Mb (New) (10X5X2Ml) Etamsylate 125 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Etamsylate is used to help reduce excessive bleeding, including heavy menstrual bleeding and certain types of bleeding from small blood vessels. It should be used only for the cause of bleeding diagnosed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It helps strengthen small blood vessels and improves the formation of the initial platelet plug, which can help control capillary bleeding.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. The dose and treatment duration depend on the cause and severity of the bleeding. Do not self-treat unexplained or heavy bleeding.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, headache, skin rash or other mild allergic reactions.

Precautions
Seek medical advice promptly for heavy, persistent or unexplained bleeding. Stop using it and seek urgent help for swelling of the face or throat, difficulty breathing or a severe skin reaction. Tell the healthcare professional about any history of blood clots, other medical conditions, pregnancy or breastfeeding before use.

title: Fenicol Eye 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Chloramphenicol By Martin & Brown
name: Fenicol Eye 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Chloramphenicol By Martin & Brown
searchText: Fenicol Eye 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Chloramphenicol By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Chloramphenicol is an antibiotic used to treat certain serious bacterial infections. Some formulations are used for bacterial eye infections. It is generally reserved for situations where other suitable antibiotics are not appropriate because it can cause serious blood-related side effects.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow and multiply. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How to take/use it
Use only in the form and manner prescribed. The instructions depend on whether it is an eye preparation or a medicine taken by mouth or given by injection. Do not use it for longer than prescribed or share it with others.

Common side effects
Depending on the formulation, side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, or irritation and temporary blurred vision with eye preparations.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision, especially for prolonged or repeated treatment. Tell the doctor about any blood disorder, liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek urgent medical help for unusual bruising or bleeding, marked paleness, persistent fever, sore throat, severe weakness, or signs of a serious allergic reaction. Avoid using it for viral infections unless specifically prescribed.

title: Frnsix 2Ml Amp (Bl) (10X5X2 Ml) Frusemide 10Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Frnsix 2Ml Amp (Bl) (10X5X2 Ml) Frusemide 10Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Frnsix 2Ml Amp (Bl) (10X5X2 Ml) Frusemide 10Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Frusemide is a diuretic used to remove excess fluid from the body. It is commonly used for swelling caused by heart, kidney or liver problems and may also be prescribed for high blood pressure.

How does it work?
It helps the kidneys remove extra salt and water from the body through urine, reducing fluid build-up and sometimes lowering blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Use it exactly as prescribed. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice. It may increase urination, so follow the prescribed timing and drink fluids only as advised by the doctor.

Common side effects
Increased urination, dizziness, headache, dehydration, low blood pressure and changes in body salts such as low potassium or sodium.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver disease, low blood pressure, gout, diabetes, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being used. Medical monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function and body salts may be needed. Seek medical help for severe dizziness, fainting, unusual weakness, confusion or very little urine.

Frusemide is a diuretic used to remove excess fluid from the body. It is commonly used for swelling caused by heart, kidney or liver problems, and may also be prescribed for high blood pressure.

It helps the kidneys remove extra salt and water from the body through urine. This reduces fluid build-up and may help lower blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. It can increase urination, so follow the prescribed instructions about when to take it. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Increased urination, dizziness, headache, dehydration, low blood pressure, muscle cramps and changes in body salts such as potassium or sodium.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney or liver disease, dehydration, gout, diabetes, low blood pressure or an electrolyte imbalance. Medical advice is needed for severe dizziness, fainting, confusion, extreme weakness, irregular heartbeat, very little urine or signs of an allergic reaction.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Gentamicin is an antibiotic used to treat certain serious bacterial infections. Depending on its formulation, it may be used for infections affecting the skin, eyes, or other parts of the body.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which prevents them from growing and helps clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Use gentamicin only in the form and dose prescribed. Follow the instructions for the specific formulation, and complete the prescribed treatment unless advised otherwise. Injectable treatment may require medical monitoring.

Common side effects
Local forms may cause irritation, redness, itching, or discomfort. Injectable or systemic treatment can cause injection-site reactions, kidney problems, or hearing and balance changes.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, or previous reactions to aminoglycoside antibiotics. Kidney function and hearing may need monitoring, especially with injectable treatment or prolonged use. Seek medical help for reduced urination, ringing in the ears, hearing loss, severe dizziness, or a serious allergic reaction.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used in topical preparations to treat bacterial infections with inflammation, commonly affecting the eye or ear.

How does it work?
Gentamicin kills susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces swelling, redness and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Use only in the body area and for the duration prescribed on the label. Follow the product instructions carefully. Do not touch the applicator tip to the eye, ear or other surfaces, and do not share the medicine.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, itching, irritation or blurred vision may occur after application.

Precautions
Do not use for viral or fungal infections unless specifically advised by a doctor. Prolonged or repeated use, especially in the eye, can delay healing, increase eye pressure or worsen an infection. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, vision changes, severe pain or swelling develops, or there is no improvement. Ear preparations should be used only as directed, particularly if there may be a damaged eardrum.

What is it used for?
Gentamicin injection is an aminoglycoside antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, especially infections caused by certain Gram-negative bacteria. It may be used for infections of the blood, lungs, urinary tract, abdomen or other parts of the body when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by interfering with their ability to make essential proteins.

How to take/use it
This injection is given into a muscle or vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function and sometimes blood-test results. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, injection-site pain or irritation, and headache may occur. Serious side effects can include hearing or balance problems and kidney problems.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Kidney function and, when needed, gentamicin blood levels may be monitored during treatment. Seek medical help for reduced urination, ringing in the ears, hearing loss, dizziness, severe weakness or breathing difficulty. Inform the doctor about other medicines, especially those that can affect the kidneys or hearing.

What is it used for?

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which kills the bacteria and helps control the infection.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional as an injection into a vein or muscle. The dose and treatment duration are individually decided based on the infection, body weight and kidney function. It should not be self-injected.

Common side effects
Pain or irritation at the injection site, nausea and vomiting may occur. Gentamicin can also cause kidney problems, hearing loss, ringing in the ears, dizziness or balance problems, particularly with prolonged treatment or higher exposure.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, or a neuromuscular disorder. Kidney function and, when needed, blood levels, hearing and balance may be monitored during treatment. Inform the doctor about all medicines being used, especially other medicines that may affect the kidneys, hearing or muscles. Seek medical help promptly for reduced urination, swelling, unusual thirst, ringing in the ears, hearing changes, severe dizziness or muscle weakness.

title: Healthcrepe (1 Unit (10Cm X 4M)) Crepe Bandage By Martin & Brown
name: Healthcrepe (1 Unit (10Cm X 4M)) Crepe Bandage By Martin & Brown
searchText: Healthcrepe (1 Unit (10Cm X 4M)) Crepe Bandage By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
A crepe bandage is used to provide support and gentle compression for sprains, strains, swelling and minor soft-tissue injuries. It can also help hold wound dressings in place.

How does it work?
It applies gentle pressure to the affected area and provides support, which may help reduce swelling and discomfort.

How to take/use it
Wrap it evenly around the affected area, starting below the injured area and moving upwards. It should feel supportive but not tight. Keep fingers or toes visible when possible, and loosen or remove it if there is numbness, tingling, increasing pain, swelling, or colour change.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, itching or discomfort. If wrapped too tightly, it may cause numbness, tingling, pain or reduced circulation.

Precautions
Do not apply it tightly or over an untreated wound. Check the skin and circulation regularly, especially in people with diabetes or circulation problems. Seek medical advice for severe pain, marked swelling, deformity, numbness, or an injury that does not improve.

title: Healthcrepe (1 Unit (15Cm X 4M)) Crepe Bandage By Martin & Brown
