searchText: Healthcrepe (1 Unit (15Cm X 4M)) Crepe Bandage By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
A crepe bandage is used to provide light support and compression for sprains, strains, mild swelling and injured joints. It can also help hold a dressing in place.

How does it work?
It gently compresses the affected area and provides support, which may help limit swelling and movement.

How to take/use it
Wrap it evenly around the affected area, starting below the injured area and moving upward. It should feel snug but not tight. Do not wrap over an open wound unless a suitable dressing is covering it. Loosen or remove it if there is increasing pain, numbness, tingling, coldness or a change in skin colour.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, itching or discomfort. If applied too tightly, it may cause numbness, tingling, swelling or reduced circulation.

Precautions
Do not apply it too tightly or leave it on if circulation is affected. Seek medical advice for severe pain, marked swelling, deformity, inability to move the limb or difficulty bearing weight. Keep the bandage clean and dry, and follow the product instructions for washing and reuse.

title: Healthcrepe (1 Unit (6Cm X 4M)) Crepe Bandage By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
A crepe bandage is used to provide support and gentle compression for sprains, strains, minor swelling and injured joints. It can also help hold a wound dressing in place.

How does it work?
It gently supports the injured area and applies light pressure, which may help reduce swelling and provide comfort during movement.

How to take/use it
Wrap it evenly around the affected area without making it too tight. Secure it in place and check the fingers or toes regularly for normal colour, warmth and sensation. Use over a dressing when covering a wound, and follow a healthcare professional’s advice for injuries.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, itching or discomfort. A bandage that is too tight may cause numbness, tingling, pain, swelling or colour changes.

Precautions
Do not wrap it tightly or over an area with poor circulation. Loosen or remove it if numbness, tingling, increasing pain, swelling, coldness or bluish/pale skin develops. Seek medical help for severe pain, deformity, suspected fracture or an injury that does not improve.

What is it used for?
A crepe bandage is used to support and gently compress injured or swollen areas, such as sprains and strains. It can also help hold a dressing in place.

How does it work?
It provides gentle pressure and support to the affected area, which may help reduce swelling and limit movement.

How to take/use it
Wrap it evenly around the affected area without making it too tight. Ensure the fingers or toes remain warm and normally coloured. Remove or loosen it if there is numbness, tingling, increasing pain, coldness or colour change. Follow a healthcare professional’s advice for use after a significant injury.

Common side effects
Skin irritation, discomfort, numbness, tingling or reduced circulation if applied too tightly.

Precautions
Do not apply it tightly or over an untreated wound. Check the skin and circulation regularly, especially in children, older adults or people with circulation problems. Seek medical help for severe pain, deformity, suspected fracture or worsening swelling.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Micropore paper tape is used to secure wound dressings, bandages, and medical tubing. It is designed for gentle use, including on sensitive skin.

How does it work?
Its adhesive backing sticks to the skin to keep dressings or medical devices securely in place while allowing them to be removed when needed.

How to take/use it
Apply to clean, dry skin and press gently to secure the dressing or tubing. Avoid wrapping it too tightly. Remove carefully, especially from fragile skin, and follow the instructions of the healthcare professional or product packaging.

Common side effects
Mild redness, itching, irritation, or discomfort where the tape is applied. Skin peeling or an allergic reaction may occur in sensitive people.

Precautions
Do not use if there is a known allergy to adhesive tape. Stop using it if significant irritation, swelling, blistering, or a rash develops. Do not apply over infected or severely damaged skin unless advised by a healthcare professional.

title: Healthpore (12 X 2.5Cm(1") X 9Mtr) Micropore Paper Tape By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?

What is it used for?
Hydrocortisone sodium succinate injection is a corticosteroid used in hospitals and emergencies to reduce severe inflammation or allergic reactions. It may also be used to replace the body’s cortisol when the adrenal glands are not producing enough.

How does it work?
It acts like the natural hormone cortisol. It reduces inflammation and suppresses an overactive immune response, while helping replace cortisol when it is deficient.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose and treatment duration depend on the condition and response to treatment. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Possible side effects include increased blood sugar, increased blood pressure, fluid retention, stomach upset, mood or sleep changes, and increased risk of infection. Side effects may be more likely with higher doses or prolonged treatment.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental health conditions, or any current infection. Corticosteroids can mask signs of infection and may worsen some infections. Seek medical help for severe allergic reactions, serious infection symptoms, vision changes, or severe mood changes. Do not stop prolonged corticosteroid treatment suddenly unless advised by a doctor.

Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Ibuprofen reduces the production of substances that cause pain, swelling and fever.

Use only as prescribed by a doctor. The dose, frequency and duration depend on the reason for treatment and the product form. Do not self-medicate or use it as a routine vitamin supplement without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort or flushing may occur. Seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, unusual weakness, dark urine or worsening bleeding.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, a history of blood disorders, or glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency. It may interact with blood thinners such as warfarin; medical monitoring may be needed. Use in newborns, infants, pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Kaytin-Mb (Jali) (10X5X1Ml) Menadione Sod. 10Mg (Vit K) By Martin & Brown
name: Kaytin-Mb (Jali) (10X5X1Ml) Menadione Sod. 10Mg (Vit K) By Martin & Brown
searchText: Kaytin-Mb (Jali) (10X5X1Ml) Menadione Sod. 10Mg (Vit K) By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Menadione sodium is a form of vitamin K used to prevent or treat vitamin K deficiency and support normal blood clotting. It should be used only when recommended by a doctor.

How does it work?
Vitamin K helps the liver produce proteins needed for normal blood clotting. This helps reduce the risk of bleeding caused by vitamin K deficiency.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the doctor. Do not change the dose or duration on your own. Tell the doctor about all medicines being used, especially blood thinners.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort or skin rash may occur. Seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, unusual weakness or difficulty breathing.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, anaemia, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency or a history of medicine allergy. Vitamin K can affect blood-thinning medicines such as warfarin. Menadione should not be given to newborns or infants unless specifically prescribed.

title: Ketolik (Bl) 1Ml Amp (10X5X1 Ml) Ketorolac Tromethamine 30 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ketolik (Bl) 1Ml Amp (10X5X1 Ml) Ketorolac Tromethamine 30 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ketolik (Bl) 1Ml Amp (10X5X1 Ml) Ketorolac Tromethamine 30 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ketorolac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine used for the short-term relief of moderate to severe acute pain. It is generally used for a limited period under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. If supplied as an injection, it should be given by a healthcare professional. Do not use it for longer than advised or combine it with other painkillers without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, headache, dizziness and drowsiness.

Precautions
It can cause stomach ulcers or bleeding and may affect kidney function. Avoid use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, severe kidney disease, or allergy to aspirin or other NSAIDs, unless specifically advised by a doctor. Avoid taking it with other NSAIDs, blood thinners or alcohol without medical advice. Tell the doctor if pregnant, especially during the last three months, or if there is heart disease, high blood pressure or asthma. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty or facial swelling.

title: Kvit- Mb 1Ml Amp (50X1Ml) Phytomenadone Sod. 1 Mg ( Vit-K1) By Martin & Brown
name: Kvit- Mb 1Ml Amp (50X1Ml) Phytomenadone Sod. 1 Mg ( Vit-K1) By Martin & Brown
searchText: Kvit- Mb 1Ml Amp (50X1Ml) Phytomenadone Sod. 1 Mg ( Vit-K1) By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Phytomenadone (vitamin K1) is used to prevent or treat bleeding caused by vitamin K deficiency. It may also be used under medical supervision to help correct excessive effects of certain blood-thinning medicines.

How does it work?
Vitamin K1 helps the liver produce proteins needed for normal blood clotting. This helps the body control bleeding when vitamin K levels are too low.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. The dose, route and duration depend on the reason for treatment and the product formulation. Do not change or stop blood-thinning treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Side effects depend on how it is given. Nausea, flushing or discomfort at the injection site may occur. Rarely, serious allergic reactions can occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies, liver disease and use of blood thinners such as warfarin. Injectable vitamin K should be administered by a healthcare professional. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, severe dizziness or unusual bleeding.

title: Kvit- Mb 1Ml Amp (Bl) (10X5X1Ml) Phytomenadone 1 Mg ( Vit-K1) By Martin & Brown
name: Kvit- Mb 1Ml Amp (Bl) (10X5X1Ml) Phytomenadone 1 Mg ( Vit-K1) By Martin & Brown
searchText: Kvit- Mb 1Ml Amp (Bl) (10X5X1Ml) Phytomenadone 1 Mg ( Vit-K1) By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Phytomenadone (vitamin K1) is used to prevent or treat bleeding caused by vitamin K deficiency or reduced blood clotting. It may also be used to help reverse the effects of certain blood-thinning medicines, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Vitamin K1 helps the liver produce clotting factors needed for normal blood clotting.

How to take/use it
Use it only as directed by a doctor. The dose and route of administration depend on the reason for treatment and the product form. If it is an injection, it should be given by a healthcare professional. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, flushing, rash, or pain and irritation at the injection site may occur. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, or a severe allergic reaction.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, a bleeding or clotting disorder, or an allergy to vitamin K products. People taking blood thinners such as warfarin need careful medical supervision, as vitamin K1 can reduce their effect. Do not use it to treat unexplained bleeding without medical evaluation.

title: Lairzo-Ag (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Chloroquine Phosphate Susp.60 Ml By Martin & Brown
name: Lairzo-Ag (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Chloroquine Phosphate Susp.60 Ml By Martin & Brown
searchText: Lairzo-Ag (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Chloroquine Phosphate Susp.60 Ml By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Chloroquine phosphate is used to prevent and treat certain types of malaria. It should only be used when prescribed, as some malaria parasites may be resistant to chloroquine.

How does it work?
It interferes with the malaria parasite's ability to process haemoglobin, helping to kill the parasite inside red blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take only in the dose and for the duration prescribed. Shake the suspension well before use and measure it with an oral syringe or measuring spoon. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset. Complete the prescribed course unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, itching or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about eye or retinal problems, liver or kidney disease, psoriasis, porphyria, heart-rhythm problems, or any medicines being taken. Seek medical help promptly for blurred or reduced vision, severe skin rash, fainting, unusual heartbeat, severe weakness or confusion. Keep this medicine out of children's reach, as overdose can be dangerous.

title: Livociz Syp. (M.Cap) (60 Ml) Levocetirizine Dihydrochloride 2.5 Mg. By Martin & Brown
name: Livociz Syp. (M.Cap) (60 Ml) Levocetirizine Dihydrochloride 2.5 Mg. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Livociz Syp. (M.Cap) (60 Ml) Levocetirizine Dihydrochloride 2.5 Mg. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levocetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, and itchy or watery eyes. It is also used for itchy skin rashes and hives (urticaria).

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance released during an allergic reaction. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Do not take more than the recommended amount. It may cause drowsiness in some people.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, and sometimes stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery until the effect of the medicine is known. Consult a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for signs of a severe allergic reaction, such as swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.

title: Livociz Tab (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Livociz Tab (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Livociz Tab (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Levocetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, itchy or watery eyes, and skin itching or hives.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet with water and do not take more than the recommended amount. Follow the advice of a doctor or pharmacist if treatment is needed for a child, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or for a longer period.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, and occasionally stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Levocetirizine may cause drowsiness. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or drinking alcohol until its effects are known. People with kidney disease may need medical advice before using it. Seek medical help for severe allergic symptoms or unusual swelling or breathing difficulty.

title: Lobitin-Mb 4Ml (5X5X4Ml) Labetalol Hcl 5Mg. By Martin & Brown
name: Lobitin-Mb 4Ml (5X5X4Ml) Labetalol Hcl 5Mg. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Lobitin-Mb 4Ml (5X5X4Ml) Labetalol Hcl 5Mg. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Labetalol is used to lower high blood pressure, including severe high blood pressure when rapid control may be needed under medical supervision.

How does it work?
It blocks certain signals that make the heart beat faster and blood vessels narrow. This slows the heartbeat and relaxes blood vessels, helping to reduce blood pressure.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed. The 5 mg strength may be given by a healthcare professional, depending on the prescribed product and treatment. Do not change the dose or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Dizziness, tiredness, nausea, headache, slow heartbeat and low blood pressure may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is asthma or wheezing, a slow heartbeat, heart failure, circulation problems, diabetes, liver disease or other heart conditions. It may cause dizziness, especially when standing up. Seek medical help for fainting, severe breathing difficulty, very slow heartbeat or swelling of the legs.

title: Lopramac Tab (10X6 X10) Loperamide 2Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Lopramac Tab (10X6 X10) Loperamide 2Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Lopramac Tab (10X6 X10) Loperamide 2Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Loperamide 2mg is used to relieve diarrhoea and reduce frequent, watery stools. It may also help control diarrhoea in some longer-term bowel conditions when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It slows the movement of food and fluids through the intestines, allowing more water to be absorbed and making stools less frequent and watery.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the package or by a doctor. Swallow with water and do not exceed the recommended amount. Drink plenty of fluids to help prevent dehydration. Do not use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Constipation, nausea, stomach cramps, bloating, dry mouth, dizziness and headache.

Precautions
Do not use it for diarrhoea with blood in the stools, high fever, severe abdominal pain or a swollen abdomen unless advised by a doctor. Stop using it and seek medical help if diarrhoea worsens, signs of dehydration occur, severe constipation develops, or there is no improvement within 48 hours. It is not suitable for all children; follow the product instructions or medical advice. Avoid taking more than recommended, as excessive use can cause serious heart problems.

title: Lycowin-Z (20X1X10) Lycopene, Vitamin E, Vitamin C, Copper Chromium Picolinate, Manganese, Zinc & Selenium Softgel Capsules By Martin & Brown
name: Lycowin-Z (20X1X10) Lycopene, Vitamin E, Vitamin C, Copper Chromium Picolinate, Manganese, Zinc & Selenium Softgel Capsules By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This supplement provides lycopene, vitamins C and E, and trace minerals including zinc, selenium, copper, chromium and manganese. It is used to supplement the diet and support antioxidant protection and general nutritional wellness.

How does it work?
Its vitamins, minerals and lycopene help support normal body functions and antioxidant defences, which help protect cells from oxidative stress.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow the softgel with water, preferably with food. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Some people may experience nausea, stomach upset or diarrhoea. Allergic reactions are uncommon but possible.

Precautions
Do not use more than the recommended amount or combine it with other vitamin and mineral supplements without medical advice. Seek advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is a medical condition or regular use of medicines. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of an allergic reaction occur.

searchText: Maget Mb 2Ml ( Bl) (50X2Ml) Magnesium Sulphate 500Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
The intended use cannot be confirmed from “Magnesium Sulphate 500mg” alone. Magnesium sulphate may be used in different formulations for magnesium replacement or other medical purposes; check the product label or prescription.

How does it work?
It provides magnesium, a mineral needed for normal muscle, nerve and body functions. Its effects vary depending on the formulation and intended use.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not determine the dose or route of use from the strength alone.

Common side effects
Depending on the formulation, oral use may cause diarrhoea, nausea or stomach cramps. Side effects may differ for injectable products.

Precautions
Check the formulation and intended use before taking or using it. Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, as excess magnesium can accumulate. Do not use without professional guidance if the product is intended for injection or another medical procedure.

title: Maget Mb 2Ml ( Jali) (50X2Ml) Magnesium Sulphate 500Mg By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Magnesium sulphate 500 mg may be used for different purposes depending on its formulation and prescribed indication, such as treating magnesium deficiency or as a laxative. The exact use cannot be confirmed from the generic name alone.

How does it work?
It provides magnesium, a mineral needed for normal muscle, nerve and heart function. In some formulations, it also draws water into the bowel to help produce a bowel movement.

How to take/use it
Use only according to the product label or a healthcare professional’s instructions. The route, dose and treatment duration depend on the formulation and reason for use. Do not use an injectable form without medical supervision.

Common side effects
Oral use may cause diarrhoea, stomach cramps, nausea or vomiting. Side effects depend on the formulation and route of administration.

Precautions
Seek medical advice before use if there is kidney disease, as magnesium can build up in the body. Do not self-treat with this medicine when the formulation or intended use is unclear. Seek urgent medical help for weakness, confusion, breathing difficulty or an irregular heartbeat.

title: Martibion Forte 10 Ml Inj (24X10Ml) Vit B1,B6,B12+D- Panthenol+Niacinamide By Martin & Brown
name: Martibion Forte 10 Ml Inj (24X10Ml) Vit B1,B6,B12+D- Panthenol+Niacinamide By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martibion Forte 10 Ml Inj (24X10Ml) Vit B1,B6,B12+D- Panthenol+Niacinamide By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat deficiency of B vitamins, including vitamins B1, B6 and B12. These vitamins support normal nerve function, energy metabolism and red blood cell formation.

How does it work?
It replenishes important B vitamins and related nutrients that the body needs for normal nerve function, energy production and blood formation.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. The method of use depends on the product form; do not self-administer if it is an injectable product. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Mild nausea, stomach upset or headache may occur. Injectable products may cause pain, redness or swelling at the injection site.

Precautions
Tell the doctor or pharmacist about any allergy to these ingredients or previous reactions to vitamin injections. Prolonged or excessive use of vitamin B6 can cause nerve problems. Seek medical help for rash, breathing difficulty, severe dizziness or other signs of an allergic reaction.

title: Martibion- Plus 100Ml (100Ml) Vit B10.75Mg+Niacinamide 15Mg+B12 2Mcg+Lysine 37.5Mg+Sorbitol Q.S By Martin & Brown
name: Martibion- Plus 100Ml (100Ml) Vit B10.75Mg+Niacinamide 15Mg+B12 2Mcg+Lysine 37.5Mg+Sorbitol Q.S By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martibion- Plus 100Ml (100Ml) Vit B10.75Mg+Niacinamide 15Mg+B12 2Mcg+Lysine 37.5Mg+Sorbitol Q.S By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to provide B-group vitamins and lysine when dietary intake may be inadequate or supplementation is recommended.

How does it work?
B vitamins help support energy metabolism, nerve function and normal blood-cell formation. Lysine is an essential amino acid needed for protein formation.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort or diarrhoea may occur. Sorbitol can have a laxative effect, especially in larger amounts.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to any ingredient. Excessive use may cause diarrhoea or abdominal cramps. People with diabetes or hereditary fructose intolerance should seek medical advice before use because it contains sorbitol.

searchText: Martibion- Plus 200Ml (200Ml) Vit B10.75Mg+Niacinamide 15Mg+B12 2Mcg+Lysine 37.5Mg+Sorbitol Q.S By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a nutritional supplement to help prevent or correct deficiencies of certain B vitamins and support normal energy metabolism and protein nutrition. It should not be used as a substitute for a balanced diet.

How does it work?
The B vitamins help the body release energy from food and support normal nerve and blood-cell function. Lysine is an essential amino acid needed for protein production.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or loose motions may occur. Sorbitol may have a laxative effect, especially in larger amounts.

Precautions
Check the ingredients before use if there is a known allergy. Avoid use in hereditary fructose intolerance because the product contains sorbitol. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or in children unless recommended by a healthcare professional. Stop use and seek help if an allergic reaction occurs.

title: Martical-D 500 (20X15) Calcium With Vitamin D3 (Uncoated) By Martin & Brown
name: Martical-D 500 (20X15) Calcium With Vitamin D3 (Uncoated) By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martical-D 500 (20X15) Calcium With Vitamin D3 (Uncoated) By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Calcium with vitamin D3 is used to supplement calcium and vitamin D levels and support normal bone and teeth health. It may help prevent or treat deficiency when dietary intake is insufficient.

How does it work?
Calcium provides a mineral needed for strong bones and teeth, as well as normal muscle and nerve function. Vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. If taking other medicines, ask a healthcare professional about the appropriate timing.

Common side effects
Constipation, gas, bloating, nausea or stomach discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Consult a healthcare professional before use if there is kidney disease, a history of kidney stones, high calcium levels or vitamin D disorders. Calcium can reduce the absorption of some medicines, including iron supplements, thyroid medicines and certain antibiotics; these may need to be taken at different times as advised. Seek medical advice if severe or persistent side effects occur.

title: Martidex 100 Ml (100 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
name: Martidex 100 Ml (100 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martidex 100 Ml (100 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of dry cough, sneezing and runny nose associated with the common cold or allergies.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the cough reflex. Chlorpheniramine is an antihistamine that helps relieve allergy-related symptoms such as sneezing and a runny nose.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid using other cough-and-cold medicines containing similar ingredients unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and constipation may occur.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving and alcohol until its effects are known. Do not use with or within 14 days of monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines. Seek medical advice before use if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate enlargement, breathing problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, severe drowsiness or a persistent or worsening cough.

title: Martigil-N Susp. 30 Ml (M.Cap) (30Ml) Norfloxacin 100Mg+ Tinidazole 100Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Martigil-N Susp. 30 Ml (M.Cap) (30Ml) Norfloxacin 100Mg+ Tinidazole 100Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martigil-N Susp. 30 Ml (M.Cap) (30Ml) Norfloxacin 100Mg+ Tinidazole 100Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial and parasitic infections of the digestive tract that can cause diarrhoea, loose motions or dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Norfloxacin kills susceptible bacteria, while tinidazole acts against certain parasites and other microorganisms that can cause intestinal infections.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the recommended course. Swallow with water. Avoid taking it with milk or dairy products, and keep antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium or magnesium separate as advised by a healthcare professional. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 3 days after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to norfloxacin, tinidazole, other quinolone antibiotics or nitroimidazole medicines. Tell the healthcare professional about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver or kidney problems, seizures, nerve disorders or a history of tendon problems. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for severe rash, breathing difficulty, tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, or severe or persistent diarrhoea.

title: Martigin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Analgin I.P 500 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Martigin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Analgin I.P 500 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martigin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Analgin I.P 500 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Analgin 500 mg is used to relieve moderate to severe pain and reduce fever.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances in the body that cause pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Swallow with water and do not take more than recommended. Do not use it for a prolonged period without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, dizziness, or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not take it if there has been an allergy to Analgin (metamizole) or similar painkillers. Use only with medical advice if there is a history of blood disorders, bone-marrow problems, liver or kidney disease, or asthma triggered by painkillers. Stop taking it and seek urgent medical help if there is difficulty breathing, facial swelling, a severe rash, persistent sore throat, fever, chills, or unusual infections, as serious allergic or blood-related reactions can occur. Consult a doctor during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Martigyl 400 Tab (50X10) (50X 10) Metronidazole 400Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Martigyl 400 Tab (50X10) (50X 10) Metronidazole 400Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martigyl 400 Tab (50X10) (50X 10) Metronidazole 400Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Metronidazole is used to treat certain infections caused by anaerobic bacteria and parasites, including some infections of the stomach and intestines, teeth and gums, reproductive organs, and skin. It may also be used for bacterial vaginosis and certain sexually transmitted infections, as prescribed.

How does it work?
It damages the genetic material of susceptible bacteria and parasites, stopping them from growing and surviving.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. It may be taken with food if it causes stomach upset. Do not drink alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, metallic taste and dark-coloured urine.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, nervous-system problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being taken, especially warfarin, lithium or disulfiram. Seek medical advice for numbness or tingling, seizures, severe diarrhoea, or signs of an allergic reaction.

title: Martigyl Susp. 60 Ml (M.Cap) (60 Ml) Metronidazole Susp 200 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Martigyl Susp. 60 Ml (M.Cap) (60 Ml) Metronidazole Susp 200 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martigyl Susp. 60 Ml (M.Cap) (60 Ml) Metronidazole Susp 200 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Metronidazole suspension is used to treat certain infections caused by anaerobic bacteria and parasites, including some infections of the stomach, intestines and reproductive or urinary tract. It does not treat viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It enters susceptible bacteria and parasites and damages their genetic material, stopping them from growing and surviving.

How to take/use it
Shake the suspension well before each use and measure it with the supplied measuring device. Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the course, even if symptoms improve. Do not take more or use it for longer than directed. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste in the mouth. The urine may sometimes become darker.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is liver disease, a blood disorder, a nervous-system disorder or pregnancy. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially warfarin or other blood thinners. Seek medical help for severe rash, numbness or tingling, seizures, confusion, or persistent severe diarrhoea.

title: Martinex 5 Ml Amp (5X5X5Ml) Tranexamic Acid 500Mg/5Ml By Martin & Brown
name: Martinex 5 Ml Amp (5X5X5Ml) Tranexamic Acid 500Mg/5Ml By Martin & Brown
searchText: Martinex 5 Ml Amp (5X5X5Ml) Tranexamic Acid 500Mg/5Ml By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Tranexamic acid injection is used to reduce or prevent excessive bleeding, including bleeding related to surgery, injury, childbirth or certain medical conditions. The exact use depends on the doctor's assessment.

How does it work?
It helps prevent blood clots from breaking down too quickly, which helps control bleeding.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection, usually into a vein, by a healthcare professional. The dose and treatment duration depend on the reason for treatment and kidney function. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, dizziness and headache may occur. Low blood pressure can occur if it is given too quickly.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any history of blood clots, kidney problems, seizures or vision problems. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, sudden breathlessness, swelling or pain in a limb, seizures, or changes in vision. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only when advised by a doctor.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Tranexamic acid injection is used to prevent or reduce excessive bleeding, including bleeding associated with surgery or other medical conditions. It is given only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It helps prevent the breakdown of blood clots, allowing clots to remain stable and reducing bleeding.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection, usually by a doctor or nurse. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the cause and severity of bleeding, kidney function and medical advice. Do not self-inject.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, dizziness and headache may occur. Tell a healthcare professional about any visual changes.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of blood clots, kidney disease, seizures or vision problems. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, sudden breathlessness, swelling or pain in a limb, severe headache, seizures or sudden changes in vision.

title: Martisonate 120 Mg (15X20) Artesunate (Sterile) I.P 120 Mg. By Martin & Brown

searchText: Martisonate 120 Mg (15X20) Artesunate (Sterile) I.P 120 Mg. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Artesunate injection is used to treat severe malaria, including malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum. It is usually given in a hospital or healthcare setting.

How does it work?
It rapidly kills malaria parasites in the blood, helping to control the infection and reduce its complications.

How to take/use it
It is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a healthcare professional. The dose and treatment schedule depend on body weight, the severity of malaria and the prescribed treatment plan. A follow-up antimalarial treatment may be needed.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, injection-site discomfort and changes in blood counts may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision. Tell the doctor about any previous allergy to artesunate or other artemisinin medicines. Medical monitoring and blood tests may be needed because delayed breakdown of red blood cells can occur after treatment. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling, severe weakness, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or dark urine.

searchText: Martisonate 60 Mg (15X20) Artesunate (Sterile) I.P 60 Mg. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Artesunate injection is used for the emergency treatment of severe malaria, especially when the patient cannot take medicines by mouth. It is given in a hospital or healthcare facility.

How does it work?
It rapidly kills malaria parasites in the blood, helping to reduce the severity of the infection.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose and treatment schedule depend on the severity of malaria and must be decided by the treating doctor. Once the patient can take medicines by mouth, additional antimalarial treatment may be needed as advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, fever, injection-site reactions and temporary changes in blood tests may occur.

Precautions
Severe malaria is a medical emergency and requires hospital care. Do not self-administer this injection. Medical monitoring is important because delayed destruction of red blood cells (haemolysis), anaemia, allergic reactions or liver-related problems can occur after treatment. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, unusual weakness, yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine or worsening symptoms.

What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat deficiencies of vitamins A, D3 and B-group vitamins, and to support general nutritional health when dietary intake is insufficient.

How does it work?
It supplies vitamins needed for normal vision, bones, skin, nerve function and energy metabolism.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by the doctor or product label. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
May cause nausea, stomach upset or headache. These are more likely with excessive use.

Precautions
Do not combine with other vitamin A or vitamin D supplements unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy, especially if there may be a risk of excess vitamin A, or if there is liver or kidney disease. Keep out of reach of children.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This vitamin B-complex supplement is used to help prevent or treat deficiencies of B vitamins and support normal energy metabolism, nerve function and blood cell formation.

How does it work?
It supplies several B vitamins that help the body convert food into energy and support the normal functioning of the nervous system and other body tissues.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
It is usually well tolerated. Mild nausea, stomach upset, headache or flushing may occur. Riboflavin may harmlessly make urine bright yellow.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is liver disease or another medical condition. Seek advice if symptoms persist or worsen.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This B-complex supplement is used to provide several B vitamins and to help prevent or treat B-vitamin deficiency. These vitamins support normal energy metabolism and nerve function.

How does it work?
It supplies B vitamins needed for the body's energy-producing processes, normal nerve function and other essential body functions.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount, especially if using other vitamin supplements.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Mild nausea or stomach upset may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a healthcare professional before use if pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other vitamin or mineral supplements. Seek advice if symptoms persist or worsen.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used for short-term relief of pain and inflammation. Cetirizine may also help relieve allergy symptoms, while magnesium trisilicate helps reduce excess stomach acid.

How does it work?
Diclofenac and paracetamol reduce pain, and diclofenac also reduces inflammation. Cetirizine blocks histamine to reduce allergy symptoms, while magnesium trisilicate neutralises stomach acid.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor or pharmacist. Take with or after food and swallow with water. Do not take more than recommended, or combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol, diclofenac or other NSAIDs unless advised.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea or constipation, dizziness, drowsiness and headache.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and driving if drowsy or dizzy. Tell a doctor before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, or an allergy to painkillers. Avoid use during pregnancy unless specifically advised. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash.

title: Maxtrim Susp.{Dabi} 50 Ml (50Ml) T.M.P 40Mg+ Sulphamethoxazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Maxtrim Susp.{Dabi} 50 Ml (50Ml) T.M.P 40Mg+ Sulphamethoxazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Maxtrim Susp.{Dabi} 50 Ml (50Ml) T.M.P 40Mg+ Sulphamethoxazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some infections of the urinary tract, respiratory tract and skin. It does not work for viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It contains trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole, which work together to block the production of folic acid that bacteria need to grow and multiply.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with a full glass of water. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset. Do not use leftover antibiotics or share this medicine with others.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, diarrhoea, headache and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it if allergic to trimethoprim, sulfonamide medicines or any ingredient. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, blood disorders, folate deficiency, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being taken. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for a severe or blistering rash, swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty, unusual bruising, severe diarrhoea or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Maxtrim Susp.{M.Cap) 50 Ml (T) (50Ml) T.M.P 40Mg+ Sulphamethoxazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Maxtrim Susp.{M.Cap) 50 Ml (T) (50Ml) T.M.P 40Mg+ Sulphamethoxazole 200Mg By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This antibiotic is used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some urinary tract, respiratory, ear and intestinal infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It combines trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole to block two steps that bacteria need to make folic acid and grow.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. Complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Take with plenty of water. Do not share this medicine or use leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, diarrhoea, headache and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to trimethoprim, sulfonamide medicines or this combination. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems, folate deficiency, blood disorders, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being used. Seek urgent medical help for severe or blistering rash, swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty, unusual bruising, severe diarrhoea or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

title: Mbcal D3 1Ml (600000 Iu) (10 X 6X 1Ml) Cholecalciferol (Vit-D3 600000 Iu) By Martin & Brown
name: Mbcal D3 1Ml (600000 Iu) (10 X 6X 1Ml) Cholecalciferol (Vit-D3 600000 Iu) By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mbcal D3 1Ml (600000 Iu) (10 X 6X 1Ml) Cholecalciferol (Vit-D3 600000 Iu) By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) is used to prevent or treat vitamin D deficiency and to support calcium absorption and healthy bones. This high-strength preparation should be used only when recommended by a doctor or pharmacist.

How does it work?
Vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine. These minerals are important for maintaining strong bones and muscles.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take extra doses or combine it with other vitamin D or calcium supplements unless advised. Do not repeat high-strength doses without medical guidance.

Common side effects
Excess vitamin D can cause nausea, vomiting, constipation, stomach pain, weakness, excessive thirst or frequent urination.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, kidney stones, high calcium levels, or a condition that increases calcium levels. Seek medical advice if symptoms of excess calcium occur. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Mbcort-40 1Ml Inj. (30*1Ml) Triamcinolone Acetonide By Martin & Brown

searchText: Mbcort-40 1Ml Inj. (30*1Ml) Triamcinolone Acetonide By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Triamcinolone acetonide is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation, redness and itching in conditions such as eczema, dermatitis and other inflammatory skin problems. Its use can vary depending on the formulation.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances in the body that cause inflammation, redness and itching.

How to take/use it
Use only the formulation, amount and duration advised by a doctor or stated on the label. If it is a skin preparation, apply it only to the affected area and wash hands before and after use, unless the hands are being treated. Do not use more often or for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Mild burning, stinging, irritation, dryness or redness at the application site. Prolonged or excessive use on the skin may cause skin thinning or other skin changes.

Precautions
For skin preparations, avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and broken skin unless specifically directed. Do not use on untreated skin infections unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical advice if the condition worsens, does not improve, or signs of infection develop. Children and people using it on the face or skin folds should use it only under medical advice.

title: Mb Dexa 10 Ml Inj (24X10 Ml) Dexamethasone Sod. 4Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dexamethasone injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce severe inflammation and overactive immune reactions. The exact condition and reason for use depend on the doctor's prescription.

How does it work?
It acts like natural corticosteroid hormones and reduces inflammation and immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional, usually by injection. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the condition being treated. Do not self-inject or use it without medical supervision.

Common side effects
Increased blood sugar, stomach upset, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, increased appetite, fluid retention and increased risk of infections may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is diabetes, high blood pressure, a stomach ulcer, osteoporosis, an existing infection, or a history of mental-health problems. Corticosteroids can mask infection symptoms. Do not stop prolonged treatment suddenly unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for signs of a serious infection, severe mood changes, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dexamethasone injection is a corticosteroid used under medical supervision to reduce severe inflammation and suppress overactive immune or allergic reactions. Its use depends on the condition being treated.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and allergic reactions. It also suppresses excessive immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or nurse. The dose and injection route depend on the medical condition and response to treatment. It should not be self-injected.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, increased blood sugar, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, increased appetite, fluid retention and increased risk of infections may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, infections or a history of mental health problems. Dexamethasone may mask signs of infection. Use only as prescribed, and do not stop prolonged treatment suddenly without medical advice.

title: Mb Dexa 30 Ml Inj (25X30 Ml) Dexamethasone Sod. 4Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown
name: Mb Dexa 30 Ml Inj (25X30 Ml) Dexamethasone Sod. 4Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dexamethasone injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce severe inflammation and allergic reactions, and to suppress an overactive immune response in various medical conditions. Its exact use depends on the condition being treated.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and allergic symptoms. It also lowers excessive immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or nurse. The dose, injection route and treatment duration depend on the medical condition. Do not self-administer it.

Common side effects
Increased blood sugar, stomach upset, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, increased appetite, fluid retention and pain or irritation at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, mental health conditions, osteoporosis or any infection. Dexamethasone can reduce the body's ability to fight infections and may mask infection symptoms. Seek medical advice for signs of infection, severe mood changes, vision problems or severe stomach pain. If used repeatedly or for a prolonged period, it should not be stopped suddenly without medical advice.

title: Mb Genta 10 Ml Inj (24X10 Ml) Gentamicin Sulphate 40Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Gentamicin injection is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, including certain infections of the blood, lungs, abdomen, urinary tract and other areas. It is usually used when treatment with an injectable antibiotic is needed.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by interfering with their ability to make essential proteins.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional, usually by injection into a muscle or through a vein. The dose and treatment length depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function and other medicines being used. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Pain at the injection site, nausea, dizziness and headache may occur. Serious effects can include reduced kidney function, ringing in the ears, hearing loss or problems with balance.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Kidney function and, when needed, hearing should be monitored during treatment. Seek medical help for reduced urination, swelling, severe dizziness, ringing in the ears, hearing changes, breathing difficulty or unusual muscle weakness. Other medicines that can affect the kidneys, hearing or muscles may increase the risk of side effects.

title: Mb Genta 20 Ml Inj (25X20 Ml) Gentamicin Sulphate 40Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown
name: Mb Genta 20 Ml Inj (25X20 Ml) Gentamicin Sulphate 40Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb Genta 20 Ml Inj (25X20 Ml) Gentamicin Sulphate 40Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Gentamicin injection is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections. It is usually given in hospitals or clinics when treatment with an injectable antibiotic is needed.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which kills the bacteria and helps control the infection.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional into a vein or muscle. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, body weight and kidney function. Do not self-inject or change the dose. Kidney function and, when needed, blood levels may be monitored during treatment.

Common side effects
Pain at the injection site, nausea or vomiting may occur. Serious effects can include kidney problems, hearing loss, ringing in the ears, dizziness or balance problems.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, myasthenia gravis, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Extra monitoring may be needed in older adults. Seek medical help for reduced urine, swelling, unusual tiredness, ringing in the ears, hearing changes, severe dizziness or difficulty breathing. Inform the doctor about other medicines, especially those that may affect the kidneys, hearing or muscles.

title: Mb Genta 30 Ml Inj (25X30 Ml) Gentamicin Sulphate 40Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown
name: Mb Genta 30 Ml Inj (25X30 Ml) Gentamicin Sulphate 40Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb Genta 30 Ml Inj (25X30 Ml) Gentamicin Sulphate 40Mg/2Ml By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Gentamicin injection is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections caused by bacteria that are sensitive to gentamicin. It may be used for certain infections of the blood, lungs, abdomen, urinary tract or other parts of the body, as decided by a doctor.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making essential proteins, which kills the bacteria or prevents them from growing.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type of infection, body weight and kidney function. Kidney function and, when needed, medicine levels may be monitored during treatment.

Common side effects
Injection-site pain, nausea, vomiting, headache and dizziness may occur. Gentamicin can also seriously affect the kidneys or hearing, especially with prolonged treatment or higher doses.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, hearing or balance problems, dehydration, pregnancy, or a muscle or nerve disorder. Inform the doctor about all medicines being used, especially other medicines that may affect the kidneys or hearing. Seek medical help for reduced urine, swelling, ringing in the ears, hearing loss, severe dizziness, unusual weakness or breathing difficulty.

title: Mb Gin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Analgin I.P 250 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Mb Gin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Analgin I.P 250 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb Gin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Analgin I.P 250 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Analgin (metamizole) is used for short-term relief of moderate to severe pain and for reducing fever.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances involved in pain and fever, helping relieve discomfort and lower body temperature.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth with water exactly as prescribed or as directed on the label. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, dizziness, and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to metamizole or similar pain medicines. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, a severe rash, unusual weakness, sore throat, fever, or mouth ulcers, as serious allergic reactions or a rare reduction in white blood cells can occur. Consult a doctor before use if there is a history of blood disorders, bone-marrow problems, or significant kidney or liver disease. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Mb -Nar-Tz (20X10) Norfloxacin 200Mg + Tinidazole 300 By Martin & Brown
name: Mb -Nar-Tz (20X10) Norfloxacin 200Mg + Tinidazole 300 By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb -Nar-Tz (20X10) Norfloxacin 200Mg + Tinidazole 300 By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Norfloxacin + tinidazole is used to treat certain bacterial and parasitic infections of the stomach and intestines, including infectious diarrhoea and dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Norfloxacin kills susceptible bacteria, while tinidazole acts against certain parasites and bacteria that can cause intestinal infections.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the recommended course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water. Avoid taking it with milk or dairy products, and separate it from antacids or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc as advised by a healthcare professional. Do not drink alcohol during treatment or for at least 72 hours after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste in the mouth.

Precautions
Do not use it without medical advice, especially during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is kidney or liver disease, a history of seizures, nerve problems or heart-rhythm problems. Stop taking it and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe dizziness, allergic reactions, or severe or bloody diarrhoea. Avoid driving if dizzy or drowsy.

title: Mb- Nar-Tz (30X6) Norfloxacin 200Mg + Tinidazole 300 By Martin & Brown
name: Mb- Nar-Tz (30X6) Norfloxacin 200Mg + Tinidazole 300 By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb- Nar-Tz (30X6) Norfloxacin 200Mg + Tinidazole 300 By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections of the stomach and intestines that may cause diarrhoea, loose motions or dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Norfloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Tinidazole damages the genetic material of certain parasites and anaerobic bacteria, helping to clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed with water and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Avoid taking it with milk or dairy products, and ask a pharmacist about separating it from antacids or iron, calcium or zinc supplements. Do not use it for self-treatment of every episode of diarrhoea.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain or discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste in the mouth.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for 72 hours after the last dose. Tell the doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding, under 18 years of age, or if there is kidney disease, a history of seizures, nerve problems or tendon disorders. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe dizziness, an allergic reaction, or severe or bloody diarrhoea.

title: Mbplex 10Ml Inj (25X10Ml) Vitamin B- Complex By Martin & Brown
name: Mbplex 10Ml Inj (25X10Ml) Vitamin B- Complex By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mbplex 10Ml Inj (25X10Ml) Vitamin B- Complex By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Vitamin B-complex supplements are used to prevent or treat deficiency of B vitamins. They support normal energy metabolism, nerve function and formation of healthy blood cells.

How does it work?
The B vitamins act as coenzymes that help the body release energy from food and support the normal function of the nervous system and blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take or use it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Mild nausea or stomach upset may occur. Bright-yellow urine can occur with riboflavin and is usually harmless. Some formulations may cause flushing or headache.

Precautions
Avoid long-term use of high doses, especially vitamin B6, unless medically advised, as it may cause nerve problems. Check with a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is kidney or liver disease or regular medicine use. Seek advice if unusual numbness, tingling or weakness develops.

title: Mbplex 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Vitamin B- Complex By Martin & Brown
name: Mbplex 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Vitamin B- Complex By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mbplex 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Vitamin B- Complex By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Vitamin B-complex is used to prevent or treat deficiency of B vitamins. It supports normal energy metabolism, nerve function and the formation of red blood cells.

How does it work?
The B vitamins act as coenzymes that help the body use carbohydrates, proteins and fats for energy. They also support normal nerve and blood-cell function.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset or diarrhoea may occur. Riboflavin (vitamin B2) may harmlessly turn urine bright yellow.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional about any medical conditions, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and medicines or supplements being used. Avoid prolonged use of high doses unless advised by a healthcare professional, as some B vitamins can cause harm in excessive amounts.

title: Mbquine Inj.30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Chloroquine Phosphate Ip 64.5 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Mbquine Inj.30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Chloroquine Phosphate Ip 64.5 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mbquine Inj.30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Chloroquine Phosphate Ip 64.5 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Chloroquine is mainly used to prevent and treat certain types of malaria. It may also be prescribed for some autoimmune conditions, such as lupus or rheumatoid arthritis, under specialist supervision.

How does it work?
It acts against malaria parasites by interfering with their ability to process haemoglobin inside red blood cells. It also reduces abnormal immune-system activity in some autoimmune conditions.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, preferably with food or milk to reduce stomach upset. Do not change the dose, stop treatment early, or use it to treat malaria without medical advice, as chloroquine does not work against all malaria parasites.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, itching or skin rash, and temporary blurred vision.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about eye or retinal problems, psoriasis, hearing problems, liver or kidney disease, heart-rhythm problems, or glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency. Long-term use may require regular eye examinations. Seek urgent medical help for severe vision changes, fainting, fast or irregular heartbeat, severe weakness, or signs of a serious allergic reaction.

title: Mb-Solone-125 Mg (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium 125 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Mb-Solone-125 Mg (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium 125 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb-Solone-125 Mg (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium 125 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylprednisolone sodium injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce severe inflammation and overactive immune or allergic reactions. It may be used for conditions such as severe asthma or allergic reactions, autoimmune disorders, and other inflammatory illnesses when rapid treatment is needed.

How does it work?
It reduces inflammation and suppresses excessive immune-system activity, helping decrease swelling, redness, pain and allergic or inflammatory symptoms.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or other trained healthcare professional. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the condition being treated and the response to treatment. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Increased blood sugar or blood pressure, indigestion, fluid retention, mood changes, difficulty sleeping, headache and injection-site discomfort may occur. It can also increase the risk of infections.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental health problems, eye disease or any current infection. Corticosteroids can mask infection symptoms and may worsen infections. Avoid live vaccines unless specifically advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for severe allergic symptoms, signs of infection, vision changes or serious mood changes.

title: Mb-Solone-40 D (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Mb-Solone-40 D (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb-Solone-40 D (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium 40 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylprednisolone sodium injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and an overactive immune response in conditions such as severe allergic, inflammatory, or autoimmune problems. The exact use depends on the medical condition and the doctor's prescription.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and suppresses excessive immune-system activity.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose, injection route and treatment duration depend on the condition being treated. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Increased blood sugar, increased blood pressure, indigestion, fluid retention, mood changes, sleep problems and increased risk of infections may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental health problems, liver or kidney disease, or any current infection. Corticosteroids may mask infection symptoms and can interact with vaccines and other medicines. Do not stop treatment suddenly if it has been used for a prolonged period unless advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for signs of a serious infection, severe mood changes or an allergic reaction.

title: Mb-Solone-80 Mg (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium Succinate Usp 80 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Mb-Solone-80 Mg (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium Succinate Usp 80 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mb-Solone-80 Mg (1 Vial) Methylprednisolone Sodium Succinate Usp 80 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylprednisolone sodium succinate injection is a corticosteroid used to reduce severe inflammation and suppress an overactive immune response. It may be used for severe allergic, inflammatory and autoimmune conditions, as well as certain other conditions requiring corticosteroid treatment.

How does it work?
It reduces the activity of substances in the body that cause inflammation and helps control an overactive immune response.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a healthcare professional. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the condition and response to treatment. Do not self-administer it.

Common side effects
Increased blood sugar, increased blood pressure, fluid retention, stomach upset, difficulty sleeping, mood changes and pain or irritation at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the healthcare professional about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, mental health problems or any infection. Corticosteroids can reduce the body's ability to fight infections and may mask infection symptoms. Avoid live vaccines unless specifically advised. After prolonged treatment, it may need to be stopped gradually rather than suddenly. Seek medical help for signs of a serious infection, severe mood changes, vision problems or a severe allergic reaction.

title: Mef-Forte -Ds 60 Ml (M.F) (60 Ml) Mefenamic Acid I.P 100Mg..+ Paracetamol Ip 250 Mg. By Martin & Brown
name: Mef-Forte -Ds 60 Ml (M.F) (60 Ml) Mefenamic Acid I.P 100Mg..+ Paracetamol Ip 250 Mg. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mef-Forte -Ds 60 Ml (M.F) (60 Ml) Mefenamic Acid I.P 100Mg..+ Paracetamol Ip 250 Mg. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and fever.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid and paracetamol reduce the production of substances involved in pain and fever. Mefenamic acid also helps reduce inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor or pharmacist. Swallow with water, preferably with or after food. Do not take more than the recommended dose or use it for longer than advised. Avoid taking other medicines containing paracetamol or mefenamic acid unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, dizziness, or headache.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if allergic to mefenamic acid, paracetamol, aspirin, or other painkillers. Consult a doctor before use if there is a history of stomach ulcers or bleeding, liver or kidney disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, or heart problems. Avoid alcohol. Seek medical help for severe stomach pain, black stools, vomiting blood, rash, breathing difficulty, or yellowing of the skin or eyes. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy, especially in the last three months, or while breastfeeding.

title: Mef Forte (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60Ml) Mefenamic Acid I.P. + Paracetamol Ip By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and fever, including general body pain and pain associated with inflammation.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label, preferably with or after food. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or mefenamic acid/other NSAIDs unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache.

Precautions
Avoid if allergic to mefenamic acid, paracetamol or other NSAID painkillers. Seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, or heart problems. Avoid alcohol. Do not use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, unless prescribed. Stop and seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe skin rash, breathing difficulty, or yellowing of the skin or eyes.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve mild to moderate pain and reduce fever. It may be prescribed for pain such as menstrual, dental, muscle or joint pain.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed, preferably with or after food and with water. Do not take more than recommended or combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol or painkillers such as ibuprofen unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea or dizziness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to painkillers. Avoid alcohol and other paracetamol-containing products. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially in the last 3 months. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a serious skin rash.

searchText: Mefpar Tab (20X10) Mefenamic Acid 450Mg + Para 325 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of pain and fever, including body aches and other mild to moderate painful conditions.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces the production of substances that cause pain, inflammation and fever. Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor or as directed on the label. Take with or after food and swallow with water. Do not take it with other medicines containing paracetamol or other painkillers such as ibuprofen or aspirin unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, indigestion, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache.

Precautions
Avoid or seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, heart disease, or allergy to anti-inflammatory medicines. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially in the last 3 months. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash.

title: Mefspas Tab (30X10) Mefenamic Acid 250+Dicyclomine 10 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Mefspas Tab (30X10) Mefenamic Acid 250+Dicyclomine 10 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mefspas Tab (30X10) Mefenamic Acid 250+Dicyclomine 10 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of painful cramps, especially menstrual cramps and spasmodic abdominal pain.

How does it work?
Mefenamic acid reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Dicyclomine relaxes spasms in the smooth muscles of the intestine and abdomen, helping to reduce cramping.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by a doctor. It is usually taken with or after food to reduce stomach irritation. Swallow with water and do not take more than the prescribed amount or for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, nausea, diarrhoea or constipation, dizziness, dry mouth and blurred vision may occur.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, severe kidney or liver disease, or allergy to painkillers such as aspirin or other NSAIDs, unless specifically advised by a doctor. Seek medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or vision problems. Use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, only under medical advice. It may not be suitable for glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or intestinal blockage. Avoid alcohol and driving if dizzy or if vision is blurred.

title: Methatin 1Ml (Bl) (50X1Ml) Methylergometrine 0.2Mg By Martin & Brown

searchText: Methatin 1Ml (Bl) (50X1Ml) Methylergometrine 0.2Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Methylergometrine is used after childbirth or abortion to help the uterus contract and prevent or treat heavy bleeding caused by poor uterine contraction.

How does it work?
It is a uterotonic medicine that makes the muscles of the uterus contract, helping reduce bleeding.

How to take/use it
Use only on the advice of a doctor or midwife and exactly as prescribed. Follow the instructions for the specific product and route of administration. Do not use it during pregnancy before delivery unless specifically advised by a specialist.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, abdominal cramps and increased blood pressure.

Precautions
It should not be used in people with high blood pressure or certain heart and blood-vessel problems unless specifically advised by a doctor. Seek urgent medical help for very heavy or continuing bleeding, chest pain, severe headache, difficulty breathing or seizures.

title: Metoclopramide 10 Ml Inj (2 5 X 1 0 M L) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown
