searchText: Metoclopramide 10 Ml Inj (2 5 X 1 0 M L) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Metoclopramide is used to relieve nausea and vomiting. It may also be used to help delayed stomach emptying and related digestive symptoms when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It blocks dopamine signals in the vomiting centre of the brain, helping reduce nausea and vomiting. It also increases movement of food through the stomach and intestines.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. Do not take more than recommended or use it for longer than advised. Do not drive or operate machinery if it causes drowsiness or restlessness.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, tiredness, restlessness, headache, diarrhoea and dizziness.

Precautions
Inform the doctor if there is a blockage, bleeding or perforation in the stomach or intestine, Parkinson’s disease, epilepsy, depression or a history of involuntary muscle movements. Avoid prolonged use unless specifically advised, as it can cause serious movement-related effects. Seek medical help for unusual muscle spasms, uncontrolled movements, severe restlessness or muscle stiffness.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Fungal diastase and pepsin are digestive enzymes used to help relieve indigestion, fullness and bloating related to incomplete digestion of food.

How does it work?
Fungal diastase helps break down carbohydrates, while pepsin helps digest proteins. This may support the digestion of food and reduce digestive discomfort.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Mild stomach discomfort, nausea, diarrhoea or constipation may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Stop use and seek medical advice if symptoms are severe, persistent or keep returning. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in children.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to support digestion and relieve symptoms such as indigestion, bloating and a feeling of fullness after meals.

How does it work?
Fungal diastase helps break down carbohydrates, while pepsin helps digest proteins. Together, they support the digestive process.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Mild stomach discomfort, nausea, bloating or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms are severe, persistent or keep coming back.

title: Metozyme Syrup 200 Ml (200Ml) Fungal Diastase 50Mg+ Pepsin 10Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Metozyme Syrup 200 Ml (200Ml) Fungal Diastase 50Mg+ Pepsin 10Mg By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to help relieve indigestion, a feeling of fullness, bloating and discomfort after meals caused by difficulty digesting food.

How does it work?
Fungal diastase helps break down carbohydrates, while pepsin helps digest proteins. This may support digestion and reduce meal-related digestive discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use by mouth exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Follow any instructions about taking it with or after meals, and do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, bloating or diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to fungal diastase, pepsin or any ingredient in the product. Seek medical advice if indigestion is severe, persistent or associated with severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, black stools or unexplained weight loss. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in children.

title: Montolo-L 60 Ml (M.C.) (60 Ml) Levocetirizine + Montelukast Sodium By Martin & Brown
name: Montolo-L 60 Ml (M.C.) (60 Ml) Levocetirizine + Montelukast Sodium By Martin & Brown
searchText: Montolo-L 60 Ml (M.C.) (60 Ml) Levocetirizine + Montelukast Sodium By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergies such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose, and watery or itchy eyes. It may also be prescribed for other allergy-related symptoms when advised by a doctor.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, which can contribute to allergy symptoms and nasal blockage.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed or directed on the pack. Do not take more than the recommended amount. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effect is known.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach discomfort, or abdominal pain.

Precautions
Tell a doctor if there is kidney disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or a history of mental health problems. Avoid alcohol if it increases drowsiness. Seek medical help promptly for major mood or behaviour changes, disturbing dreams, depression, or thoughts of self-harm.

title: Montolo-L Tab (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg + Montelukast Sodium 10 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Montolo-L Tab (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg + Montelukast Sodium 10 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Montolo-L Tab (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg + Montelukast Sodium 10 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve symptoms of allergic rhinitis (nasal allergies), such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, nasal itching and watery eyes.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a substance that causes allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals involved in allergic inflammation and airway symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed or directed on the label. Swallow the tablet with water and do not take more than recommended. Do not stop or change treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Drowsiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach pain or nausea may occur.

Precautions
Levocetirizine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or alcohol until its effects are known. Tell a doctor about kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding before use. Seek medical advice promptly if mood or behaviour changes, sleep problems, anxiety, depression or suicidal thoughts occur. This medicine is not a substitute for a rescue inhaler during a sudden asthma attack.

title: Montolo-L Tab (M.C.) (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg + Montelukast Sodium 10 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Montolo-L Tab (M.C.) (20X10) Levocetirizine 5 Mg + Montelukast Sodium 10 Mg By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used mainly to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy nose or throat, and watery or itchy eyes. It may also help control allergy-related nasal symptoms when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Levocetirizine blocks histamine, a substance that causes allergy symptoms. Montelukast blocks leukotrienes, chemicals that contribute to inflammation and nasal allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Do not take more than the recommended amount or stop treatment without medical advice.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, stomach discomfort, and dizziness.

Precautions
This medicine may cause sleepiness or dizziness; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Tell the doctor about kidney disease or a history of depression, anxiety, sleep problems, or other mental health concerns. Seek medical advice promptly if unusual mood or behaviour changes, nightmares, agitation, or suicidal thoughts occur. It is not intended to treat a sudden asthma attack.

title: Moxib D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Moxifloxacin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown
name: Moxib D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Moxifloxacin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown
searchText: Moxib D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Moxifloxacin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat bacterial eye infections when there is also redness and inflammation, only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Moxifloxacin is an antibiotic that stops the growth of bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces swelling, redness and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as prescribed. Wash hands before use and avoid touching the applicator tip to the eye or other surfaces. Do not wear contact lenses unless advised by a doctor. Complete the prescribed course and do not use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Temporary eye irritation, burning or discomfort, blurred vision, increased watering or a bad taste in the mouth may occur.

Precautions
Use only after medical advice, as steroid-containing eye medicines may worsen some viral or fungal eye infections and can delay healing. Tell the doctor about glaucoma, eye injury, recent eye surgery or an allergy to quinolone antibiotics or corticosteroids. Seek medical help for worsening pain, vision changes, severe swelling, rash or breathing difficulty. Prolonged use may increase eye pressure or cause a secondary infection.

title: Moxib E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Moxifloxacin By Martin & Brown
name: Moxib E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Moxifloxacin By Martin & Brown
searchText: Moxib E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Moxifloxacin By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Moxifloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections. The specific infection treated depends on the formulation, such as tablets, injections or eye drops. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making and repairing their genetic material, which prevents them from growing and surviving.

How to take/use it
Use moxifloxacin exactly as prescribed. The dose and duration depend on the infection and formulation. Complete the prescribed course unless a healthcare professional tells otherwise. Do not share leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache and dizziness may occur. Eye drops may cause temporary eye irritation or discomfort.

Precautions
Tell a healthcare professional about allergies to quinolone antibiotics, heart rhythm problems, tendon disorders, nerve problems, seizures, kidney or liver disease, or pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe or persistent diarrhoea, irregular heartbeat, severe dizziness, confusion, or a serious allergic reaction. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizzy.

title: Multimin 10Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Multivitamin Injection By Martin & Brown
name: Multimin 10Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Multivitamin Injection By Martin & Brown
searchText: Multimin 10Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Multivitamin Injection By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Multivitamin Injection is used to prevent or treat vitamin deficiencies, especially when vitamins cannot be taken or absorbed adequately by mouth. The exact uses depend on the vitamins included in the product.

How does it work?
It supplies essential vitamins needed for normal energy production, metabolism, growth and body maintenance.

How to take/use it
It is given by injection into a muscle or vein by a doctor or nurse, according to the product instructions. Do not self-inject. The dose and duration depend on the specific formulation and medical need.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; nausea or headache may occur. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe rash.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any allergy to vitamins or medicines, and about liver or kidney problems. Do not take additional vitamin supplements unless advised, as excessive intake of some vitamins can be harmful. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Multimin (20X1X10) Multivitamin, Multimineral & Antioxidants Softgel Capsules By Martin & Brown
name: Multimin (20X1X10) Multivitamin, Multimineral & Antioxidants Softgel Capsules By Martin & Brown
searchText: Multimin (20X1X10) Multivitamin, Multimineral & Antioxidants Softgel Capsules By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to supplement the diet with vitamins, minerals and antioxidant nutrients when dietary intake may be inadequate.

How does it work?
It provides nutrients needed for normal body functions. Antioxidant nutrients help protect cells from oxidative damage.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Swallow the softgel with water and do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
May cause nausea, stomach upset, constipation or an unpleasant taste in some people.

Precautions
Do not use it as a replacement for a balanced diet. Avoid taking more than the recommended amount or combining it with other vitamin and mineral supplements without medical advice. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or if taking regular medicines or having a medical condition.

title: Murobion 3Ml Amp (Jali) (E 50X3Ml) Vit B1 +B6 + B 12 + Calcium Pantothenate By Martin & Brown
name: Murobion 3Ml Amp (Jali) (E 50X3Ml) Vit B1 +B6 + B 12 + Calcium Pantothenate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Murobion 3Ml Amp (Jali) (E 50X3Ml) Vit B1 +B6 + B 12 + Calcium Pantothenate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat deficiency of vitamins B1, B6, B12 and B5 (provided as calcium pantothenate), when advised by a healthcare professional. These vitamins support normal nerve function, energy metabolism and blood cell formation.

How does it work?
It supplies B-group vitamins needed for energy production, healthy nerves and normal blood formation. Vitamin B12 and B6 also support normal red blood cell production and nerve function.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Nausea, stomach upset or headache may occur. Allergic reactions are uncommon.

Precautions
Avoid prolonged or excessive use, as high amounts of vitamin B6 may cause nerve problems. Tell a healthcare professional about all medicines being taken, especially levodopa. Seek medical help for rash, swelling, breathing difficulty, or persistent tingling or numbness.

title: M-Vil 10 Ml (Dabbi) Inj (24X10 Ml) Pheniramine Maleate I.P 22.75Mg By Martin & Brown
name: M-Vil 10 Ml (Dabbi) Inj (24X10 Ml) Pheniramine Maleate I.P 22.75Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: M-Vil 10 Ml (Dabbi) Inj (24X10 Ml) Pheniramine Maleate I.P 22.75Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pheniramine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itching and watery eyes.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions, helping reduce allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than recommended. It may cause drowsiness.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and dizziness.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery, as drowsiness may occur. Seek medical advice before use if there is glaucoma, difficulty urinating or prostate enlargement. Use in children only as directed by a healthcare professional.

title: M-Vil 2 Ml (Bl) Amp (5X10X2Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown
name: M-Vil 2 Ml (Bl) Amp (5X10X2Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown
searchText: M-Vil 2 Ml (Bl) Amp (5X10X2Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pheniramine maleate injection is used to relieve allergic conditions such as hives, itching, skin rashes and other allergy symptoms. It may also be used by healthcare professionals as part of treatment for severe allergic reactions.

How does it work?
It is an antihistamine that blocks histamine, a chemical involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce itching, redness, swelling and other allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection only by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose and injection method depend on the condition being treated. Do not self-inject.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and weakness may occur. Injection-site discomfort may also occur.

Precautions
Avoid driving or using machinery if drowsy or dizzy. Alcohol and other medicines that cause sleepiness may increase these effects. Tell the healthcare professional if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate problems, asthma or severe breathing problems. Seek urgent medical help for severe breathing difficulty, facial or throat swelling, fainting or a rapidly worsening allergic reaction.

title: M-Vil 2 Ml (Jali) Amp (50X2Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown
name: M-Vil 2 Ml (Jali) Amp (50X2Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown
searchText: M-Vil 2 Ml (Jali) Amp (50X2Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pheniramine maleate injection is an antihistamine used to relieve allergic reactions such as hives, itching, skin rashes and swelling. It is generally used when an injectable medicine is needed and is administered by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce itching, redness, rashes and swelling.

How to take/use it
This injection should be given only by a healthcare professional. The dose and method of administration depend on the condition being treated. Do not self-inject.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and weakness may occur.

Precautions
Avoid driving, operating machinery and alcohol because it may cause drowsiness. Tell the healthcare professional if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate enlargement, asthma or other breathing problems. Older adults may be more sensitive to its effects. Seek urgent medical help for severe breathing difficulty, fainting or rapidly worsening swelling; this medicine may not be sufficient as the only treatment for a severe allergic reaction.

title: Mvil 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown
name: Mvil 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Mvil 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Pheniramine Maleate Inj. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pheniramine maleate injection is used to relieve allergic symptoms such as itching, hives, skin rashes and a runny nose. It may be used for more severe or rapidly developing allergic reactions when an injection is needed.

How does it work?
It is an antihistamine that blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce itching, redness, swelling and other allergy symptoms.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a doctor or other trained healthcare professional. Do not self-inject it. The dose and method of injection depend on the condition and response to treatment.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and weakness may occur.

Precautions
It may cause drowsiness; avoid driving, operating machinery and alcohol until its effects are known. Tell the healthcare professional if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate problems, asthma or other breathing problems. Older adults may be more sensitive to its effects. Seek urgent medical help for severe breathing difficulty, facial or throat swelling, or fainting.

title: Nervotone-Forte 2Ml Amp (Bl) (10X1X2 Ml) Methylcobalamin 1000,Nicotinamide 100, Pyridoxine 100 & D-Panthenol 50 By Martin & Brown
name: Nervotone-Forte 2Ml Amp (Bl) (10X1X2 Ml) Methylcobalamin 1000,Nicotinamide 100, Pyridoxine 100 & D-Panthenol 50 By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nervotone-Forte 2Ml Amp (Bl) (10X1X2 Ml) Methylcobalamin 1000,Nicotinamide 100, Pyridoxine 100 & D-Panthenol 50 By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat deficiencies of certain B vitamins and to support normal nerve function, energy metabolism and blood cell formation. It may be recommended when additional B vitamins are needed.

How does it work?
It supplies methylcobalamin, pyridoxine, nicotinamide and D-panthenol, which are B-vitamin forms involved in nerve function, energy production and other normal body processes.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach upset or diarrhoea may occur. Stop use and seek medical advice if an unusual rash or other signs of allergy develop.

Precautions
Inform a doctor about any existing medical conditions or other supplements being taken. Prolonged or excessive use of pyridoxine (vitamin B6) can cause nerve problems such as tingling or numbness; seek medical advice if these symptoms occur.

title: Neurovit Forte Tab (10 X 5 X 10) B1+B6+B12+Nia+ Cal Pentothenate By Martin & Brown
name: Neurovit Forte Tab (10 X 5 X 10) B1+B6+B12+Nia+ Cal Pentothenate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Neurovit Forte Tab (10 X 5 X 10) B1+B6+B12+Nia+ Cal Pentothenate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This B-complex vitamin supplement helps prevent or treat deficiencies of vitamin B1, B6, B12, niacin and calcium pantothenate. These vitamins support energy metabolism, normal nerve function and the formation of healthy blood cells.

How does it work?
The ingredients act as essential nutrients and coenzymes that help the body release energy from food and support the nervous system and blood cells.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, headache or flushing may occur. Urine may become bright yellow, which is usually harmless.

Precautions
Avoid taking more than the recommended dose, especially for long periods, because excessive vitamin B6 may cause nerve problems. Tell a healthcare professional about other supplements or medicines being taken. Seek medical help for signs of an allergic reaction or unusual tingling, numbness or weakness.

title: Nimac Nile (M.C) 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown
name: Nimac Nile (M.C) 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nimac Nile (M.C) 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ibuprofen + paracetamol suspension is used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and reduction of fever.

How does it work?
Ibuprofen reduces the production of substances that cause pain, swelling and fever. Paracetamol also reduces pain and fever through a different action.

How to take/use it
For oral use only. Shake the bottle well and measure the dose with the supplied measuring device. Follow the dose and frequency on the label or as advised by a doctor. Do not take more than recommended, use it for longer than advised, or take it with other medicines containing ibuprofen or paracetamol.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash.

Precautions
Avoid this medicine if allergic to ibuprofen, paracetamol, aspirin or other NSAIDs. Seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, asthma triggered by painkillers, kidney or liver disease, heart problems, dehydration, or pregnancy—especially during the last 3 months. Stop use and seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, vomiting blood or black stools. Taking more than the recommended amount can cause serious liver damage, even if feeling well.

title: Nimac Nile (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown
name: Nimac Nile (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nimac Nile (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and fever. It may also help reduce pain linked with inflammation, such as body aches, toothache, headache or muscle and joint pain.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Ibuprofen reduces substances in the body that cause pain, fever and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Shake the bottle well before use. Measure the suspension with the supplied measuring device and follow the dose and frequency on the package or as prescribed. Do not take more than recommended, and do not use it with other medicines containing paracetamol, ibuprofen or other NSAIDs.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to ibuprofen, paracetamol, aspirin or other NSAIDs. Seek medical advice before use in people with stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, NSAID-sensitive asthma, dehydration, or during pregnancy, especially the last three months. Stop use and seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, vomiting blood or black stools. Seek medical advice if pain or fever continues or worsens.

title: Nimac Tab (20 X 15) Nimesulide 100Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Nimac Tab (20 X 15) Nimesulide 100Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nimac Tab (20 X 15) Nimesulide 100Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Nimesulide is used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and fever, such as pain from muscle or joint problems, dental pain or menstrual cramps.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and fever.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. It is usually taken with or after food to reduce stomach irritation. Do not use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain, indigestion, dizziness and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice. Nimesulide can rarely cause serious liver problems; stop taking it and seek medical help if yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe nausea, unusual tiredness or upper abdominal pain occurs. Avoid alcohol and do not combine it with other painkillers or anti-inflammatory medicines unless advised. Tell the doctor about liver, kidney, stomach or heart problems, or if pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid use in children unless specifically prescribed.

title: Nimiz Plus Mf 60 Ml (60Ml) Paracetamol + Mefenamic Acid By Martin & Brown
name: Nimiz Plus Mf 60 Ml (60Ml) Paracetamol + Mefenamic Acid By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nimiz Plus Mf 60 Ml (60Ml) Paracetamol + Mefenamic Acid By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve mild to moderate pain and reduce fever. It may also be used for pain linked to inflammation, including menstrual cramps, when prescribed.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Mefenamic acid reduces the production of substances that cause pain and inflammation.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed, preferably with or after food and with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid taking other medicines containing paracetamol or other NSAID painkillers unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcer or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, asthma triggered by painkillers, or allergy to NSAIDs. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially in the last three months. Avoid excessive alcohol. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin rash.

title: Nimiz Plus Tab (20 X 10) Nimesulide 100 Mg + Pcm 325Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Nimiz Plus Tab (20 X 10) Nimesulide 100 Mg + Pcm 325Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nimiz Plus Tab (20 X 10) Nimesulide 100 Mg + Pcm 325Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and fever, such as body pain, muscle or joint pain, toothache or painful injuries.

How does it work?
Nimesulide reduces the substances that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol helps relieve pain and reduce fever.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water, preferably after food. Do not take more than the recommended amount or use it for longer than advised. Avoid taking other medicines containing paracetamol or nimesulide unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or headache may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice, especially if there is liver, kidney or stomach disease, or a history of stomach ulcers or bleeding. Avoid alcohol. Do not use with other painkillers or paracetamol-containing medicines unless advised. Avoid use during pregnancy, particularly the last 3 months, unless specifically prescribed. Stop taking it and seek medical help for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe skin rash, breathing difficulty, unusual bleeding or severe stomach pain.

title: Nimtex Plus Tab (20X10) Nimesulide 100Mg + Para 325Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Nimtex Plus Tab (20X10) Nimesulide 100Mg + Para 325Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nimtex Plus Tab (20X10) Nimesulide 100Mg + Para 325Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Nimesulide 100 mg + paracetamol 325 mg is used for short-term relief of pain, inflammation and fever, such as body pain, muscle or joint pain, toothache and period pain.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances involved in pain, inflammation and fever. Nimesulide mainly provides anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving effects, while paracetamol helps relieve pain and fever.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and preferably with or after food, with water. Do not take more than the recommended dose or use it for longer than advised. Avoid taking other medicines containing paracetamol or additional painkillers unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use without medical advice if there is liver disease, kidney disease, stomach ulcer or bleeding, or an allergy to painkillers. Avoid alcohol. Stop using it and seek medical help if yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe stomach pain, unusual bleeding, breathing difficulty or a serious skin rash occurs. It should generally be avoided during pregnancy, especially the last three months, unless specifically prescribed.

title: Nocof Junior M.Cap (M.C) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr 10 Mg , C.P.M. 2Mg & Phenylephrine Hcl5 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Nocof Junior M.Cap (M.C) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr 10 Mg , C.P.M. 2Mg & Phenylephrine Hcl5 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nocof Junior M.Cap (M.C) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr 10 Mg , C.P.M. 2Mg & Phenylephrine Hcl5 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of cough, blocked nose, runny nose and sneezing associated with the common cold or similar upper-respiratory symptoms.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the cough reflex. Chlorpheniramine helps reduce allergy-related symptoms such as sneezing and runny nose, while phenylephrine helps relieve nasal congestion.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Do not take more than recommended, and avoid using other cough, cold or allergy medicines containing the same ingredients.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, headache, nervousness, increased blood pressure or a fast heartbeat.

Precautions
May cause drowsiness; avoid driving, alcohol and activities requiring alertness until the effect is known. Consult a doctor before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, prostate or urination problems. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitors, and ask a doctor or pharmacist before use with antidepressants or other medicines that cause drowsiness. Seek medical help for severe palpitations, breathing difficulty or an allergic reaction.

title: Norlac-T 30 Ml (M.Cap ) (30Ml) Norfloxacin 100Mg+ Tinidazole 75Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Norlac-T 30 Ml (M.Cap ) (30Ml) Norfloxacin 100Mg+ Tinidazole 75Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Norlac-T 30 Ml (M.Cap ) (30Ml) Norfloxacin 100Mg+ Tinidazole 75Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain infectious diarrhoea and loose motions caused by susceptible bacteria or intestinal parasites. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Norfloxacin stops the growth of susceptible bacteria. Tinidazole damages the DNA of certain parasites and bacteria, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water; norfloxacin is generally taken on an empty stomach. Keep antacids and mineral supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc separate from the dose as advised by a doctor or pharmacist. Avoid alcohol during treatment and for 72 hours after the last dose.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to norfloxacin, tinidazole or similar medicines. Seek medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, blood in the stool, severe abdominal pain, rash or breathing difficulty. Stop the medicine and contact a doctor for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe weakness, confusion or seizures. Consult a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or if there is a history of seizures, nerve problems, heart-rhythm problems or tendon disorders.

title: Norplox 400 Tab (6 X 5 X 10) Norfloxacin 400Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Norplox 400 Tab (6 X 5 X 10) Norfloxacin 400Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Norplox 400 Tab (6 X 5 X 10) Norfloxacin 400Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Norfloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, mainly urinary tract infections and some bacterial intestinal infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying, helping the body clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Swallow with water, preferably on an empty stomach. Avoid taking it together with milk or dairy products, antacids, or supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc; follow the timing instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Nausea, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and sleep disturbance.

Precautions
Use only on medical advice, especially if there is kidney disease, a history of tendon problems, seizures, heart rhythm problems, or aortic disease. Stop taking it and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe mood or nerve symptoms, a severe allergic reaction, or persistent or severe diarrhoea. Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, or other medicines being taken. Avoid unnecessary exposure to strong sunlight and use sun protection.

title: Nosy Clear 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Xylometazoline Hydrochloride Nasal Solution Ip By Martin & Brown
name: Nosy Clear 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Xylometazoline Hydrochloride Nasal Solution Ip By Martin & Brown
searchText: Nosy Clear 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Xylometazoline Hydrochloride Nasal Solution Ip By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Xylometazoline nasal solution provides short-term relief from a blocked or stuffy nose caused by the common cold, allergic rhinitis or sinus congestion.

How does it work?
It narrows swollen blood vessels inside the nose, reducing swelling and helping improve airflow.

How to take/use it
Use only inside the nose and follow the instructions on the product label or as advised by a healthcare professional. Do not use more often or for longer than recommended, as prolonged use can worsen nasal blockage. Do not swallow the solution.

Common side effects
Nasal dryness, irritation, burning or sneezing. Headache or a fast heartbeat may occur less commonly.

Precautions
Ask a healthcare professional before use if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, hyperthyroidism, diabetes, glaucoma or prostate problems, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Avoid prolonged use. Stop and seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, persist or if severe palpitations occur.

title: Ofaxin-M Susp. 30 Ml(Red) (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ofaxin-M Susp. 30 Ml(Red) (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ofaxin-M Susp. 30 Ml(Red) (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections of the stomach and intestines, including infectious diarrhoea and dysentery, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Metronidazole damages the DNA of certain anaerobic bacteria and parasites, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the doctor. Follow the prescribed dose and duration, and complete the course even if symptoms improve. Do not self-medicate for diarrhoea, as some cases do not require antibiotics.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, and a metallic or unusual taste.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 2 days after the last dose. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children, or if there is a history of seizures, nerve problems, or tendon disorders. Stop the medicine and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe dizziness, allergic reactions, or persistent or bloody diarrhoea.

title: Ofaxin-M Susp. 30 Ml (Yellow) (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ofaxin-M Susp. 30 Ml (Yellow) (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ofaxin-M Susp. 30 Ml (Yellow) (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal intestinal infections that may cause infectious diarrhoea or dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Metronidazole benzoate damages the DNA of certain anaerobic bacteria and parasites, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, with or without food. Complete the prescribed course unless a healthcare professional advises otherwise. Drink adequate fluids during diarrhoea. Do not use it for self-treatment of every episode of loose motion.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, and a metallic or unusual taste may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, blood in the stool, severe abdominal pain, allergic reaction, unusual tingling or numbness, or tendon pain or swelling. Inform the prescriber about pregnancy, breastfeeding, seizures, liver disease, or previous tendon problems, and about all other medicines being taken.

title: Ofaxin-M Susp. 60 Ml (60Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ofaxin-M Susp. 60 Ml (60Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ofaxin-M Susp. 60 Ml (60Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg+ Met Benzoate 100Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial or protozoal infections of the stomach and intestines that may cause diarrhoea or dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin stops susceptible bacteria from multiplying. Metronidazole damages certain bacteria and parasites that can cause intestinal infections.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor and complete the recommended course. Do not self-medicate or use it for ordinary viral diarrhoea. If it is a liquid, measure each dose with the provided measuring device and shake well before use.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and a metallic taste in the mouth.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, blood in the stool, severe dizziness, numbness or tingling, unusual mood or behaviour changes, or tendon pain or swelling. Use only under medical supervision, especially in children, older adults, and people with kidney, liver, nerve or tendon problems.

title: Ofaxin Susp. 30 Ml (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ofaxin Susp. 30 Ml (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ofaxin Susp. 30 Ml (30Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ofloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills bacteria by blocking enzymes needed for their growth and reproduction.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor and follow the instructions on the label. Complete the prescribed course unless advised otherwise. Do not share it or use leftover antibiotics.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain, headache, dizziness and indigestion.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ofloxacin or other quinolone antibiotics. Seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe dizziness, mood or behaviour changes, irregular heartbeat, or severe or persistent diarrhoea. Tell the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, epilepsy, heart rhythm problems, kidney disease or previous tendon problems. Avoid driving if dizzy or experiencing vision or nervous-system symptoms.

title: Ofaxin Susp. 60 Ml (60Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ofaxin Susp. 60 Ml (60Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ofaxin Susp. 60 Ml (60Ml) Ofloxacin 50Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ofloxacin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops bacteria from making the enzymes needed for their growth and reproduction, helping clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Use it exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Do not skip doses or stop treatment early unless advised. Do not use leftover antibiotics or share them. Antacids and supplements containing iron, calcium, magnesium or zinc may affect its absorption; ask a doctor or pharmacist how to space them.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness and difficulty sleeping may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about allergies, kidney problems, seizures, tendon problems, nerve disorders, heart-rhythm problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Stop using it and seek medical help for tendon pain or swelling, numbness or tingling, severe diarrhoea, serious rash, breathing difficulty, fainting or unusual mood or nervous-system changes. Avoid driving if dizzy or affected by the medicine.

title: Ofil-Dex E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ofloxacin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown
name: Ofil-Dex E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ofloxacin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ofil-Dex E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Ofloxacin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to treat certain bacterial infections of the eye or ear that are accompanied by redness, swelling or other inflammation. Use only when prescribed for the affected area.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin kills susceptible bacteria by stopping their growth. Dexamethasone reduces inflammation, swelling and irritation.

How to take/use it
Use only by the route stated on the label and exactly as prescribed. Do not use it for longer than advised. Avoid touching the applicator tip to the eye, ear or other surfaces.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, irritation or discomfort at the application site. Temporary blurred vision may occur when used in the eye.

Precautions
Do not use for viral or fungal infections unless specifically advised by a doctor. Prolonged or repeated use may delay healing or increase the risk of other infections and, when used in the eye, may increase eye pressure. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, do not improve, or if severe pain, vision changes, rash or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Ofil-Oz Tab (20X10) Ofloxacin 200Mg +Ornidazole 500Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ofil-Oz Tab (20X10) Ofloxacin 200Mg +Ornidazole 500Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ofil-Oz Tab (20X10) Ofloxacin 200Mg +Ornidazole 500Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ofloxacin + ornidazole is used to treat certain bacterial and protozoal infections, including some mixed infections of the digestive system such as infectious diarrhoea or dysentery. It should be used only when prescribed by a doctor and is not useful for viral infections.

How does it work?
Ofloxacin kills susceptible bacteria by blocking enzymes they need to multiply. Ornidazole acts against certain disease-causing protozoa and anaerobic bacteria.

How to take/use it

searchText: Polywin 200 Ml (200 Ml) Vit B1 1.5 Mg + Vit B2 1.5 Mg + Vit B6 0.5 Mg + D-Panthenol 1 Mg + Niacinamide 15 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to prevent or treat deficiency of certain B vitamins and support normal energy metabolism, nerve function and skin health.

How does it work?
The included B vitamins help the body release energy from food and support normal nerve, blood cell and skin function.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Nausea, stomach upset or headache may occur. Riboflavin may make urine appear bright yellow; this is generally harmless.

Precautions
Check with a healthcare professional before use if allergic to any ingredient or if taking other vitamin supplements. Avoid exceeding the recommended dose. Seek medical advice if unusual or severe symptoms occur.

title: Polywin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) B1+B6+B25+Nia+Vit B12+D-Pantheol By Martin & Brown
name: Polywin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) B1+B6+B25+Nia+Vit B12+D-Pantheol By Martin & Brown
searchText: Polywin 30 Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) B1+B6+B25+Nia+Vit B12+D-Pantheol By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This vitamin B-complex supplement is used to provide several B vitamins and help prevent or treat deficiencies when dietary intake is inadequate. B vitamins support energy metabolism, nerve function, and the formation of healthy blood cells.

How does it work?
Its B vitamins act as nutrients and cofactors needed for energy production, normal nerve function, and other body processes.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset.

Common side effects
Mild nausea, stomach upset, or headache may occur. Bright-yellow urine can occur with some B vitamins and is usually harmless.

Precautions
Check with a healthcare professional before use if pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other vitamin supplements. Avoid prolonged use of high doses, especially vitamin B6, unless medically advised. Stop use and seek medical help if a severe rash, swelling, or breathing difficulty occurs.

title: Polywin (Bl) 2Ml Amp (5X10X2Ml) Vitamin B-Complex By Martin & Brown
name: Polywin (Bl) 2Ml Amp (5X10X2Ml) Vitamin B-Complex By Martin & Brown
searchText: Polywin (Bl) 2Ml Amp (5X10X2Ml) Vitamin B-Complex By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Vitamin B-complex is used to prevent or treat deficiency of B vitamins. It may be recommended when the body needs additional B vitamins for normal energy metabolism, nerve function and red blood cell formation.

How does it work?
B vitamins act as coenzymes that help the body use carbohydrates, fats and proteins for energy. They also support normal nerve and blood-cell function.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. It may be taken with food if it causes stomach discomfort. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated. Possible effects include nausea, stomach upset, headache or bright yellow urine.

Precautions
Check the product ingredients if there is an allergy or sensitivity to any B vitamin. Avoid prolonged use of high-strength products, especially those containing high-dose vitamin B6, unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice if unusual numbness, tingling or weakness develops.

title: Progen 2Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Promethazine Hydrochloride 25Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Progen 2Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Promethazine Hydrochloride 25Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Progen 2Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Promethazine Hydrochloride 25Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Promethazine is used to relieve allergy symptoms such as itching, rash and runny nose. It is also used to help prevent or treat nausea, vomiting and motion sickness.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. It also reduces signals in the brain that can cause nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Do not take it with alcohol or other medicines that cause sleepiness unless advised by a doctor.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision and constipation may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful with other sedating medicines. Seek medical advice before use if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, breathing problems or severe liver disease. Promethazine should not be given to children under 2 years because of the risk of serious breathing problems. Seek urgent help for severe breathing difficulty, extreme sleepiness or an allergic reaction.

title: Progen 2Ml (Jali) Amp (50X2Ml) Promethazine Hydrochloride 25Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Progen 2Ml (Jali) Amp (50X2Ml) Promethazine Hydrochloride 25Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Progen 2Ml (Jali) Amp (50X2Ml) Promethazine Hydrochloride 25Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Promethazine is used to relieve allergy symptoms such as itching, sneezing and a runny nose. It is also used to prevent or treat nausea, vomiting and motion sickness.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine, a chemical involved in allergic symptoms. It also reduces signals in the brain that can cause nausea and vomiting, and may make a person feel sleepy.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than recommended. It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision, dry mouth and constipation may occur.

Precautions
Do not use in children under 2 years unless specifically directed by a doctor. Seek medical advice before use in older adults or people with breathing problems, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate problems, seizures or liver disease. Seek urgent medical help for severe breathing difficulty, extreme sleepiness or a serious allergic reaction.

title: Protonfix-40 Inj (1 Vial) Pantoprazole 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Protonfix-40 Inj (1 Vial) Pantoprazole 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Protonfix-40 Inj (1 Vial) Pantoprazole 40 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pantoprazole is used to reduce excess stomach acid and treat acidity, heartburn, acid reflux (GERD) and related stomach or intestinal ulcers.

How does it work?
It blocks the acid-producing pumps in the stomach, reducing the amount of acid produced.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. It is commonly taken before food, as directed by the doctor.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, vomiting, gas and constipation.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver problems, vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis, or low magnesium levels. Long-term use should be monitored by a doctor. Seek medical advice for severe or persistent diarrhoea, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, unexplained weight loss or continuing stomach pain. Inform the doctor about all other medicines being taken.

title: Protonfix-40 Inj (T.P) (1 Vial) Pantoprazole 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Protonfix-40 Inj (T.P) (1 Vial) Pantoprazole 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Protonfix-40 Inj (T.P) (1 Vial) Pantoprazole 40 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pantoprazole 40 mg is used to reduce excess stomach acid. It helps treat acidity, heartburn, acid reflux (GERD) and stomach or intestinal ulcers, as prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It blocks the stomach’s acid-producing pumps, thereby lowering acid production and relieving acid-related symptoms.

How to take/use it
Take it by mouth exactly as prescribed. Swallow the tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. It is commonly taken before food, but follow the instructions provided by the doctor or pharmacist.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, vomiting and gas.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and all other medicines being taken. Long-term use should be medically monitored. Seek medical advice for difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, unexplained weight loss, persistent vomiting or severe diarrhoea.

title: Protonfix 40 Tab (20X10) Pantoprazole Sodium 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Protonfix 40 Tab (20X10) Pantoprazole Sodium 40 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Protonfix 40 Tab (20X10) Pantoprazole Sodium 40 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Pantoprazole is used to reduce excess stomach acid and treat acidity, heartburn, acid reflux (GERD), and stomach or intestinal ulcers. It may also be used to help heal acid-related damage to the food pipe.

How does it work?
It blocks the stomach’s acid-producing pump, reducing the amount of acid released into the stomach.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, usually before a meal. Swallow the tablet whole with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not change the dose or duration without medical advice.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, vomiting, constipation, or gas.

Precautions
Tell a doctor if symptoms continue or worsen, or if there is difficulty swallowing, repeated vomiting, unexplained weight loss, vomiting blood, or black stools. Long-term use should be monitored by a doctor, as it may affect vitamin B12 or magnesium levels and may increase the risk of certain infections or bone fractures. Tell the doctor about other medicines being taken, especially blood thinners or medicines for HIV treatment.

title: Protonfix-D Tab (20X10) Pantoprazole 40 Mg + Domperidone 10 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Protonfix-D Tab (20X10) Pantoprazole 40 Mg + Domperidone 10 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Protonfix-D Tab (20X10) Pantoprazole 40 Mg + Domperidone 10 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux. It may also help with nausea, vomiting and fullness linked to slowed stomach movement.

How does it work?
Pantoprazole reduces the amount of acid made in the stomach. Domperidone helps improve stomach movement and helps control nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Follow the prescribed timing in relation to meals, and do not take more or use it for longer than advised.

Common side effects
Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of heart rhythm problems, heart disease, liver disease or electrolyte imbalance. Domperidone may interact with some medicines and can rarely cause serious heart rhythm problems. Seek medical help for fast or irregular heartbeat, fainting or severe dizziness. Avoid prolonged use without medical advice.

title: Ranimac 30Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 27.9Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Ranimac 30Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 27.9Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ranimac 30Ml Inj (10X30 Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 27.9Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine is used to reduce excess stomach acid and relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux. It may also be prescribed for stomach or intestinal ulcers.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine H2 receptors in the stomach, reducing the production of stomach acid.

How to take/use it
Take only as directed on the product label or by a doctor. Swallow with water and do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Do not use old or unverified ranitidine stock; check with a pharmacist or doctor because ranitidine products have been withdrawn or restricted in many countries.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Seek medical advice for persistent or recurring heartburn, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, unexplained weight loss or severe stomach pain. Tell the doctor if there is kidney or liver disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if other medicines are being taken. Stop use and seek medical help for signs of a serious allergic reaction.

title: Ranimac (Bl) 2Ml (10X5X2Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown
name: Ranimac (Bl) 2Ml (10X5X2Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ranimac (Bl) 2Ml (10X5X2Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine reduces excess stomach acid. It is used for acidity and heartburn, acid reflux (GERD), and certain stomach or intestinal ulcers when prescribed.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine H2 receptors in the stomach, reducing the amount of acid produced.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist and follow the product label. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Swallow the medicine with water.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation, or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Seek medical advice for persistent or recurrent heartburn, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, unexplained weight loss, or severe stomach pain. Tell the doctor about kidney or liver problems and other medicines being used. Because ranitidine has been withdrawn or restricted in some countries due to contamination concerns, check with a pharmacist or doctor before using older stock or obtaining it.

title: Ranimac (Jali ) 2Ml (50X2Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown
name: Ranimac (Jali ) 2Ml (50X2Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown
searchText: Ranimac (Jali ) 2Ml (50X2Ml) Ranitidine Hydrochloride By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine reduces excess stomach acid and is used for acidity, heartburn, acid reflux and some stomach or intestinal ulcers.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine H2 receptors in the stomach, reducing the amount of acid produced.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Swallow with water unless advised otherwise.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or constipation.

Precautions
Ranitidine has been withdrawn or restricted in many countries because of concerns about possible contamination with NDMA. Check local availability and do not use old or unapproved stock. Seek medical advice for unexplained weight loss, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, persistent symptoms or severe stomach pain. Tell a doctor about other medicines and any history of liver or kidney problems.
