What is it used for?
The supplied information only identifies a rubber bottle and does not specify its medical or therapeutic use.

How does it work?
Its action cannot be determined without knowing the product's intended use.

How to take/use it
Use only according to the product instructions or advice from a healthcare professional. Do not use it for medical purposes unless its intended use is confirmed.

Common side effects
Not applicable based on the information provided.

Precautions
Check the product instructions before use. Do not use if damaged, leaking or deteriorated. Seek clarification from a pharmacist or healthcare professional if the intended use is unclear.

title: Sbc-Mb 10 Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Sodium Bicarbonate Injection By Martin & Brown
name: Sbc-Mb 10 Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Sodium Bicarbonate Injection By Martin & Brown
searchText: Sbc-Mb 10 Ml Amp (50X10 Ml) Sodium Bicarbonate Injection By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sodium bicarbonate injection is used in hospitals to correct excess acid in the blood (metabolic acidosis). It may also be used in selected medical emergencies, such as some poisonings or severely high blood potassium, when specifically advised by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It provides bicarbonate, which helps neutralise excess acid and raise the blood’s pH. It also adds sodium to the body.

How to take/use it
This injection is given into a vein by a doctor or nurse. The dose and rate depend on the medical condition and blood test results, so it must be used under close medical monitoring.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, thirst, irritation at the injection site, fluid retention, increased blood sodium and low potassium. Excessive use may cause blood alkalosis.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision, especially in people with heart failure, kidney disease, high blood pressure, swelling, or electrolyte problems. Blood sodium, potassium, acid levels and fluid balance may need monitoring. Seek urgent medical attention for breathing difficulty, severe swelling, confusion, or worsening symptoms.

title: Simlectin 200 Ml (200Ml) Tricholine Citrate+Cyproheptadine Hcl By Martin & Brown
name: Simlectin 200 Ml (200Ml) Tricholine Citrate+Cyproheptadine Hcl By Martin & Brown
searchText: Simlectin 200 Ml (200Ml) Tricholine Citrate+Cyproheptadine Hcl By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This medicine is used to stimulate appetite and support weight gain in people with poor appetite or inadequate food intake, when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Cyproheptadine blocks histamine and serotonin activity and can increase appetite. Tricholine citrate provides choline and is included to support nutritional and metabolic needs.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by the healthcare professional. Do not take more than prescribed, and avoid driving or operating machinery until its effect is known.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, increased appetite, weight gain, nausea or stomach discomfort.

Precautions
Cyproheptadine may cause sleepiness; avoid alcohol and take care with driving. Tell the healthcare professional about glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate problems, asthma, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe allergic reactions, unusual confusion or extreme drowsiness.

title: Sin Cold Plus Tab (20X10) Pcm+Phenylephrine+Cetirizine Hcl By Martin & Brown
name: Sin Cold Plus Tab (20X10) Pcm+Phenylephrine+Cetirizine Hcl By Martin & Brown
searchText: Sin Cold Plus Tab (20X10) Pcm+Phenylephrine+Cetirizine Hcl By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve common cold symptoms such as fever, headache, body aches, blocked or runny nose, sneezing and watery eyes.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce fever and pain. Phenylephrine helps reduce nasal congestion, while cetirizine helps relieve sneezing and a runny or watery nose.

How to take/use it
Use exactly as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid using it with other medicines containing paracetamol, phenylephrine or antihistamines.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, headache, nervousness or difficulty sleeping. Some people may experience a fast heartbeat or increased blood pressure.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is high blood pressure, heart disease, liver disease, glaucoma, thyroid disease or difficulty passing urine. Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving if drowsy or dizzy. Consult a healthcare professional during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for severe allergic reactions, chest pain, severe palpitations or persistent/worsening symptoms.

title: Somi -Mb 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown
name: Somi -Mb 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown
searchText: Somi -Mb 60 Ml (60Ml) Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ibuprofen + Paracetamol Suspension is used for short-term relief of mild to moderate pain and reduction of fever. It may also help reduce pain associated with inflammation.

How does it work?
Paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever. Ibuprofen reduces pain, fever and inflammation by lowering the production of substances involved in these symptoms.

How to take/use it
Shake the bottle well before use. Measure the suspension with the supplied measuring device and use it only as directed on the label or by a doctor. Do not take it with other medicines containing ibuprofen, paracetamol or other NSAIDs. Taking it with food or milk may help reduce stomach discomfort.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, dizziness or skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to ibuprofen, paracetamol, aspirin or other NSAIDs. Seek medical advice before use if there is a history of stomach ulcers or bleeding, asthma triggered by painkillers, kidney or liver disease, heart problems, dehydration, or regular alcohol use. Avoid ibuprofen during the last three months of pregnancy unless specifically advised by a doctor. Stop use and seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe skin rash, vomiting blood, black stools or suspected overdose.

title: Speclon 100 Ml Lotion (100 Ml) Antiseptic Liquid By Martin & Brown
name: Speclon 100 Ml Lotion (100 Ml) Antiseptic Liquid By Martin & Brown
searchText: Speclon 100 Ml Lotion (100 Ml) Antiseptic Liquid By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used on the skin to clean minor cuts, grazes and wounds and help reduce the risk of infection.

How does it work?
It kills or inhibits the growth of microorganisms on the skin and may help prevent infection in minor wounds.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Use on the affected skin exactly as directed on the product label. Do not dilute unless the label specifically instructs it. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, stinging, redness or dryness. Allergic reactions may rarely occur.

Precautions
Do not use on deep, severe or heavily bleeding wounds unless advised by a healthcare professional. Stop using it if significant irritation or an allergic reaction occurs. Seek medical care if the wound is deep, contaminated, worsening or shows signs of infection such as increasing redness, swelling, pus or fever.

title: Speclon 1 Ltr Lotion (1 Ltr) Antiseptic Liquid By Martin & Brown
name: Speclon 1 Ltr Lotion (1 Ltr) Antiseptic Liquid By Martin & Brown
searchText: Speclon 1 Ltr Lotion (1 Ltr) Antiseptic Liquid By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Antiseptic liquid is used on the skin to help clean minor cuts, grazes and other superficial wounds and reduce the risk of infection.

How does it work?
It helps kill or reduce the growth of germs on the skin. The exact action may vary depending on the antiseptic ingredient.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Use on the affected skin exactly as directed on the product label. Do not swallow, and do not dilute unless the label specifically advises it. Keep away from the eyes and avoid applying to deep or serious wounds unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, dryness, redness or skin irritation may occur. Stop use if a rash or other signs of an allergic reaction develop.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other sensitive areas. Seek medical help for deep wounds, severe burns, animal bites, spreading redness, pus, fever or wounds that do not heal.

title: Spectradine 10% Lotion (100 Ml) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown
name: Spectradine 10% Lotion (100 Ml) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown
searchText: Spectradine 10% Lotion (100 Ml) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 10% is a topical antiseptic used to help prevent or treat infection in minor cuts, wounds, burns and other affected skin areas. It may also be used to disinfect the skin before certain procedures.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or reduces many types of bacteria, viruses and fungi on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean the affected area, apply the solution as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional, and wash hands before and after use. Do not swallow it or apply it inside the eyes, mouth or other body openings.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, redness, dryness or skin irritation may occur. Rarely, an allergic reaction can occur.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine-containing products. Do not use repeatedly over large areas or for prolonged periods unless advised by a healthcare professional, especially in people with thyroid disease, kidney problems, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Stop use and seek medical help for severe irritation, swelling, breathing difficulty or worsening of the wound.

title: Spectradine 10% Lotion (2 Ltr) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown
name: Spectradine 10% Lotion (2 Ltr) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown
searchText: Spectradine 10% Lotion (2 Ltr) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 10% is a topical antiseptic used to clean and help prevent infection in minor cuts, wounds, scrapes and burns. It may also be used to disinfect the skin before certain medical procedures.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or inactivates many bacteria, viruses and fungi on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean the affected area, then apply as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not swallow it or apply it to the eyes.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, redness, dryness or skin irritation. Allergic skin reactions are uncommon.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to povidone iodine. Avoid prolonged or repeated use over large areas, deep wounds or serious burns unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice for worsening redness, swelling, pain, pus or an allergic reaction. People with thyroid problems, those taking lithium, and women who are pregnant or breastfeeding should seek medical advice before extensive or repeated use.

title: Spectradine 10% Lotion (500 Ml) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown
name: Spectradine 10% Lotion (500 Ml) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown
searchText: Spectradine 10% Lotion (500 Ml) Povidone Iodine 10% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 10% is a topical antiseptic used to help prevent or treat infection in minor cuts, grazes, burns and other small skin wounds. It may also be used to disinfect the skin before certain procedures, as directed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or inactivates many types of bacteria, viruses and fungi on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean the affected area and apply the product as directed on the label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes, and do not swallow it.

Common side effects
Temporary skin irritation, redness, dryness or a stinging sensation may occur. Stop using it and seek medical help if severe irritation, swelling or difficulty breathing develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine-containing products. Avoid applying it repeatedly over large areas or for prolonged periods unless advised by a healthcare professional. Ask a doctor before use in newborns, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if there is thyroid disease or treatment with lithium. Seek medical advice if the wound is deep, extensive, badly burned or not improving.

title: Spectradine 5% Lotion (100 Ml) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown
name: Spectradine 5% Lotion (100 Ml) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown
searchText: Spectradine 5% Lotion (100 Ml) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 5% is a topical antiseptic used to reduce germs on the skin and minor wounds. Some 5% formulations are intended for antiseptic preparation of the eye before procedures; the exact use depends on the product formulation and label.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or reduces many types of bacteria, viruses and fungi on contact.

How to take/use it
Use only on the body area specified on the product label. Apply as directed to clean skin or wounds. Do not use it in the eyes unless the product is specifically labelled for ophthalmic use. Do not swallow it.

Common side effects
Mild stinging, irritation, redness or temporary staining of the skin may occur. Stop use and seek medical help for severe rash, swelling or breathing difficulty.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to povidone iodine. Do not use repeatedly over large areas or for prolonged periods without medical advice, especially in people with thyroid problems. Keep away from children. Seek medical advice before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if the wound is deep, extensive or not healing.

title: Spectradine 5% Lotion (2 Ltr) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown
name: Spectradine 5% Lotion (2 Ltr) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown
searchText: Spectradine 5% Lotion (2 Ltr) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 5% is an antiseptic used to reduce germs on the skin or around the eye before certain procedures, depending on the product formulation. The exact use depends on whether it is intended for skin, eye or another site.

How does it work?
It releases iodine, which kills or reduces a wide range of bacteria, viruses and fungi.

How to take/use it
Use only on the body site and in the manner stated on the product label or advised by a healthcare professional. Do not swallow it. Do not use a skin preparation in the eyes, or an eye preparation on the skin, unless specifically directed.

Common side effects
Temporary irritation, burning, redness or dryness may occur. Allergic reactions are uncommon but possible.

Precautions
Check the product instructions carefully because the dosage form and intended use are important. Avoid use if allergic to povidone iodine or other iodine-containing products. Seek medical help for severe irritation, swelling, breathing difficulty or other signs of an allergic reaction. Prolonged or repeated use should be medically supervised, especially in people with thyroid problems, during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Spectradine 5% Lotion (500 Ml) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown
name: Spectradine 5% Lotion (500 Ml) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown
searchText: Spectradine 5% Lotion (500 Ml) Povidone Iodine 5% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 5% is an antiseptic used to reduce germs and help prevent infection in minor cuts, wounds and affected skin. The exact use depends on the product formulation; some 5% products are specifically made for use in the eyes.

How does it work?
It releases iodine, which kills or inactivates many types of bacteria, viruses and fungi on contact.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label. Apply to the affected area only if it is labelled for skin or wound use. Do not use it in the eyes or swallow it unless the product is specifically intended for that use.

Common side effects
Temporary skin irritation, redness, dryness or burning. Rarely, an allergic reaction may occur.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine-containing products. Do not apply repeatedly to large areas or deep wounds unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice for worsening redness, swelling, pain, pus or fever. People with thyroid problems, pregnant or breastfeeding individuals, and those using it on children should seek medical advice before prolonged or repeated use.

title: Spectradine 5% Ointment (125 Gm) Povidone Iodine Oint 5% By Martin & Brown
name: Spectradine 5% Ointment (125 Gm) Povidone Iodine Oint 5% By Martin & Brown
searchText: Spectradine 5% Ointment (125 Gm) Povidone Iodine Oint 5% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine ointment is a topical antiseptic used to help prevent infection in minor cuts, scrapes, and minor burns.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills many types of germs on the skin and helps reduce the risk of infection.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean and dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not apply over large areas unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, dryness, or itching may occur. Stop using it and seek medical help if severe irritation or an allergic reaction develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine. Ask a doctor before use on deep wounds, serious burns, large areas of skin, or for prolonged use, especially if there is a thyroid disorder, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Seek medical care if the wound is deep, worsening, or shows signs of infection.

title: Spectradine 5% Ointment (15 Gm) Povidone Iodine Oint 5% By Martin & Brown

searchText: Spectradine 5% Ointment (15 Gm) Povidone Iodine Oint 5% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine ointment is a topical antiseptic used to help prevent infection in minor cuts, scrapes, and superficial wounds or burns.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or inactivates many types of germs on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean and dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer as directed by a doctor or the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not use on deep or extensive wounds unless medically advised.

Common side effects
Temporary skin irritation, redness, itching or dryness may occur. Stop use and seek medical help if severe irritation, swelling or a rash develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to povidone iodine or other iodine-containing products. Avoid prolonged or repeated use over large areas, especially in children, people with thyroid problems, or those with kidney problems. Seek medical advice for deep wounds, serious burns, animal bites, or wounds that are not healing. Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

What is it used for?
Povidone iodine ointment is an antiseptic used on minor cuts, grazes, and minor burns to help prevent infection.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills many types of germs on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Clean and dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes and do not swallow it.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, itching, or dryness may occur. Stop use if a severe rash or swelling develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine. Avoid prolonged or repeated use over large areas, especially if there is thyroid disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding, unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice for deep wounds, large or serious burns, worsening redness or swelling, pus, or wounds that do not heal.

searchText: Spectradine 7.5% Scrub (100 Ml) Povidone Iodine 7.5% By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 7.5% is a topical antiseptic used to clean the skin and help prevent infection during minor wound care or before medical procedures.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or inactivates many bacteria, viruses and fungi on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply or use it on the affected skin exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other body openings. Do not swallow.

Common side effects
Mild skin irritation, redness, dryness, itching or a temporary stinging sensation. Stop use and seek medical help if severe irritation, swelling or breathing difficulty occurs.

Precautions
Avoid use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine-containing products. Do not use repeatedly over large areas or for prolonged periods unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice before use in people with thyroid disorders, during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or when treating deep, extensive or serious wounds.

title: Spectradine 7.5% Scrub (500 Ml) Povidone Iodine 7.5% By Martin & Brown

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Povidone iodine 7.5% is a topical antiseptic used to clean the skin and help reduce germs around minor cuts, grazes, wounds or before certain procedures.

How does it work?
It slowly releases iodine, which kills or reduces many types of bacteria, viruses and fungi on the skin.

How to take/use it
For external use only. Apply or use it on the affected skin as directed on the product label. Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth and other body openings. Do not swallow it.

Common side effects
Temporary skin irritation, redness, dryness or itching may occur. Stop use and seek medical help if severe irritation, swelling or breathing difficulty develops.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to povidone iodine or iodine. Avoid prolonged use or applying it over large areas unless advised by a healthcare professional. Seek medical advice for deep, extensive or infected wounds, or if the wound is not healing. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Sucrol-Mb 200 Ml (200Ml) Sucralfate 500Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Sucrol-Mb 200 Ml (200Ml) Sucralfate 500Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Sucrol-Mb 200 Ml (200Ml) Sucralfate 500Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Sucralfate is used to treat and help heal stomach and duodenal ulcers. It may also be prescribed to protect the stomach lining in some conditions causing irritation or inflammation.

How does it work?
It forms a protective coating over ulcers and irritated areas in the stomach and intestine. This barrier helps protect them from stomach acid and digestive enzymes while healing occurs.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed. It is usually taken on an empty stomach; follow the product label or prescriber's instructions. Sucralfate can affect the absorption of other medicines, so ask a doctor or pharmacist how to space it from other medicines.

Common side effects
Constipation, dry mouth, nausea and indigestion.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, as the medicine contains aluminium. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines being taken because sucralfate may reduce their absorption. Seek medical advice if symptoms continue or worsen.

title: Tears-Aid Eye 10 Ml (20X10 Ml) Carboxy Methylcellulose Sodium By Martin & Brown

searchText: Tears-Aid Eye 10 Ml (20X10 Ml) Carboxy Methylcellulose Sodium By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Carboxymethylcellulose sodium is used as an artificial tear to relieve dryness, irritation, burning and discomfort caused by dry eyes.

How does it work?
It forms a lubricating layer over the surface of the eye, helping keep it moist and reducing irritation.

How to take/use it
Use in the eyes exactly as directed on the product label or by an eye-care professional. Wash hands before use and avoid touching the dropper tip to the eye or other surfaces. If using other eye medicines, ask a healthcare professional about the correct order of use.

Common side effects
Temporary blurred vision, mild stinging, irritation or redness may occur after use.

Precautions
Do not use if the product is discoloured or contaminated. Stop use and seek medical advice if eye pain, vision changes, worsening redness or irritation occurs, or if symptoms persist. Seek advice before use if there is an eye injury or infection.

title: Theto-Mb 2Ml (Bl) Amp ® (10X5X2Ml) Etofylline + Theophylline By Martin & Brown
name: Theto-Mb 2Ml (Bl) Amp ® (10X5X2Ml) Etofylline + Theophylline By Martin & Brown
searchText: Theto-Mb 2Ml (Bl) Amp ® (10X5X2Ml) Etofylline + Theophylline By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Etofylline + theophylline is a bronchodilator used to help prevent and relieve breathing difficulty, wheezing and chest tightness in conditions such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It is not usually intended for immediate relief of a sudden severe asthma attack unless specifically advised by a doctor.

How does it work?
It relaxes the muscles around the airways, helping to widen them and make breathing easier.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow oral forms with water and do not take more than the recommended amount. Do not stop regular treatment without medical advice. Avoid taking other theophylline-containing medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, headache, restlessness, difficulty sleeping, tremors and fast or irregular heartbeat may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision because theophylline levels can become too high and cause serious side effects. Tell the doctor about heart disease, high blood pressure, seizures, liver disease, fever, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and if smoking habits change. Limit excessive caffeine, as it may worsen side effects. Seek urgent medical help for severe vomiting, persistent or irregular heartbeat, seizures, or worsening breathing difficulty.

title: Theto-Mb 2Ml (Jali) Amp ® (50X2Ml) Etofylline + Theophylline By Martin & Brown
name: Theto-Mb 2Ml (Jali) Amp ® (50X2Ml) Etofylline + Theophylline By Martin & Brown
searchText: Theto-Mb 2Ml (Jali) Amp ® (50X2Ml) Etofylline + Theophylline By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Etofylline + theophylline is used to help relieve breathing difficulty, wheezing and tightness of the airways in conditions such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

How does it work?
It relaxes the muscles around the airways, helping them widen and making breathing easier.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed, at the same time each day if advised. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid taking extra doses for sudden breathing difficulty; use the quick-relief inhaler prescribed for such episodes.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, headache, restlessness, difficulty sleeping, tremors and fast or irregular heartbeat.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision, especially with heart disease, high blood pressure, seizures, thyroid problems, liver disease or stomach ulcers. Tell the doctor about all medicines being taken, as theophylline can interact with several medicines. Limit excessive caffeine, and seek medical help for severe vomiting, persistent palpitations, seizures or worsening breathing difficulty.

title: Tobracin-D E/E 10 Ml (24X10 Ml) Tobramycin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown
name: Tobracin-D E/E 10 Ml (24X10 Ml) Tobramycin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown
searchText: Tobracin-D E/E 10 Ml (24X10 Ml) Tobramycin + Dexamethasone By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for eye inflammation when a bacterial eye infection is present or likely, such as certain cases of bacterial conjunctivitis. It should be used only when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

How does it work?
Tobramycin is an antibiotic that fights susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces eye inflammation, redness and swelling.

How to take/use it
Use in the affected eye(s) exactly as prescribed and follow the product instructions. Wash hands before use and avoid touching the dropper or tube tip to the eye or other surfaces. Do not wear contact lenses unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Temporary stinging, irritation, itching, redness or blurred vision may occur after use. Prolonged use may increase pressure inside the eye or delay healing.

Precautions
Do not use for untreated viral or fungal eye infections unless specifically advised. Tell the prescriber about glaucoma, eye ulcers, recent eye surgery or other eye problems. Avoid prolonged or repeated use without medical supervision. Seek medical help for worsening pain, vision changes, severe swelling or an eye infection that does not improve.

title: Vomicon 2 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride 5Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Vomicon 2 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride 5Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Vomicon 2 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride 5Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Metoclopramide is used to relieve nausea and vomiting. It may also be prescribed for conditions where the stomach empties slowly, such as diabetic gastroparesis.

How does it work?
It blocks certain chemical signals in the brain that trigger nausea and vomiting. It also helps food move more quickly through the upper digestive system.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. Do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Avoid alcohol if it makes you sleepy or dizzy.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, tiredness, dizziness, restlessness, headache, diarrhoea and weakness.

Precautions
Use only under medical advice, usually for a short period, because prolonged or repeated use can cause involuntary movements. Seek medical help urgently for unusual muscle movements, muscle stiffness, severe restlessness or seizures. Tell the doctor before use if there is bowel blockage or bleeding, epilepsy, Parkinson’s disease, depression, or if taking medicines that cause drowsiness or affect movement.

title: Vomicon 2 Ml (Jali) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride 5Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Vomicon 2 Ml (Jali) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride 5Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Vomicon 2 Ml (Jali) Amp (10X5X2Ml) Metoclopramide Hydrochloride 5Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Metoclopramide is used to relieve nausea and vomiting. It may also be prescribed for certain conditions where the stomach empties slowly.

How does it work?
It blocks dopamine signals in the vomiting centre of the brain and helps food move more quickly through the upper digestive system.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and do not take more or use it for longer than advised. Swallow the tablet with water. Follow the prescribed timing and instructions carefully.

Common side effects
Sleepiness, tiredness, restlessness, headache and diarrhoea may occur.

Precautions
Avoid driving or operating machinery if sleepy or less alert, and avoid alcohol. Tell the doctor if there is bowel blockage or bleeding, epilepsy, Parkinson’s disease, depression, or kidney or liver problems. Use only as prescribed, as prolonged use can cause abnormal movements. Seek urgent medical help for uncontrollable movements, severe muscle stiffness, high fever or confusion.

title: Vomispas 1 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X1Ml) Diclofenac Sodium I.P 50Mg +Dicyclomine By Martin & Brown
name: Vomispas 1 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X1Ml) Diclofenac Sodium I.P 50Mg +Dicyclomine By Martin & Brown
searchText: Vomispas 1 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X1Ml) Diclofenac Sodium I.P 50Mg +Dicyclomine By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for short-term relief of painful abdominal cramps or colicky pain associated with muscle spasms. It may also be prescribed for other painful conditions involving spasms, as decided by a doctor.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces pain and inflammation. Dicyclomine relaxes spasms of the muscles in the intestine and other internal organs, helping relieve cramp-like pain.

How to take/use it
Take only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow with water and do not exceed the recommended amount. Taking it with or after food may help reduce stomach irritation. Do not take it with other diclofenac or NSAID painkillers unless advised.

Common side effects
Indigestion, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision or drowsiness.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney, liver or heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, or bowel blockage. Use during pregnancy, especially the last 3 months, only if prescribed. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe stomach pain, breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin reaction.

title: Vomitnorm Drops 30 Ml (30 Ml) Domperidone 1 Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Vomitnorm Drops 30 Ml (30 Ml) Domperidone 1 Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Vomitnorm Drops 30 Ml (30 Ml) Domperidone 1 Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Domperidone is used to relieve nausea and vomiting. It may also be used for symptoms related to slow movement of the stomach, when prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It blocks dopamine signals involved in nausea and vomiting and helps improve movement of food through the upper digestive system.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by a doctor or pharmacist, and do not take more than recommended. Follow the instructions on the product label or prescription, including when to take it in relation to meals.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, headache, stomach cramps, diarrhoea, and increased breast tenderness or milk production may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about heart rhythm problems, heart disease, liver disease, or a history of fainting. Domperidone can rarely cause serious abnormal heart rhythms and may interact with some antibiotics, antifungals, and other medicines. Seek urgent medical help for a fast or irregular heartbeat, fainting, or seizures. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only after medical advice.

title: Vovinac Ag 3 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X3Ml) Diclofenac Sodium 25 Mg/1Ml By Martin & Brown
name: Vovinac Ag 3 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X3Ml) Diclofenac Sodium 25 Mg/1Ml By Martin & Brown
searchText: Vovinac Ag 3 Ml (Bl) Amp (10X5X3Ml) Diclofenac Sodium 25 Mg/1Ml By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Diclofenac injection is used for short-term relief of moderate to severe pain and inflammation, including pain affecting the muscles, joints and bones.

How does it work?
It reduces the production of substances called prostaglandins that cause pain, swelling and inflammation.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by a healthcare professional, usually by injection. Do not self-inject. The dose, route and duration depend on the medical condition and must be decided by the prescriber.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and pain or irritation at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of stomach ulcers or bleeding, asthma triggered by painkillers, heart disease, high blood pressure, kidney or liver problems. Diclofenac may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and cardiovascular problems. Avoid taking it with other NSAID painkillers unless advised by a doctor. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, especially after 20 weeks and in the last trimester. Seek urgent medical help for black stools, vomiting blood, severe allergic symptoms, chest pain or breathing difficulty.

title: Z-Drox Syrup 100 Ml (100 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
name: Z-Drox Syrup 100 Ml (100 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Z-Drox Syrup 100 Ml (100 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to relieve a dry cough along with cold or allergy symptoms such as a runny nose and sneezing.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the cough reflex in the brain. Chlorpheniramine is an antihistamine that helps relieve runny nose and sneezing.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the package or by a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than recommended, and use a measuring device if it is a liquid. Avoid taking other cough, cold or allergy medicines at the same time unless advised.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and constipation may occur.

Precautions
Avoid alcohol and be careful when driving or operating machinery, as this medicine may cause drowsiness. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitors or within 14 days of stopping them; check with a doctor or pharmacist before use with antidepressants or other medicines that cause drowsiness. Seek advice before use if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, breathing problems, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Do not give to children unless the product is appropriate for their age and a healthcare professional confirms its use. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty or a persistent or worsening cough.

title: Z-Drox Syrup 60 Ml (60 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
name: Z-Drox Syrup 60 Ml (60 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown
searchText: Z-Drox Syrup 60 Ml (60 Ml) Dextromethorphan Hbr+Chlorpheniramine Maleate By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used for temporary relief of cough, especially dry cough, along with cold or allergy symptoms such as a runny nose and sneezing.

How does it work?
Dextromethorphan reduces the urge to cough. Chlorpheniramine is an antihistamine that helps relieve allergy-related symptoms such as a runny nose and sneezing.

How to take/use it
Take or use exactly as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount. Avoid taking it with other cough-and-cold medicines unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Common side effects
Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea and constipation may occur.

Precautions
This medicine may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase drowsiness. Do not use with monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) medicines or within 14 days of stopping them. Seek medical advice before use if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, breathing problems, liver disease, or if taking antidepressants or other medicines that cause drowsiness. Seek medical help for a severe or persistent cough, breathing difficulty, or allergic reaction.

title: Zecort-D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Gentamicin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown
name: Zecort-D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Gentamicin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zecort-D E/E 10 Ml (25X10 Ml) Gentamicin + Dexamethasone Sod. By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is generally used in eye or ear preparations to treat bacterial infections accompanied by redness, swelling or inflammation. The exact use depends on the product formulation and prescribed route.

How does it work?
Gentamicin is an antibiotic that kills susceptible bacteria. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation, redness and swelling.

How to take/use it
Use only in the eye or ear, and only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not use it by mouth or inject it. Do not touch the dropper tip to the eye, ear or other surfaces.

Common side effects
Temporary burning, stinging, irritation, itching or discomfort may occur. Eye preparations may briefly cause blurred vision.

Precautions
Do not use for unexplained redness or irritation without medical advice, as corticosteroids can worsen some viral or fungal infections and may delay healing. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, vision changes, severe pain or hearing problems develop. Do not use in an ear with a perforated eardrum unless specifically advised. Prolonged eye use may increase eye pressure and requires medical monitoring.

title: Zede (M.C.) 30 Ml (30 Ml) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 5.0Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Zede (M.C.) 30 Ml (30 Ml) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 5.0Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zede (M.C.) 30 Ml (30 Ml) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 5.0Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or itchy nose, itchy or watery eyes, and skin itching or hives.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as directed on the label or by a doctor. It may be taken with or without food. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, and dizziness.

Precautions
Cetirizine may cause drowsiness, which can be increased by alcohol or sedative medicines. Consult a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Seek urgent medical help for swelling of the face or throat, breathing difficulty, or a severe allergic reaction.

title: Zede (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 5.0Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Zede (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 5.0Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zede (M.Cap) 60 Ml (60 Ml) Cetirizine Dihydrochloride 5.0Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cetirizine is used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching. It is also used to relieve hives (urticaria) and related skin itching.

How does it work?
It is an antihistamine that blocks the action of histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This helps reduce allergy symptoms and itching.

How to take/use it
Take by mouth exactly as directed on the package or by a doctor. It may be taken with or without food. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Sleepiness or drowsiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, or dizziness.

Precautions
Cetirizine may cause drowsiness in some people; avoid driving or operating machinery until its effects are known. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase drowsiness. Consult a doctor before use if there is kidney disease, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Seek medical help for signs of a severe allergic reaction, such as swelling of the face or throat or difficulty breathing.

title: Zednorm Tab (30X10) Ranitidine Hydro 150Mg +Domperidone 10Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Zednorm Tab (30X10) Ranitidine Hydro 150Mg +Domperidone 10Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zednorm Tab (30X10) Ranitidine Hydro 150Mg +Domperidone 10Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This combination is used to reduce excess stomach acid and relieve acidity, heartburn, acid reflux and indigestion, especially when these symptoms are associated with nausea or vomiting.

How does it work?
Ranitidine reduces the production of stomach acid. Domperidone helps stomach contents move forward and helps control nausea and vomiting.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed or as directed on the pack. Swallow the tablet whole with water and follow the recommended timing. Do not take more than advised or use it for a longer period without medical guidance.

Common side effects
Headache, dizziness, dry mouth, stomach cramps, diarrhoea or constipation may occur. Domperidone can rarely cause a fast or irregular heartbeat.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is a history of heart disease, irregular heartbeat, liver or kidney problems, or bleeding or blockage in the stomach or intestine. Inform the doctor about all medicines being taken, especially medicines that can affect heart rhythm. Seek urgent medical help for fainting, severe dizziness, or a fast or irregular heartbeat. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding only on medical advice.

title: Zee-Peptin 60 Ml (60 Ml) Alpha Amylase + Papain By Martin & Brown
name: Zee-Peptin 60 Ml (60 Ml) Alpha Amylase + Papain By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zee-Peptin 60 Ml (60 Ml) Alpha Amylase + Papain By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Alpha amylase and papain are digestive enzymes used to support the digestion of carbohydrates and proteins. They may help relieve digestive discomfort such as indigestion, fullness or bloating when related to difficulty digesting food.

How does it work?
Alpha amylase helps break down starches and other carbohydrates. Papain helps break down proteins, supporting the normal digestive process.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Take with water and follow any instructions about taking it with meals.

Common side effects
Stomach discomfort, nausea, diarrhoea or constipation may occur. Allergic reactions are possible.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to papaya, papain, alpha amylase or any ingredient in the product. Stop use and seek medical help if swelling, breathing difficulty or a severe rash occurs. Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if symptoms are persistent or severe.

title: Zee-Peptin Drops 15 Ml (15 Ml) Alfa- Amylase,Dill Oil, Caraway Oil , Anise Oil By Martin & Brown
name: Zee-Peptin Drops 15 Ml (15 Ml) Alfa- Amylase,Dill Oil, Caraway Oil , Anise Oil By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zee-Peptin Drops 15 Ml (15 Ml) Alfa- Amylase,Dill Oil, Caraway Oil , Anise Oil By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used as a digestive aid to help relieve indigestion, bloating and gas associated with digestion.

How does it work?
Alpha-amylase helps break down starches into smaller sugars. Dill, caraway and anise oils act as carminatives, which may help reduce intestinal gas and digestive discomfort.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed on the product label or by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended amount.

Common side effects
Stomach upset, nausea, heartburn or loose motions may occur. Allergic reactions are possible.

Precautions
Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Stop use and seek medical help if signs of an allergic reaction occur, such as rash, swelling or breathing difficulty. Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms are severe, persistent or recurrent, or before use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in young children.

title: Zenspas Tab (20X10) Ranitidine 150Mg+ Dicyclomine 10Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Zenspas Tab (20X10) Ranitidine 150Mg+ Dicyclomine 10Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zenspas Tab (20X10) Ranitidine 150Mg+ Dicyclomine 10Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Used to reduce excess stomach acid and relieve acidity, heartburn and indigestion associated with stomach or intestinal cramps.

How does it work?
Ranitidine reduces the production of stomach acid. Dicyclomine relaxes the muscles of the intestine, helping to relieve abdominal cramps and spasms.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed by the doctor. Swallow the tablet with water and do not take more or use it for longer than recommended.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, dizziness, blurred vision, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea and headache.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine, prostate enlargement, myasthenia gravis, or kidney or liver disease. Dicyclomine may cause blurred vision or dizziness; avoid driving if affected. Seek medical help for severe or persistent abdominal pain, black stools, vomiting blood or an allergic reaction.

title: Zindac-150 Tab (30X10) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 150Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Zindac-150 Tab (30X10) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 150Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zindac-150 Tab (30X10) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 150Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine is used to reduce excess stomach acid and relieve acidity, heartburn and acid reflux. It may also be prescribed for stomach or intestinal ulcers and other acid-related digestive conditions.

How does it work?
It blocks H2 receptors in the stomach, reducing the production of stomach acid.

How to take/use it
Take it only as directed by a doctor or according to the product label. Swallow with water and do not take more or for longer than recommended. Check with a pharmacist before using it, as ranitidine availability and use may be restricted in some countries because of safety concerns.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney or liver disease, a history of stomach ulcers, or difficulty swallowing. Seek medical advice for persistent or severe symptoms, vomiting blood, black stools, unexplained weight loss or severe abdominal pain. Seek urgent help for swelling, breathing difficulty or a severe allergic reaction.

title: Zindac-300 Tab (20X10) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 300Mg By Martin & Brown
name: Zindac-300 Tab (20X10) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 300Mg By Martin & Brown
searchText: Zindac-300 Tab (20X10) Ranitidine Hydrochloride 300Mg By Martin & Brown Martin & Brown
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ranitidine reduces excess stomach acid. It has been used to relieve heartburn and acid reflux, and to treat stomach or duodenal ulcers and other acid-related conditions.

How does it work?
It blocks histamine H2 receptors in the stomach, reducing the production of stomach acid.

How to take/use it
Take it only as prescribed or directed on the product label. Swallow the tablet with water and do not take more or use it for longer than recommended. Ranitidine products have been withdrawn or restricted in many countries; confirm with a doctor or pharmacist that this product is appropriate before use.

Common side effects
Headache, nausea, stomach discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea, and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney or liver disease, a history of porphyria, or other medicines being taken. Seek medical advice for persistent or worsening symptoms, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, unexplained weight loss, or severe stomach pain. Avoid self-treating recurring acidity without medical advice.

title: Acyclotech 250 (10 Ml) Acyclovir 250 Mg By Protech
name: Acyclotech 250 (10 Ml) Acyclovir 250 Mg By Protech
searchText: Acyclotech 250 (10 Ml) Acyclovir 250 Mg By Protech Protech ACYCLOTECH250
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Acyclovir is an antiviral medicine used to treat herpes virus infections, including serious herpes simplex infections and chickenpox or shingles caused by the varicella-zoster virus.

How does it work?
It blocks the ability of the herpes virus to multiply, helping control the infection and reduce its severity.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of the infection and kidney function. Do not stop treatment early without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness, tiredness, and irritation or pain at the administration site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney problems, dehydration, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or any other medicines being used. Drink adequate fluids unless a doctor has advised fluid restriction. Seek medical help for reduced urination, confusion, tremors, seizures, or a severe allergic reaction.

title: Acyclotech 500 Mg (10 Ml) Acyclovir 500 Mg By Protech
name: Acyclotech 500 Mg (10 Ml) Acyclovir 500 Mg By Protech
searchText: Acyclotech 500 Mg (10 Ml) Acyclovir 500 Mg By Protech Protech ACYCLOTECH500MG
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Acyclovir is used to treat herpes virus infections, including genital herpes, cold sores, shingles and chickenpox. It can reduce the severity and duration of symptoms but does not remove the virus from the body.

How does it work?
It blocks the ability of herpes viruses to make their genetic material, which slows the growth and spread of the virus.

How to take/use it
Use it only as prescribed and follow the instructions on the label. The dose, frequency, duration and route depend on the infection and the formulation. Drink plenty of fluids unless a doctor has advised otherwise, and complete the prescribed course.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, dizziness and tiredness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is kidney disease, dehydration, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or a weakened immune system. Dose adjustment may be needed in kidney disease. Seek medical help for severe allergic reactions, confusion, seizures, very little urine or unusual bruising.

title: Adrapro-1Ml (1 Ml) Adrenaline Bitartrate By Protech
name: Adrapro-1Ml (1 Ml) Adrenaline Bitartrate By Protech
searchText: Adrapro-1Ml (1 Ml) Adrenaline Bitartrate By Protech Protech ADRAPRO1ML
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Adrenaline is an emergency medicine used to treat severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) and, in hospital settings, cardiac arrest and other serious breathing or circulation problems. Its exact use depends on the prescribed product and medical condition.

How does it work?
It quickly stimulates the heart and blood vessels, helping improve blood pressure and blood flow. It also relaxes the airways and reduces swelling during a severe allergic reaction.

How to take/use it
Use only as directed by a doctor or trained healthcare professional. The dose, route and timing depend on the emergency and the product. Emergency medical care is required after use for a severe allergic reaction.

Common side effects
Fast or pounding heartbeat, shaking, anxiety or restlessness, headache, sweating, dizziness, nausea and vomiting.

Precautions
Use under medical supervision, especially in people with heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid problems or diabetes. Seek urgent medical help for chest pain, severe headache, fainting, irregular heartbeat or worsening breathing difficulty.

title: Ampitech-1000 Mg (10 Ml) Ampicillin 1 G By Protech
name: Ampitech-1000 Mg (10 Ml) Ampicillin 1 G By Protech
searchText: Ampitech-1000 Mg (10 Ml) Ampicillin 1 G By Protech Protech AMPITECH1000MG
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ampicillin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from building their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. Take or receive the medicine exactly as directed and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. The dose and route depend on the type and severity of the infection.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and skin rash may occur.

Precautions
Do not use it if there has been a serious allergy to ampicillin, penicillin or related antibiotics. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe rash. Contact a doctor for severe or persistent diarrhoea, especially during or after treatment. Tell the doctor about kidney problems and any other medicines being used.

title: Ampitech-500 Mg (20 Ml) Ampicillin 500 Mg By Protech
name: Ampitech-500 Mg (20 Ml) Ampicillin 500 Mg By Protech
searchText: Ampitech-500 Mg (20 Ml) Ampicillin 500 Mg By Protech Protech AMPITECH500MG
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Ampicillin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by interfering with the formation of their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed by the doctor and complete the prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Take each dose with water and follow the product label or medical advice regarding food. Do not take an extra dose if one is missed without medical advice.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and skin rash.

Precautions
Do not use it if there has been a previous serious allergy to ampicillin, penicillin or related antibiotics. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, or a severe rash. Contact a doctor if diarrhoea is severe, persistent or bloody. Use only on medical advice, especially during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in people with kidney problems.

title: Artipro 120Mg (10 Ml) Artesunate 120 Mg By Protech
name: Artipro 120Mg (10 Ml) Artesunate 120 Mg By Protech
searchText: Artipro 120Mg (10 Ml) Artesunate 120 Mg By Protech Protech ARTIPRO120MG
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Artesunate is an antimalarial medicine used mainly to treat severe malaria. It may also be used as part of a prescribed treatment regimen for malaria.

How does it work?
It damages malaria parasites in the blood, helping to clear the infection.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. The route and schedule depend on the formulation and severity of malaria; injectable artesunate must be given by a healthcare professional. Complete the full antimalarial treatment as directed.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, stomach discomfort and tiredness may occur.

Precautions
Malaria, especially severe malaria, requires urgent medical care. Seek medical attention for allergic symptoms, unusual tiredness, pale skin, dark urine, yellowing of the eyes or skin, or worsening symptoms, as delayed anaemia and other serious reactions can occur. Inform the doctor about pregnancy, breastfeeding, liver problems or any previous reaction to antimalarial medicines.

title: Artipro 60Mg (5 Ml) Artesunate 60 Mg By Protech
name: Artipro 60Mg (5 Ml) Artesunate 60 Mg By Protech
searchText: Artipro 60Mg (5 Ml) Artesunate 60 Mg By Protech Protech ARTIPRO60MG
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Artesunate is used to treat malaria, especially severe malaria that may require hospital treatment. It is usually followed by a complete course of another antimalarial medicine as prescribed.

How does it work?
It rapidly kills malaria-causing parasites in the blood, helping to reduce the infection and its symptoms.

How to take/use it
This medicine is usually given by injection by a trained healthcare professional. The dose, route and treatment schedule depend on the severity of malaria and must be decided by a doctor. Complete the recommended follow-up antimalarial treatment.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, headache, dizziness, fever and pain or reactions at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Use only under medical supervision. Seek urgent medical help for difficulty breathing, swelling, severe rash, fainting, unusual weakness, pale skin, dark urine or yellowing of the eyes or skin. Blood tests may be needed after treatment because delayed breakdown of red blood cells can rarely occur.

title: Atrabid 2.5Ml (1X4) Atracurium Besylate 25 Mg/2.5 Ml Inj By Protech
name: Atrabid 2.5Ml (1X4) Atracurium Besylate 25 Mg/2.5 Ml Inj By Protech
searchText: Atrabid 2.5Ml (1X4) Atracurium Besylate 25 Mg/2.5 Ml Inj By Protech Protech ATRABID25ML
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Atracurium injection is used during general anaesthesia to relax the muscles and help doctors place a breathing tube during surgery. It may also be used to help control muscle movement while a patient is receiving mechanical ventilation. It does not cause unconsciousness or relieve pain by itself.

How does it work?
It temporarily blocks nerve signals to the muscles, including the muscles used for movement and breathing. The effect wears off after the medicine is stopped and the body breaks it down.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given into a vein only by trained healthcare professionals in a hospital. Breathing support and careful monitoring are required because it temporarily weakens or stops the breathing muscles. The dose and timing are decided by the anaesthetist.

Common side effects
Flushing, low blood pressure, fast heartbeat, wheezing or bronchospasm, skin rash and temporary muscle weakness may occur.

Precautions
It must not be self-administered. Tell the anaesthetist about any previous reaction to muscle-relaxing medicines, asthma or breathing problems, heart or blood-pressure problems, or neuromuscular disorders. Seek immediate medical attention for severe breathing difficulty, swelling, widespread rash or other signs of a serious allergic reaction.

title: Atropro 1 Ml (1 Ml) Atropine 0.6 Mg/Ml By Protech
name: Atropro 1 Ml (1 Ml) Atropine 0.6 Mg/Ml By Protech
searchText: Atropro 1 Ml (1 Ml) Atropine 0.6 Mg/Ml By Protech Protech ATROPRO1ML
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Atropine 0.6 mg/ml injection is used by healthcare professionals in emergencies to treat a dangerously slow heartbeat. It may also be used to reduce excessive secretions before procedures and as part of treatment for certain poisonings, such as organophosphate poisoning.

How does it work?
It blocks the action of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine. This can increase the heart rate and reduce saliva, airway and other secretions.

How to take/use it
This injection must be given by a doctor or nurse. The dose, route and frequency depend on the condition being treated and the patient's response. It should not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, blurred vision, enlarged pupils, sensitivity to light, flushing, fast heartbeat, constipation, difficulty passing urine and dizziness may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor if there is glaucoma, prostate enlargement, difficulty passing urine, bowel blockage, heart disease or high fever. Seek urgent medical help for severe palpitations, confusion, extreme agitation, breathing difficulty or inability to pass urine.

title: Azipro 500 (20 Ml) Azithromycin 500 Mg By Protech
name: Azipro 500 (20 Ml) Azithromycin 500 Mg By Protech
searchText: Azipro 500 (20 Ml) Azithromycin 500 Mg By Protech Protech AZIPRO500
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Azithromycin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some infections of the chest, throat, ears, skin and reproductive system. It does not work against viral infections such as common colds or flu.

How does it work?
It stops susceptible bacteria from making proteins needed for their growth and survival.

How to take/use it
Take it exactly as prescribed and complete the full course, even if symptoms improve. It may be taken with or without food unless the prescriber advises otherwise. Do not share leftover antibiotics or use them for a future illness.

Common side effects
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain, vomiting and headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about an allergy to azithromycin or other macrolide antibiotics, liver disease, heart rhythm problems or a history of prolonged QT interval. Tell the doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines being taken. Seek urgent medical help for severe or persistent diarrhoea, facial or throat swelling, difficulty breathing, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or a fast or irregular heartbeat.

title: Azotech 1000 (Vial) Aztreonam 1000 Mg By Protech
name: Azotech 1000 (Vial) Aztreonam 1000 Mg By Protech
searchText: Azotech 1000 (Vial) Aztreonam 1000 Mg By Protech Protech AZOTECH1000
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Aztreonam injection is an antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by certain Gram-negative bacteria, including some infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, skin, blood and reproductive organs. It does not treat viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment length depend on the type and severity of infection and kidney function. Use it only as prescribed.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; diarrhoea; nausea or vomiting; rash; headache; and changes in liver tests.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any previous allergy to aztreonam or other antibiotics, kidney or liver problems, or a history of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea. Seek urgent medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, or severe or persistent diarrhoea. Do not use it for viral infections.

title: Azotech 250 (Vial) Aztreonam 250 Mg By Protech
name: Azotech 250 (Vial) Aztreonam 250 Mg By Protech
searchText: Azotech 250 (Vial) Aztreonam 250 Mg By Protech Protech AZOTECH250
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Aztreonam is an antibiotic used to treat certain serious bacterial infections, especially infections caused by susceptible Gram-negative bacteria. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall, which stops the infection from spreading.

How to take/use it
Aztreonam is usually given by injection by a healthcare professional. Use it only as prescribed, and complete the recommended treatment even if symptoms improve. Do not self-administer unless specifically trained to do so.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash and headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any previous allergy to aztreonam, penicillin, cephalosporins or other antibiotics. Inform the doctor if there is kidney or liver disease. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, or severe or persistent diarrhoea, as these may indicate a serious reaction.

title: Azotech 2Gm (20 Ml) Aztreonam 2 G By Protech
name: Azotech 2Gm (20 Ml) Aztreonam 2 G By Protech
searchText: Azotech 2Gm (20 Ml) Aztreonam 2 G By Protech Protech AZOTECH2GM
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Aztreonam is an injectable antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by susceptible Gram-negative bacteria. It may be used for infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, skin and soft tissues, reproductive organs, or bloodstream, as prescribed by a doctor.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by preventing them from forming a protective cell wall. It does not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

How to take/use it
Aztreonam is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function, and medical advice. Complete the prescribed course unless the doctor advises otherwise.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; diarrhoea; nausea or vomiting; rash; and headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any previous allergy to aztreonam, other beta-lactam antibiotics, or severe medicine allergies. Dose adjustment may be needed in kidney problems. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling, severe rash, or severe or persistent diarrhoea, including diarrhoea that occurs after treatment.

title: Azotech 500 (Vial) Aztreonam 500 Mg By Protech
name: Azotech 500 (Vial) Aztreonam 500 Mg By Protech
searchText: Azotech 500 (Vial) Aztreonam 500 Mg By Protech Protech AZOTECH500
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Aztreonam 500 mg is an injectable antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by certain bacteria, especially Gram-negative bacteria. It may be used for infections of the lungs, urinary tract, abdomen, skin, blood or reproductive organs, as determined by the doctor.

How does it work?
It kills susceptible bacteria by blocking the formation of their protective cell wall.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection into a vein or muscle by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration depend on the type and severity of infection, kidney function and medical advice. Do not self-inject or stop treatment early.

Common side effects
Pain, redness or swelling at the injection site; diarrhoea; nausea or vomiting; skin rash; and headache.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about any previous allergy to aztreonam or other antibiotics, and about kidney or liver problems. Seek medical help for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe rash. Contact a doctor if severe or persistent diarrhoea develops during or after treatment, as this may indicate a serious intestinal infection.

title: Betavis-1Ml (1 Ml) Betamethasone 4 Mg By Protech
name: Betavis-1Ml (1 Ml) Betamethasone 4 Mg By Protech
searchText: Betavis-1Ml (1 Ml) Betamethasone 4 Mg By Protech Protech BETAVIS1ML
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Betamethasone is a corticosteroid used on prescription to reduce inflammation and control overactive allergic or immune reactions. The exact condition it treats depends on the prescribed formulation and the doctor's diagnosis.

How does it work?
It reduces the release of substances that cause inflammation and suppresses excessive immune responses.

How to take/use it
Use it only as prescribed. The dose, route and treatment duration depend on the formulation and condition being treated. Do not change the dose or stop prolonged treatment suddenly without medical advice.

Common side effects
Possible side effects include indigestion, increased appetite, difficulty sleeping, mood changes, fluid retention, and increases in blood sugar or blood pressure.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about diabetes, high blood pressure, stomach ulcers, osteoporosis, glaucoma, mental health conditions, or any infection. Corticosteroids can reduce resistance to infection and may mask infection symptoms. Seek medical advice for signs of infection, severe mood changes, vision problems, or serious allergic reactions.

title: Betrapro-2Ml (1X4) Alpha-Beta Arteether By Protech
name: Betrapro-2Ml (1X4) Alpha-Beta Arteether By Protech
searchText: Betrapro-2Ml (1X4) Alpha-Beta Arteether By Protech Protech BETRAPRO2ML
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Alpha-Beta Arteether is an antimalarial injection used to treat malaria, especially severe or complicated malaria caused by Plasmodium parasites.

How does it work?
It forms active compounds that damage the malaria parasite and help clear it from the blood.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given by injection by a doctor or other healthcare professional. The dose and treatment schedule depend on the severity of malaria and must be decided by the prescriber. Do not self-administer it.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, headache and pain at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Inform the doctor about any allergy to arteether or other artemisinin medicines, pregnancy, or liver, kidney or heart problems. Malaria can become serious quickly; seek urgent medical care for worsening fever, confusion, breathing difficulty, seizures or extreme weakness. Complete the prescribed treatment and do not stop it without medical advice.

title: Bontech 1 Ml (1 Ml) Cholecalciferol 600000 Iu By Protech
name: Bontech 1 Ml (1 Ml) Cholecalciferol 600000 Iu By Protech
searchText: Bontech 1 Ml (1 Ml) Cholecalciferol 600000 Iu By Protech Protech BONTECH1ML
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) is used to prevent or treat vitamin D deficiency and support healthy bones and muscles. It may be prescribed when vitamin D levels are low or when the body needs extra vitamin D.

How does it work?
It helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from food, supporting bone mineralisation and normal muscle function.

How to take/use it
Use only in the dose and by the route prescribed by a doctor. This is a high-strength vitamin D product; do not repeat the dose or take other vitamin D supplements unless advised. The correct schedule depends on the patient's vitamin D level and treatment plan.

Common side effects
Usually well tolerated when used as prescribed. Excessive vitamin D can cause nausea, vomiting, constipation, stomach pain, increased thirst or frequent urination.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about kidney disease, kidney stones, high calcium levels, or disorders that cause excess calcium. Avoid taking additional vitamin D or calcium products without medical advice. Seek medical help if severe nausea, vomiting, confusion, unusual weakness or excessive thirst occurs.

title: Brotech-60 (Vial) Cerebroprotein 60 Mg By Protech
name: Brotech-60 (Vial) Cerebroprotein 60 Mg By Protech
searchText: Brotech-60 (Vial) Cerebroprotein 60 Mg By Protech Protech BROTECH60
bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Cerebroprotein is used under medical supervision for certain neurological conditions, such as recovery support after stroke or brain injury and some disorders affecting memory or thinking. The exact use depends on the diagnosis and the prescribing doctor's advice.

How does it work?
It contains small protein fragments and amino acids that may support nerve-cell function and recovery in the brain. Its exact benefits can vary depending on the neurological condition.

How to take/use it

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
This injection is generally used for short-term relief of painful abdominal cramps, spasms and colicky pain.

How does it work?
Diclofenac reduces pain and inflammation. Dicyclomine relaxes spasms in the muscles of the stomach and intestines, helping relieve cramp-like pain.

How to take/use it
This injection should be given only by a healthcare professional. Do not self-inject. The dose and duration should be decided by the prescriber.

Common side effects
Nausea, indigestion, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea or constipation, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision and pain at the injection site may occur.

Precautions
Tell the doctor about stomach ulcers or bleeding, kidney or liver disease, heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma triggered by painkillers, glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or bowel blockage. Avoid use if allergic to diclofenac, dicyclomine or similar medicines. Diclofenac may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and is generally avoided during late pregnancy unless specifically prescribed. Seek medical help for severe stomach pain, black stools, vomiting blood, breathing difficulty or facial swelling.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dicyclomine is used to relieve stomach and intestinal cramps or spasms, including symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome.

How does it work?
It relaxes the muscles of the stomach and intestines by reducing abnormal muscle spasms, helping to relieve cramping and pain.

How to take/use it
Use only as prescribed by a doctor. If supplied as an injection, it should be administered by a healthcare professional. Do not self-inject or use more than prescribed.

Common side effects
Dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness, blurred vision, nausea, constipation and difficulty passing urine.

Precautions
Use with medical advice if there is glaucoma, difficulty passing urine or prostate enlargement, bowel blockage, severe ulcerative colitis, myasthenia gravis, or liver or kidney problems. Avoid driving or operating machinery if dizzy or drowsy. Seek medical help for severe confusion, a fast heartbeat, inability to urinate, breathing difficulty or swelling of the face or throat.

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dobutamine injection is used in hospitals for short-term treatment of severe heart failure, low blood flow from the heart, or cardiogenic shock. It helps the heart pump more strongly when urgent circulatory support is needed.

How does it work?
Dobutamine stimulates receptors in the heart, increasing the strength of heart contractions and improving blood flow. It may also affect heart rate and blood pressure.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given into a vein as a controlled infusion by a doctor or nurse. The dose and treatment duration are decided by the doctor based on the condition. Heart rhythm, blood pressure and other vital signs require close monitoring during treatment.

Common side effects
Increased heart rate, palpitations, abnormal heart rhythms, changes in blood pressure, headache, nausea and chest discomfort may occur.

Precautions
Use only under close medical supervision. Tell the doctor about heart rhythm problems, high blood pressure, reduced blood volume, or allergies to medicines. Seek urgent medical attention for severe chest pain, fainting, difficulty breathing or a fast or irregular heartbeat.

title: Dopatech 200 (5X5 Ml) Dopamine 200 Mg/5 Ml By Protech

bodyHtml:
What is it used for?
Dopamine injection is used in hospitals to support blood pressure and heart function in severe low blood pressure, shock, or reduced blood flow to vital organs. It is given in emergency and critical-care situations under close medical supervision.

How does it work?
It stimulates specific receptors in the heart and blood vessels. This can increase the force of the heartbeat and help raise blood pressure and blood flow.

How to take/use it
This medicine is given only by intravenous infusion by a doctor or trained healthcare professional, usually after dilution and with continuous monitoring. The dose and infusion rate are adjusted according to the patient’s condition. It must not be self-administered.

Common side effects
Nausea, vomiting, headache, fast heartbeat, palpitations, irregular heartbeat, increased blood pressure and chest discomfort. Pain or tissue damage can occur if the medicine leaks outside the vein.

Precautions
Use only in a hospital or emergency-care setting. Blood pressure, heart rate, heart rhythm and the infusion site require close monitoring. Tell the doctor about heart rhythm problems, poor circulation, thyroid disease, or use of monoamine oxidase inhibitor medicines. Seek immediate medical attention for severe chest pain, breathing difficulty, or a markedly irregular heartbeat.

title: Doritech-500 (Vial) Doripenem 500 Mg By Protech
